title: Composite carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a composite carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of (1) providing a spray head, wherein the spray head comprises an inner channel and an outer channel, the outer channel is arranged around the periphery of the inner channel, a polyacrylonitrile solution is introduced into the outer channel, a mixed solution comprising polyacrylonitrile and mesophase pitch is introduced into the inner channel for spinning, a core layer comprising polyacrylonitrile and mesophase pitch is obtained, a sheath layer comprising primary fibers of polyacrylonitrile is obtained, (2) the primary fibers are sequentially subjected to boiling water drafting, water washing, oiling, drying densification and steam drafting, and precursor fibers with a sheath-core structure are obtained, and (3) the precursor fibers are sequentially subjected to pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization, so that the composite carbon fiber is obtained. The method can be used for preparing the composite carbon fiber with small radial graphitization difference, and the composite carbon fiber has excellent tensile strength and tensile modulus at a lower graphitization temperature.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Composite carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application discloses a composite carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Providing a spray head, wherein the spray head comprises an inner channel and an outer channel, the outer channel is arranged around the periphery of the inner channel, a polyacrylonitrile solution is introduced into the outer channel, a mixed solution comprising polyacrylonitrile and mesophase pitch is introduced into the inner channel for spinning, a core layer comprising polyacrylonitrile and mesophase pitch is obtained, and a skin layer comprising nascent fibers of polyacrylonitrile is obtained; (2) Sequentially carrying out boiling water drafting, water washing, oiling, drying densification and steam drafting on the nascent fiber to obtain a precursor fiber with a sheath-core structure; (3) And (3) sequentially performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization on the precursor fiber to obtain the composite carbon fiber. The method can be used for preparing the composite carbon fiber with small radial graphitization difference, and the composite carbon fiber has excellent tensile strength and tensile modulus at a lower graphitization temperature.

title: High-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with regular surface cross-section structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with a regular surface cross-section structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) polymerizing acrylonitrile and itaconic acid or acrylonitrile and itaconic acid and methyl acrylate to obtain a polymer spinning solution; (2) sequentially solidifying, steam drafting, washing, oiling, drying, superheated steam drafting and heat setting the polymer spinning solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile protofilaments; (3) carrying out preoxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain carbon fiber, wherein in the step (2), the solidification process adopts three-level gradient solidification: the concentration of the first coagulation bath is 65-80 wt%, the temperature is 30-65 ℃, the coagulation draft multiple is 0.5-1.0 time, the concentration of the second coagulation bath is 35-50 wt%, and the concentration of the third coagulation bath is 5-10 wt%. The method can be used for obtaining the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with a circular section and an oriented surface groove structure, wherein the linear density of the carbon fiber is 225-235 g/km (6K), 435-447 g/km (12K), the tensile strength is 4.4-5.0 GPa, the tensile modulus is 350-400 GPa, and the bulk density is 1.77-1.79g/cm 3 。
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: A kind of preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-radical high-strength high-modules carbon fibre
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of polyacrylonitrile-radical high-strength high-modules carbon fibre preparation methods.By polyacrylonitrile (PAN) precursor after conventional pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, by improving high temperature cabonization temperature and matching certain stretching, or by promoting high temperature cabonization stretching ratio, carbon crystallite orientation can effectively be controlled, obtain the high temperature cabonization fiber that the angle of orientation is not more than 17.5 °, then high temperature graphitization hot-stretch processing is carried out at a temperature of relatively low high temperature graphitization, and the carbon fiber with high-strength and high-modulus feature of 3.8~5.0GPa of tensile strength, 500~600GPa of stretch modulus has been prepared.The preparation method of the present invention reduces requirement of the high temperature graphitization to equipment, is conducive to energy-saving and reduces cost, and operation is simple.

title: Dry-jet wet-spinning ultra-high performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application relates to a dry-jet wet-spinning ultra-high performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fibers. A preparation method of dry-jet wet-spinning ultra-high performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the steps of S1, mixing acrylonitrile, a comonomer, a chain transfer agent, an initiator and a solvent, carrying out polymerization reaction through a solvent dripping method, and preparing spinning stock solution, wherein the comonomer comprises a first comonomer, a second comonomer and a third comonomer, S2, solidifying, washing, water drawing, oiling, drying and steaming the spinning stock solution to obtain a precursor fiber, and S3, sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization, graphitization, surface treatment, sizing and drying on the precursor fiber to obtain the ultra-high performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the pre-oxidation adopts four-stage pre-oxidation treatment. The strength and the modulus of the carbon fiber can be effectively and synergistically optimized, and the carbon fiber with high strength and high modulus can be prepared.

title: High-strength middle-mode, high-strength high-mode carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength medium-mode, high-strength high-mode carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of adding polyacrylonitrile, 2,4, 6-triaminopyrimidine and barbituric acid into an organic solvent according to raw material proportion to prepare a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution; the method comprises the steps of preparing a primary fiber from a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution through a wet spinning process or a dry-wet spinning process after defoaming and filtering, then preparing a polyacrylonitrile precursor gradually through the steps of washing, drafting, oiling, drying densification and steam drafting, and carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor through a multi-stage pre-oxidation process, and then carrying out carbonization process or graphitization process treatment to obtain the high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber and the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber respectively. The invention can reduce the carbonization or graphitization temperature required by production and can simultaneously realize the aims of high modulus and high strength of the carbon fiber.

title: Continuous preparation process of high-strength carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The application provides a continuous preparation process of high-strength carbon fiber precursor, which realizes accurate control of the proportion of copolymerization components by monitoring multidimensional parameters in the polymerization reaction process in real time, establishing a molecular weight distribution prediction model and carrying out self-adaptive regulation. On the basis, the application constructs a fiber pore structure distribution model, optimizes spinning process parameters, monitors the pre-oxidation process by a differential scanning calorimetry method, and adjusts a heating curve to obtain the pre-oxidized fiber with high cyclizing degree. Finally, the segmented carbonization treatment is adopted, the dehydrocyclization and graphitization degree are controlled, and the high-performance carbon fiber with the tensile strength exceeding 3.5GPa is prepared. According to the application, through intelligent monitoring and regulation of the whole process, the accurate control of the preparation process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is realized, and the product performance and the production efficiency are remarkably improved.

title: Composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt is prepared mainly through precursor crimping, chopping, opening, carding to form a net, pre-oxidizing, layering, needle punching forming, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and high-temperature graphitization, and sizing; according to the invention, through a pre-needling and re-needling process, the size uniformity and the tensile strength of the formed pre-oxidized fiber felt are greatly improved; the pre-oxidation treatment process is advanced to carding and net forming, so that the production efficiency is greatly improved by 200-300% compared with the traditional production process, and the problems of ignition and the like caused by heat accumulation in the pre-oxidation process due to insufficient heat dissipation of the carbon fiber soft felt are effectively avoided.

title: Large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus and high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with surface groove structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a large-diameter polyacrylonitrile-based high-strength medium-modulus and high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with a surface groove structure and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts wet spinning to prepare large-diameter precursor, carries out pre-oxidation treatment in a pre-oxidation gas atmosphere with the volume concentration higher than that of oxygen in air to obtain homogeneous pre-oxidation fiber with basically the same radial optical density value, then carries out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to prepare large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with the diameter of 8.5-10 mu m, the strength of 4.90-6.10 GPa and the modulus of 270-310 GPa, and carries out high-temperature graphitization treatment with the length longer than the conventional treatment time to obtain large-diameter high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with the surface groove structure, the diameter of 7-10 mu m, the strength of 3.70-5.50 GPa and the modulus of 370-688 GPa. The improvement of the diameter of the carbon fiber not only improves the alignment of the fiber and improves the wettability of the resin in the preparation of the composite material, but also is beneficial to the meshing effect of the carbon fiber and the resin due to the surface groove structure, and finally improves the mechanical property of the composite material.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Method for producing graphite fibers by catalytic graphitization
abstract: The invention provides a method for producing graphite fibers by catalytic graphitization, which comprises the following steps: taking polyacrylonitrile-based precursor, and pre-oxidizing in an air atmosphere; carbonizing at low temperature; carbonizing at high temperature; preparing a boron-containing catalyst; immersing the carbonized carbon fiber in a boron-containing catalyst, and drying at 180-200 ℃ for 60-90 s; graphitizing: graphitizing for 20-40 s at the temperature of 2200-2400 ℃ in an argon atmosphere. According to the invention, the hydrogen chloride gas with a certain concentration is introduced into the atmosphere of the carbonization section, so that the carbonization time and temperature can be reduced, and the purity of the fiber can be improved; meanwhile, the graphitized fiber is subjected to graphitization treatment by impregnating the carbonized fiber with the boron compound, so that the graphitization temperature can be reduced, the graphitization time can be shortened, the strength and modulus of the graphite fiber can be improved to a certain extent, an antioxidation coating can be formed by using the boron-containing catalyst, the service life of graphitization equipment can be prolonged, and the running and maintenance cost of the equipment can be reduced.

title: Large-diameter high-strength medium-mode and high-strength high-mode carbon fiber with surface groove structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a large-diameter polyacrylonitrile-based high-strength medium-modulus and high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with a surface groove structure and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of preparing large-diameter precursor by wet spinning, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment in a pre-oxidation gas atmosphere with the volume concentration higher than that of oxygen in air to obtain 'homogeneous pre-oxidation fibers' with basically the same radial optical density value, carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers with surface groove structures, wherein the diameters of the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers are 8.5-10 mu m, the strengths of the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers are 4.90-6.10 GPa, and the moduli of the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers are 270-310 GPa, and carrying out high-temperature graphitization treatment for a longer time than conventional treatment to obtain the large-diameter high-strength high-. The improvement of the diameter of the carbon fiber not only improves the collimation of the fiber and improves the wettability of resin in the preparation of the composite material, but also is beneficial to the meshing effect of the carbon fiber and the resin by the surface groove structure, and finally improves the mechanical property of the composite material.

title: Carbon fiber, process for production thereof, prepregs, and golf club shafts
abstract: A carbon fiber tow composed of many carbon filaments and having a strand tensile strength of 3.8 to 5.5 GPa, a strand tensile modulus of 180 to 220 GPa and a carbon crystal size (Lc) of 13 to 18 Å. This carbon fiber tow can be produced by subjecting a precursor fiber tow composed of many polyacrylonitrile filaments which have a lightness difference (ΔL) of 50 or below and fineness of 1.1 to 1.7 dtex to oxidative stabilization and subjecting the stabilized fiber tow to carbonization with the maximum temperature within the range of 1,100 to 1,300° C. in an inert atmosphere while raising the temperature from 1,000° C. to the maximum temperature at a temperature rise rate of 100 to 2,000° C./min.

title: Preparation method of large-tow carbon fiber and obtained large-tow carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a large-tow carbon fiber and the obtained large-tow carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of pre-oxidizing a large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based precursor at 180-300 ℃ for 40-80min, wherein 2-4 temperature areas are adopted for pre-oxidation, the cyclizing degree difference of the pre-oxidized fibers in the adjacent temperature areas is controlled to be 10% -25%, the oxygen content difference is controlled to be 0.8% -2%, and the pre-oxidized fibers are subjected to carbonization treatment to prepare the large-tow carbon fiber. In the preoxidation stage of the large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, a better progressive preoxidation fiber structure is obtained through fine control of a cyclization structure, an oxidation structure and a microcrystalline structure, a good foundation is provided for subsequent carbonization, and meanwhile, small fiber structure difference is beneficial to reducing performance dispersion and improving fiber quality stability. The tensile strength of the prepared large-tow carbon fiber is more than or equal to 5.0GPa, the discrete coefficient in a tensile strength batch is less than or equal to 3%, and the tensile modulus is more than or equal to 240GPa.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维连云港有限公司

title: Large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application relates to a large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production. The preparation method comprises the steps of introducing 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, acrylonitrile, methyl acrylate and itaconic acid to carry out quaternary copolymerization to obtain spinning stock solution, spinning by adopting a dry-jet wet spinning method, controlling the number of spinning holes of a spinneret plate to be less than or equal to 6000, controlling the aperture to be 0.08-0.15 mm, controlling the length-diameter ratio to be (3:1) - (5:1), forming by using a three-stage coagulation bath with gradient concentration of 40-50 wt%, 25-35 wt% and 10-20 wt%, obtaining large-tow precursor with good uniformity and low fuzziness rate, and finally carrying out preoxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and sizing drying to obtain large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, thereby effectively improving the production efficiency of the large-tow carbon fibers, improving the tensile strength and tensile modulus and reducing the discrete coefficient in batches.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and obtained carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) -based carbon fiber and the obtained carbon fiber. Adding a certain amount of ammonium polyphosphate (APP) into a polymerization system for polymerization reaction to obtain spinning solution, preparing PAN precursor by a wet or dry-wet spinning method, and preparing carbon fiber by pre-oxidation and carbonization. The tensile strength of the carbon fiber prepared by the method provided by the invention can reach 5.58GPa under the premise that the fineness is not lower than 0.66dtex, the elastic modulus is more than 260GPa, and the carbon yield is not lower than 53%.

title: Preoxidation method for homogenizing high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a preoxidation method of a homogenized high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber precursor. The method preoxidizes polyacrylonitrile precursor at 200-300 ℃, controls the oxygen content in the fiber to increase to 8-11% at a uniform speed with an increasing gradient of 1-3%, and adopts 3-6 partition constant tension control to obtain the homogenized preoxidized fiber. The sheath-core parameters of the pre-oxidized fiber prepared by the method are more than or equal to 50%, the orientation degree is more than or equal to 80%, the tensile strength of the obtained carbon fiber is more than or equal to 5.9Pa after low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization of the pre-oxidized fiber, the tensile strength discrete coefficient is less than or equal to 5%, the tensile modulus is more than or equal to 295Pa, the tensile modulus discrete coefficient is less than or equal to 2%, the elongation at break is more than or equal to 1.9%, and the pre-oxidized fiber is suitable for the aerospace field.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fiber. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has tensile strength of 6000-7000 MPa, preferably 6375-7000MPa, tensile modulus of 285-305 GPa, interlaminar shear strength of 110-130 MPa and monofilament diameter of 5-6 μm, preferably 5.45-6 μm. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared by using polyacrylonitrile fiber prepared by a wet spinning process as a precursor through optimized steps of pre-oxidation, carbonization, surface treatment and the like. The invention is mainly used for providing or preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property and resin bonding property.
assignee: 山西钢科碳材料有限公司

title: Polyacrylonitrile fiber microwave plasma graphitization method and device
abstract: The invention relates to a microwave plasma graphitization method and a device for polyacrylonitrile fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. Firstly, pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile precursor in air atmosphere at the temperature of 240-300 ℃ for 30-50min to obtain pre-oxidized polyacrylonitrile precursor; carrying out microwave carbonization on the preoxidized polyacrylonitrile precursor for 4min at the temperature of 700 ℃ and 1400 ℃ in an inert atmosphere under the microwave condition to obtain carbonized polyacrylonitrile precursor; graphitizing the obtained carbonized polyacrylonitrile protofilament for 1-5min by microwave plasma at the temperature of 1600 ℃ and 2800 ℃ to obtain the polyacrylonitrile fiber with better mechanical property. By adopting the method and the device, the microwave plasma graphitization treatment of the polyacrylonitrile fiber can be completed within 5min, the tensile strength of the prepared carbon fiber can reach 6.52GPa, the tensile modulus can reach 665GPa, and a better technical effect is achieved.

title: Pre-oxidation method of homogeneous high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a preoxidation method of a homogeneous high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber precursor. The method comprises the steps of pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile precursor at 200-300 ℃, controlling the oxygen content in the fiber to increase to 8-11% at a constant speed by increasing the gradient to 1-3%, and obtaining the homogenized pre-oxidized fiber by adopting 3-6 subarea constant tension control. The sheath-core parameter of the pre-oxidized fiber prepared by the method is more than or equal to 50%, the orientation degree is more than or equal to 80%, the carbon fiber obtained after low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization has the tensile strength of more than or equal to 5.9Pa, the dispersion coefficient of the tensile strength of less than or equal to 5%, the tensile modulus of more than or equal to 295Pa, the dispersion coefficient of the tensile modulus of less than or equal to 2% and the elongation at break of more than or equal to 1.9%, and is suitable for the field of aerospace.

title: High-modulus carbon fiber and method for preparing high-modulus carbon fiber by regulating and controlling thermal stabilization fiber oxygen ring structure
abstract: The invention relates to a high modulus carbon fiber and a method for preparing the high modulus carbon fiber by regulating and controlling a thermal stabilization fiber oxygen ring structure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) performing thermal stabilization treatment on polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers in an air atmosphere to obtain air thermal stabilization fibers with OC values of 0.31-0.36; (2) carrying out thermal stabilization treatment on the air thermal stabilization fiber in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain a nitrogen thermal stabilization fiber with an OC value of 0.17-0.23; (3) sequentially carrying out low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization treatment on the nitrogen heat-stabilized fibers to obtain high-modulus carbon fibers, wherein OC (c ═ f) O [ CI ], wherein: f. of O CI is the cyclization index of the thermally stabilized fiber as the mass fraction of elemental oxygen in the thermally stabilized fiber. Therefore, the carbon fiber with the tensile strength of 3815-4882 MPa and the tensile modulus of 503-559 GPa can be prepared by the method.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has the outer diameter of 10-20 microns, the hollowness of 10-35 percent, the shape factor of 1.00-1.01, the tensile strength of 3.0-4.0Gpa, the tensile modulus of more than 250Gpa and no obvious bonding mark on the surface. The method adopts a binary or ternary polymerization system which takes acrylonitrile as a main monomer and is matched with an arc slit type spinneret plate for dry-jet wet spinning to spin, so that hollow carbon fiber precursor can be obtained, the precursor can be treated by an oxidation carbonization process to prepare the hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and the precursor and the carbon fiber have smooth surfaces and low section profile. The invention adopts the spinning technology of the dry-jet wet spinning method, the spinning speed is high, and the production efficiency is improved; the surfaces of the precursor and the carbon fiber are smooth and compact, the section profile degree is low, and the performance is excellent; the process is simple and feasible, the dry section can realize high-power drafting in the process of solidification forming, and the fine denier of the fiber diameter is facilitated; the arc-shaped liquid flow is bonded into a hollow structure in the air drying section, and no obvious closed mark exists.
assignee: 中国科学院山西煤炭化学研究所

title: High-resin-wettability polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with high resin wettability and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, 2, 3-Dichloropropene (DCP) is added to regulate and control the molecular weight and the distribution of polyacrylonitrile, so that the viscosity of a spinning solution is controlled, the spinning speed is improved in combination, the coagulation drafting is increased, the coagulation temperature and concentration conditions are regulated, a certain primary and secondary drafting are combined to prepare precursor fibers, and the surface cross-section structure of carbon fibers is finally regulated and controlled through preoxidation and carbonization, so that the preparation of high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with a cross section of a nearly circular shape, an equivalent diameter of 6.5-7.5 mu m, a contour length of more than or equal to 0.45 mu m, a tensile strength of 4.9-5.6 GPa and a tensile modulus of 230-290 GPa is realized. The invention improves the resin wettability of the high-strength carbon fiber, realizes the preparation of the large-diameter high-resin-wettability high-strength medium-mode carbon fiber by optimizing the structure of the carbon fiber, and develops ideas and lays a foundation for improving the interface associativity of the carbon fiber composite material.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-strength high-modulus carbon fibers. After Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) protofilament is subjected to conventional pre-oxidation and low-temperature carbonization, the orientation of carbon microcrystals can be effectively controlled by increasing the high-temperature carbonization temperature and matching certain stretching or increasing the high-temperature carbonization stretching ratio to obtain high-temperature carbonized fiber with the orientation angle not greater than 17.5 degrees, and then high-temperature graphitization hot stretching treatment is carried out at a relatively low high-temperature graphitization temperature to prepare the carbon fiber with the tensile strength of 3.8-5.0 GPa and the tensile modulus of 500-600 GPa and having the high-strength high-modulus characteristic. The preparation method of the invention reduces the requirements of high-temperature graphitization on equipment, is beneficial to energy conservation, consumption reduction and cost reduction, and has simple and easy operation.

title: High-tensile-strength high-tensile-modulus carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-tensile-strength high-tensile-modulus carbon fiber, which comprises the following preparation methods: (1) taking the content of the H element in the fiber as a fiber structure control index, and carrying out preoxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fiber in a six-temperature zone by using a preoxidation furnace to prepare a preoxidation fiber with the content of the H element of 4.0-4.4%; (2) carrying out low-temperature carbonization treatment of a five-temperature area on the pre-oxidized fiber by using a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and then carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment of a four-temperature area by using a high-temperature carbonization furnace; (3) and carrying out ultra-high temperature graphitization treatment on the high-temperature carbonized fiber by adopting an ultra-high temperature graphitization furnace to prepare the carbon fiber. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the high tensile strength and the high tensile modulus of the carbon fiber are realized by matching and designing the temperature, the drawing multiplying power and the retention time of pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization, and the tensile strength of the carbon fiber prepared by the method is higher than 4.5GPa, and the tensile modulus is higher than 540 GPa.

title: Low-diameter high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a low-diameter polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. Acrylonitrile containing itaconic acid and methyl methacrylate is used as a ternary polymerization system, a spinning stock solution with polymer content of 12.5-17.5% and viscosity of 120-800 poise is obtained by adding an organic glycol cross-linking agent in the polymerization process, the addition of the cross-linking agent improves the low polymer content and the spinnability and high-power drawability of the low-viscosity spinning solution, then a wet spinning process is adopted, and a reasonable solidification condition and a spinning drafting process are matched to prepare low-diameter polyacrylonitrile precursor with surface grooves, the precursor is subjected to preoxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain low-diameter high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with filament equivalent diameter of 2-3 mu m, tensile strength of more than or equal to 3.5GPa, tensile modulus of more than or equal to 230Gpa and surface groove structures. The carbon fiber obtained by the invention can improve the flexibility of the carbon fiber paper for the fuel cell.

title: High-permeability polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high permeability polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out binary copolymerization on acrylonitrile and itaconic acid, or carrying out ternary copolymerization on acrylonitrile, itaconic acid and methyl acrylate; (2) spinning solution sequentially passes through a spinneret plate for spinning, solidifying, primary drafting, washing, oiling, drying, secondary drafting and heat setting; (3) preoxidation and carbonization are carried out on the precursor, a spinneret plate with the aperture of 0.07mm is selected, and in the solidification process, the solidification draft is controlled to be 0.3-0.7 times, the primary draft is controlled to be 2-3.8 times, and the secondary draft is controlled to be 4.7-5.2 times. The method is adopted to obtain precursor fibers with the linear density of 0.125-0.265 g/m and the diameter of 13-20 mu m, and after the precursor fibers are pre-oxidized and carbonized, high-permeability polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers with the diameter of 7-10 mu m, the tensile strength of 4.6-5.4 GPa and the tensile modulus of 260-300 GPa are finally prepared, and compared with T300 and T700 carbon fibers with the diameter of 7 mu m, the carbon fibers have the glue solution permeability increased by 28%; compared with T800-grade carbon fiber with the diameter of 5.4 mu m, the impregnation rate of the glue solution is increased by 52 percent.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fiber. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has tensile strength of 6000-7000 MPa, preferably 6375-7000 MPa, tensile modulus of 285-305 GPa, interlaminar shear strength of 110-130 MPa, and monofilament diameter of 5-6 μm, preferably 5.45-6 μm. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared by using polyacrylonitrile fiber prepared by a wet spinning process as a precursor through optimized steps of pre-oxidation, carbonization, surface treatment and the like. The invention is mainly used for providing or preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property and resin bonding property.

title: Utilize the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof of waste polypropylene nitrile fiber preparation
abstract: The invention discloses the polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers and preparation method thereof using the preparation of waste polypropylene nitrile fiber, and method includes: that waste polypropylene nitrile fiber is carried out dehydrating by (1), the waste polypropylene nitrile fiber being dehydrated completely；(2) after the waste polypropylene nitrile fiber being dehydrated completely being chopped and the swelling of solvent mixed room temperature, high-temperature stirring dissolve prepared polymer solution, obtain spinning solution through filtering, deaeration；(3) spinning solution is subjected to spinning, obtains polyacrylonitrile fibril；(4) polyacrylonitrile fibril is pre-oxidized and is carbonized, obtain polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber.It obtains being dehydrated waste silk completely using this method, prepare the carbon fibre precursor spinning solution that polyacrylonitrile mass concentration is 19~22wt%, with the precursor of this spinning solution preparation after pre-oxidation and carbonization, the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber of 38~66g/km of line density, 3.8~5.6GPa of tensile strength, 230~300GPa of stretch modulus is finally prepared.

title: The method that high modulus carbon fiber and regulation thermostabilization fiber oxygen ring structure prepare high modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of methods that high modulus carbon fiber and regulation thermostabilization fiber oxygen ring structure prepare high modulus carbon fiber, this method comprises: polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibre is carried out thermostabilization processing by (1) in air atmosphere, the air thermostabilization fiber that OC value is 0.31~0.36 is obtained；(2) the air thermostabilization fiber is subjected to thermostabilization processing in a nitrogen atmosphere, obtains the nitrogen thermostabilization fiber that OC value is 0.17~0.23；(3) the nitrogen thermostabilization fiber is successively subjected to low-temperature carbonization, high temperature cabonization and graphitization processing, obtains high modulus carbon fiber, wherein the OC=f O / CI, in formula: f O For the mass fraction of oxygen element in thermostabilization fiber, CI is the cyclisation index of thermostabilization fiber.Tensile strength can be prepared in 3815~4882MPa, carbon fiber of the stretch modulus in 503~559GPa using this method as a result,.

title: Hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has the outer diameter of 10-20 microns, the hollowness of 10-35 percent, the shape factor of 1.00-1.01, the tensile strength of 3.0-4.0Gpa, the tensile modulus of more than 250Gpa and no obvious bonding mark on the surface. The method adopts a binary or ternary polymerization system which takes acrylonitrile as a main monomer and is matched with an arc slit type spinneret plate for dry-jet wet spinning to spin, so that hollow carbon fiber precursor can be obtained, the precursor can be treated by an oxidation carbonization process to prepare the hollow polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and the precursor and the carbon fiber have smooth surfaces and low section profile. The invention adopts the spinning technology of the dry-jet wet spinning method, the spinning speed is high, and the production efficiency is improved; the surfaces of the precursor and the carbon fiber are smooth and compact, the section profile degree is low, and the performance is excellent; the process is simple and feasible, the dry section can realize high-power drafting in the process of solidification forming, and the fine denier of the fiber diameter is facilitated; the arc-shaped liquid flow is bonded into a hollow structure in the air drying section, and no obvious closed mark exists.

title: A kind of high stretch modulus carbon fiber of high tensile and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of high stretch modulus carbon fibers of high tensile, preparation method includes: (1) using fibrous inside H element content as fibre structure Con trolling index, the pre-oxidized fibers that H element content is 4.0~4.4% are made in the pre-oxidation treatment for carrying out six warm areas to polyacrylonitrile fibre using pre-oxidation furnace；(2) it is handled using the low-temperature carbonization that low temperature carbonization furnace carries out five warm areas to pre-oxidized fibers, then is handled with the high temperature cabonization that high temperature carbonization furnace carries out four-temperature region；(3) superhigh temperature graphitization processing is carried out to high temperature cabonization fiber using superhigh temperature graphitizing furnace, the carbon fiber is prepared.In the continuous preparation process of fiber, by carrying out matched design to pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high temperature cabonization and graphited temperature, draft ratio and residence time, the high tensile of realization carbon fiber, high stretch modulus, the carbon fiber tensile strength being prepared by the method for the invention is higher than 4.5GPa, stretch modulus is higher than 540GPa.

title: Manufacturing method of 12K quaternary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: A manufacturing method of 12K quaternary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the following steps: subjecting a precursor to preoxidation treatment in four temperature zones through a preoxidation furnace; carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization on the precursor subjected to preoxidation treatment respectively in six temperature zones and four temperature zones; and carrying out subsequent treatment to obtain high-density and high-crystal orientation quaternary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. According to the invention, the spinning solution is high in homogenization degree in the solidification forming process, which is more beneficial to later drafting and dry densification of tows, and the precursor is relatively good in spinnability. By adopting the manufacturing method, the tensile strength and elasticity modulus of tow carbon fiber are increased, the fiber property variation coefficient is relatively small, the process applicability is good, and the work condition of 60 tows silking of oxidizing equipment with a furnace mouth width of 610mm can be met, and the production efficiency is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a process for producing polyacrylonitrile based carbon fibers, which comprises the following steps of: selecting polyacrylonitrile precursors according to mechanical properties, morphological structure of the section and hole analysis of the precursors; on the basis of designing a furnace body of a preoxidation furnace, studying the influence of temperature, time, drafting and fiber number of the precursors on a preoxidation process; and on the basis of designing furnace bodies of low and high temperature carbonizing furnaces, studying the influence of temperature, gasseal, tension, N2, carbonization rate, waste gas emission and treatment factors on low and high temperature carbonization processes. abstract: A carbon fiber tow composed of many carbon filaments and having a strand tensile strength of 3.8 to 5.5 GPa, a strand tensile modulus of 180 to 220 GPa and a carbon crystal size (Lc) of 13 to 18 AA. title: High-performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing polyacrylonitrile, a solvent and a plasticizer in proportion, heating and stirring to obtain uniform spinning stock solution, wherein the plasticizer is diphenyl phthalate, bisphenol A-bis (diphenyl) phosphate or resorcinol bis (diphenyl) phosphate, spinning the spinning stock solution to obtain a polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor, carrying out hot drawing treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor, and carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the pre-oxidation temperature is 200-300 ℃, and the pre-oxidation time is 80-160min. The preparation method of the carbon fiber can effectively improve the spinnability and the drawability of PAN fiber, and promote the improvement of the crystallinity and the graphitization degree of the carbon fiber, thereby enhancing the mechanical property of the fiber.

title: Carbon fiber paper based on composite carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cells, and provides carbon fiber paper based on composite carbon fiber pre-oxidized fibers, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of mixing a soluble asphalt solution and a polyacrylonitrile resin solution, sequentially carrying out wet spinning and solidification forming on a spinning stock solution, sequentially carrying out water washing, hot water drafting and heat setting on nascent fibers, sequentially carrying out program pre-oxidation and short cutting treatment on composite carbon fiber precursor, mixing the short cutting pre-oxidized fibers with a dispersing agent solution, sequentially carrying out wet papermaking, dipping in the resin solution, and carrying out hot press curing to obtain pre-oxidized fiber paper, and sequentially carrying out carbonization and graphitization on the pre-oxidized fiber paper to obtain the carbon fiber paper based on the composite carbon fiber pre-oxidized fibers. According to the invention, the soluble asphalt is introduced into the polyacrylonitrile wet spinning solution, the content of active groups on the fiber surface is improved in the pre-oxidation stage, and the formation and distribution of graphite microcrystals are regulated and controlled in the carbonization graphitization stage, so that the raw material types of carbon fiber paper for the fuel cell gas diffusion layer are expanded.

title: Hydrophobically modified carbon fiber paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cell gas diffusion layers, and provides a hydrophobic modified carbon fiber paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein polyacrylonitrile-based chopped fiber precursor and a surfactant are mixed and then subjected to wet papermaking, pre-oxidation, resin solution impregnation and drying treatment in sequence to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber base paper; sequentially swelling, stirring and defoaming the acrylonitrile-N-vinylformamide copolymer solution to obtain a precursor solution; and electrospinning the precursor solution on polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber base paper through electrostatic spinning, and sequentially performing thermocompression curing, carbonization and graphitization to obtain the hydrophobic modified carbon fiber paper. The invention also provides application of the hydrophobically modified carbon fiber paper. The invention expands the preparation process of the carbon paper for the gas diffusion layer of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell, realizes the accurate control of conductivity, hydrophobicity and air permeability, has good effect in PEMFC, and provides a new design idea for the actual industrial production of the carbon paper.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas diffusion layers of fuel cells, and provides hydrophobic modified carbon fiber paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein polyacrylonitrile-based chopped fiber precursors and a surfactant are mixed and then sequentially subjected to wet papermaking, pre-oxidation, resin solution impregnation and drying treatment to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber base paper; sequentially swelling, stirring and defoaming the acrylonitrile-N-vinyl formamide copolymer solution to obtain a precursor solution; and (3) electrospinning the precursor solution on polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber base paper through electrostatic spinning, and sequentially carrying out hot-pressing solidification, carbonization and graphitization to obtain the hydrophobic modified carbon fiber paper. title: Preparation method and application of high-regularity doped graphene carbon nanofiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method and application of high-regularity doped graphene carbon nanofibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. According to the invention, the addition of graphene is realized by taking the polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite material as a raw material, the precursor is prepared by an electrostatic spinning process, and finally, the high-performance carbon nanofiber material can be obtained by pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment. The preparation process disclosed by the invention is short in flow, high in production efficiency, the nanometer fiber diameter effectively avoids the generation of a skin-core structure in the heat treatment process, the graphene is doped to accelerate the dissolution of the polymer raw material, improve the graphitization degree of the fiber, effectively enhance the mechanical property and the heat conductivity of the carbon nanofiber and have good practical application value.

title: Preparation method of carbon-carbon fiber composite material for conical surface friction layer of heavy-duty automobile transmission synchronizer cone ring
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon-carbon fiber composite material for a conical surface friction layer of a heavy-duty automobile transmission synchronizer cone ring, which comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization treatment, surface treatment and sizing treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain a carbon fiber fabric; dehydrogenating and decomposing hydrocarbon source gas by a chemical phase deposition method, and depositing carbon by taking a carbon fiber fabric as a matrix to obtain a carbon-carbon fiber friction layer; mixing FB resin glue and epoxy resin and homogenizing to obtain prepreg glue; and (3) coating prepreg glue solution on one surface of the carbon-carbon fiber friction layer, preserving heat, solidifying and naturally cooling to obtain the carbon-carbon fiber composite material for the conical surface friction layer of the heavy-duty automobile transmission synchronizer. The prepared carbon-carbon fiber composite material has the advantages of high friction coefficient, stable wear resistance, strong comprehensive performance and long service life.

title: Preparation method of high-performance low-cost polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-performance low-cost polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Firstly, mixing acrylonitrile and a comonomer capable of improving a skin-core structure in a solvent, then uniformly dispersing nano boride in a mixed solution, and then adding an initiator to synthesize a boron-containing Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) precursor; and finally, preparing the PAN-based carbon fiber through wet spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization processes. The invention solves the problem of skin-core structure of PAN-based carbon fiber by improving the comonomer used for PAN precursor polymerization; meanwhile, the size and orientation of a microcrystalline structure of the PAN-based carbon fiber in the graphitization process are regulated and controlled by utilizing the catalytic graphitization effect of boron atoms, the graphitization temperature is reduced, and the PAN-based carbon fiber with high graphitization degree is prepared, so that the high performance and the low cost of the PAN-based carbon fiber preparation are realized.

title: Preparation method of high-performance composite carbon felt
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-performance composite carbon felt, and particularly relates to the technical field of fiber products, wherein the preparation method comprises the following specific steps: raw material purification, PAN precursor preparation, pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization, surface treatment and coating treatment. According to the invention, the raw material purification step is added in the composite carbon felt process, so that the impurity condition in the carbon felt finished product can be effectively solved from the source, the influence on the finished product quality of the carbon felt can be prevented, and n-butyl alcohol is used for dissolving polyacrylonitrile, thereby ensuring the characteristics of carbon fibers and carbon felts of subsequent branches, enabling the stress of each part of the carbon felt to be uniform, avoiding the fracture caused by uneven stress at the impurity position in the traditional process, effectively ensuring the promotion of the stretching effect in the use process of the finished product carbon felt, ensuring the service life of the carbon felt, and enabling the volatilized n-butyl alcohol steam to be liquefied again after being cooled for reuse, thereby ensuring the production cost of manufacturers.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fiber. The preparation method comprises the steps of continuously polymerizing acrylonitrile serving as a main monomer to prepare a polymerization stock solution, removing monomers and defoaming to obtain a homogeneous polymerization solution, spinning the homogeneous polymerization solution by adopting a dry-jet wet forming process, sequentially performing water washing, hot water drawing, drying, steam drawing and oiling to obtain fiber precursor, sequentially performing pretreatment, pre-oxidation and multistage carbonization on the fiber precursor to obtain carbonized fibers, and sequentially performing surface treatment, water washing, sizing and drying on the carbonized fibers to obtain carbon fiber products. The invention can prepare a new generation of carbon fiber products with comprehensive advantages of strength and modulus through the improvement of the whole process, and lays a foundation for the application of the carbon fiber products in the aspects of the multi-technical field and the multi-composite material forming process system which are wider in the follow-up process.

title: Composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite polyacrylonitrile-based graphite soft felt is prepared by mainly curling precursor, cutting, opening, carding and forming, pre-oxidizing, layering, needling and forming, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature graphitization and sizing, the size uniformity and the tensile strength of the formed pre-oxidized fiber felt are greatly improved by the pre-needling and re-needling processes, the production efficiency is greatly improved by 200-300% compared with the production efficiency of the traditional production process, and the problems of ignition and the like caused by heat accumulation of the carbon fiber soft felt in the pre-oxidizing process are effectively avoided.

title: Preparation, product and application of high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent
abstract: The patent provides a preparation, a product and application of a high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent. Amino silicone oil, epoxy silicone oil, amino modified epoxy silicone oil, an emulsifier, a defoaming agent and an antistatic agent are compounded, and then water is added for emulsification under high-speed homogenizing stirring to prepare the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent. The prepared oiling agent is utilized to oil the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, the oiling agent on the surface of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor is subjected to a crosslinking reaction in the high-temperature drying process, the oiling agent is converted into a pasty or solid film from liquid, and the high-temperature steam-resistant and high-temperature water-resistant high-temperature soaking characteristics are realized, so that the high-temperature steam drafting or high-temperature water soaking drafting process of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor after oiling is suitable. The emulsion particle size of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent prepared by the method can be regulated and controlled, the emulsion is stable in storage at room temperature, in addition, the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor after oiling is free from sticking rollers and fuzzing in the drying process and the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, and the tensile strength of the carbon fiber after carbonization of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor can be improved by 10% -20%.

title: High-strength high-model graphite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a high-strength high-model graphite fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, carbonization treatment and ultra-high-temperature graphitization treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the high-strength high-model graphite fiber, wherein the carbonization treatment comprises low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment, the temperature of the low-temperature carbonization treatment is 400-550 ℃, the draft multiple is 0.96-0.98 times, the temperature of the high-temperature carbonization treatment is 1050-1550 ℃, and the draft multiple is 0.95-0.97 times. In the invention, the graphite fiber obtained by the preparation method has high tensile strength and elastic modulus, stable product quality, mass production and low cost.

title: Preparation method of hollow carbon fiber with hydrophobic inner hole
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a hollow carbon fiber with a hydrophobic inner hole, belonging to the technical field of chemical fibers. The method comprises the four steps of preparing a shell spinning solution, mixing polyacrylonitrile and a high polymer according to a specific mass ratio, dissolving the mixture in an organic solvent, preparing an inner layer spinning solution, dissolving the high polymer in the organic solvent, adding nano particles, obtaining a double-layer carbon fiber precursor with the nano particles in an inner core through a spinning technology, and performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the precursor to obtain the hollow carbon fiber with the hydrophobic inner holes. Wherein the micro-size and the high specific surface area of the nano particles obviously enhance the mechanical properties such as the tensile strength of the fiber, and the carbon particles and the nano particles remained by carbonizing the high polymer form a uniform micro-nano hydrophobic inner wall together. The hollow carbon fiber prepared by the invention has an excellent hydrophobic inner hole structure, is suitable for the fields of fuel cells and the like, realizes gas/liquid separation, and improves the performance of the cells.

title: Preparation method for preparing carbon nanofiber membrane by plasma-assisted temperature programming
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber membrane based on the synergistic effect of plasma pretreatment and temperature programming in a three-temperature zone, and relates to the technical field of high-performance carbon fiber material preparation. The method takes Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based nanofiber non-woven fabric prepared by electrostatic spinning as a precursor, and sequentially comprises the following steps of carrying out surface activation and cleaning treatment on the precursor by adopting oxygen, air or Ar/O  2  mixed gas low-temperature plasma, then carrying out three-stage temperature programming pre-oxidation treatment under an air atmosphere, wherein the target temperatures of the three stages are 220-240 ℃, 245-265 ℃ and 280-300 ℃, realizing gradual uniform cyclization of PAN molecules by controlling the temperature rising rate and the heat preservation time of each stage, and finally carrying out two-stage temperature rising carbonization treatment under an inert atmosphere to obtain a final product. According to the invention, through the synergistic effect of plasma pretreatment and multistage precise temperature control, surface impurities are effectively removed, active sites are introduced, the problems of uneven initiation of the pre-oxidation reaction and skin-core effect are solved, the process time is obviously shortened, the tensile strength of the obtained carbon nanofiber membrane is more than or equal to 185MPa, the performance consistency is good, and the carbon nanofiber membrane is suitable for continuous large-scale production.

title: Preparation process of polyacrylonitrile precursor of high-tensile-strength carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation process of polyacrylonitrile precursor of high tensile strength carbon fiber, which relates to the technical field of novel carbon materials and fiber materials, and comprises the following two steps of polymerization and spinning, wherein the polymerization is carried out by taking acrylonitrile as a main monomer, itaconic acid and methyl acrylate as comonomers and preferably taking dimethyl sulfoxide as a solvent, azo or peroxide as an initiator, the dosage is 0.1-0.5% of the total mass of the monomers, reacting for 10-40h by a two-step method at 50-75 ℃, and then removing monomers and concentrating to obtain spinning stock solution. The spinning sequentially comprises spinning and solidifying, water washing, stretching, oiling and heat setting, wherein the spinning enters a solidifying bath after spinning, the water washing adopts a specific temperature process, the total stretching multiplying power is 5-8 times, the oiling is performed by using a silicon-based oiling agent, and the heat setting comprises the steps of secondary drafting and setting. Finally, the prepared precursor has regular cross section, compact structure and stable mechanical property, is suitable for industrial production and environment-friendly, and reserves high-strength potential for subsequent pre-oxidation and carbonization.

title: High-strength high-modulus high-elongation carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and discloses a high-strength high-modulus high-elongation carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, polymerizing acrylonitrile and comonomer solution to obtain spinning solution; step 2, adopting wet spinning, solidifying, washing, hot water drafting, oiling and drying the spinning solution, and then carrying out steam drafting and heat setting to obtain precursor fibers with boiling water shrinkage of 5.0-6.8%, elongation at break of 9.5-11.0% and tensile strength of 4.7-5.9 cN/dtex; and 3, preparing the precursor fiber by pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and ultrahigh-temperature graphitization to obtain the carbon fiber with the tensile strength of more than or equal to 5.00GPa, the tensile modulus of more than or equal to 540GPa and the elongation at break of more than or equal to 0.90%, wherein the carbon fiber has excellent comprehensive performance.

title: Low-temperature carbonized fiber body and low-temperature carbonization treatment method
abstract: The invention provides a low-temperature carbonized fiber body and a low-temperature carbonization treatment method, which relate to the technical field of carbon fibers, wherein the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is obtained by carrying out low-temperature carbonization treatment on a polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized fiber body by adopting an inclined low-temperature carbonization furnace, the linear density of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is 778-787 g/km, the bulk density of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is 1.625-1.635 g/cm  3 , the elastic modulus of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is more than 43.5GPa, the orientation degree of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is 67-68.5%, the skin proportion of a skin-core structure is more than 90%, the carbon content of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is 68.5-70.5%, and the sediment proportion of the low-temperature carbonized fiber body is less than 0.08%, and the polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized fiber body is obtained by carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on a dry-jet wet polyacrylonitrile precursor with a monofilament diameter of 5-6 mu m. The invention provides a low-temperature carbonized fiber body with excellent performance, which is used as an evaluation standard, thereby preparing the carbon fiber with the average strength of 6348MPa (the strength of more than 5880MPa is up to the standard), the CV value of 2.32% and the linear density of 515+/-8 g/cm  3 .

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fiber. Continuously polymerizing acrylonitrile serving as a main monomer to prepare a polymerization stock solution, obtaining a homogeneous polymerization solution after demonomerization and defoaming, spinning the homogeneous polymerization solution by adopting a dry-spray wet method forming process, sequentially carrying out washing, hot water drafting, drying, steam drafting and oiling to obtain fiber precursors, and sequentially carrying out pretreatment, preoxidation and multi-stage carbonization on the fiber precursors to obtain carbonized fibers; and sequentially carrying out surface treatment, washing, sizing and drying on the carbonized fiber to obtain a carbon fiber product. The invention can prepare a new generation of carbon fiber product with the comprehensive advantages of strength and modulus through the improvement of the whole process, and lays a foundation for the subsequent wider application in multiple technical fields and multiple composite material forming process systems.

title: Method for producing graphite fiber by catalytic graphitization
abstract: The invention provides a method for producing graphite fibers by catalytic graphitization, which comprises the following steps: taking polyacrylonitrile-based protofilament, and pre-oxidizing in air atmosphere; carbonizing at low temperature; carbonizing at high temperature; preparing a boron-containing catalyst; soaking the carbonized carbon fiber in a boron-containing catalyst, and drying at 180-200 ℃ for 60-90 s; graphitization: graphitizing for 20-40 s at 2200-2400 ℃ in an argon atmosphere to obtain the graphite. According to the invention, hydrogen chloride gas with a certain concentration is introduced into the atmosphere of the carbonization section, so that the carbonization time and temperature can be reduced, and the purity of the fiber can be improved; meanwhile, the carbonized fiber is subjected to graphitization treatment by dipping the boron compound, so that the graphitization temperature can be reduced, the graphitization time can be shortened, the strength and the modulus of the graphite fiber can be improved to a certain degree, an anti-oxidation coating can be formed by using a boron-containing catalyst, the service life of graphitization equipment is prolonged, and the operation and maintenance cost of the equipment is reduced.

title: Preparation method of large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber and high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of large-diameter Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) -based high-strength medium-modulus and high-strength high-modulus carbon fibers. The method adopts dry-wet spinning to prepare the large-diameter protofilament, the protofilament is subjected to pre-oxidation treatment in a pre-oxidation gas atmosphere with the volume concentration higher than that of oxygen in air to obtain 'homogeneous pre-oxidation fibers' with basically the same radial optical density value, and then the 'homogeneous pre-oxidation fibers' are subjected to low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to prepare the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber, wherein the diameter is 8.5-10 mu m, the strength is 5.40-6.30 GPa, and the modulus is 280-330 GPa; and then, performing high-temperature graphitization for a longer time than conventional treatment to obtain the large-diameter high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber with the diameter of 7-10 mu m, the strength of 3.90-5.70 GPa and the modulus of 380-688 GPa. The large-diameter high-strength medium-mode or high-strength high-mode carbon fiber prepared by the method has the advantages that the diameter of the carbon fiber is increased, the collimation of the fiber is effectively improved, the resin wettability of the fiber in the preparation of the composite material is improved, and the mechanical property of the composite material is finally improved.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Carbon fiber with cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile composite fiber as precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber taking cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile composite fiber as a precursor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) reacting cellulose nanocrystal with acrylonitrile monomer in an organic solvent to obtain a cellulose nanocrystal-acrylonitrile polymer solution; (2) filtering, defoaming and spinning the cellulose nanocrystal-acrylonitrile polymer solution to obtain cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile composite fibers; (3) and carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile composite fiber to obtain the carbon fiber taking the cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile composite fiber as a precursor. Compared with the common polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber (without adding the cellulose nanocrystal), the cellulose nanocrystal-polyacrylonitrile-based composite carbon fiber obtained by the invention has the advantages that the monofilament strength can be improved by at least 8%, and the modulus can be improved by at least 10%.

title: High-strength high-modulus carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber, and a preparation method thereof comprises the following steps: (1) taking the density of a fiber body as a structural performance index, and carrying out six-temperature-zone pre-oxidation treatment on the precursor fiber by using a pre-oxidation furnace to obtain pre-oxidized fiber; (2) carrying out low-temperature carbonization treatment of six temperature regions on the pre-oxidized fiber by using a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and then carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment of five temperature regions on the low-temperature carbonized fiber by using a high-temperature carbonization furnace to prepare carbon fiber; (3) and carrying out ultra-high temperature graphitization treatment on the carbon fiber by adopting a high-temperature graphitization furnace to prepare the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the high strength, the high modulus and the stable performance of the carbon fiber are realized through matching design of the temperature, the drawing multiplying power, the residence time and the like of pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization, and the carbon fiber prepared by the method has the tensile strength higher than 4.2GPa and the tensile modulus higher than 500 GPa.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber and a preparation method thereof. The main technical scheme adopted is as follows: the polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber has tensile strength of 4.01-4.46 GPa, tensile modulus of 541-547 GPa and bulk density of 1.89-1.91 g/cm 3 (ii) a The linear density of the 6K polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber is 215-218 g/km. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber comprises the following steps: carrying out preoxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization, graphitization and post-treatment on the precursor in sequence to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber; wherein the protofilament is polyacrylonitrile fiber; the monofilament diameter of the protofilament is 9-11 μm; the average depth of the grooves of the precursor is 0.2 to 0.5 μm, the average width of the grooves is 0.1 to 0.4 μm, and the average Ra of the surface roughness is 0.0182 to 0.0201 μm. The method is mainly used for preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based graphite fiber with excellent mechanical property indexes such as strength, modulus and the like.

title: Ultrahigh-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an ultrahigh-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) polymerizing acrylonitrile and itaconic acid or acrylonitrile and itaconic acid and methyl acrylate; (2) sequentially carrying out solidification, steam drafting, water washing, oiling, drying, superheated steam drafting and heat setting on the polymer spinning solution; (3) and (3) carrying out preoxidation and carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the ultrahigh-strength and medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein in the step (2), the solidification comprises primary solidification, secondary solidification and tertiary solidification, the drafting multiplying factor of the primary solidification is-0.5-3.0, the drafting multiplying factor of the secondary solidification is 1.0-2.0, the drafting multiplying factor of the tertiary solidification is 1.2-3.0, and in the step (3), the temperature is 200-280 ℃ and the time is 10-30 minutes in the preoxidation process. The method can prepare the ultrahigh-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber under the condition of greatly shortening the pre-oxidation treatment time.

title: A kind of preparation method of continuous high-performance Mesophase Pitch-based Carbon Fibers
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of preparation method of continuous high-performance Mesophase Pitch-based Carbon Fibers, first by the carbon fiber precursors spun by hard waste mechanism in the graphite crucible with micropore, graphite crucible is placed in pre-oxidation furnace again, air is passed through and the carbon fiber precursors in pre-oxidation furnace is pre-oxidized；After pre-oxidation terminates, inert gas is passed through, low-temperature carbonization and high temperature carbonization are carried out to pre-oxidation Carbon fibe；Pre-oxidation furnace is cooled to normal temperature, takes out graphite crucible and is placed in intermittent high temperature graphitization stove progress graphitization processing, obtains continuous high intensity, high-modulus and high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber.Preparation method of the invention is simple, controllability is good, yield is high, can not be warming up to by having evaded domestic continuous graphitizing furnace by more than 2800 DEG C, and the tensile strengths of the high-performance Mesophase Pitch-based Carbon Fibers of preparation is 2.2~3.5GPa, modulus of elasticity is 650~750GPa and thermal conductivity is 900~1050W/m*K.

title: A kind of high strength high modulus carbon fiber and preparation method thereof

title: The preparation method of high strength and modulus graphite fibre
abstract: The present invention relates to organic polymer field, specifically a kind of preparation method of high strength and modulus graphite fibre, it is characterised in that comprise the following steps：Polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibre is applied into 2~3 times of drawing-off in the steam drafting stage, precursor of the degree of orientation 91~93% is obtained；By obtained precursor in air atmosphere in being pre-oxidized in 180~280 DEG C of temperature ranges, 60~110min is heat-treated using 6 sections of gradient increased temperature modes, it is 1.34 ± 0.02g/cm that density, which is made, 3 Pre-oxidized fibers；By gained pre-oxidized fibers under nitrogen protection, under 0~4% draw ratio, in 3 ± 1.5min of low-temperature carbonization at 300~900 DEG C; by gained fiber at 1000~1800 DEG C 3 ± 1.5min of high temperature cabonization; draw ratio is 4~0%, obtains phosphorus content more than 96%, a diameter of 7 μm of carbon fiber；By gained carbon fiber under inert gas shielding, in 2 ± 1min of graphitization at 2200~2500 DEG C, draw ratio is 1~5%, obtains graphite fibre.

title: Magneto-carbonization method for production of carbon fiber, and high performance carbon fibers made thereby
abstract: Method for the preparation of carbon fiber from fiber precursor, wherein the fiber precursor is subjected to a magnetic field of at least 3 Tesla during a carbonization process. The carbonization process is generally conducted at a temperature of at least 400° C. and less than 2200° C., wherein, in particular embodiments, the carbonization process includes a low temperature carbonization step conducted at a temperature of at least or above 400° C. or 500° C. and less than or up to 1000° C., 1100° C., or 1200° C., followed by a high temperature carbonization step conducted at a temperature of at least or above 1200° C. In particular embodiments, particularly in the case of a polyacrylonitrile (PAN) fiber precursor, the resulting carbon fiber may possess a minimum tensile strength of at least 600 ksi, a tensile modulus of at least 30 Msi, and an ultimate elongation of at least 1.5%.

title: Carbon filament made from the hybrid precursor fiber and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to carbon fibers prepared from hybrid precursor fibers and comprising isotropic pitch-based carbon fibers and, specifically, to carbon fibers prepared from hybrid precursor fibers, wherein the carbon fibers comprise 30-60 wt% of isotropic pitch-based carbon fibers on the total 100 wt% thereof, and have a tensile strength of 2.0 GPa or higher. The carbon fibers prepared from hybrid precursor fibers, according to the present invention, can compensate for low mechanical properties, which are disadvantages of the isotropic pitch-based carbon fibers, and can solve problems of high prices and impossibility of melt spinning, which are disadvantages of existing polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based carbon fibers, by mixing PAN with isotropic pitch-based carbon fibers as a backbone, followed by stretching, stabilization, carbonization, and the like. Therefore, carbon filaments having a tensile strength of 2 GPa or higher and an elongation rate of 2% or more, which correspond to the minimum requirements of carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRPs), can be prepared. The carbon fibers according to the present invention can be applied to CFRPs, and can substitute for CFRP, including existing PAN-based carbon fibers, due to excellent physical properties and low prices.
