title: Method for preparing high-intensity high-modulus graphite fibers
abstract: The invention relates to the field of organic polymer, in particular to a method for preparing high-intensity high-modulus graphite fibers. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: carrying out pre-oxidation on polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers in the air atmosphere at a temperature interval of 180 to 280 DEG C; carrying out thermal treatment for 60 to 110min in a 6-stage gradient temperature rising mode to prepare pre-oxidized fibers with density of 1.34 plus and minus 0.02g/cm<3>; carrying out low-temperature carbonization for 3 plus and minus 1.5min under the conventional carbonization conditions, i.e. under the nitrogen protection, a draw ratio is 0 to 4 percent and a temperature is 300 to 900 DEG C; carrying out high-temperature carbonization on the obtained fibers for 3 plus and minus 1.5min at a temperature of 1,000 to 2,000 DEG C under a draw ratio of minus 4 to 0 percent so as to prepare carbon fibers with carbon content of over 98 percent and a diameter of 5mum; carrying out graphitization on the obtained carbon fibers for 2 plus and minus 1min under the protection of inert gas at a temperature of 2,200 to 2,500 DEG C under a draw ratio of 1 to 5 percent so as to obtain the graphite fibers.

title: Magneto-carbonization method for production of carbon fiber, and high performance carbon fibers made thereby
abstract: Method for the preparation of carbon fiber from fiber precursor, wherein the fiber precursor is subjected to a magnetic field of at least 3 Tesla during a carbonization process. The carbonization process is generally conducted at a temperature of at least 400° C. and less than 2200° C., wherein, in particular embodiments, the carbonization process includes a low temperature carbonization step conducted at a temperature of at least or above 400° C. or 500° C. and less than or up to 1000° C., 1100° C., or 1200° C., followed by a high temperature carbonization step conducted at a temperature of at least or above 1200° C. In particular embodiments, particularly in the case of a polyacrylonitrile (PAN) fiber precursor, the resulting carbon fiber may possess a minimum tensile strength of at least 600 ksi, a tensile modulus of at least 30 Msi, and an ultimate elongation of at least 1.5%.

title: Method of preparing carbon fibers through crosslinked reaction of boron trichloride and polyacrylonitrile precursors
abstract: The invention relates to a method of preparing carbon fibers through crosslinked reaction of boron trichloride and polyacrylonitrile precursors. In the method, the boron-nitrogen bonds are formed by the reaction of the boron trichloride and unsaturated functional groups such as cyan in polyacrylonitrile precursors, the boron is uniformly introduced in the fiber, the chemical crosslinking of the polyacrylonitrile precursors is also realized, the crosslinked precursors are carbonized under the nitrogen protection and graphitized under the argon protection, and the original air preoxidation process is replaced. Compared with unmodified fiber obtained through air preoxidation, the release of the highly toxic gas such as hydrogen cyanide in the pyrolysis tail gas is greatly reduced, and the modulus of the carbon fiber is obviously improved. In the method, the process steps are not increased, the uniform chemical modification of boron is realized, the boron introduced by bonding can keep to the graphitization stage, no influence can be caused on the graphitization process, the production cost is low, and the industrialized production is convenient.

title: Pre-oxidation method for carbon fiber precursor polyacrylnitrile fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preoxidation method for a polyacrylonitrile fiber of former body of carbon fiber. The method is, under normal pressure, to subject the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor orderly and continuously to constant preoxidation, that is, preoxidation at five temperatures in a low temperature carbonization furnace, including a cyclization process under the protection of nitrogen at a first temperature and a second temperature with rigid drawing at the second temperature, and a  oxidation crosslink process with the presence of air at a third temperature, a fourth temperature and a fifth temperature; to low temperature carbonization with nitrogen passing through the furnace at a sixth temperature; and finally to high temperature carbonization under the protection of nitrogen after entering a high temperature carbonization furnace through a tension bracket. The method has the advantages that in case of the protection of nitrogen gas, the heat treatment to fiber can improve the reactivity of the fiber, is favorable for the implement of cyclization reaction, and meanwhile in the case of the protection of nitrogen gas, the applied rigid drawing can improve the orientation degree of a molecular chain along the fiber axis, and thus polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with higher strength and higher modulus can be obtained.

abstract: The invention relates to polyacrylonitrile nascent fiber for carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which mainly solve the problems of lower light transmittance of the nascent fiber and low quality of the obtained carbon fiber product in the prior art. The polyacrylonitrile nascent fiber for the carbon fiber has the single-color light transmittance of not less than 35% at 550nm, and can obtain a carbon fiber product with the tensile strength of 5.0-5.5 GPa and the Young modulus of 450-550 GPa through subsequent oxidative carbonization processing. The invention can be used in industrial production in the field of carbon fiber precursors.

title: High-strength ultrahigh-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and discloses a high-strength ultrahigh-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of 1, pre-oxidizing and carbonizing polyacrylonitrile fibers at low temperature to obtain low-temperature carbonized fibers, 2, carrying out gradient heating high-temperature carbonization treatment in a six-temperature area on the low-temperature carbonized fibers, wherein the total drawing multiplying power of the fibers in the high-temperature carbonization treatment process is-7.0% -1.0%, the total treatment time is 4-12 min to obtain high-temperature carbonized fibers, and 3, carrying out ultrahigh-temperature graphitization treatment on the high-temperature carbonized fibers to obtain the high-strength ultrahigh-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers. The ultra-high modulus carbon fiber with the tensile strength more than or equal to 4000MPa and the tensile modulus more than or equal to 640GPa is prepared by treating the high-temperature carbonized multi-temperature zone, improving the final heat treatment temperature and optimizing the technological parameters such as the draft ratio, the treatment time and the like, has excellent comprehensive performance and has wide application prospect.

title: Carbon fiber and method of manufacturing same
abstract: A carbon fiber includes single fibers having lengths of 10 cm or less, a fiber axis of each single fiber having an undulation width of 2.5 μm or more when a part thereof between two points with a straight-line distance of 1 mm is observed from a lateral direction, and a coefficient of variation in the undulation width being 100% or less. A method of producing carbon fiber production includes performing stabilization treatment of a precursor fiber bundle for polyacrylonitrile based carbon fiber, performing pre-carbonization treatment, and performing carbonization treatment in this order, followed by cutting the resulting carbon fiber bundle in the form of continuous fiber to a single fiber length of 10 cm or less, the twist count of the fiber bundle during the carbonization treatment step being 16 turns/m or more.

title: Carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out tension control pre-oxidation treatment on polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber in an air atmosphere to obtain pre-oxidized fiber with the oxygen content of 6-9wt%, 2) carrying out tension control low-temperature carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized fiber in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain low-temperature carbonized fiber, and (3) carrying out tension control high-temperature carbonization on the low-temperature carbonized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber. The carbon fiber with the tensile modulus of 340-380GPa and the carbon content of less than or equal to 98wt% can be prepared by adopting the method, so that the interface performance of the composite material can be effectively improved.

title: Polyacrylonitrile fiber and preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile fiber and a preparation method thereof, and a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method mainly adopts the technical scheme that the preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile fiber comprises the following steps of conveying a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to a spinning device through a conveying pipeline for spinning, sequentially carrying out solidification molding, water washing treatment and post treatment after spinning to obtain the polyacrylonitrile fiber, wherein the inner wall surface of the conveying pipeline is a polished surface, the roughness Ra is less than or equal to 0.40 mu m, and the conveying speed of the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution in the conveying pipeline is controlled to be 1-10 cm/s. The method is mainly used for eliminating or controlling defects generated in the production process of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, reasonably matching and finely controlling the technological conditions of carbonization treatment and graphitization treatment, effectively controlling the structural characteristics of the fiber such as microcrystalline orientation, multidimensional grain size, pore defect size and the like of the fiber, further improving the tensile strength and tensile modulus index of the fiber, and solving the problem that high tensile strength and high tensile modulus are difficult to coexist.

title: Polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fibers. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution comprises the following steps of enabling a first monomer, a second monomer and a third monomer to undergo polymerization reaction to prepare the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, wherein the first monomer is acrylonitrile, the second monomer is vinyl comonomer with ester groups and/or carboxyl groups, and the third monomer is styrene. The method is used for introducing the third monomer styrene in the preparation of the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, can effectively improve the contractility and the stretchability of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, is favorable for reducing the yarn breakage phenomenon during dry-wet spinning, thereby improving the tensile strength, the elasticity and the elongation at break of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, and can properly improve the draft ratio to improve the tensile strength and the elastic modulus of the carbon fiber and reduce the yarn breakage and the yarn breakage phenomenon during the pre-oxidation stage when the polyacrylonitrile fiber is used as a precursor for preparing the carbon fiber.

title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, high-strength high-modulus low-hairiness polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, a high-strength high-modulus low-hairiness polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which mainly solve the problems of easy fluffing caused by high-temperature carbonization, low carbon fiber tensile film quantity and high CV value in the prior art. The invention adopts wet spinning, which comprises the step that polyacrylonitrile nascent fiber is subjected to at least 3 sections of hot water drafting treatment, wherein the values of a drafting ratio parameter lambda and a fiber swelling degree B in the hot water drafting meet the conditions that lambda/2.3 is less than or equal to B and less than or equal to lambda/1.7, and the drafting ratio parameter λ＝(0.9×λ 1 +0.5×λ 2 +0.2×λ 3 +0.1×λ 4 +0.01×λ 5 …+0.01×λ n )×100％,λ 1 、λ 2 、λ 3 …λ n  is the drafting ratio of each section of hot water drafting respectively. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the technical problems are better solved, and the method can be used for industrial production of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursors.

title: System for producing carbon fibers from multipurpose commercial fibers
abstract: A method of producing carbon fibers includes the step of providing polyacrylonitrile precursor polymer fiber filaments. The polyacrylonitrile precursor filaments include from 87-97 mole % acrylonitrile, and less than 0.5 mole % of accelerant functional groups. The filaments are no more than 3 deniers per filament. The polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber filaments can be arranged into tows of at least 150,000 deniers per inch width. The arranged polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber tows are stabilized by heating the tows in at least one oxidation zone containing oxygen gas and maintained at a first temperature T 1  while stretching the tows at least 10% to yield a stabilized precursor fiber tow. The stabilized precursor fiber tows are carbonized by passing the stabilized precursor fiber tows through a carbonization zone. Carbon fibers produced by the process are also disclosed.

title: Carbon fibre manufacturing
abstract: Method of identifying stabilisation conditions for producing a thermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based carbon fibre precursor from any batch of precursor for use in carbon fibre manufacturing process are useful for reducing cost of carbon fibre manufacture. Method of manufacturing carbon fibres, comprising the steps of: providing a batch of isothermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based precursor fibres which presents as absent of evidence of tow burning or tow breakage, and having a structural conversion index selected from the range of from 0.5 to 0.7; subjecting the provided batch of isothermally treated precursor fibres to a carbonisation process to produce carbon fibre.

title: Method for realizing densification and orientation synchronization of carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a method for realizing synchronization of densification and orientation of carbon fiber precursor, which is characterized in that polyacrylonitrile fiber produced by a dry-wet method is heated in a first area and a second area at a high temperature of 160-220 ℃ in a drying process to reach the glass transition temperature of the fiber, then the fiber is dried and densified through three to five areas, the whole driving draft ratio is kept unchanged at 1.0-4.0 times in the drying process, the fiber is stretched in a mode that the front and back area draft ratios are different, the synchronization of the precursor densification and the orientation is realized, the crystallinity of the obtained precursor is 85-95%, the diameter of a monofilament is 6-12 mu m, the orientation degree of the precursor is 90-96%, the tensile strength after carbonization can reach 4900-5520MPa, and the tensile modulus is 250-330GPa.

title: Preoxidation method for dry-jet wet-spinning polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation method of dry-jet wet-spinning polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor is prepared by a dry-jet wet spinning process, wherein if the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with the monofilament diameter of 7+/-0.5 mu m is prepared, the pre-oxidation treatment is carried out on the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, so that the pre-oxidation degree of the pre-oxidized fiber is as follows: the bulk density is 1.328-1.339g/cm  3  The tensile modulus is 10-11.5GP, the orientation degree is 74-76.3%, the skin ratio of the skin-core structure is 96.8-98.4%, and the linear density is 1630-1639g/km; if the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with the monofilament diameter of 5.5+/-0.5 mu m is prepared, the pre-oxidation degree of the pre-oxidized fiber yarn after pre-oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor is as follows: the bulk density is 1.357-1.369g/cm  3  The tensile modulus is 10.8-12.3GP, the orientation degree is 77.8-79.6%, the skin layer ratio of the skin-core structure is 98.1-99.3%, and the linear density is 1233-1240g/km. The invention is used for providing a control standard of the pre-oxidation degree, so that the carbon fiber with excellent performance can be obtained after the pre-oxidized fiber yarn is carbonized.

title: Hemicellulose/polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a hemicellulose/polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which is characterized in that the hemicellulose/polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared by first blending and granulating the hemicellulose and polyacrylonitrile and spinning by adopting a melt spinning method; and then carrying out the process flows of pre-oxidation, pre-carbonization, post-treatment and the like on the cellulose fiber to obtain the hemicellulose/polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The carbon content of the carbon fiber prepared by the invention reaches more than 93 percent, the tensile strength reaches more than 5.7GPa, the tensile modulus is more than 230GPa, and the fiber diameter is 14-15 μm. The invention adopts hemicellulose as raw material, which has wide source and is renewable resource; the production process is simple, no pollution is caused to the environment, and the production cost of the carbon fiber is greatly reduced.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and discloses a high-strength ultrahigh-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile fibers and carbonizing the polyacrylonitrile fibers at a low temperature to obtain low-temperature carbonized fibers; step 2, carrying out six-temperature zone gradient heating high-temperature carbonization treatment on the low-temperature carbonized fiber, wherein the total draft ratio of the fiber in the high-temperature carbonization treatment process is-7.0% -1.0%, and the total treatment time is 4-12 min, so as to obtain the high-temperature carbonized fiber; and step 3, carrying out ultrahigh-temperature graphitization treatment on the high-temperature carbonized fiber to obtain the high-strength ultrahigh-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The ultra-high modulus carbon fiber with the tensile strength more than or equal to 4000MPa and the tensile modulus more than or equal to 640GPa is prepared by treating the high-temperature carbonized multi-temperature zone, improving the final heat treatment temperature and optimizing the technological parameters such as the draft ratio, the treatment time and the like, has excellent comprehensive performance and has wide application prospect.

title: High-speed preparation method for producing large-tow carbon fibers
abstract: The invention provides a high-speed preparation method for producing large-tow carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of large-tow carbon fiber material preparation. Pre-oxidizing large-tow polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers at a temperature range of 220-300 ℃ in an air atmosphere, performing heat treatment for 45-90 min in an oxidation furnace by adopting 6 gradient temperature rise modes, wherein the temperature gradient is 9 +/-3 ℃, the production speed is 12-15m/min, and the draw ratio is 0.98-1.20 to obtain pre-oxidized filaments of the tow carbon fibers; carrying out low-temperature carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized filaments; and (3) carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment on the carbon fiber subjected to low-temperature carbonization treatment to obtain the large-tow carbon fiber. The tensile strength of the carbon fiber prepared by the method is more than 5000MPa, and the modulus is 240-250 GPa.

title: Preparation method of 25k large-tow carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides 25k large-tow carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber material preparation. The method comprises the steps of placing 25K large-tow polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber in an oxidation furnace in an air atmosphere, and pre-oxidizing at the temperature of 215-280 ℃, wherein the pre-oxidation time is 40-120 min, the production speed is 12-15m/min, the circulating air control of the oxidation furnace is 7-8 m/s, the draft ratio is 1.50-1.80%, so as to obtain pre-oxidized filaments of the tow carbon fiber; and (3) carrying out low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized filaments to obtain the large-tow carbon fibers. The linear density of the carbon fiber obtained by the method is 2.0 +/-0.05 g/m, the tensile strength of the carbon fiber is more than 5.0GPa, and the modulus is 240-260 GPa.

title: Rapid pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors, which mainly solves the technical problems of long oxidation time and high energy consumption in the existing carbon fiber preparation process. Adopting an optimized polymerization formula and proportion, and taking acrylonitrile, acid containing an imine structure and unsaturated ester as raw materials to carry out copolymerization to prepare carbon fiber precursor; the precursor is subjected to gradient heating in a continuous oxidation furnace with two temperature zones in sequence. The pre-oxidation time is reduced to 20-40 min from the conventional 60-90 min, the tensile strength of the carbon fiber is 4527MPa, and the dispersion coefficient of the tensile strength is 1.58%; the tensile modulus is 265GPa, and the dispersion coefficient of the tensile modulus is 0.85 percent, so that a better technical effect is achieved.

title: High-resin-wettability polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with high resin wettability and a preparation method thereof. The invention regulates and controls the molecular weight and the distribution of polyacrylonitrile by adding 2, 3-Dichloropropene (DCP), further controls the viscosity of spinning solution, improves the spinning speed in combination, increases the solidification drafting, regulates the solidification temperature and the concentration condition, combines certain primary and secondary drafting to prepare protofilament, finally realizes the regulation and control of the surface section structure of the carbon fiber by pre-oxidation and carbonization, and realizes the preparation of the high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with the section being nearly circular, the equivalent diameter being 6.5-7.5 mu m, the profile length being more than or equal to 0.45 mu m, the tensile strength being 4.9-5.6 GPa and the tensile modulus being 230-290 GPa. The invention improves the resin wettability of the high-strength carbon fiber, realizes the preparation of the large-diameter high-resin-wettability high-strength medium-mode carbon fiber by optimizing the structure of the carbon fiber, and develops ideas and lays a foundation for improving the interface associativity of the carbon fiber composite material.

abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance carbon fiber which is prepared by the following steps: step S1, preparing a solvent; step S2, preparing polyacrylonitrile fibers; step S3, rinsing; step S4, heat stabilization treatment; step S5, carbonizing; step S6, modifying the surface of the carbon fiber; a method for graphitizing high-performance carbon fibers comprises the following steps: degumming, passivating and graphitizing; according to the invention, sorbic acid is chemically grafted on the surface of the carbon fiber, the graft has good chemical stability and thermal stability, and cannot be removed by water, acid and other substances, so that the corrosion resistance of the carbon fiber is improved, and the intermolecular acting force is far smaller than van der Waals force, so that the tensile strength of the carbon fiber can be obviously improved. The breaking strength and the elastic modulus of the carbon fiber are improved by changing the functional groups on the surface of the carbon fiber, and the carbon fiber is simple to prepare, low in production cost and capable of meeting the requirements of industrial production.

abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers. title: Method of producing carbon fibers from multipurpose commercial fibers
abstract: A method of producing carbon fibers includes the step of providing polyacrylonitrile precursor polymer fiber filaments. The polyacrylonitrile precursor filaments include from 87-97 mole % acrylonitrile, and less than 0.5 mole % of accelerant functional groups. The filaments are no more than 3 deniers per filament. The polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber filaments can be arranged into tows of at least 150,000 deniers per inch width. The arranged polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber tows are stabilized by heating the tows in at least one oxidation zone containing oxygen gas and maintained at a first temperature T1 while stretching the tows at least 10% to yield a stabilized precursor fiber tow. The stabilized precursor fiber tows are carbonized by passing the stabilized precursor fiber tows through a carbonization zone. Carbon fibers produced by the process are also disclosed.

title: Preparation methods of high modulus carbon fiber (HMCF) and precursor (mesophase pitch (MP)) thereof
abstract: Preparation methods of a high modulus carbon fiber (HMCF) and a precursor (mesophase pitch (MP)) thereof are provided. The preparation method of MP includes: separating components with a molecular weight distribution (MWD) of 400 to 1,000 from a heavy oil raw material through size-exclusion chromatography (SEC); subjecting the components to ion-exchange chromatography (IEC) to obtain modified feedstock oil, where, the components are passed through macroporous cation-exchange and anion-exchange resins in sequence to remove acidic and alkaline components; and subjecting the modified feedstock oil to thermal polycondensation and carbonization to obtain high-quality MP with prominent spinnability. With high mesophase content, low softening point, low viscosity, and prominent meltability and spinnability, the obtained MP is a high-quality raw material for preparing HMCFs. The obtained MP can be subjected to melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization, and graphitization to obtain an MP-based HMCF.

abstract: The invention provides a high-speed preparation method for producing large-tow carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of large-tow carbon fiber material preparation. title: Modification of continuous carbon fibers during manufacturing for composites having enhanced moldability
abstract: Methods of producing continuous carbon fibers for composites having enhanced moldability are provided. Discrete regions are introduced into a continuous precursor fiber comprising an acrylic polymer material, such as polyacrylonitrile (PAN) during carbon fiber manufacture. Laser energy may be applied to the precursor fiber while it is in an oven or furnace to create heterogeneous fibers with discrete regions where laser energy is applied. In other aspects, mechanical pressure may be intermittently applied to create the discrete regions. After the continuous precursor fiber is fully heated for carbonization and/or graphitization, the precursor forms a continuous carbon fiber having a plurality of discrete weak regions. These relatively weak regions provide noncontiguous break points that reduce stiffness and improve moldability for carbon fiber polymeric composites, while retaining high strength levels. Carbon fiber polymeric composites incorporating continuous carbon fibers having the plurality of discrete noncontiguous weak regions are also provided.

abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing high-performance carbon fibers and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. The method comprises the following steps: placing polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers in a heat treatment furnace; carrying out hot oxygen stabilization on the polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers, wherein the temperature is set at 180-280 DEG C and the total draft degree is set at 5-12 %; controlling the retention time of the fibers at 17-22 minutes within a temperature region of 265-280 DEG C so as to obtain oxidized fibers; carrying out low temperature and high temperature carbonization treatments on the oxidized fibers so as to prepare carbon fibers; and carrying out low temperature and high temperature carbonization treatments on the fibers with IO values within a range of 33-50 % by using control indexes with oxidation reaction indexes IO in the oxidized fibers as chemical structures so as to prepare the carbon fibers. title: High strength polyacrylonitrile-base carbon fibers having structured surface grooves, and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to high strength carbon fibers having structured surface grooves, and a preparation method thereof. According to the present invention, a wet spinning technology is adopted, and a solvent adopted by polymerization and solidification molding is modified, such that the solvent and the modifying agent form a complex structure so as to improve solidification double-diffusion in the wet spinning solidification molding process to prepare a polyacrylonitrile precursor having a axial structured surface groove structure and a uniform and dense radial structure; and then pre-oxidation structure control is adopted in a pre-oxidation process to prepare the high strength polyacrylonitrile-base carbon fibers having the structured surface groove structure. The carbon fibers of the present invention have high tensile strength and high modulus, and are easily compounded with other materials so as to improve performances of the composite material.

title: Preparation method for high strength high modulus carbon fiber
abstract: A preparation method for high strength high modulus carbon fiber is characterized in that polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber is placed in a thermal treatment furnace at the temperature of 160 to 180 DEG C, thermal treatment time ranges from 4 to 8 minutes, 2 to 12% of draft ration is exerted, and an orientation degree of fa value of a molecular chain of an amorphous region in the polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber serves as a structural control index. Fiber with the fa value ranging from 35 to 45% is selected to be processed through thermal oxidation stabilization, low temperature carbonization and high temperature carbonization to obtain the carbon fiber. Tensile strength of the obtained carbon fiber is higher than 3.6 GPa, and tensile modulus of the obtained carbon fiber is higher than 240 GPa.

title: Method for preparing high-performance carbon fibers
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing high-performance carbon fibers and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. The method comprises the following steps: placing polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers in a heat treatment furnace; carrying out hot oxygen stabilization on the polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibers, wherein the temperature is set at 180-280 DEG C and the total draft degree is set at 5-12 %; controlling the retention time of the fibers at 17-22 minutes within a temperature region of 265-280 DEG C so as to obtain oxidized fibers; carrying out low temperature and high temperature carbonization treatments on the oxidized fibers so as to prepare carbon fibers; and carrying out low temperature and high temperature carbonization treatments on the fibers with IO values within a range of 33-50 % by using control indexes with oxidation reaction indexes IO in the oxidized fibers as chemical structures so as to prepare the carbon fibers. According to the invention, the tensile strength of the prepared carbon fiber is higher than 3.5 GPa and the Young modulus of the prepared carbon fiber is higher than 250 GPa.

title: Binary copolymerized polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber spinning solution and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a binary copolymerized polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber spinning solution and a preparation method thereof. The spinning solution is prepared by taking dimethyl sulfoxide as a solvent, azodiisobutyronitrile as an initiator and acrylonitrile and itaconic acid as polymer monomers. The spinning solution is subjected to wet spinning, coagulating and molding, coagulation bath drafting, water washing, hot water dragging, oil coating, drying and compacting, saturated pressurized steam drafting, steam shaping and after-treatment, thereby obtaining a polyacrylonitrile protofilament. According to the testing, the monofilament tensile strength of the polyacrylonitrile protofilament is from 6.0 to 6.7 CN/dtex; the tensile modulus is from 100 to 110 N/dtex; the elongation at break is from 13.5 to 14.6%; the boiling water shrinkage is from 6.0 to 6.5%; the oil content rate is from 0.6 to 1.0%; and the fineness is 1.152 to 1.176 dtex. Under the observation of a microphotograph, the protofilament is round and bright in cross section and free of generating pores and holes. Based on the testing of preoxidation and carbonization, the strength of carbon fibers is from 3.8 to 4.2 GPa.

title: 6k polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre manufacturing method
abstract: The invention provides a 6k polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre manufacturing method, which employs a routine method for obtaining a protofilament, and the carbon fiber is obtained by pre-oxidation, low temperature carbonization and high temperature carbonization of the protofilament. A spinning stock solution of the present invention employs a four-element formula, thereby improving the homogenization degree of the spinning stock solution in the solidification moulding process, and minimizing the performance variation coefficient of the protofilament. A copolymerization monomer is added during pre-oxidation, and reaction speeds of pre-oxidation and carbonization are increased, and the loop strength and modulus of carbon fiber are increased with smaller coefficient of variation by employing a low-carbon low-temperature and high draft ratio, and the tensile strength of the carbon fiber is substantially improved. In the low temperature and high temperature carbonization process, the matching of temperature and draft ratio is adjusted, thereby the tension force of the fiber in the operation process reaches the expected requirements that the low temperature carbonization tension force is 600CN and the high temperature carbonization tension force is 640CN, and the tension force of fiber in the operation process is increased, and the fiber orientation degree is improved, and the molecular arrangement is more dense, and the carbon fiber intensity is increased.

title: High-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber preparation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers, and especially relates to a high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber preparation method. The high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber preparation method comprises the following steps: 1, mixing acrylonitrile, an oil-soluble azo initiator, a copolymerization monomer and an alcoholic end-capping reagent, and carrying out a heating reaction in a dimethyl sulfoxide organic solvent to a spinning stock solution; 2, carrying out demonomerization and foam removal of the spinning stock solution obtained in step 1 to prepare a spinning solution, and spinning the spinning solution to obtain a carbon fiber precursor; and 3, and carrying out preliminary oxidation charring of the carbon fiber precursor obtained in step 2 to obtain a carbon fiber. The bulk density, tensile strength and tensile modulus of the carbon fiber obtained through the preparation method are 1.7-1.8g/cm<3>, above 4.9GPa and above 230GPa.

title: Carbon fibres, carbon fibre precursors and production thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for the continuous production of high-strength endless filament yarns with a compact, especially homogeneous structural morphology based on polyacrylonitrile for carbon fibre precursors, which are produced on the basis of this method, and relates to carbon fibres that can be obtained by carbonization of the carbon fibre precursors. The fibres are formed from polymer solutions in ionic fluids as part of a wet or dry-wet process. In the production of yarns and filaments, there is a further stretching of the freshly formed elements immediately after precipitation in an organic solvent or a diluted aqueous solution of the respective ionic fluid or in a saturation vapour zone. The precursor yarns and filaments obtained primarily have an increased tear resistance with simultaneously sufficient elongation, a round cross-section and a compact, especially homogeneous fibre morphology and are particularly well-suited for further processing and production of high-strength carbon fibres for technical applications in composite materials. Carbon fibres produced in this manner are also characterized by a tensile strength in the range of 3.0 to 8.5 GPa, an elongation at rupture in the range of 0.5 to 3.0%, a modulus of elasticity between 100 and 600 MPa, and a titer of 0.1 to 3.0 dtex.

title: Method for producing high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for producing a carbon fiber, by which the carbon fiber not having a difference between the structures of inner and outer layers and having a high tensile strength and a high tensile elastic modulus can simply be produced.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for producing the carbon fiber comprises preparing a spinning dope comprising a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer and carbon nanotubes dispersed in the polyacrylonitrile-based polymer, spinning and drawing the spinning dope to produce a carbon fiber precursor, and then subjecting the precursor to a fire-resisting treatment and a carbonization treatment. In the method. the fire-resisting treatment is performed by irradiating the carbon fiber precursor with energy rays. The carbon fiber is characterized in that Ro/Ri is 0.5-2.0, wherein Ro and Ri are the G/D ratios of the outermost layer and innermost layer of the fiber, respectively, determined with Raman spectrum.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Method of producing carbon fibers, and methods of making protective clothing and a filter module
abstract: Porous carbon fibers, whose active centers are formed by pores that are filled at least in part by carbon and/or metal and/or metal carbide, obtainable by carbonization of organic or inorganic polymers, the use thereof for the adsorption or separation of gaseous substances, in particular of CO 2 , and also a method for the production thereof. First, a spinning mixture containing polyacrylonitrile-based polymer A and an organic or metallo-organic polymer B is produced. Next, the spinning mixture is spun to form mixed fibers of polymer A and polymer B. The mixed fiber is stabilized by oxidation. This is followed by carbonization or graphitization of the mixed fiber under non-oxidizing conditions in such a way that the polymer B forms a carbon and/or metal and/or metal carbide residue of at least 22 wt %, the residue forming active centers.

title: Acrylic nitrile-containing polymerization composition for carbon fibre and preparation thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an acrylonitrile polymer composite prepared through polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, carbon fiber precursors and carbon fibers prepared through the polymer composites, as well as the preparation methods for the carbon fiber precursors and carbon fibers. In particular, the polymer composite of the invention comprises a acrylonitrile-containing composite and an alkaline compound, the carbon fiber precursors and carbon fibers prepared through the polymer composite, and the preparation methods. With the methods of the invention, precursor fibers with high density and regular surface groove structures can be obtained without increasing the spinning draw-down ratio, or even under the condition of reducing the draw-down ratio appropriately; the volume density of precursor fibers can reach 1.19g/cm3 or more; through preoxidized carbonization, the precursor fibers can obtain high-performance carbon fibers with volume density exceeding 1.78g/cm3, the tensile strength surpassing 4.9GPa, and the tensile modulus greater than 230GPa.

abstract: Activated porous carbon fibers, whose active centers are formed by pores that are filled at least in part by carbon and/or metal and/or metal carbide, obtainable by carbonization of organic or inorganic polymers, the use thereof for the adsorption or separation of gaseous substances, in particular of CO 2 , and also a method for the production thereof. The method includes the following steps. The first step is production of a spinning mixture containing polyacrylonitrile-based polymer A and an organic or metallo-organic polymer B. The next step is spinning of the spinning mixture to form mixed fibers of polymer A and polymer B. The next step is stabilization of the mixed fiber by oxidation. title: Preparation method of carbon fiber based on electron beam irradiation
abstract: A preparation method of carbon fiber based on electron beam irradiation comprises the steps of winding large-tow polyacrylonitrile fiber onto two parallel guide rollers to form spiral coils to form a plurality of parallel wires, simultaneously irradiating the plurality of parallel wires through an irradiation window of an electron accelerator, simultaneously starting traction equipment to traction the large-tow polyacrylonitrile fiber, enabling each parallel wire to repeatedly pass through the irradiation window of the electron accelerator, carrying out intermittent periodic electron beam irradiation under an air atmosphere to obtain an irradiation modified PAN precursor, continuously connecting or transferring the irradiation modified PAN precursor onto a carbon fiber production line, carrying out rapid pre-oxidation by a multi-temperature-zone pre-oxidation furnace to obtain pre-oxidized wires, and sequentially carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized wires in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain high-performance large-tow carbon fiber, wherein the number of filaments of the high-performance large-tow carbon fiber is greater than or equal to 24K. Compared with the prior art, the method can successfully and effectively introduce the electron beam irradiation technology into the production process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber paper with gradient pore diameter structure for fuel cell gas diffusion layer and carbon fiber paper obtained by preparation method
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbon fiber paper for a fuel cell gas diffusion layer with a gradient pore diameter structure and the carbon fiber paper, wherein the method comprises the steps of preparing polyacrylonitrile and N, N-dimethylacetamide into a plurality of mixed solutions with different mass fractions of the polyacrylonitrile according to preset mass; and (3) placing the mixed solution into electrostatic spinning equipment to continuously perform electrostatic spinning for a plurality of times to form an electrostatic spinning fiber membrane, and sequentially performing preoxidation, carbonization and graphitization processes on the electrostatic spinning fiber membrane to obtain the carbon fiber paper. According to the invention, the polyacrylonitrile solution with different mass fractions is sequentially replaced to continuously carry out electrostatic spinning, so that the carbon fiber paper with multiple layers of apertures with different sizes is obtained, the ideal combination of high porosity and low resistivity is realized, and meanwhile, the mechanical property is improved, so that the fuel cell can maintain higher and more stable voltage output especially under the high-power density running condition.

title: PH/temperature dual-responsiveness polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer, preparation method of precursor, preparation method of carbon fiber, carbon fiber and application
abstract: The invention discloses a pH/temperature dual-responsiveness polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer, a preparation method of a precursor, a preparation method of a carbon fiber, a carbon fiber and an application, wherein the preparation method of the pH/temperature dual-responsiveness polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the steps of synthesizing the pH/temperature dual-responsiveness polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer, then co-dissolving the copolymer, a cross-linking agent and an initiator in a solvent to prepare spinning solution, synchronously completing fiber forming and cross-linking network construction in a low-temperature coagulation bath through an innovative 'thermal phase separation-in-situ cross-linking' wet spinning technology, and finally obtaining intelligent response-type carbon fiber through multistage thermal cross-linking solidification, pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment. The invention successfully solves the field problem that the stimulus responsiveness is difficult to be reserved in the high-temperature carbonization process through molecular design and process innovation, and the obtained carbon fiber has excellent mechanical property and sensitive reversible pH/temperature dual response characteristic, and has great application value in the field of intelligent materials.

title: Preparation method of N/O/Bi co-doped carbon nanofiber electrode material and application of N/O/Bi co-doped carbon nanofiber electrode material in iron-chromium flow battery
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of battery materials and energy storage, and particularly relates to an application of a preparation method of an N\O\Bi co-doped carbon nanofiber electrode material in an iron-chromium flow battery. Bismuth ammonium citrate is used as a functional component and added into a solution of polyacrylonitrile and N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare an electrospinning precursor solution. The polyacrylonitrile-based three-dimensional nanofiber containing bismuth ammonium citrate is prepared by utilizing an electrostatic spinning technology, and then the obtained fiber is subjected to pre-oxidation and carbonization, and in the process, active functional components of nitrogen, oxygen and bismuth can be simultaneously introduced into the carbon fiber by utilizing the pyrolysis of the bismuth ammonium citrate, so that the carbon nanofiber electrode material is endowed with high hydrogen evolution overpotential and good electrocatalytic activity. The material can fully exert the synergistic effect of all components when used for the anode material of the iron-chromium flow battery, and effectively improve the energy conversion efficiency and the rate capability of the battery. The method is simple, efficient and suitable for large-scale production, and has wide application prospect.
assignee: 辽宁大学

title: Preparation method of flame-retardant heat-insulating carbon fiber with three-dimensional cage carbon structure
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of flame-retardant heat-insulating carbon fibers with a three-dimensional cage carbon structure, and belongs to the technical field of composite flame-retardant materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and dispersing epoxy resin, cage-shaped polysilsesquioxane and dimethylacetamide to form a mixed solution, mixing the mixed solution, a curing agent, an accelerator and a coupling modifier to form a mixed spinning solution, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the mixed spinning solution to obtain a nanofiber felt, carrying out preoxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain carbon fibers, carrying out anodic oxidation treatment on the carbon fibers to obtain pretreated carbon fibers, dip-coating a sizing agent on the pretreated carbon fibers to obtain modified carbon fibers, and carrying out hot press molding on the modified carbon fibers and the nanofiber felt after being bonded by a flame-retardant fire-extinguishing adhesive to obtain the flame-retardant heat-insulating carbon fibers. The flame-retardant heat-insulating carbon fiber prepared by the method has good flame-retardant heat-insulating performance and good mechanical performance.
assignee: 合肥微神科技有限公司

title: Carbon fiber paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cell gas diffusion layers, and provides carbon fiber paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein an acrylonitrile-N-4-pyridyl-2-acrylamide copolymer and N, N-dimethylformamide are mixed to obtain an electrostatic spinning solution; the preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out electrostatic spinning on an electrostatic spinning solution to obtain a polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt to obtain a polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized felt, and sequentially carrying out drying, hot-press solidification, carbonization and graphitization on the polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized felt after being immersed in a resin solution to obtain the carbon fiber paper. The invention also provides application of the carbon fiber paper in a proton exchange membrane fuel cell gas diffusion layer. According to the invention, the polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt with different thicknesses is prepared by adopting an electrostatic spinning technology, so that the ultrathin thickness and controllable preparation of the carbon fiber paper are realized, and the carbon fiber paper has excellent conductivity, so that the carbon fiber paper has a good effect in a proton exchange membrane fuel cell.
assignee: 东华大学

title: Preparation method of high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-performance graphene-based carbon fibers, which comprises the following steps of (1) dispersing graphene oxide powder in an organic solvent to form uniform dispersion liquid, adding an ammonia source into the dispersion liquid to form corresponding mixed liquid, and obtaining amino graphene powder, (2) dissolving the amino graphene powder in the organic solvent to form the dispersion liquid, fully immersing polyacrylonitrile fibers in the formed dispersion liquid to obtain polyacrylonitrile fibers infiltrated with amino graphene, (3) performing pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fibers infiltrated with amino graphene to form nitride composite fibers, (4) continuously performing cross-linking carbonization on the nitride composite fibers at a high temperature of 1000-1300 ℃ to form composite carbon fiber materials, and then further increasing the temperature to 1400-1800 ℃ to perform graphitization treatment to form graphene-based carbon fibers with high crystallinity. The graphene-based carbon fiber preparation scheme provided by the invention can be used for preparing the high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber, and the graphene-based carbon fiber has high strength and high conductivity.
assignee: 上海骐杰新材料股份有限公司

title: Method for preparing mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber by using coal pitch
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal tar oil separation and utilization, and relates to a method for preparing mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers by using coal tar pitch, which comprises the following steps of 1) taking medium-low temperature coal tar pitch as a raw material under a nitrogen atmosphere, and alternately performing polycondensation reaction and hydrogenation reaction to obtain mesophase pitch; 2) purifying the mesophase pitch by using pyridine insoluble substances to obtain spinnable mesophase pitch, 3) dissolving polyacrylonitrile, a composite additive and the spinnable mesophase pitch in a dimethyl sulfoxide solvent to obtain spinnable sol, and 4) sequentially carrying out melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization on the spinnable sol to obtain the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber. The invention synthesizes mesophase pitch through a hydrogenation polycondensation process, then is co-dissolved with polyacrylonitrile and a composite additive in dimethyl sulfoxide to form sol, and then is subjected to melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization in sequence to obtain the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber with compact transverse section, excellent mechanical property and higher conductivity.
assignee: 陕西榆能集团能源化工研究院有限公司

title: Preparation method of bismuth nitride co-doped porous graphite felt, graphite felt prepared by preparation method and application of graphite felt
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a nitrogen-bismuth co-doped porous graphite felt, a graphite felt prepared by the same and application of the graphite felt, and relates to the technical field of all-vanadium redox flow batteries. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out needling treatment on polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber to obtain PAN-based carbon fiber soft felt, dissolving polyacrylonitrile, urea and bismuth salt in a solvent to obtain a precursor solution, spraying the precursor solution on the PAN-based carbon fiber soft felt through a solution spraying spinning process, drying to obtain a spinning substrate, and carrying out pre-carbonization treatment, carbonization treatment and graphitization treatment on the spinning substrate in sequence to obtain the nitrogen-bismuth co-doped porous graphite felt. The porous graphite felt structure of the invention can greatly improve the specific surface area of the graphite felt, improve the enhanced hydrophilicity, increase the conductivity of the graphite felt and increase the surface functional groups, thereby being beneficial to improving the efficiency of the vanadium redox flow battery.
assignee: 浙江星辉新材料科技有限公司

title: Preparation method of hollow section polyacrylonitrile dry-jet wet-spinning carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of hollow section polyacrylonitrile dry-jet wet-spinning carbon fiber. The method comprises the steps of extruding spinning solution through a spinneret plate with an annular cavity, entering a coagulating bath, carrying out multistage desalting and water washing, hot water drafting, oiling, drying and densification, winding and filament collecting after steam drafting to obtain a hollow section precursor, and carrying out preoxidation, low-temperature furnace and high-temperature furnace carbonization on the hollow section precursor to obtain the dry-jet wet-spun carbon fiber with a hollow section. The preparation method is simple, the effective control of the hollow-section polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber structure is realized by controlling the structure of the spinneret plate with the annular cavity and the subsequent process conditions, and the prepared hollow-section carbon fiber has the advantages of high specific surface area, low sheath-core ratio, low cost and the like, and has wide application prospects in the fields of wave-absorbing materials, electromagnetic shielding materials, resin-based composite materials, carbon/carbon composite materials and the like.

abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of hollow section polyacrylonitrile dry-jet wet-spinning carbon fiber. The method comprises the steps of extruding spinning solution through a spinneret plate with an annular cavity, entering a coagulating bath, carrying out multistage desalting and water washing, hot water drafting, oiling, drying and densification, winding and filament collecting after steam drafting to obtain a hollow section precursor, and carrying out preoxidation, low-temperature furnace and high-temperature furnace carbonization on the hollow section precursor to obtain the dry-jet wet-spun carbon fiber with a hollow section. title: Coal-based hollow carbon fiber membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a coal-based hollow carbon fiber membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of water treatment, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of collecting a hollow fiber precursor on an aluminum foil by a coaxial electrostatic spinning method according to the push injection speed ratio of a shell spinning solution to a core spinning solution of 18:1-6, and then sequentially carrying out air low-temperature pre-oxidation and high-temperature carbonization treatment under inert gas to obtain the coal-based hollow carbon fiber membrane; wherein the shell spinning solution contains oxidized coal and polyacrylonitrile, and the core spinning solution contains polystyrene. The invention prepares coal-based hollow carbon fibers with different inner diameters by fixing the injection speed of the shell spinning solution and adjusting the injection speed of the core spinning solution, wherein the hollow structure carbon fiber membrane has larger specific surface area, can provide more active sites so as to improve the deionized capacity and efficiency, and the oxidized coal modified hollow carbon fiber can be used for preparing an electrode material without a binder, reduces the use of an inactive material, builds a three-dimensional conductive network to improve the conductivity of an electrode, enhances the structural integrity of the electrode under the action of mechanical stress, and remarkably improves the cycle service life of the electrode.
assignee: 新疆大学
inventors: WANG LUXIANG; ZHANG DAN; MA QINGTAO; JIA DIANZENG; LENG CHANGYU

abstract: The invention discloses a coal-based hollow carbon fiber membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of water treatment, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of collecting a hollow fiber precursor on an aluminum foil by a coaxial electrostatic spinning method according to the push injection speed ratio of a shell spinning solution to a core spinning solution of 18:1-6, and then sequentially carrying out air low-temperature pre-oxidation and high-temperature carbonization treatment under inert gas to obtain the coal-based hollow carbon fiber membrane; wherein the shell spinning solution contains oxidized coal and polyacrylonitrile, and the core spinning solution contains polystyrene. The invention prepares coal-based hollow carbon fibers with different inner diameters by fixing the injection speed of the shell spinning solution and adjusting the injection speed of the core spinning solution, wherein the hollow structure carbon fiber membrane has larger specific surface area, can provide more active sites so as to improve the deionized capacity and efficiency, and the oxidized coal modified hollow carbon fiber can be used for preparing an electrode material without a binder, reduces the use of an inactive material, builds a three-dimensional conductive network to improve the conductivity of an electrode, enhances the structural integrity of the electrode under the action of mechanical stress, and remarkably improves the cycle service life of the electrode.

title: Graphene reinforced polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a graphene reinforced polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding a metal salt solution into a graphene oxide dispersion liquid with negative charges to prepare a graphene oxide dispersion liquid with positive charges, soaking polyacrylonitrile fibers in a strong acid solution with oxidability to acidify the graphene oxide dispersion liquid to obtain acidified polyacrylonitrile fibers, soaking the acidified polyacrylonitrile fibers in the graphene oxide dispersion liquid with positive charges, drying after soaking, soaking in the graphene oxide dispersion liquid, drying after soaking, and sequentially performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization on the graphene oxide-coated polyacrylonitrile fibers to obtain the graphene reinforced polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers.

title: Composite fiber textile and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of textile manufacturing, in particular to a preparation method of a composite fiber textile, which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting and preparing raw materials, S1-1, selecting high-strength carbon fibers as an inner rib material, slowly passing Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) precursor through a pre-oxidation furnace with the temperature controlled at 200-300 ℃ at the speed of 0.5-1m/min for 1-2 hours, heating the pre-oxidized fibers to 1000-1500 ℃ at the heating rate of 5-10 ℃/min under the protection of inert gas, and performing a series of fine processes such as pre-oxidation, carbonization, surface treatment and the like on the pre-oxidized fibers.
assignee: 杭州睿典布艺有限公司

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber and carbon fiber
abstract: The disclosure provides a preparation method of carbon fiber and the carbon fiber. The preparation method of the carbon fiber comprises the steps of preparing a polymerization stock solution by polymerization of a first monomer, a second monomer and a third monomer with preset mass ratio, spinning and forming the polymerization stock solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based precursor with preset densification degree, carrying out multistage pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor to obtain pre-oxidized fiber, and carrying out carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber. According to the preparation method of the carbon fiber, the polymerization stock solution is prepared through polymerization reaction, and the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor is obtained through spinning and forming of the polymerization stock solution, and has the preset densification degree, so that the permeability of oxygen element in the polyacrylonitrile precursor in the subsequent pre-oxidation treatment process is controlled, the pre-oxidation degree of the pre-oxidized fiber in the pre-oxidation treatment process is controlled, and the mechanical property of the prepared carbon fiber is guaranteed.

title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises (1) copolymerizing acrylonitrile and acrylamide to obtain a polymer spinning solution; the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) sequentially carrying out spinning, coagulation forming, primary drawing, water washing, oiling, drying, secondary drawing and heat setting on the polymer spinning solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile precursor, and (3) sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber. Therefore, the radial structure difference of the primary fiber can be effectively controlled by adopting the method, the radial structure of the obtained primary fiber is more uniform, and the radially uniform polyacrylonitrile precursor is obtained, so that the prepared carbon fiber has more excellent performance or thicker diameter, and simultaneously, the ammonification process link is omitted.

title: Conversion medium for treating nitrogen oxides and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application discloses a conversion medium for treating nitrogen oxides, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of tail gas treatment. The method takes specific pine branch and leaf-based active porous carbon as a carrier to load a manganese source in advance, then takes the manganese source as precursor particles to be compounded with polyacrylonitrile for electrostatic spinning to prepare a composite fiber membrane, and can prepare a conversion medium with special configuration fiber after specific oxidation-carbonization treatment, in the product, manganese dioxide with catalytic activity is limited in the inner core due to the cage effect of the pine branch and leaf-based active porous carbon, based on the synergistic effect of the pine branch and leaf-based active porous carbon carrier and the externally coated carbon fiber, the high-efficiency catalytic oxidation and adsorption of nitrogen oxides can be realized at normal temperature, the conversion medium can be regenerated after conventional heating treatment, the service life is long, and the application cost performance is high.

title: PI/PAN coaxial composite base carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides PI/PAN coaxial composite base carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1, taking polyamide acid polymer solution as core layer spinning solution and polyacrylonitrile polymer solution as shell layer spinning solution, and preparing PAA/PAN fiber through a coaxial spinning process; and 2, performing pre-oxidation and imidization treatment on the PAA/PAN fibers to obtain PI/PAN fibers, and performing carbonization treatment or carbonization and graphitization treatment on the PI/PAN fibers to obtain the PI/PAN coaxial composite base carbon fibers. The PI core layer and the PAN shell layer have a synergistic effect, so that the PI/PAN coaxial composite base carbon fiber has higher graphitization degree and higher heat conduction performance.

title: Amorphous cathode material of battery, preparation method of amorphous cathode material and battery
abstract: The application discloses a battery amorphous negative electrode material, a preparation method thereof and a battery, and belongs to the technical field of new energy, wherein the preparation method of the battery amorphous negative electrode material comprises the steps of stirring polyacrylonitrile and dimethylformamide under a first preset condition to obtain a sol-gel solution, adding bismuth salt and antimony salt into the sol-gel solution, stirring for preset time to uniformly disperse the bismuth salt and the antimony salt to obtain a sol-gel solution containing metal ions, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the sol-gel solution containing the metal ions under a second preset condition to obtain a film precursor material, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the film precursor material in air to obtain a pre-treated material, carrying out carbonization and reduction treatment on the pre-treated material under a third preset condition to obtain a carbonized material, carrying out vulcanization treatment on the carbonized material to obtain a carbon fiber wrapped nano alloy material, and carrying out heating and pressurizing treatment on the carbon fiber wrapped nano alloy material to obtain the carbon fiber wrapped amorphous nano alloy sulfide material.

title: Carbon fiber paper based on asphalt/polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber paper, and provides carbon fiber paper based on asphalt/polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps of sequentially stirring, mixing and defoaming a soluble asphalt solution and an acrylonitrile-itaconic acid copolymer solution, carrying out electrostatic spinning on an electrostatic spinning solution, sequentially drying an asphalt/polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt, carrying out program pre-oxidation to obtain a pre-oxidized felt, immersing the pre-oxidized felt in a resin solution, and sequentially carrying out drying, hot-press solidification, carbonization and graphitization. According to the invention, the soluble asphalt component is introduced into the electrospinning stock solution, so that the distribution of graphite microcrystals in the carbon fiber is regulated and controlled by utilizing the characteristic that polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon is easy to form carbon crystals at high temperature, and further the electron transfer performance of carbon fiber paper is improved, the synchronous and accurate regulation and control of electric conduction, ventilation and thickness ultrathin are realized, and the method has a good application effect in fuel cells.
assignee: 东华大学
inventors: JU ANQI; DU JIANG; WANG MINGLEI

title: Preparation method of graphene composite bulletproof material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a graphene composite bulletproof material, which belongs to the technical field of bulletproof material preparation, wherein polyacrylonitrile is used as a carbon fiber precursor, PMMA microspheres are coated with zinc oxide to be used as a pyrolysis template, carbon fibers with porous structures are prepared through high-temperature carbonization, polydopamine and graphene oxide are adopted to carry out surface modification on the porous carbon fibers, and after gamma-methacryloxypropyl trimethoxysilane treatment, the interface bonding strength of the graphene oxide and a matrix is obviously improved, the problem of insufficient energy dissipation caused by interface failure in the ballistic impact process is effectively avoided, so that the buffer capacity of the composite material to high-speed impact load is obviously improved, and the zinc oxide nanospheres have excellent heat conductivity, can obviously improve the heat conduction efficiency in the pre-oxidation process, and avoid the problems of long reaction time, low efficiency and high production cost in the traditional pre-oxidation process.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The application provides a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber manufacturing. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber comprises the following steps of S1 providing a polyalcohol compound, then adopting a halogenating reagent to react with the polyalcohol compound to enable at least part of hydroxyl groups in the polyalcohol compound to be halogenated to obtain an initiator, S2 carrying out atom transfer radical polymerization reaction on the initiator, an acrylonitrile monomer and a catalyst in a solvent to obtain a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, S3 carrying out spinning treatment on the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to obtain a polyacrylonitrile precursor, S4 carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber, and S5 carrying out carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber.

title: Lignin-based carbon fiber for electromagnetic wave absorbing material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomass resource high-value utilization and electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, and discloses lignin-based carbon fibers for an electromagnetic wave absorbing material, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, lignin as an industrial byproduct is used as a raw material, carbon fiber with a defective structure is prepared by combining electrostatic spinning with a magnetic metal doping process, and the carbon fiber is further compounded with magnetic metal particles to construct an electromagnetic wave absorption composite material. Specifically, polyacrylonitrile and lignin are used as carbon sources, N, N-dimethylformamide is used as a spinning auxiliary agent, metal salt is combined, lignin-based carbon fiber precursors prepared by electrostatic spinning of lignin and polyacrylonitrile solution at room temperature are prepared, and then lignin-based carbon fibers for electromagnetic wave absorption composite materials are prepared by vacuum drying, pre-oxidation and carbonization. Meanwhile, lignin waste is converted into a high-performance electromagnetic wave absorbing material in the preparation process, and meanwhile, consumption of solvents, energy sources and auxiliary reagents is reduced, so that the method accords with the concept of green chemistry and sustainable development.
assignee: 广东工业大学

title: Polyacrylonitrile/lignin composite carbon fiber spinning solution, precursor fiber, composite carbon fiber and composite activated carbon
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile/lignin composite carbon fiber spinning solution, precursor fibers, composite carbon fibers and composite activated carbon. The spinning solution is prepared by the steps of S1, dissolving polyacrylonitrile and lignin in a solvent, wherein the total solid content of the polyacrylonitrile and the lignin is 12-25 wt%, S2, filtering out insoluble matters, carrying out mechanical stirring at 50-95 ℃ for 100rpm/min for reaction for 12 hours, S3, drying and defoaming. The method combines the dealkalized lignin and Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) through a dry-jet wet spinning technology, successfully prepares the low-cost high-performance carbon fiber through coagulation bath parameter optimization and different-temperature pre-oxidation-high-temperature carbonization process regulation and control, has remarkable advantages in mechanical and electrical properties, and provides a sustainable development technical path for the green carbon fiber in the fields of structural engineering and lightweight composite materials.
assignee: 宁夏大学
inventors: GAO QUAN; WANG ZHIHAN; ZHOU YONGFA; XU YUNXIANG; Shu Longjiang; HONG TIANXIANG

title: Carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of applying tension of 50MPa-500MPa, carrying out pre-cyclization treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor under inert atmosphere to obtain pre-cyclization fiber, and carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the pre-cyclization fiber in sequence to obtain the carbon fiber. Therefore, the method can be used for considering the thermal stability of the fiber in the pre-oxidation process and avoiding the defect caused by excessive oxidation, thereby obtaining the high-performance carbon fiber.

title: Degradable polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application relates to a degradable polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber manufacturing. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out copolymerization reaction on acrylonitrile and functional monomers containing ester groups to obtain spinning solution, spinning the spinning solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile precursor, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor in sequence, and carrying out surface activation treatment by adopting hydrogen peroxide to obtain the degradable polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The degradable polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared by copolymerizing acrylonitrile and a functional monomer containing an ester group, introducing a degradable ester bond into a polyacrylonitrile molecular chain, constructing a hydrolytic breaking point, performing surface activation treatment on hydrogen peroxide after pyrolysis, etching the fiber surface to generate micropores, and selectively oxidizing the fiber surface to form carboxyl groups, so that the prepared degradable polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has a short degradation period and an adjustable degradation rate while keeping high strength.

title: Preparation method for high-performance, low-cost carbon fiber
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for preparing high-performance and low-cost carbon fiber, relating to the technical field of carbon fiber and carbon fiber preparation. The method for preparing high-performance and low-cost carbon fiber includes: providing polyacrylonitrile precursor; passing the polyacrylonitrile precursor through a plurality of temperature zones in sequence to perform a pre-oxidation process treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor, to obtain pre-oxidized fiber, and an aromatization index of the polyacrylonitrile precursor increasing with an equal magnitude when the polyacrylonitrile precursor is passed through the plurality of temperature zones in sequence; and performing a carbonization process treatment on the pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber.
