title: Process for producing carbon fiber materials for separating CO2 or NH3 from gas mixtures, carbon fiber materials and its use
abstract:
A method for producing a carbon fiber material is disclosed, the method comprising the steps of
         a) Preparation of a solution of polyacrylonitrile in a suitable organic solvent   b) Electrospinning of the solution obtained in a) and drying of the obtained fiber material   c) Crosslinking of the obtained fiber material by heating to 150 to 350° C. in an air or oxygen atmosphere for 1 to 30 h   d) Carbonization of the obtained fiber material in an inert gas atmosphere at a temperature in the range of 500 to 2,500° C.,       characterized in that   no silicon, sulfur, metal compounds, intermetallic compounds, silicon compounds and/or sulfur compounds are added to the polyacrylonitrile solution in step a) and that neither stabilization nor surface modification steps are carried out with the fiber material by treatment with chemical reagents and/or exposure to tensile stress.   

     Also disclosed is a carbon fiber material obtainable by the above process, as well as a carbon fiber material, characterized in that it has a proportion of ultramicropores V <0.4 nm  of 0.01 to 10, more preferably 0.02 to 5, even more preferably 0.025 to 0.1, most preferably 0.03 to 0.06 cm 3 /g, determined by CO 2  adsorption tests and evaluation with DFT and GC-MC simulation.

title: Preparation method for high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber
abstract: A preparation method for a high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber, comprising the following steps: (1) dispersing graphene oxide powder in an organic solvent to form a uniform dispersion liquid, adding an ammonia source into the dispersion liquid to form a corresponding mixed solution, and obtaining aminated graphene powder; (2) dissolving the aminated graphene powder in an organic solvent to form a dispersion liquid, and fully soaking a polyacrylonitrile fiber in the formed dispersion liquid to obtain the polyacrylonitrile fiber infiltrated with aminated graphene; (3) performing pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fiber infiltrated with aminated graphene, so as to form a nitride composite fiber; and (4) continuously performing cross-linking carbonization on the nitride composite fiber at a high temperature of 1000-1300°C to form a composite carbon fiber material, and then heating to 1400-1800°C to perform graphitization treatment to form the graphene-based carbon fiber having high crystallinity. The graphene-based carbon fiber prepared by the preparation method has high strength and high conductivity.

title: Pre-oxidation equipment of polyacrylonitrile precursor wire head and wire head connecting method
abstract: The invention relates to pre-oxidation equipment of a polyacrylonitrile precursor filament head, which comprises a hot air circulation oven and a filament bundle tension frame; the inside of the hot air circulation oven is divided into a pre-oxidation cavity, a return air cavity and an air inlet cavity; the pre-oxidation cavity, the return air cavity and the air inlet cavity form a communicated air flow channel, a fan and a heater are arranged in the air inlet cavity, an inlet and an outlet are arranged on the side face of the hot air circulation oven, a sealing door is arranged at the inlet and outlet, and a tow tension frame extending into the hot air circulation oven from the inlet and outlet is positioned in the pre-oxidation cavity; the tow tension frame is provided with a tension adjuster for clamping the tow, the tow passes through the tension adjuster, and the free end of the tow is fixed on the tow tension frame. The invention also relates to a wire head connecting method, and the pre-oxidation equipment can realize the pre-oxidation of the high-quality wire head, thereby laying a foundation for the subsequent air connection of two high-quality wire bundles. The method for connecting the wire heads can completely and smoothly realize continuous production of large-tow carbon fibers through the pre-oxidation and carbonization procedures.
assignee: 广州赛奥碳纤维技术有限公司

title: Nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber, preparation method and application
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber, which has the diameter of 90-135 mu m, the nitrogen content of 10-20%, the oxygen content of 8-15%, and a lotus root-shaped pore canal structure inside, and is prepared by the following preparation method: carrying out wet spinning on the polyacrylonitrile/polyimide acid precursor mixed solution to obtain a composite fiber precursor; and (3) performing preoxidation-imidization treatment and carbonization treatment on the composite fiber precursor to obtain the nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber. According to the invention, polyimide acid is introduced into the polyacrylonitrile solution, the phase separation process in the heat treatment process is controlled by adjusting the proportion of polyimide formed after imidization of polyacrylonitrile and polyimide acid, so that the nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber with a lotus-root-shaped pore structure is prepared, the hetero-atom self-doping of the porous carbon fiber is realized, and the porous carbon fiber can be used for rapidly and efficiently adsorbing carbon dioxide in a simulated flue gas environment and can be applied to the field of carbon dioxide adsorption.
assignee: 中国科学院宁波材料技术与工程研究所

title: Modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method for preparing the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the steps of sequentially adding dicyandiamide and phosphoric acid into a solution of an acrylonitrile polymer to obtain a modified spinning solution; spinning the modified spinning solution to obtain modified precursor; and carrying out heat treatment on the modified precursor under inert atmosphere, and then carrying out air oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The method for preparing the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber realizes high-efficiency preparation and improves the carbon yield.
assignee: 上海电气风电集团股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and prepared polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for improving polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which mainly solves the problems of more broken filaments, more broken filaments and poor mechanical properties of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in the prior art. According to the invention, in the steam drafting process, the polyacrylonitrile nascent fiber with the crystallization degree of 50-80%, the grain size of 5-9 nm and the crystal region orientation degree of 65-90% is stretched at the deformation rate of 0.05s  ‑1 ～0.5s ‑1 , and then subjected to heat setting to obtain the polyacrylonitrile precursor, and finally the polyacrylonitrile precursor is subjected to preoxidation and carbonization to prepare the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used in the preparation process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: MOF-derived graphene/carbon fiber electromagnetic wave absorption composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a MOF-derived graphene/carbon fiber electromagnetic wave absorption composite material, which is realized by the following technical scheme: firstly dispersing graphene into an organic solution to form a first dispersion liquid, dispersing polyacrylonitrile into the organic solvent to form a second dispersion liquid, uniformly blending the first dispersion liquid and the second dispersion liquid to form a spinning precursor liquid, spinning to form graphene/carbon fiber precursor, and performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain graphene/carbon fiber; then preparing a MOF precursor by taking cobalt salt, nickel salt, ferric salt and dihydroxyterephthalic acid as raw materials; and finally, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the graphene/carbon fiber and the MOF precursor, and carrying out high-temperature treatment to form the MOF-derived graphene/carbon fiber electromagnetic wave absorption composite material. The wave-absorbing material has the advantages of wide wave-absorbing frequency band, strong wave-absorbing capacity and the like, and is particularly suitable for the technical field of design and processing of wave-absorbing materials.

title: Method for preparing mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber by using coal pitch
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal tar oil separation and utilization, and relates to a method for preparing mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers by using coal tar pitch, which comprises the following steps: 1) Under the nitrogen atmosphere, medium-low temperature coal pitch is used as a raw material, and polycondensation reaction and hydrogenation reaction are alternately carried out to obtain mesophase pitch; 2) Purifying the mesophase pitch by using pyridine insoluble substances to obtain spinnable mesophase pitch; 3) Dissolving polyacrylonitrile, a composite additive and spinnable mesophase pitch in a dimethyl sulfoxide solvent to obtain spinnable sol; 4) The spinnable sol is sequentially subjected to melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization to obtain the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber. The invention synthesizes the mesophase pitch through a hydrogenation polycondensation process; then the mixture and polyacrylonitrile and a composite additive are dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide together to form sol; and then sequentially carrying out melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization to obtain the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber with a more compact transverse section, excellent mechanical property and higher conductivity.

title: High-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and preparation method thereof
abstract: A high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and a preparation method thereof. 20-40 parts of surfactant, 40-60 parts of epoxy modified linear polydimethylsiloxane, 5-15 parts of special modified high-viscosity high-ammonia-value silicone oil, 10-30 parts of amino, polyether and other active group modified silicone oil, 10-30 parts of epoxy modified silicone oil, 3-8 parts of modified organosilicon softener, 1-5 parts of elastic finishing agent, 1-5 parts of antistatic agent, 20-30 parts of ethylene glycol monobutyl ether and 200-300 parts of deionized water. The oiling agent disclosed by the invention has good stability, antistatic property, heat resistance and bundling property for PAN carbon fiber precursor, solves the problem of roller sticking of precursor during a drying process, reduces the generation of broken filaments and broken filaments, improves the quality of carbon fiber precursor, greatly reduces the generation of phenomena of broken filaments, doubling and burning of precursor during pre-oxidation and carbonization, and can be used for preparing high-strength carbon fibers.

title: Original station yarn changing and tape yarn changing method for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a method for replacing silk ribbon at original station of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the steps of sequentially passing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor through a pre-oxidation furnace, a low-temperature carbonization furnace and a high-temperature carbonization furnace for pre-oxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment: when the Nth station is subjected to wire replacement, connecting the tail end of a first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor wire bundle running at the Nth station with the head end of a second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor wire bundle to be replaced; the connection part is a joint; after the wire change at the nth station, when the joints on the wire bundle operated at the nth station follow the wire bundle to pass through the last preoxidation furnace and enter the low-temperature carbonization furnace inlet: the connector is connected to the filament bundle operated at the Mth station, so that the connector can smoothly pass through the carbonization furnace by means of the filament bundle operated at the Mth station. The invention is used for increasing the probability of the connector of the silk bundle passing through the low-temperature carbonization furnace and the high-temperature carbonization furnace, reducing the accidents of silk breakage and roller winding and improving the production efficiency.

title: Preparation method and application of carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber post-processing oiling agent
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber oiling agents, and discloses a preparation method and application of a carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber post-processing oiling agent, wherein quaternized modified amino silicone oil contains quaternary ammonium salt cations with positive charges and can be neutralized with negative charges on the surfaces of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursors to form a continuous hydrophobic oil film, so that static electricity generation and damage to the carbon fiber precursors are reduced; the phenyl functional group in the structure has higher heat resistance, and meanwhile, antioxidants such as boron carbide and the like can form liquid glassy substances at high temperature, so that the in-situ carbonization process of the pre-oxidized fibers in the material is protected; the oiling agent prepared by quaternized modified amino silicone oil can prevent the phenomenon of adhesion and doubling of the precursor in the pre-oxidation process, effectively reduce the surface defect of the precursor, reduce the friction and abrasion between the precursor and a roller, and improve the comprehensive performance of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor in the subsequent processing.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt, which comprises the following steps: cutting polyacrylonitrile-based acrylic fiber and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber into short filaments; carrying out needling processing on the carbon fiber short fibers, the acrylic fiber short fibers and the felt body to obtain a fiber felt; feeding the fiber felt into a pre-oxidation furnace for heat treatment, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 150-260 ℃, and the pre-treatment time of the fiber felt is 10-20 minutes; and (3) delivering the pre-oxidized fiber felt into a carbonization furnace for carbonization treatment, and delivering the fiber felt into a graphite grinding tool for graphitization treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt. The polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt has the advantages of low heat capacity, good heat preservation performance, energy conservation, high temperature change speed, random folding, easy cutting, high-temperature heat insulation resistance, electric conductivity, friction performance, small heat conductivity coefficient and the like. The preparation method can improve the strength, the flexibility and the impurity reduction of the polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt, and can lead the surface of the graphite felt to shrink uniformly and lead the surface to be flat.

title: High-temperature-resistant carbon fiber cloth and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber cloth, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant carbon fiber cloth and a preparation method thereof, wherein polypropylene glycol is used for modifying polyacrylonitrile to prepare a modified spinning solution, the modified spinning solution is prepared into fiber precursor, and the fiber precursor is subjected to pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment to prepare carbon fiber, wherein the addition of the polypropylene glycol can regulate and control the compactness of the fiber, so that the pores in the fiber are reduced, the mechanical property of the carbon fiber is improved, the surface of the fiber subjected to the pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment is more uniform and compact, the mechanical property of the carbon fiber is further enhanced, the polyacrylonitrile fiber has higher heat resistance, and the high-temperature-resistant property of the carbon fiber can be further improved through the addition of the polypropylene glycol and the pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment, so that the carbon fiber can resist higher temperature; when the bismaleimide resin modified component is coated on the carbon fiber cloth, the high temperature resistance of the carbon fiber cloth can be remarkably improved, and good mechanical properties and chemical stability can be kept in a high temperature environment.

title: Preparation method and application of flexible carbon fiber membrane-based silicon-carbon anode material
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a flexible carbon fiber membrane-based silicon-carbon anode material, which comprises the following steps: (S1) dissolving polyacrylonitrile, a sacrificial agent and a phosphazene-based multi-arm boride in an organic solvent to form a spinning solution, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain a fiber membrane precursor; the phosphazene-based multi-arm boride is prepared by reacting raw materials comprising hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene and phenylboronic acid compounds, wherein the mol ratio of the hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene to the phenylboronic acid compounds is 1 (3.05-3.2); (S2) sequentially performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation on the fiber membrane precursor to obtain a flexible carbon fiber membrane; and (S3) carrying out vapor phase silicon deposition and carbon coating on the flexible carbon fiber film to obtain the flexible carbon fiber film-based silicon-carbon negative electrode material. The flexible carbon fiber membrane-based negative electrode material prepared by the method has good flexibility and higher specific surface area, and the assembled lithium battery has low capacity loss rate under 10t pressure and excellent electrochemical performance.

abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a flexible carbon fiber membrane-based silicon-carbon anode material, which comprises the following steps: (S1) dissolving polyacrylonitrile, a sacrificial agent and a phosphazene-based multi-arm boride in an organic solvent to form a spinning solution, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain a fiber membrane precursor; the phosphazene-based multi-arm boride is prepared by reacting raw materials comprising hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene and phenylboronic acid compounds, wherein the mol ratio of the hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene to the phenylboronic acid compounds is 1 (3.05-3.2); (S2) sequentially performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation on the fiber membrane precursor to obtain a flexible carbon fiber membrane; and (S3) carrying out vapor phase silicon deposition and carbon coating on the flexible carbon fiber film to obtain the flexible carbon fiber film-based silicon-carbon negative electrode material. The flexible carbon fiber membrane-based negative electrode material prepared by the method has good flexibility and higher specific surface area, and the assembled lithium battery has low capacity loss rate under 10t pressure and excellent electrochemical performance.

title: Method for improving activity of carbon fiber for vanadium redox flow battery
abstract: The application relates to the field of vanadium redox flow battery raw materials, in particular to a method for improving the activity of carbon fibers for a vanadium redox flow battery. A method for improving the activity of carbon fibers for a vanadium redox flow battery, comprising the following steps: s1, adding polyacrylonitrile into dimethylacetamide, and stirring and mixing uniformly under the water bath condition to obtain a polymer solution; s2, firstly adding MOFs-N-P precursor into the polymer solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain electrostatic spinning solution; the MOFs-N-P precursor contains transition metal, and B and N are co-doped in the MOFs-N-P precursor; s3, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the electrostatic spinning solution to obtain a nanofiber membrane; and S4, placing the nanofiber membrane in air for preoxidation, and placing the nanofiber membrane in an argon or nitrogen atmosphere for high-temperature carbonization after the preoxidation is completed to obtain the active porous carbon fiber electrode. The method for improving the activity of the carbon fiber for the vanadium redox flow battery promotes the carbon fiber to have better electrochemical activity and long-term stability.

abstract: The application relates to the field of vanadium redox flow battery raw materials, in particular to a method for improving the activity of carbon fibers for a vanadium redox flow battery. A method for improving the activity of carbon fibers for a vanadium redox flow battery, comprising the following steps: s1, adding polyacrylonitrile into dimethylacetamide, and stirring and mixing uniformly under the water bath condition to obtain a polymer solution; s2, firstly adding MOFs-N-P precursor into the polymer solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain electrostatic spinning solution; the MOFs-N-P precursor contains transition metal, and B and N are co-doped in the MOFs-N-P precursor; s3, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the electrostatic spinning solution to obtain a nanofiber membrane; and S4, placing the nanofiber membrane in air for preoxidation, and placing the nanofiber membrane in an argon or nitrogen atmosphere for high-temperature carbonization after the preoxidation is completed to obtain the active porous carbon fiber electrode. title: Preparation method of bismuth nitride co-doped porous graphite felt, graphite felt prepared by preparation method and application of graphite felt
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a nitrogen-bismuth co-doped porous graphite felt, a graphite felt prepared by the same and application of the graphite felt, and relates to the technical field of all-vanadium redox flow batteries. The preparation method comprises the following steps: performing needling treatment on polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers to obtain PAN-based carbon fiber soft felt; dissolving polyacrylonitrile, urea and bismuth salt in a solvent to obtain a precursor solution; spraying the precursor solution on the PAN-based carbon fiber soft felt through a solution spraying spinning process, and drying to obtain a spinning substrate; and (3) sequentially carrying out pre-carbonization treatment, carbonization treatment and graphitization treatment on the spinning substrate to obtain the nitrogen-bismuth co-doped porous graphite felt. The porous graphite felt structure of the invention can greatly improve the specific surface area of the graphite felt, improve the enhanced hydrophilicity, increase the conductivity of the graphite felt and increase the surface functional groups, thereby being beneficial to improving the efficiency of the vanadium redox flow battery.

title: Application of carbon nanofiber electrode material with high hydrogen evolution overpotential and high activity in vanadium battery
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of battery materials and energy storage, and particularly relates to an application of a carbon nanofiber electrode material with high hydrogen evolution overpotential and high activity in a vanadium battery. The carbon nanofiber electrode material takes bismuth ammonium citrate as a functional component, is added into a solution of polyacrylonitrile and N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare an electrospun precursor solution, utilizes an electrostatic spinning technology to prepare polyacrylonitrile-based three-dimensional nanofiber containing bismuth ammonium citrate, and then performs pre-oxidation and carbonization, and utilizes pyrolysis of the bismuth ammonium citrate in the process, bismuth, nitrogen and oxygen components can be simultaneously introduced into the carbon fiber, so that the carbon nanofiber electrode material is endowed with higher hydrogen evolution overpotential and high activity, and the carbon nanofiber electrode material can fully play the synergistic effect of all the components when used for a vanadium battery anode material, and effectively improves the energy conversion efficiency and the multiplying power performance of a battery. The method is simple, has strong practicability, is suitable for large-scale production, and has wide application prospect.

title: Carbon fibre manufacturing
abstract: Method of identifying stabilisation conditions for producing a thermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based carbon fibre precursor from any batch of precursor for use in carbon fibre manufacturing process are useful for reducing cost of carbon fibre manufacture. Method of manufacturing carbon fibres, comprising the steps of: providing a batch of isothermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based precursor fibres which presents as absent of evidence of tow burning or tow breakage, and having a structural conversion index selected from the range of from 0.5 to 0.7; subjecting the provided batch of isothermally treated precursor fibres to a carbonisation process to produce carbon fibres..

title: Preparation method for low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a preparation method of a low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and relates to the technical field of carbon fibers. The preparation method comprises: preparing a carbon fiber precursor; drawing the carbon fiber precursor to pass through a plurality of independent temperature-controlled pre-oxidation furnaces sequentially, the carbon fiber precursor in the pre-oxidation furnaces is given different degrees of drafting through the independent drive of each of the plurality of pre-oxidation furnaces, and the carbon fiber precursor is pre-oxidized to form a pre-oxidized tow; drawing the pre-oxidized tow to pass through a low-temperature carbonization furnace with a two-stage gas seal chamber structure to allow a low-temperature carbonization treatment to produce a low-carbon tow; drawing the low-carbon tow to pass through a high-temperature carbonization furnace with a tow dehumidification device to allow a high-temperature carbonization treatment to produce a high-carbon tow; drawing the high-carbon tow to pass through a one to two-stage surface treatment tank to allow a surface treatment; and the high-carbon tow is dried after sizing.

title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with low defects and high strength and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with low defects and high strength and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, through a reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) polymerization technology and adopting trithiocarbonate (TRIT) with carboxyl functional groups as a RAFT reagent, the molecular weight and the distribution of the polyacrylonitrile are controlled on one hand, and the polyacrylonitrile with carboxyl at the tail end is prepared, and meanwhile, a second monomer with double functional groups and similar to the reactivity ratio of the acrylonitrile is adopted for copolymerization reaction, so that the polyacrylonitrile with high chain structure regularity and uniform distribution of copolymerization units is obtained, a high-quality precursor is prepared, and further, the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with low defects and high strength is prepared through pre-oxidation, carbonization and post-treatment.

title: Pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: pretreating polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor by adopting a pretreatment solvent, wherein the pretreatment solvent comprises water, an oil agent, a modifier and a preoxidation accelerator; pre-oxidizing the pretreated polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor in an air atmosphere at a temperature range of 200-280 ℃, and heating in six temperature zones in a gradient manner, wherein each temperature zone is pre-oxidized for 8-10 min, and the pre-oxidation treatment time is 50-60 min in total; then carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the carbon fiber. According to the invention, effective control of reactions such as cyclization, oxidation and the like in the pre-oxidation process of the polyacrylonitrile precursor is realized through pre-oxidation pretreatment, temperature gradient heating of six temperature zones, traction ratio control and the like, pre-oxidized fibers subjected to full homogeneous pre-oxidation are obtained, and corresponding high-strength medium-model (T800 grade) carbon fibers are prepared.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of low carbon fiber strength, high dispersion coefficient, more broken filaments and more broken filaments in the processes of thermal stabilization and carbonization in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of solidification, hot water drafting, water washing, oiling, drying densification, saturated steam drafting, steam heat setting, filament winding to obtain polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber, and thermal stabilization and carbonization to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the solidification is at least one step, and the preparation method is characterized in that the mass percentage concentration of an organic solvent in an internal aqueous solution of the primary fiber leaving the first solidification bath is 70-85%, so that the problem is well solved, and the preparation method can be used for preparing high-performance carbon fiber.

title: Heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, mainly solve the problem that the polyacrylonitrile heat stabilization process time is longer in the prior art, and the fiber is easy to produce the skin-core structure to influence the final carbon fiber performance, through adopting a heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, include carrying on the microwave heat treatment of polyacrylonitrile protofilament in the microwave heating oven of the air atmosphere and carrying on the step of heat stabilization treatment in the ordinary pressure heat stabilization oven of the air atmosphere; the method is characterized in that the technical scheme of modifying pretreatment is carried out on the polyacrylonitrile precursor in a strong oxidizing solution before microwave heat treatment, so that the method better solves the problem and can be used in industrial production of polyacrylonitrile precursor heat stabilization and carbonization processes.

title: Dry-method carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a dry-method carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high-performance fiber preparation, and specifically comprising the following steps: and (3) feeding the refined binary or ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer spinning solution into a spinning channel for dry spinning, and continuously feeding the obtained nascent fiber into post-treatment procedures such as hot water drafting, water washing, drying densification, steam drafting, heat setting and the like to obtain the dry carbon fiber precursor. Different from the common wet method or dry-wet method carbon fiber precursor, the dry method carbon fiber precursor obtained by the invention has the characteristics of pre-cyclization, good compactness, controllable cross section, low solvent content and low production and manufacturing cost, is suitable for preparing carbon fibers, activated carbon fibers or pre-oxidized fibers by continuous pre-oxidation carbonization, and can meet the requirements of different industrial fields.

title: Acrylic fiber and preparation method thereof, and preparation method of carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to an acrylic fiber, a preparation method thereof and a preparation method of carbon fiber, wherein the acrylic fiber is copolymerized with a second monomer and/or a third monomer, and the acrylic fiber has the following structural formula: wherein X and Y are compounds containing one group of carboxyl, amido, amino, hydroxyl, sulfonic acid group, ester group or halogen and corresponding salts thereof, X and Y are the same or different, and the mole percentage of m is 85% -99.5%; the mol percentage of n is 0.5-15%; the mole percentage of p is 0-14.5%. The preparation of the acrylic fiber comprises the following steps: and (3) performing solidification molding, water washing, oiling, drying and post-drafting treatment on the stock solution to obtain the acrylic fiber. When the carbon fiber is prepared, the acrylic fiber is subjected to roller feeding, pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment to obtain the carbon fiber. Compared with polyacrylonitrile precursor, the invention has lower cost and higher cost performance; compared with commercial acrylic fiber, the cost for producing the carbon fiber is equivalent, but the manufacturability is stronger, the mechanical property performance is better, so the application field is wider, and the promotion of the competitiveness is facilitated.

title: Three-dimensional V 2 O 3 Carbon nanofiber composite flexible electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional V  2  O  3  Carbon nanofiber composite flexible electrode, preparation method and application thereof, wherein the electrode comprises carbon nanofibers and V distributed on the carbon nanofibers  2  O  3  ；V  2  O  3  Assembling the nano sheets to form a three-dimensional sea urchin shape, and embedding the three-dimensional sea urchin shape on the surface of the carbon nano fiber in a bead-hanging shape; three-dimensional sea urchin-like VO synthesized by solvothermal method  2  And dissolving the vanadium source in a polyacrylonitrile solution to obtain a precursor solution, obtaining polymer fibers by an electrostatic spinning method from the precursor solution, and performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the polymer fibers in an inert atmosphere to obtain the composite flexible electrode. title: Preparation method of low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with low structural defects. The method comprises the steps of unwinding a precursor, sequentially performing carbonization procedures such as a pre-oxidation furnace, a low-temperature carbonization furnace, a high-temperature carbonization furnace, surface treatment, washing, sizing, drying, winding and the like to obtain a finished carbon fiber, wherein the low-temperature carbonization furnace of the high-efficiency coke discharging system discharges low-temperature carbonized waste gas out of a furnace chamber more instantaneously and efficiently in the low-temperature carbonization process, so that the damage of byproducts such as tar and the like to the fiber is reduced; meanwhile, the high-temperature carbonization furnace is provided with a tow dehumidifying device, so that the damage of water vapor to fibers in the high-temperature carbonization process is reduced; finally, the preparation of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with low structural defects is realized by combining the fine blending of the drafting at each stage in the carbonization process.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Method for loading polyacrylonitrile fibers into carbon fibers
abstract: The invention discloses a method for loading a polyacrylonitrile fiber into a carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of loading the polyacrylonitrile fiber, braiding the polyacrylonitrile fiber, resetting the length of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, passing through an oxidation furnace, passing through a carbonization furnace and carrying out surface treatment; the invention adopts a mode of cooperatively carrying out temperature rise and furnace penetration, and mainly comprises the following steps: (1) Determining a heating node of the oxidation furnace and the reached temperature when the drafting is required to be given; (2) Determining the drafting and transmission speed of an oxidation section in a non-heating period in a stopping and heat-preserving period; (3) Determining the transmission speed of the tow joints after all the tow joints enter a 1 st oxidation furnace; (4) determining the time for passing through the low-carbon furnace; (5) determining the furnace pressure range when the low-carbon furnace passes through. The invention reduces the times of broken wire and winding roller to the minimum in the process of putting on the frame, obviously shortens the time of furnace penetration and wire separation, improves the production efficiency and reduces the consumption of precursor wires.
assignee: 山西钢科碳材料有限公司

title: Preparation method of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber and application of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber in tool products
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber and application thereof in tool products, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparation of amino-modified polyacrylonitrile; (2) preparation of acyl chloride graphene oxide; (3) wet spinning: dissolving lignin and amino-modified polyacrylonitrile in a solvent, adding acyl chloride graphene oxide, and performing ultrasonic reaction for 30-60 min to obtain spinning solution; spinning the spinning solution and forming primary fibers in a coagulating bath, and drawing, washing, oiling and drying the primary fibers to obtain carbon fiber precursors; (4) pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment. According to the invention, the amino-modified polyacrylonitrile and lignin are blended for wet spinning, and the acylated chlorinated graphene oxide is added as the cross-linking agent, so that the strength of the carbon fiber can be effectively improved, the cost of the carbon fiber is reduced, and the application of the amino-modified polyacrylonitrile and lignin in tool products is facilitated.

title: Method for utilizing electrostatic spinning overlapped three-dimensional gradient layer structure for electromagnetic shielding composite material
abstract: The invention discloses a method for utilizing electrostatic spinning to overlap an electromagnetic shielding composite material with a three-dimensional gradient layer structure, and belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic shielding. The preparation method takes Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) as a spinning polymer raw material, prepared by an electrostatic spinning technology. The PAN is selected as the precursor for preparing the carbon fiber, so that the carbonization yield is high (50-55 percent at 1000-1500 ℃), and the skeleton structure is rarely damaged when the hetero atoms except carbon are removed. The electrostatic spinning PAN is the simplest and most economical method for preparing the carbon nanofiber precursor in batches, and the carbon nanofiber can be obtained through pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment, the diameter of the carbon nanofiber is generally 100-500 nm, the carbon nanofiber is a quasi-one-dimensional carbon material between CNT and common carbon fiber, the carbon nanofiber has high degree of crystal orientation and good electrical conductivity and heat conductivity, and the dielectric loss of the material is favorably enhanced. This work will provide new solutions for low density, high flexibility and excellent electromagnetic shielding performance materials in next generation foldable and wearable electronics.
assignee: 天津工业大学
inventors: LI LEI; WEI GUOLAN; Su Jingna

title: Preparation system and method for graphitizing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production, and particularly relates to a system and a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber by graphitization; the preparation system for graphitizing the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber comprises pre-oxidation equipment, low-temperature carbonization equipment and integrated graphitization equipment for performing high-temperature carbonization and graphitization on the fiber, wherein the integrated graphitization equipment is internally divided into a low-temperature zone and a high-temperature zone, the temperature of the low-temperature zone is 1200-1600 ℃, and the temperature of the high-temperature zone is 1800-2400 ℃. The invention firstly improves a preparation system for graphitizing polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers, and particularly realizes that high-temperature carbonization and graphitization of the fibers are completed in an integrated graphitization device, namely, the high-temperature carbonization and graphitization procedures are completed through one device, so that the energy loss and the maintenance cost of the high-temperature device are reduced, and meanwhile, the occupied area of the device is also reduced, so that the construction integration degree of a production workshop of the carbon fibers is higher.

title: Polyacrylonitrile initial-stage thermal oxidation stabilized fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers, and particularly relates to polyacrylonitrile thermal oxidation stabilized fiber and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention prepares polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber by controlling the orientation structure of initial thermal oxidation stabilization fiber of polyacrylonitrile, firstly carries out initial thermal oxidation stabilization treatment on polyacrylonitrile precursor at 170-240 ℃, then carries out later thermal oxidation stabilization treatment at 220-280 ℃ to obtain preoxidized fiber of polyacrylonitrile fiber, and carries out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the preoxidized fiber of polyacrylonitrile fiber in sequence to obtain high-performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The method obtains the carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property by controlling the orientation structure of the thermal oxidation stabilized fiber molecular chain in the initial stage of polyacrylonitrile, and has important guiding significance for the high-performance carbon fiber industry.

title: Modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fibers. The preparation method of the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a graphene/bagasse mixture with a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to form a spinning solution; step two, preparing the spinning solution into modified polyacrylonitrile precursor through a spinning process; and thirdly, performing pre-oxidation treatment on the modified polyacrylonitrile precursor, and then performing low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization treatment in a protective atmosphere to obtain the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. According to the invention, the graphene is mixed with the bagasse, and the graphene is adhered to the netlike pores of the bagasse, so that the problem of aggregation of the graphene is solved, and the bagasse can be uniformly mixed with the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, so that the graphene is uniformly dispersed, and the problem of effectively improving the comprehensive performance of the carbon fiber is solved.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber based on electron beam irradiation
abstract: A preparation method of carbon fiber based on electron beam irradiation comprises the following steps: winding large-tow polyacrylonitrile fibers onto two parallel guide rollers to form spiral coils, so as to form a plurality of parallel wires; simultaneously irradiating a plurality of parallel wires through an irradiation window of an electron accelerator, and simultaneously starting traction equipment to carry out traction on large-tow polyacrylonitrile fibers, so that each parallel wire repeatedly passes through the irradiation window of the electron accelerator, and carrying out intermittent periodic electron beam irradiation under air atmosphere to obtain an irradiation modified PAN precursor; continuously connecting or transferring the irradiation modified PAN precursor to a carbon fiber production line, and carrying out rapid pre-oxidation by a multi-temperature-zone pre-oxidation furnace to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber; and (3) sequentially carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized fiber in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the high-performance large-fiber-bundle carbon fiber, wherein the number of monofilaments of the high-performance large-fiber-bundle carbon fiber is greater than or equal to 24K. Compared with the prior art, the method can successfully and effectively introduce the electron beam irradiation technology into the production process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method and application of TiN@CNF material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a TiN@CNF material and a lithium sulfur battery, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing carbon fibers by using a polyacrylonitrile solution as a spinning solution and adopting an electrostatic spinning method; carrying out high-temperature carbonization on the carbon fiber after low-temperature pre-oxidation treatment to obtain a CNF material; immersing a CNF material in an organic solution of tetrabutyl titanate, taking out and drying after immersing to obtain a TiN@CNF precursor; and (3) placing the TiN@CNF precursor in an ammonia atmosphere for calcination, and obtaining the TiN@CNF material after the calcination is finished. The TiN@CNF material prepared by the preparation method is used as an intermediate layer of the lithium-sulfur battery to inhibit the shuttle effect of the lithium-sulfur battery, so that the utilization rate of sulfur in the lithium-sulfur battery is improved.
assignee: 内蒙古大学
inventors: KUSUJO; XIAO YIBO

title: Preparation method and application of sodium metal battery anode material
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy materials and devices, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a sodium metal battery anode material. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing polyacrylonitrile and nickel acetate in N, N-dimethylformamide, mixing and stirring to obtain a precursor solution, preparing a polymeric fiber film from the precursor solution through an electrostatic spinning technology, drying the obtained polymeric fiber film, and performing pre-oxidation and carbonization to obtain the nickel-coupled carbon fiber anode material with a three-dimensional structure. The prepared carbon fiber anode material has rich active centers, defect sites and larger specific surface area due to the advantage of nickel coupling. The nickel-coupled carbon fiber composite material is applied to the field of sodium metal batteries, and is used as a negative electrode material of the sodium metal batteries, so that the nickel-coupled carbon fiber composite material not only has good ion transmission rate, but also is beneficial to reducing nucleation overpotential, thereby improving the coulomb efficiency and the cycle stability of the sodium metal batteries.

title: Preparation method for low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of carbon fibers, and discloses a preparation method for a low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The preparation method comprises: preparing a carbon fiber precursor; pulling the carbon fiber precursor to pass through multiple independently temperature-controlled pre-oxidation furnaces to pre-oxidize the carbon fiber precursor, so as to form a pre-oxidized filament bundle; pulling the pre-oxidized filament bundle to pass through a low-temperature carbonization furnace provided with a two-stage air sealing chamber structure to perform low-temperature carbonization treatment, so as to form a low-carbon filament bundle; pulling the low-carbon filament bundle to pass through a high-temperature carbonization furnace provided with a bundle dehumidifying apparatus, so as to form a high-carbon filament bundle; pulling the high-carbon filament bundle to pass through a one-to-two-stage surface treatment tank to perform surface treatment; and sizing the high-carbon filament bundle and then drying.

title: Carbon fibre manufacturing
abstract: Method of identifying stabilisation conditions for producing a thermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based carbon fibre precursor from any batch of precursor for use in carbon fibre manufacturing process are useful for reducing cost of carbon fibre manufacture. Method of manufacturing carbon fibres, comprising the steps of: providing a batch of isothermally stabilised polyacrylonitrile (PAN) based precursor fibres which presents as absent of evidence of tow burning or tow breakage, and having a structural conversion index selected from the range of from 0.5 to 0.7; subjecting the provided batch of isothermally treated precursor fibres to a carbonisation process to produce carbon fibres..
assignee: Deakin University

title: High-permeability polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high permeability polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out binary copolymerization on acrylonitrile and itaconic acid, or carrying out ternary copolymerization on acrylonitrile, itaconic acid and methyl acrylate; (2) spinning solution sequentially passes through a spinneret plate for spinning, solidifying, primary drafting, washing, oiling, drying, secondary drafting and heat setting; (3) preoxidation and carbonization are carried out on the precursor, a spinneret plate with the aperture of 0.07mm is selected, and in the solidification process, the solidification draft is controlled to be 0.3-0.7 times, the primary draft is 2-3.8 times, and the secondary draft is 4.7-5.2 times.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: High-heat-resistance oil agent and preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high heat resistance oil agent and a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber thereof. Wherein the high heat-resistant oil agent is an emulsion which is prepared from an effective component and water and has a mass concentration of 25-40%. The oil agent with high heat resistance is obtained by stirring, dispersing and uniformly blending, and is characterized in that the effective components are heated in the air environment, the residual mass fraction is more than 90% when the temperature is raised to 275 ℃ from 20 ℃ at the speed of 10 ℃/min, and the residual mass fraction is more than 70% when the temperature is raised to 430 ℃. The oil is applied to the polyacrylonitrile precursor through the high heat resistance oil agent, and the smooth proceeding of the carbon fiber production process is ensured through the lubrication and protection mechanism of the oil agent to the fiber surface in the subsequent pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, so that the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property is obtained.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with smooth surface
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with smooth surfaces. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out ultrasonic pretreatment, preoxidation treatment and ozone treatment on polyacrylonitrile fiber protofilament, then irradiating the preoxidized fiber under gamma rays for modification, and finally slowly heating through a carbonization process to prepare the modified preoxidized fiber into carbon fiber with a smooth surface. The specific preparation process comprises the following steps: 1. putting polyacrylonitrile precursor into an acetone solution, ultrasonically cleaning, and drying the precursor; 2. standing the dried precursor in an oxygen atmosphere for a certain time; 3. performing thermal stabilization treatment on the precursor after standing by a proper process to obtain pre-oxidized fibers; 4. and (3) standing the pre-oxidized fiber in ozone for a certain time to obtain the ozone-treated pre-oxidized fiber. 5. And irradiating the pre-oxidized fiber under gamma rays to obtain the modified pre-oxidized fiber. 6. And (3) slowly heating and carbonizing the modified pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber with a smooth surface.
assignee: 天津工业大学

title: Ferric oxide nanometer flower modified carbon fiber composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an iron sesquioxide nano flower modified carbon fiber composite material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a super capacitor. Firstly, preparing electrostatic spinning precursor solution by using polyacrylonitrile, ferric chloride powder and a strong-polarity organic solvent, then carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain an electrostatic spinning membrane, then placing the electrostatic spinning membrane in the air, heating the electrostatic spinning membrane to 200-1200 ℃ to complete pre-oxidation, soaking the obtained electrostatic spinning membrane in an ammonia water solution for a period of time, then taking out and drying the electrostatic spinning membrane, and finally heating the electrostatic spinning membrane to 600-1200 ℃ in a protective atmosphere to complete carbonization. The ferric oxide nanoflower modified carbon fiber composite material prepared by the method has excellent electrochemical activity, stability, conductivity and rate characteristics, and has a good application prospect in the field of supercapacitors.
assignee: 武汉工程大学

title: PAN-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to PAN-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of precursor preparation, pre-oxidation, carbonization treatment and the like. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the polyacrylonitrile is modified by using the phosphoric acid, so that the heat resistance of the PAN-based carbon fiber can be effectively improved, and the thermal degradation in the carbonization process is reduced, thereby improving the carbon yield; the PAN-based carbon fiber prepared by the preparation method has the advantages of high carbon yield, few internal micropore defects and good mechanical property.
assignee: 金发科技股份有限公司

title: Carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a pore-forming agent into the polyacrylonitrile solution to prepare a precursor mixed solution; hydrochloric acid is added into the precursor mixed solution to form a uniform solution, and electrostatic spinning is carried out to obtain an electrostatic spinning fiber sample; carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on an electrospinning fiber sample, and grinding to form powder; soaking the powder in potassium hydroxide solution, stirring, cleaning, filtering, and oven drying; and mixing the dried powder with potassium hydroxide, annealing, cleaning, filtering, and drying to obtain the carbon fiber. The carbon fiber prepared by the preparation method can be used in electrocatalysis, lithium ion batteries, lithium sulfur batteries and the like.
assignee: 苏州大学

title: Preparation method of large-specific-surface-area special-shaped-section carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of large-specific-surface-area special-shaped section carbon fiber, which comprises the following steps: 1) selecting the polyacrylonitrile fiber with the special-shaped cross section prepared by dry spinning, wherein the viscosity-average molecular weight of the polyacrylonitrile is 3-7 ten thousand, the intrinsic viscosity is 1.2-1.5dL/g, the strength of the polyacrylonitrile fiber is not lower than 3.5cN/dtex, and the elongation at break is 9-15%; 2) starting a pre-oxidation furnace, heating to 195-280 ℃, and introducing the precursor into the pre-oxidation furnace to obtain pre-oxidized filaments with special-shaped sections; 3) and starting the low-temperature carbonization furnace and the high-temperature carbonization furnace, heating the low-temperature carbonization furnace to 320-700 ℃ under the protection of nitrogen, heating the high-temperature carbonization furnace to 900-1500 ℃, sequentially introducing the pre-oxidized fibers with the special-shaped cross sections, taking out of the high-temperature carbonization furnace, and then sizing to obtain the special-shaped carbon fiber. The invention can process the civil acrylic fiber with natural special-shaped section prepared by dry spinning into the carbon fiber with the special-shaped section by pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, and provides a feasible scheme for preparing the high-performance carbon fiber with low cost.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber oil for dry-jet wet-spun precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber oiling agent for dry-jet wet spinning precursor and a preparation method thereof, the oiling agent mainly comprises amino modified silicone oil, epoxy modified silicone oil, polyether modified silicone oil, ternary copolymerized silicone oil, a composite emulsifier, deionized water and other components, is an oil-in-water type aqueous microemulsion, has the particle size of 50-500 nm, can better match with a dry-jet wet spinning process, uniformly oils the precursor in a short time, is not easy to stick a roller in the stages of dry densification, steam drafting and the like, is not deformed when being rolled, has little hair quantity, and has better spinning manufacturability; the method has the advantages of no adhesion in the pre-oxidation and low-temperature carbonization stages, small hair quantity, high carbonization strength and small dispersion coefficient. The method has the characteristics of environmental protection, good safety, high production efficiency, stable quality and the like, and is suitable for mass use of the dry-jet wet-spinning process of polyacrylonitrile.

title: Carbonization filament connection method for large-tow carbon fiber precursors
abstract: The invention discloses a carbonization and filament connection method for large-tow carbon fiber precursors, which comprises the following steps of: s1: and (3) oxidizing a reserved filament head and a PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor filament barrel: untwisting the tail of the original filament tow and the head of the other raw filament tow to finish a 300-filament 400mm filament head, sleeving a PAN raw filament tube at the tail end of the raw filament tow, laying the PAN raw filament tube on an oxidation frame, and naturally tensioning and fixing the raw filament; s2: and connecting the head section and the tail section of the strand bundle by using an air splicer, straightening and extending the joint, and moving the PAN strand tube to the joint for wrapping. According to the invention, the PAN precursor fiber cylinder is used for connecting the tail fiber of the first fiber cylinder and the reserved fiber head of the second fiber cylinder in a buckled manner to form a fiber bundle by using the method of pre-oxidizing the fiber bundle head and tail of the precursor fiber cylinder, so that the continuous carbonization of the large-tow carbon fiber is realized.

title: Nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber, preparation method and application
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber, which has the diameter of 90-135 mu m, the nitrogen content of 10-20% and the oxygen content of 8-15%, and has a lotus-shaped pore passage structure inside, and is prepared by the following preparation method: carrying out wet spinning on the polyacrylonitrile/polyimide acid precursor mixed solution to obtain composite fiber precursor; and carrying out preoxidation-imidization treatment and carbonization treatment on the composite fiber protofilament to obtain the nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber. According to the invention, polyimide acid is introduced into a polyacrylonitrile solution, the nitrogen-oxygen double-doped porous carbon fiber with a lotus-root-shaped pore channel structure is prepared by adjusting the proportion of the polyimide formed after imidization of the polyacrylonitrile and the polyimide acid and controlling the phase separation process in the heat treatment process, so that the heteroatom self-doping of the porous carbon fiber is realized, and the porous carbon fiber can quickly and efficiently adsorb carbon dioxide in a simulated smoke environment and can be applied to the field of carbon dioxide adsorption.

title: Carbon fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material preparation, and discloses a carbon fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the carbon fiber composite material comprises polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor, asphalt fiber precursor and phenolic fiber precursor, and the ratio of the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor to the asphalt limiting precursor to the phenolic fiber precursor is 3: 3: 2, converting linear molecular chains into a heat-resistant ladder-shaped structure through the pre-oxidation process of the oxidation furnace, and playing a role in fixing oxygen and carbon for the later carbonization process. In the process, a series of reactions such as cyclization, oxidation, dehydrogenation and the like occur, a large amount of delocalized T electrons are formed by a straight chain structure with the original o bond as the main part, and the treatment is carried out for 80-100min at six temperature regions, so that a chromogenic common-often structure is formed, a large amount of small molecules are removed by polyacrylonitrile during chemical reaction, structural change occurs, and the strength of the pre-oxidized fiber is ensured.

title: System and method for improving preoxidation carbonization efficiency of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for improving preoxidation carbonization efficiency of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors, which are sequentially provided with a filament pay-off machine, a filament guide frame, a tension adjusting wheel, a self-shielding electronic accelerating device, a preoxidation furnace, a low-carbon furnace, a high-carbon furnace, a drying furnace and a filament collecting machine according to the working procedures; the self-shielding electron acceleration device comprises a shielding body, a high-voltage generator, an electron gun, an electron accelerator and a beam leading-out structure, wherein the shielding body is a double-layer shielding shell, and the electron accelerator is fixedly arranged on an inner-layer shielding shell; the high-voltage generator is connected with the inlet end of the electron accelerator through an electron gun, the outlet of the electron accelerator is connected with the inlet end of the beam leading-out structure, and the outlet end of the beam leading-out structure is a walking path of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilaments.

title: Preparation method of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber and application of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber in tool products
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of graphene modified high-strength low-cost carbon fiber and application of the carbon fiber in a tool product, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing amino-modified polyacrylonitrile; (2) preparing acyl chloride graphene oxide; (3) wet spinning: dissolving lignin and amino modified polyacrylonitrile in a solvent, adding acylchlorination graphene oxide, and performing ultrasonic reaction for 30-60min to obtain a spinning solution; spinning the spinning solution and forming nascent fiber in a coagulating bath, and drawing, washing, oiling and drying the nascent fiber to obtain carbon fiber precursor; and (4) carrying out preoxidation and carbonization treatment. According to the invention, the amino-modified polyacrylonitrile and the lignin are blended for wet spinning, and the acylchlorinated graphene oxide is added as a cross-linking agent, so that the strength of the carbon fiber can be effectively improved, the cost of the carbon fiber is reduced, and the application of the carbon fiber in tool products is facilitated.

title: Preparation system and method for graphitizing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production, and particularly relates to a system and a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber by graphitization; the preparation system for graphitizing the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber comprises pre-oxidation equipment, low-temperature carbonization equipment and integrated graphitization equipment for performing high-temperature carbonization and graphitization on the fiber, wherein the integrated graphitization equipment is internally divided into a low-temperature zone and a high-temperature zone, the temperature of the low-temperature zone is 1200-1600 ℃, and the temperature of the high-temperature zone is 1800-2400 ℃. The invention firstly improves a preparation system for graphitizing polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers, and particularly realizes that high-temperature carbonization and graphitization of the fibers are completed in an integrated graphitization device, namely, the high-temperature carbonization and graphitization procedures are completed through one device, so that the energy loss and the maintenance cost of the high-temperature device are reduced, and meanwhile, the occupied area of the device is also reduced, so that the construction integration degree of a production workshop of the carbon fibers is higher.

title: Furnace body sealing device of abrasionproof silk
abstract: The utility model is suitable for the production process of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers and graphite fibers, and is applied to the technical field of sealing devices of pre-oxidation furnaces, low-temperature carbonization furnaces, high-temperature carbonization furnaces, graphitization furnaces and drying furnaces with the filament outlet and inlet directions being horizontal planes. A furnace body sealing device of an abrasion-proof wire is composed of an upper sealing strip, an upper abrasion-proof rod, a lower sealing strip and a lower abrasion-proof rod. The device solves the problem of fiber damage caused by furnace bar wire grinding, can change sliding friction into rolling friction, and reduces the damage to tows; when furnace slag inside the furnace body moves to the position of the furnace mouth sealing strip along with the tows, the upper anti-abrasion rod is extruded, the anti-abrasion rod is lifted and rotated under the action of external force, the discharge of the furnace slag is promoted, the upper anti-abrasion rod falls after the discharge, the original opening is recovered, and the tows are prevented from being continuously damaged by the furnace slag clamp at the furnace mouth. The device has simple structure and low cost, and is convenient to clean and maintain.

title: Process for producing carbon fiber materials for separating co2 or nh3 from gas mixtures, carbon fiber materials and its use
abstract:
A method for producing a carbon fiber material is disclosed, the method comprising the steps of
         a) Preparation of a solution of polyacrylonitrile in a suitable organic solvent   b) Electrospinning of the solution obtained in a) and drying of the obtained fiber material   c) Crosslinking of the obtained fiber material by heating to 150 to 350° C. in an air or oxygen atmosphere for 1 to 30 h   d) Carbonization of the obtained fiber material in an inert gas atmosphere at a temperature in the range of 500 to 2,500° C.,       characterized in that   no silicon, sulfur, metal compounds, intermetallic compounds, silicon compounds and/or sulfur compounds are added to the polyacrylonitrile solution in step a) and that neither stabilization nor surface modification steps are carried out with the fiber material by treatment with chemical reagents and/or exposure to tensile stress.   

     Also disclosed is a carbon fiber material obtainable by the above process, as well as a carbon fiber material, characterized in that it has a proportion of ultramicropores V <0.4 nm  of 0.01 to 10, more preferably 0.02 to 5, even more preferably 0.025 to 0.1, most preferably 0.03 to 0.06 cm 3 /g, determined by CO 2  adsorption tests and evaluation with DFT and GC-MC simulation.

title: Carbon fiber catalytic ozonation composite separation membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: A carbon fiber catalytic ozonation composite separation membrane and a preparation method and application thereof are disclosed, wherein the composite separation membrane is formed by mutually staggering carbon fiber composite materials, the carbon fiber composite materials are carbon fibers loaded with titanium oxide and/or silicon oxide, and the mass ratio of the carbon fibers to the titanium oxide and/or the silicon oxide is 1: 0.04-0.49; the diameter of the carbon fiber composite material is 200-1000 nm, the thickness of the separation membrane is 200-700 mu m, and the pore diameter range of the membrane is 20-150 nm. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber composite separation membrane containing titanium oxide and/or silicon oxide precursors by using an electrospinning method, and then carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment under the protection of preoxidation and inert gas. The composite separation membrane has higher catalytic ozonation performance and excellent membrane permeability, and realizes the integrated deep purification function of simultaneously carrying out catalytic ozonation decomposition and membrane interception filtration separation on sewage and reclaimed water.
assignee: 北京市水科学技术研究院

title: Preparation method of high-modulus carbon fiber and precursor mesophase pitch thereof
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing high-modulus carbon fiber and precursor mesophase pitch thereof, which takes heavy oil as a raw material and adopts size exclusion chromatography to separate out components with molecular weight distribution of 400-1000; then, respectively removing acidic components and alkaline components in the raw oil by ion exchange chromatography and then sequentially passing through a large-aperture cation exchange resin and an anion exchange resin to obtain modified raw oil; the modified raw oil is subjected to thermal polycondensation and carbonization to obtain high-quality mesophase pitch with good spinnability, and the high-quality mesophase pitch has high mesophase content, low softening point, low viscosity, good meltability and good spinnability and is a high-quality raw material for preparing high-modulus carbon fibers. And carrying out melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-modulus mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber.
assignee: 中国石油大学(华东)

title: Efficient polymerization preparation method of polyacrylonitrile polymer for carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a high-efficiency polymerization preparation method of polyacrylonitrile polymer for carbon fibers, wherein a polymerization reaction composition comprises a binary copolymerization system or a multi-copolymerization system containing acrylonitrile, the polymerization reaction conditions are that the reaction temperature is 78-150 ℃, the reaction pressure is 1.5-50 atmospheric pressures, the reaction time is 10-120 min, residual monomers and bubbles are removed to obtain polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, the obtained polymer is spun, and the obtained carbon fiber precursor is subjected to preoxidation carbonization to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers. The temperature of the polymerization reaction is increased in the acrylonitrile solvent polymerization reaction, and the time of the polymerization reaction is greatly shortened on the premise of ensuring the high performance of the polymer by the acrylonitrile polymerization reaction, so that the speed of the polymerization reaction is greatly increased, and the production efficiency is greatly improved.
assignee: 敖琪; 庄晗

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of low carbon fiber strength, high dispersion coefficient, more broken filaments and more broken filaments in the processes of thermal stabilization and carbonization in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of solidification, hot water drafting, water washing, oiling, drying densification, saturated steam drafting, steam heat setting, filament winding to obtain polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber, and thermal stabilization and carbonization to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the solidification is at least one step, and the preparation method is characterized in that the mass percentage concentration of an organic solvent in an internal aqueous solution of the primary fiber leaving the first solidification bath is 70-85%, so that the problem is well solved, and the preparation method can be used for preparing high-performance carbon fiber.

title: Heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, mainly solve the problem that the polyacrylonitrile heat stabilization process time is longer in the prior art, and the fiber is easy to produce the skin-core structure to influence the final carbon fiber performance, through adopting a heat treatment method of polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, include carrying on the microwave heat treatment of polyacrylonitrile protofilament in the microwave heating oven of the air atmosphere and carrying on the step of heat stabilization treatment in the ordinary pressure heat stabilization oven of the air atmosphere; the method is characterized in that the technical scheme of modifying pretreatment is carried out on the polyacrylonitrile precursor in a strong oxidizing solution before microwave heat treatment, so that the method better solves the problem and can be used in industrial production of polyacrylonitrile precursor heat stabilization and carbonization processes.

title: Ferric oxide nanometer flower modified carbon fiber composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an iron sesquioxide nano flower modified carbon fiber composite material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a super capacitor. Firstly, preparing electrostatic spinning precursor solution by using polyacrylonitrile, ferric chloride powder and a strong-polarity organic solvent, then carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain an electrostatic spinning membrane, then placing the electrostatic spinning membrane in the air, heating the electrostatic spinning membrane to 200-1200 ℃ to complete pre-oxidation, soaking the obtained electrostatic spinning membrane in an ammonia water solution for a period of time, then taking out and drying the electrostatic spinning membrane, and finally heating the electrostatic spinning membrane to 600-1200 ℃ in a protective atmosphere to complete carbonization. The ferric oxide nanoflower modified carbon fiber composite material prepared by the method has excellent electrochemical activity, stability, conductivity and rate characteristics, and has a good application prospect in the field of supercapacitors.

title: Two-dimensional structure selenium telluride modified carbon fiber electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a two-dimensional structure selenium telluride modified carbon fiber electrode material, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: firstly, obtaining a two-dimensional layered nano material tungsten disulfide or molybdenum disulfide with dispersed solution by adopting an intercalation stripping method, then obtaining a polyacrylonitrile/tungsten disulfide or molybdenum disulfide composite nanofiber precursor by adopting an electrostatic spinning technology, and obtaining a carbon nanofiber membrane modified by two-dimensional lamellar structure tungsten or molybdenum nanosheets through pre-stabilization and carbonization processes; and finally preparing the two-dimensional structure selenium telluride modified carbon fiber electrode material with the micropore confinement function through selenium or telluride displacement.
