title: Carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a pore-forming agent into the polyacrylonitrile solution to prepare a precursor mixed solution; hydrochloric acid is added into the precursor mixed solution to form a uniform solution, and electrostatic spinning is carried out to obtain an electrostatic spinning fiber sample; carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on an electrospinning fiber sample, and grinding to form powder; soaking the powder in potassium hydroxide solution, stirring, cleaning, filtering, and oven drying; and mixing the dried powder with potassium hydroxide, annealing, cleaning, filtering, and drying to obtain the carbon fiber. The carbon fiber prepared by the preparation method can be used in electrocatalysis, lithium ion batteries, lithium sulfur batteries and the like.

title: Hollow porous carbon nanofiber with tin oxide loaded on inner tube wall and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a hollow porous carbon nanofiber with tin oxide loaded on an inner tube wall, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile, polymethyl methacrylate and polyvinylpyrrolidone to obtain a shell spinning solution; dissolving polyvinylpyrrolidone and stannous chloride dihydrate to obtain a core layer spinning solution; carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on the shell layer spinning solution and the core layer spinning solution to obtain a carbon fiber precursor; carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain hollow porous carbon nanofiber with tin oxide loaded on the inner pipe wall; compared with the porous carbon nanofiber prepared by the traditional method, the tin oxide and the carbon fiber are combined to form a network skeleton, so that the carbon fiber has more active sites and higher specific capacitance, and the controllable ion and electron transmission channel of the carbon fiber improves the stability and high efficiency of the charge stored by the tin oxide.

title: Self-supporting porous carbon fiber material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a self-supporting porous carbon fiber material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of capacitive deionization. The preparation method of the self-supporting porous carbon fiber material comprises the following steps: step 1, adding SnCl into a mixed solution of polyacrylonitrile, polyvinylpyrrolidone and an organic solvent 2 Obtaining a precursor solution, and performing electrostatic spinning on the precursor solution to obtain a nascent nanofiber membrane; step 2, carrying out preoxidation, carbonization and reduction treatment on the nascent nanofiber membrane in sequence to obtain a porous Sn-carbon nanofiber composite material; step 3, carrying out acid treatment on the porous Sn-carbon nanofiber composite material in an acid solution to obtain the self-supporting porous carbon fiber materialAnd (5) feeding. The self-supporting porous carbon fiber material prepared by the invention has the advantages of large specific surface area, good mechanical property and flexibility, high capacitance capacity, long cycle service life and excellent conductivity.

title: Petroleum asphalt-based carbon fiber flexible electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a petroleum asphalt-based carbon fiber flexible electrode material and a preparation method and application thereof; the preparation method comprises the following steps: a) the volume ratio is (1-5): 1, modifying the petroleum asphalt by using concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated nitric acid to obtain mixed acid modified petroleum asphalt; b) mixing the petroleum asphalt modified by the mixed acid obtained in the step a) with polyacrylonitrile and N, N-dimethylformamide to obtain spinning precursor liquid; then carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning precursor solution to obtain a spinning fibrofelt; c) and c) sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization on the spinning fibrofelt obtained in the step b) to obtain the petroleum asphalt-based carbon fiber flexible electrode material. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method provided by the invention can greatly reduce the usage amount of polyacrylonitrile by modifying and modulating the electrostatic spinning precursor solution for the asphalt, and has the advantages of simple process and cheap and easily-obtained raw materials; and the prepared flexible electrode used as the lithium ion battery anode has the advantages of high mechanical strength, outstanding cycling stability and the like.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method therefor
abstract: An object is to obtain a carbon fiber that achieves both a strong bundle forming property and a thermal stability in a good balance and serves to realize a reduction in the molding cost and improvement in performance when producing a carbon fiber reinforced composite material containing a highly heat resistant resin as matrix. The carbon fiber bundle according to the present invention is one that satisfies the following requirements: retaining a twist count of 2 turns/m or more when suspended with one end fixed and the other end free; having a required single fiber diameter and a required heat loss rate, and meeting a specified formula expressing a relationship between the crystallite size L c  and the orientation parameter of crystallites π 002  determined from bulk measurement of the entire fiber bundle. Also provided is a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle having a required single fiber diameter and a required heat loss rate, including steps for performing stabilization of a precursor fiber bundle for polyacrylonitrile based carbon fiber, pre-carbonization thereof, and carbonization thereof performed in this order, the twist count and tension of the fiber bundle being 2 turns/m or more and 1.5 mN/dtex or more, respectively, in the carbonization step. In addition, also provided is a carbon fiber bundle that satisfies the following requirements: retaining a fiber bundle surface layer twist angle of 0.2° or more when suspended with one end fixed and the other end free; having a required single fiber diameter and a required heat loss rate; and meeting a specified formula expressing a relationship between the crystallite size L c  and the orientation parameter of crystallites π 002  determined from bulk measurement of the entire fiber bundle. Also provided is a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle retaining a fiber bundle surface layer twist angle of 0.2° or more when suspended with one end fixed and the other end free and having a required single fiber diameter and a required heat loss rate, including steps for performing stabilization of a precursor fiber bundle for polyacrylonitrile based carbon fiber, pre-carbonization thereof, and carbonization thereof performed in this order, the tension being 1.5 mN/dtex or more in the carbonization step.

title: Carbon fiber and method for manufacturing same
abstract: An object of the invention is to obtain a carbon fiber exhibiting excellent dispersibility in a process for molding and processing it into a carbon fiber reinforced composite material or in a finally obtained molded article. The carbon fiber according to the present invention is one including single fibers having lengths of 10 cm or less, the fiber axis of each single fiber having an undulation width of 2.5 µm or more when a part thereof between two points with a straight-line distance of 1 mm is observed from a lateral direction, and the coefficient of variation in the undulation width being 100% or less. Such a carbon fiber is produced by a method including steps for performing stabilization of a precursor fiber bundle for polyacrylonitrile based carbon fiber, pre-carbonization thereof, and carbonization thereof performed in this order, followed by cutting the resulting carbon fiber bundle, which is in the form of continuous fibers, the twist count of the fiber bundle being 16 turns/m or more in the carbonization step, or the twist angle of the surface of the fiber bundle being 2.0° or more.

title: Modification of continuous carbon fibers during precursor formation for composite materials with enhanced moldability
abstract: A method of producing continuous carbon fibers for composites having enhanced moldability is provided. As the precursor fiber is formed, discrete regions are introduced into a continuous precursor fiber comprising an acrylic polymeric material such as Polyacrylonitrile (PAN). The precursor may be a non-homogeneous fiber having a second dissimilar material interspersed in discrete regions with the acrylic polymer material. Alternatively, the precursor may be a non-homogeneous fiber, wherein the laser is applied to the acrylic polymer material in discrete regions to cause local molecular damage. After heating the continuous precursor fiber for carbonization and/or graphitization, the precursor forms a continuous carbon fiber having a plurality of discrete regions of weakness. These relatively weak areas provide non-contiguous discontinuities that reduce the stiffness and increase the moldability of the carbon fiber polymer composite while maintaining a high strength level. Carbon fiber polymer composites incorporating continuous carbon fibers having a plurality of discrete non-contiguous areas of weakness are also provided.

title: Preparation method and application of nano carbon fiber for lithium ion battery cathode
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation and application of new energy materials, in particular to a preparation method and application of nano carbon fibers for a lithium ion battery cathode, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: nitrogen-rich quinoline oligomers are prepared from quinoline and used as nitrogen-rich soft carbon precursors. Polyacrylonitrile is used as a hard carbon precursor and a spinning aid, and the nano-fiber is prepared by an electrostatic spinning technology. Then heating the carbon nano-fiber to 250-300 ℃ in the air atmosphere for pre-oxidation, and heating the carbon nano-fiber to 600-1200 ℃ in the nitrogen atmosphere for carbonization to obtain the target material carbon nano-fiber. The nano carbon fiber provided by the invention has higher nitrogen content and good conductivity, and has excellent rate performance and cycling stability when being used as a lithium ion battery cathode material.

title: Preparation method of carbon nanofiber-loaded mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber braided fabric
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber-loaded mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber braided fabric, which comprises the steps of spinning mesophase pitch serving as a raw material into mesophase pitch fibers with the diameter of 12-16 mu m; then, after preoxidation at the temperature of 260 ℃ and 300 ℃, low-temperature carbonization treatment at the temperature of 500 ℃ and 800 ℃ is carried out; weaving the low-temperature carbonized yarn into a carbon fiber two-dimensional fabric, and growing carbon nano-fibers on the surface of the carbon fiber in a gas phase manner; carrying out 1200-1500 ℃ high-temperature carbonization treatment and 2600-3000 ℃ graphitization treatment on the carbon fiber braided fabric loaded with the gas-phase carbon fibers to obtain the carbon nanofiber loaded mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber braided fabric. The carbon nanofiber-loaded mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber braided fabric prepared by the invention is an excellent precursor for preparing a CFRP skin material with high thermal conductivity, and has high thermal conductivity and high modulus on an X-Y surface and Z-direction thermal conductivity.

title: Preparation method of carbon-based photocatalyst
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon-based photocatalyst, which comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving polyacrylonitrile lignin in N, N-dimethylformamide solution, and then adding TiO 2 And continuously stirring to form homogeneous spinning solution, spinning the spinning solution by using an electrostatic spinning machine to prepare a carbon fiber precursor, and performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain the titanium dioxide/carbon nanofiber composite product. The method not only increases TiO 2 Hydrophobicity of (D) so that TiO 2 Can floatMore light energy is received on the sewage surface to improve the photocatalysis efficiency; and the excellent conductivity of the carbon nano-fiber is utilized to enable TiO to be in contact with 2 The generated photoproduction electrons can be transferred in time, so that the composition of the photoproduction electrons and holes is avoided, and the photocatalysis efficiency is greatly improved; in the catalysis process, the adsorption performance of the carbon nanofiber is utilized to rapidly gather the dye to TiO 2 Surface, TiO 2 The dye is degraded by the photocatalysis, and the photocatalysis efficiency is greatly improved.

title: High-heat-resistance oil agent and preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a high heat resistance oil agent and a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber thereof. Wherein the high heat-resistant oil agent is an emulsion with the mass concentration of 25-40% prepared from an effective component and water. The oil agent with high heat resistance is obtained by stirring, dispersing and uniformly blending, and is characterized in that the effective components are heated in the air environment, the residual mass fraction is more than 90% when the temperature is raised to 275 ℃ from 20 ℃ at the speed of 10 ℃/min, and the residual mass fraction is more than 70% when the temperature is raised to 430 ℃. The oil is applied to the polyacrylonitrile precursor through the high heat resistance oil agent, and the smooth proceeding of the carbon fiber production process is ensured through the lubrication and protection mechanism of the oil agent to the fiber surface in the subsequent pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, so that the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property is obtained.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with smooth surface
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with smooth surfaces. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out ultrasonic pretreatment, preoxidation treatment and ozone treatment on polyacrylonitrile fiber protofilament, then irradiating the preoxidized fiber under gamma rays for modification, and finally slowly heating through a carbonization process to prepare the modified preoxidized fiber into carbon fiber with a smooth surface. The specific preparation process comprises the following steps: firstly, putting polyacrylonitrile precursor into an acetone solution, ultrasonically cleaning, and then drying the precursor; secondly, standing the dried precursor in an oxygen atmosphere for a certain time; thirdly, performing thermal stabilization treatment on the static precursor through a proper process to obtain pre-oxidized fibers; and fourthly, standing the pre-oxidized fiber in ozone for a certain time to obtain the ozone-treated pre-oxidized fiber. Fifthly, irradiating the pre-oxidized fiber under gamma rays to obtain the modified pre-oxidized fiber. And sixthly, slowly heating and carbonizing the modified pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber with a smooth surface.

title: Sewage treatment microbial carrier and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a sewage treatment microorganism carrier, which consists of a magnetic carbon fiber bracket and a polypyrrole film layer, wherein microorganisms are fixed on the surface of the magnetic carbon fiber bracket; the magnetic carbon fiber support is woven by composite fiber bundles and is obtained by pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment; the composite fiber is polyacrylonitrile fiber doped with graphene, and magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles are uniformly distributed on the surface and inside the composite fiber. According to the invention, the iron oxide nanoparticles generated in situ have good photocatalytic activity, and can also promote local graphitization of carbon fibers and improve the conductivity of the carbon fibers in a synergistic manner with graphene; the magnetic carbon fiber support is used as a working electrode, the polypyrrole film is electrochemically deposited on the magnetic carbon fiber support, effective fixation of microorganisms is achieved, embedding is avoided, microorganism loading and proliferation are facilitated, iron oxide photocatalysts and microorganisms are in full contact with pollutants in sewage, photocatalytic degradation and microbial treatment are conducted synchronously, and sewage treatment efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: pretreating polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor by adopting a pretreatment solvent, wherein the pretreatment solvent comprises water, an oil agent, a modifier and a preoxidation accelerator; pre-oxidizing the pretreated polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor in an air atmosphere at a temperature range of 200-280 ℃, and heating in six temperature zones in a gradient manner, wherein each temperature zone is pre-oxidized for 8-10 min, and the pre-oxidation treatment time is 50-60 min; then carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the carbon fiber. According to the invention, the effective controllability of reactions such as cyclization, oxidation and the like in the pre-oxidation process of the polyacrylonitrile precursor is realized through pre-oxidation pretreatment, temperature gradient heating of six temperature zones, traction ratio control and the like, the fully-homogenized pre-oxidized fiber is obtained, and the corresponding high-strength medium-model (T800 grade) carbon fiber is prepared.

title: Preparation method of high-modulus carbon fiber and precursor mesophase pitch thereof
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing high-modulus carbon fiber and precursor mesophase pitch thereof, which takes heavy oil as a raw material and adopts size exclusion chromatography to separate out components with molecular weight distribution of 400-1000; then, respectively removing acidic components and alkaline components in the raw oil by ion exchange chromatography and then sequentially passing through a large-aperture cation exchange resin and an anion exchange resin to obtain modified raw oil; the modified raw oil is subjected to thermal polycondensation and carbonization to obtain high-quality mesophase pitch with good spinnability, and the high-quality mesophase pitch has high mesophase content, low softening point, low viscosity, good meltability and good spinnability and is a high-quality raw material for preparing high-modulus carbon fibers. And carrying out melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-modulus mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber.

title: Efficient polymerization preparation method of polyacrylonitrile polymer for carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a high-efficiency polymerization preparation method of polyacrylonitrile polymer for carbon fibers, wherein a polymerization reaction composition comprises a binary copolymerization system or a multi-copolymerization system containing acrylonitrile, the polymerization reaction conditions are that the reaction temperature is 78-150 ℃, the reaction pressure is 1.5-50 atmospheric pressures, the reaction time is 10-120 min, residual monomers and bubbles are removed to obtain polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, the obtained polymer is spun, and the obtained carbon fiber precursor is subjected to preoxidation carbonization to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers. The temperature of the polymerization reaction is increased in the acrylonitrile solvent polymerization reaction, and the time of the polymerization reaction is greatly shortened on the premise of ensuring the high performance of the polymer by the acrylonitrile polymerization reaction, so that the speed of the polymerization reaction is greatly increased, and the production efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Graphene composite fiber absorbent and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional materials. Carbon fiber precursor polyacrylonitrile is used as a carrier, a thermal treatment process is adopted to generate chemical bonding with graphene and magnetic material functional components, and anisotropy is endowed by utilizing a spinning technology. The graphene composite fiber absorbent provided by the invention takes polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers as a carrier, the fiber diameter is between 5 and 30 mu m, and the density is not more than 3.5g/cm 3 The mass composition of the effective components of the material is as follows: 0.5-15 parts of graphene, 1-25 parts of magnetic material and 100 parts of polyacrylonitrile solid, and pre-oxidizing for 60-120 min at 150-270 ℃ in air or nitrogen atmosphere through spinning, pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization-reduction processes; and carrying out carbonization and reduction for 5-30 min at 600-900 ℃ in an inert atmosphere. The graphene composite fiber absorbent has the advantages of excellent radar wave absorption characteristic, wide absorption frequency band, high wave absorption performance and strong designability. The method is suitable for the fields of wave-absorbing materials, antistatic materials and electromagnetic shielding, and is particularly suitable for the technical field of design and processing of radar stealth wave-absorbing materials.

title: The method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses the methods for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, realize in accordance with the following steps: (1) polyacrylonitrile fibre precursor being carried out Infra Red laser radiations, obtain pre-oxidized fibers；(2) by pre-oxidized fibers in nitrogen atmosphere low-temperature carbonization, obtain low-temperature carbonization fiber；(3) low-temperature carbonization fiber is carbonized in nitrogen atmosphere high temperature, obtains polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber.This method is using Infra Red laser radiations to the processing of polyacrylonitrile fibre precursor pre-oxidation, it can be realized quick heating, shorten the thermostabilization time, and the pre-oxidized fibers of available suitable degree of cyclization, the degree of orientation and volume density, low-temperature carbonization and high temperature cabonization processing, gained carbon fiber intensity with higher and the degree of orientation are carried out to the pre-oxidized fibers.Thus polyacrylonitrile fibre precursor is handled using Infra Red laser radiations and not only significantly improves carbon fiber production efficiency, and then reduce carbon fiber production cost, help to realize the popular of carbon fiber production, and guarantee to obtain high performance carbon fiber.

title: Graphene carbon fiber and preparation method thereof

title: Reduce the device and method of tar in carbon fiber production process
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of device and method of tar in reduction carbon fiber production process, and tar is excessive during mainly solving the carbon fiber that prior art and equipment are produced, and low-carbon furnace waste gas outlet is easy the technical issues of blocking.The present invention passes through between precursor uncoiling (1), pre-oxidation (2), low-temperature carbonization (5), high temperature cabonization (6), surface treatment and starching dry (7) and winding (8), increase acid solution dipping (3) and washing, dry (4) process, while fiber tension is regulated and controled by the linear velocity of transmission system middle roller before and after each process.It before by low-temperature carbonization process, is impregnated by acid solution, reduces itrile group structure and other easy small molecular weight impurities in polyacrylonitrile fibre, to make to reduce tar content of the fiber in subsequent processes.The technology can effectively reduce the amount that tar is generated in carbon fiber production process, preferably resolve above-mentioned technical problem, can be applicable in Industry of Carbon Fiber production field.

title: Modification of continuous carbon fibers during precursor formation for composites having enhanced moldability
abstract: Methods of producing continuous carbon fibers for composites having enhanced moldability are provided. Discrete regions are introduced into a continuous precursor fiber comprising an acrylic polymer material, such as polyacrylonitrile (PAN), as the precursor fiber is formed. The precursors may be heterogeneous fibers having a second distinct material interspersed in discrete regions with the acrylic polymer material. Alternatively, the precursors may be heterogeneous fibers where laser is applied to the acrylic polymer material in discrete regions to cause localized molecular disruptions. After the continuous precursor fiber is heated for carbonization and/or graphitization, the precursor forms a continuous carbon fiber having a plurality of discrete weak regions. These relatively weak regions provide noncontiguous break points that reduce stiffness and improve moldability for carbon fiber polymeric composites, while retaining high strength levels. Carbon fiber polymeric composites incorporating continuous carbon fibers having the plurality of discrete noncontiguous weak regions are also provided.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based high-performance carbon fiber preparation method
abstract: The present invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based high-performance carbon fiber preparation method. A purpose of the present invention is mainly to solve the problem of the influence of the polyacrylonitrile thermal stabilization process on the performance of the carbon fiber in the prior art. The technical scheme of the present invention comprises: carrying out heat treatment on a polyacrylonitrile precursor for not less than 40 min at a temperature of 190-270 DEG C in a normal pressure thermal stabilization furnace under at least three oxygen-containing gas atmospheres, wherein the total drafting is not more than 6%; carrying out heat treatment on the obtained fiber for not less than 5 min at a temperature of 240-270 DEG C in a normal pressure thermal stabilization furnace under at least an inert gas atmosphere, wherein the drafting is -2 to 0%; and under an inert gas condition, carrying out carbonization treatment for 4-8 min at a temperature of 350-1400 DEG C, wherein the total drafting is -2 to 2%. With the technical scheme, the problem in the prior art is well solved. The method of the present invention can be used for the polyacrylonitrile precursor thermal stabilization and carbonation process in industrial production.

title: Method for producing carbon fiber
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for producing a carbon fiber, in which impurities such as a tar-like substance to be stuck to the surface of a carbon fiber bundle are removed efficiently so that the carbon fiber bundle can be restrained from being wound around a heating roll.SOLUTION: The method for producing the carbon fiber comprises the steps of: performing flameproofing treatment on a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, which has the single fiber fineness equal to or higher than 1.0 dtex and the total fineness equal to or higher than 30,000 dtex, in an oxidizing atmosphere; performing carbonization treatment on the flameproofing treatment-performed carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere; performing electrolytic oxidation treatment on the carbonization treatment-performed carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle; immersing the electrolytic oxidation treatment-performed carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle in warm water of 60°C or higher or boiling water to perform warm water treatment thereon; performing ultrasonic treatment on the warm water treatment-performed fiber bundle in the water of 1-40°C; and performing heating roll treatment on the ultrasonic treatment-performed fiber bundle at 140°C or higher for 3 seconds or longer. The foreign matter or the like, which is stuck to the surface of the carbon fiber bundle, can be removed efficiently by the flameproofing treatment, the carbonization treatment and the electrolytic oxidation treatment so that the carbon fiber bundle can be restrained from being wound around the heating roll when the carbon fiber bundle is dried.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Method for producing carbon fiber
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide such a technique that when the surface of a carbon fiber is treated, a tar-like substance or the like in an electrolytic solution is removed efficiently so that the electrolytic solution is reused while suppressing an increase of a production cost thereof.SOLUTION: A method for producing the carbon fiber satisfies the following steps (1)-(4). At the step (1), a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle is introduced into a flameproofing furnace and flameproofing treatment is performed on the introduced fiber bundle at the temperature range of 200-300°C to obtain a flameproofing fiber bundle. At the step (2), the obtained flameproofing fiber bundle is introduced into a carbonization furnace and carbonization treatment is performed on the introduced flameproofing fiber bundle at the temperature range of 300-2,500°C to obtain a carbon fiber bundle. At the step (3), the obtained carbon fiber bundle is immersed in the electrolytic solution in an electrolytic oxidation treatment tank to perform electrolytic oxidation treatment thereon. At the step (4), a polyacrylonitrile-based fiber is immersed in the electrolytic solution by a ratio of 10 g/L or higher so that absorbance of the electrolytic solution is made equal to or lower than 0.4 and the resulting electrolytic solution is circulated through the electrolytic oxidation treatment tank and then reused.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Method of manufacturing carbon fiber with thick denier
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing carbon fibers having a monofilament fineness of 1 to 2 denier in which a thick denier polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fibers having a monofilament fineness of 2 to 4 denier is produced by using a spinning solution containing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer and a conductive carbon material, and a chlorination treatment and a carbonization treatment are performed on the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fibers to produce the carbon fibers having a monofilament fineness of 1 to 2 denier. The present invention relates to carbon fibers having a monofilament fineness of 1 to 2 denier and whose fiber fineness is relatively higher than the monofilament fineness of the conventional carbon fibers such that the productivity of the carbon fibers is greatly improved. The thick denier polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fibers of the present invention has a monofilament fineness of 2 to 4 denier and contains a conductive carbon material such that the difference (difference of chlorination) in thermal stability between the inside and the outside of the precursor fiber is minimized when the chlorination treatment is carried out. In other words, uniform thermal stabilization (chlorination) occurs both inside and outside of the precursor fiber, resulting in a large number of pores in the carbon fibers during the production of the same, thereby effectively preventing the problem of increasing cut-off rates and deteriorated mechanical properties.

title: Manufacturing method of 12K binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of 12K binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The method comprises the following steps: subjecting a precursor to preoxidation treatment in four temperature zones through a preoxidation furnace; carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization on the precursor subjected to preoxidation treatment respectively in six temperature zones and four temperature zones; and carrying out subsequent treatment to obtain high-density and high-crystal orientation quaternary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. According to the invention, the spinning solution is high in homogenization degree in the solidification forming process, which is more beneficial to later drafting and dry densification of tows, and the precursor is relatively good in spinnability. The process operation is simple, and the reaction conditions are easy to control. The prepared polyacrylonitrile spinning fluid has relatively good hydrophilicity and spinnability. The concentrated heat release of the precursor in the preoxidation stage is alleviated, and the manufacturing method is relatively good in preoxidation and carbonization process property, and applicable to engineered preparation of large-tow carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber with few surface defects
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbon fiber with few surface defects. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing polyacrylonitrile filaments from a precursor through a dry-jet wet spinning method, adjusting the drafting amount and controlling the filament strains at a temperature of 180 to 280 DEG C to carry out pre-oxidation reactions; subjecting the pre-oxidized fibers to a pre-carbonization treatment at a temperature of 300 to 900 DEG C under the protection of inert gas; then performing a carbonization treatment on the fibers at a temperature of 1000 to 1400 DEG C under the protection of inert gas so as to obtain carbon fibers with a carbon content of 94% or more; and finally subjecting the carbon fibers to steps of surface processing, sizing, drying, and reeling to obtain the finished carbon fiber product. The preparation method has the following advantages: the structures of carbon fibers are optimized during the pre-oxidation and carbonization process, so that the fibers cannot be easily broken down during the traction process, and thus the quality and strength of products are improved.

title: High thermal conductivity carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a high thermal conductivity carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method includes adding a graphene concentrate through an in-situ polymerization or dissolution method for preparing a high thermal conductivity polyacrylonitrile fiber, and conducting pre-oxidization, carbonization and graphitization on the high thermal conductivity polyacrylonitrile fiber to obtain high thermal conductivity carbon fiber. The method is as below: first adding a graphene concentrated into the polyacrylonitrile polymerization or dissolving process for preparing a polyacrylonitrile spinning stock solution, then conducting wet spinning on the spinning stock solution to obtain the high thermal conductivity polyacrylonitrile fiber, and conducting pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization on the fiber to obtain high thermal conductivity carbon fiber. The high thermal conductivity carbon fiber contains uniformly dispersed specially treated ultrafine graphene, and the treated graphene have uniform particles, few layers and high activity, does not generate agglomeration phenomenon during addition, and can be well combined with the polyacrylonitrile, thereby significantly improving the thermal performance of carbon fiber.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production device and method
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production device and method. The production device comprises a precursor unwinder, a conveyor, a pre-oxidation device, a heat storage recoverer, a multilayer heater, an air flow distributor, a cooling water processing system, a medium temperature carbonization device, a high temperature carbonization device, a tar processor, a cleaning device, a drying apparatus, an impregnation device and a waste liquor recoverer. The production method can meet the requirements for polyacrylonitrile and viscose silk based carbon fiber industrialization, the cost of the device is lowered by more than 80%, energy consumption is lowered by more than 80%, no contaminant is discharged, the production device with the production value being more than one billion yuan only needs 60 workers (three shifts), and the whole device can achieve automation and intelligence, maintenance is easy and operation is convenient. The production device breaks through blockade on techniques of developed countries, and localization is achieved totally.

title: The method of producing carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing carbon fiber which is produced, starting with a polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based precursor, by undergoing a pre-oxidation process, an oxidation process, a pre-carbonization process, and a carbonization process. To this end, in the pre-carbonization and carbonization processes, the fiber introduced and then released out from a pre-carbonization furnace comprises two fiber layers on which fibers are arranged in parallel, wherein the two fiber layers are arranged in parallel. Furthermore, the pre-carbonized fiber released from the pre-carbonization furnace consists of two fiber layers, maintains a state of being arranged in parallel, and is introduced and released out from the carbonization furnace.

title: Graphite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a graphite fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method is characterized by comprising the following steps: carrying out preoxidation on a polyacrylonitrile precursor so as to obtain a preoxidated fiber; carrying out low-temperature carbonization on the preoxidated fiber so as to obtain a low-temperature carbonized fiber; carrying out surface coating on the low-temperature carbonized fiber so as to obtain a coated fiber; carrying out high-temperature carbonization on the coated fiber so as to obtain a high-temperature carbonized fiber; carrying out secondary coating on the high-temperature carbonized fiber so as to obtain a secondary coated fiber; and carrying out graphitization on the secondary coated fiber so as to obtain a high-performance graphite fiber. The graphite fiber and the preparation method thereof disclosed by the invention has the advantages that a surface treatment by using an electrolytic bath is not performed, thereby improving the lyophilic property of the graphite fiber, reducing the equipment investments in the electrolytic bath and a rinsing bath, avoiding the surface pollution of the graphite fiber, improving the affinity of the graphite fiber to a resin matrix, and facilitating the preparation of high-performance, high-modulus and high-strength graphite fibers.

title: Method for preparing activated carbon fiber by using polyvinylidene chloride as matrix
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing an activated carbon fiber by using polyvinylidene chloride as matrix; the method comprises the following steps of: firstly preparing a polyvinylidene chloride precursor by using a melt-spinning technology, then carrying out low-temperature pre-oxidation treatment by adopting microwave heating, leading a conjugated double bond to be formed on a polyvinylidene chloride main chain, and finally leading the conjugated double bond to be cyclized by adopting high-temperature carbonization, thereby obtaining the activated carbon fiber. The microwave heating technology adopted by the invention greatly shortens the time of forming the conjugated double bond on the polyvinylidene chloride main chain, and therefore, the preparation efficiency of the carbon fiber is effectively increased, the preparation period is shortened, the yield is increased, lots of energy sources are saved, and the process of preparing the activated carbon fiber by using the polyvinylidene chloride instead of polyacrylonitrile and realizing the industrialized application of the activated carbon fiber is promoted.

title: Preparation for anode material of tin-cobalt alloy/carbon nanofiber film lithium ion battery
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method for anode material of tin-cobalt alloy/carbon nanofiber film lithium ion battery. The method process comprises a first step of preparing a polymer nanofiber film via electrostatic spinning with proper electrostatic spinning parameters by a uniform electrostatic spinning solution which is formed by employing stannous octoate as a tin precursor, cobalt acetate as a cobalt precursor, polyacrylonitrile as a carbon nanofiber precursor and an organic solvent; and a second step of preparing the tin-cobalt alloy/carbon nanofiber film by using a pre-oxidation treatment and a carbonization treatment. The tin-cobalt alloy/carbon nanofiber composite film prepared by the method effectively improves specific capacity and cycle performance of the anode material of the lithium ion battery, because tin-cobalt alloy particles are uniformly dispersed in the carbon nanofibers with uniform diameters; cobalt metal component increases conductivity of the material and can buffer volume change to a certain degree when the tin metal is charged and discharged; and simultaneously the carbon fibers can further play a role for buffering the volume change of the materials.

title: The uniform carbon fiber of a kind of chain structure is with binary acrylonitrile copolymer spinning fluid and preparation method
abstract: The present invention relates to the uniform carbon fiber binary acrylonitrile copolymer spinning fluid of a kind of chain structure.The constituting the main monomer acrylonitrile and be the dimethyl sulphoxide solution of copolymer of itaconic acid Beta-monoester of this spinning solution; Main monomer is 90～99.5% of a monomer weight, and comonomer weight is 0.5～10% of monomer weight, and monomer is main monomer and comonomer, and the weight percent concentration of monomer is 15～25%.Press proportioning with the solvent dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO); the main monomer acrylonitrile; comonomer, the radical initiator azodiisobutyronitrile joins in the reactor; at room temperature mix; behind the nitrogen bubble 20 minutes, under nitrogen protection, in 50-70 ℃ of isothermal reaction 6～36 hours; remove residual monomer and bubble, obtain product.Its chain structure is even, and itaconic acid Beta-monoester contains carboxyl and two kinds of functional groups of ester group simultaneously, and the spinnability that both can improve polyacrylonitrile resin also can be regulated and control the oxidation-carbonisation of carbon fibre precursor; Because the introducing of bifunctional monomer's itaconic acid Beta-monoester, the consumption of reduction and acrylonitrile compolymer monomer causes the raising of carbon fiber performance greatly.

title: Binary acrylonitrile copolymer spinning fluid and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to binary acrylonitrile copolymer spinning solution and a corresponding production method. The spinning solution comprises main monomer acrylonitrile and dimethyl sulfoxide solution with copolymer of itaconic acid Beta- monoester; the weight of the main monomer accounts for 90% to 99.5% of that of monomer, while the weight of the comonomer accounts for 0.5% to 10% thereof. The monomer is composed of the main monomer and the comonomer and the weight percentage concentration of the monomer is from15% to 25%. The dimethyl sulfoxide solution, the main monomer acrylonitrile, the comonomer, free radical initiator of azobisisobutyronitrile are added to a reactor by proportion and then mixed at room temperature and reacted for six to thirty six hours at a constant temperature of 50 DEG C to 70 DEG C to remove bubble of residual monomer and obtain the solution with protection from nitrogen which has bubbled for twenty minutes. The solution has a uniform chain structure and itaconic acid Beta-monoester contains two functional groups of carboxy and ester, thus being able to improve spinnability of polyacrylonitrile resin as well as regulate an oxidation-carbonization process of carbon fiber precursor. Due to introduction of a bifunctional group of monomer itaconic acid Beta-monoester, the amount of acrylonitrile comonomer is greatly reduced to improve performance of carbon fiber.

title: Boron-doped polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: According to the boron-doped high-performance polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and the preparation method thereof, the boron-containing compound is added in the pretreatment process of the polyacrylonitrile precursor, so that the activation process can be promoted, boron doping of the polyacrylonitrile fiber can be carried out at the high temperature of carbonization and activation, and the prepared boron-doped polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber has good adsorption performance, higher tensile strength and proper microporous structure, and is very suitable for being used for inner fabrics of breathable chemical protective clothing.

title: Method for determining preoxidation process parameters of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The application relates to a method for determining preoxidation process parameters of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. A method for determining preoxidation process parameters of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers comprises a first-stage preoxidation, wherein the first-stage preoxidation temperature is determined based on DSC of precursor fibers, and the first-stage preoxidation time is determined based on cyclization index of the fibers at the first-stage preoxidation temperature. Can determine more reasonable preoxidation parameters, and is beneficial to preparing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with high strength and high modulus.

title: Phosphorus-doped high-performance ternary polyacrylonitrile precursor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a phosphorus-doped high-performance ternary polyacrylonitrile precursor and a preparation method of carbon fibers, and belongs to the field of preparation of carbon fiber precursors. The method comprises the steps of respectively adding a first monomer acrylonitrile, a second monomer itaconic acid and an initiator into a solvent under the protection of nitrogen, introducing a third monomer allyl phosphate in a continuous dropwise adding mode, reacting at a certain temperature to obtain an acrylonitrile terpolymer, preparing a spinning stock solution through ammonia ammoniation, filtration, vacuum demono-ation and defoaming, obtaining a polyacrylonitrile precursor through processes such as dry spray wet spinning, water washing, drafting, oiling, dry densification, high-pressure steam drafting, heat setting and the like, and pre-oxidizing, carbonizing and graphitizing the precursor to obtain the final carbon fiber. According to the invention, the phosphorus-containing comonomer is introduced in the polymerization stage, so that the phosphorus element is uniformly distributed in the fiber, the catalytic graphitization effect of phosphorus is fully exerted, the graphitization temperature is reduced by 200-300 ℃, and the preparation cost of the high-modulus carbon fiber can be remarkably reduced.

title: Carbon fiber precursor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: A carbon fiber precursor, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, which mainly solves the problems of more filaments and low strength, modulus and elongation of carbon fiber in the preoxidation process in the prior art. According to the manufacturing method of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, dry-jet wet spinning is adopted, and the method comprises the steps of steam drafting, wherein the crystallinity of the fiber before steam drafting is 60-75%, the orientation degree is 0.65-0.9, the residence time of a drafting section is 2-6 s under the steam pressure of 0.2-0.7 MPa, the drafting multiple is 2-5 times, the crystallinity of the fiber is improved to 68-90%, and the orientation degree is improved to 0.9-0.99.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and discloses a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, and a preparation method and application thereof. The diameter of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor is x micrometers, boron elements are contained in y micrometers from outside to inside in the radial direction, silicon elements are contained in z micrometers from outside to inside in the radial direction, wherein y/x=15-45%, z/x=5-15%, the boron element content at 0.2y micrometers from outside to inside in the radial direction is A, the boron element content at 0.8y micrometers from outside to inside in the radial direction is B, and the A/B is more than or equal to 4.5. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor is easy to realize homogenization pre-oxidation, and can be used for preparing carbon fibers with excellent tensile properties.

title: High-strength high-modulus carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and discloses a high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the step of pre-oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor, wherein the pre-oxidizing is performed in at least three temperature areas, and the ratio of the static value of the filament bundle of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor to the width of the filament bundle of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor is 0.005-0.032V/mm in a first temperature area. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber is prepared by controlling the static value of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor in the pre-oxidation process, and the composite material of the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber has higher interlaminar shear strength.

title: Polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a polyacrylonitrile fiber pre-oxidized fiber, wherein the pre-oxidized fiber comprises a core part positioned at an axle center and a skin part wrapped outside the core part, and the characteristic tensile strength of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber is 475-580 cN/mu m. The polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber with the characteristic tensile strength of 475-580 cN/mu m is applied to subsequent low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization treatment, so that the structural defect of the carbon fiber due to the radial chemical structure difference of the fiber in the carbonization process can be avoided, the tensile mechanical property of the graphite fiber can be further improved, and the application range is good.

title: Method for preparing general-purpose asphalt-based carbon fiber by catalytic polycondensation of aromatic-rich slurry oil
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing general-grade asphalt-based carbon fiber by catalytic polycondensation of aromatic-rich oil slurry, which comprises the steps of inducing aromatic-rich oil to generate catalytic polycondensation reaction by a novel catalyst, adding high-purity aromatic compound as an additive to further improve the molecular structure of asphalt, removing the catalyst to obtain pure precursor asphalt, and then obtaining spinnable asphalt by deep polymerization under high-temperature and high-pressure coupling by plasma induction, wherein the spinnable asphalt is prepared into carbon fiber precursor by melt spinning, the precursor is subjected to acid treatment to realize pre-oxidation, so that the precursor meets the carbonization requirement, and finally the carbonized general-grade asphalt-based carbon fiber has excellent mechanical property, the diameter is 13.2 mu m, the tensile strength is 1143.52MPa, the Young modulus is 82.23GPa, and the elongation is 2.0%. The method has the advantages of simple process flow, reasonable design, no corrosion to reaction equipment, easy removal of the catalyst, low equipment requirement and easy realization of industrialization.

title: High-strength high-modulus high-toughness carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength high-modulus high-toughness carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber production. The preparation method comprises the following steps: before pre-oxidation treatment, oiling and drafting pretreatment is carried out on the polyacrylonitrile precursor; an auxiliary agent solution with specific composition and concentration is used in the pretreatment process; the draft ratio is 0.1-2%; the tension of the fiber is 0.5-3CN, and the water content is 5-20%. By carrying out oiling and drafting pretreatment, the orientation and structure differences of different batches of precursor wires caused by different storage periods and different environments can be eliminated, and the batch-to-batch and batch-to-batch stability of the carbon fiber performance can be improved. The auxiliary agent solution is adopted to treat the precursor, so that water molecules can penetrate into the precursor, the plasticity of the precursor is improved, the draft ratio of the precursor at the initial stage of pre-oxidation is improved, the fiber orientation, strength and modulus are improved, the pre-oxidation high-power draft yarn breakage phenomenon is improved, and the physicochemical properties and the appearance state of the high fiber are comprehensively improved.

title: Boron-doped polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: According to the boron-doped high-performance polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and the preparation method thereof, the boron-containing compound is added in the pretreatment process of the polyacrylonitrile precursor, so that the activation process can be promoted, boron doping of the polyacrylonitrile fiber can be carried out at the high temperature of carbonization and activation, and the prepared boron-doped polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber has good adsorption performance, higher tensile strength and proper microporous structure, and is very suitable for being used for inner fabrics of breathable chemical protective clothing.

title: Carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fibers, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: pretreatment, pre-oxidation, carbonization and post-treatment; the post-treatment is carried out, wherein carbonized polyethylene fiber precursors are completely soaked in acetone, taken out after being completely soaked at 20-30 ℃, washed by deionized water, then completely soaked in mixed silica sol, completely soaked at 20-30 ℃, simultaneously subjected to ultrasonic vibration, then heated under the protection of argon, kept for 30-40min after being heated to 230-250 ℃, then continuously heated, kept for 40-50min after being heated to 530-550 ℃, and cooled to room temperature to obtain carbon fibers; the invention can improve the tensile strength, elongation at break, tensile modulus and carbonization yield of the carbon fiber, and simultaneously improve the high temperature resistance, creep resistance and surface polarity of the carbon fiber.

title: Composite carbon fiber paper for fuel cell gas diffusion layer and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of proton exchange membrane fuel cell application, and discloses composite carbon fiber paper for a fuel cell gas diffusion layer and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: after a standard dissociator is used for dissociating the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber coated with the hydrophilic resin, dispersing agent polyethylene oxide and reinforcing agent polyvinyl alcohol are added into a stirrer to be uniformly stirred, a composite carbon fiber paper blank is manufactured in a paper sheet former, the paper blank is put into a phenolic resin solution to be impregnated, hot-pressed and solidified, carbonized and graphitized to manufacture high-modulus composite carbon fiber paper, and the carbon fiber paper manufactured by the method has excellent conductivity and mechanical properties, and simultaneously meets the characteristics of hydrophobicity and air permeability of the carbon paper for a gas diffusion layer of a fuel cell. The preparation method is simple, the carbonization and graphitization temperatures are low, the production cost is reduced while the preparation method has excellent performance, and the preparation method can be used for industrial production.

title: Lignin-based carbon fiber composite material with high tensile strength, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrostatic spinning carbon fiber composite materials, and discloses a lignin-based carbon fiber composite material with high tensile strength, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, lignin and polyacrylonitrile are dissolved in N, N-dimethylformamide, a spinning stock solution is filled into a syringe with a stainless steel needle for electrostatic spinning, an obtained lignin-based fiber precursor is subjected to sectional temperature rise and thermal stabilization in a muffle furnace, quenching treatment is carried out, the obtained fiber is carbonized in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain a lignin-based carbon fiber material, and finally the carbonized carbon fiber is blended with dichloromethane, E51 epoxy resin and 4, 4-diaminodiphenyl methane for solidification to obtain the lignin-based carbon fiber composite material. The lignin-based carbon fiber composite material obtained by the preparation method provided by the invention has excellent tensile strength.

title: Method for preparing carbon fiber based on blending of nanocellulose and PAN
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing carbon fiber based on blending of nanocellulose and PAN, which prepares nanocellulose by biomass, then mixes nanocellulose with polyacrylonitrile, and (3) carrying out impregnation catalytic pretreatment and electrostatic spinning to obtain precursor fiber precursor, and finally carrying out heat treatment on the precursor fiber precursor to obtain the carbon fiber. According to the invention, the interaction between the catalyst and the bamboo fiber is increased, the carbonization efficiency is accelerated, the original fiber network morphology can be maintained in the carbonization process, the prepared carbon fiber material has higher strength and modulus, light weight and high temperature resistance, and the problem that the fiber strength cannot meet the requirement due to poor interface compatibility in the preparation of the carbon fiber by the cellulose nanocrystalline-polyacrylonitrile composite fiber is solved.

title: Manufacturing method of carbon precursor fiber for gas diffusion layer
abstract: Proposed is a method of manufacturing a carbon precursor fiber for a gas diffusion layer having excellent tensile properties (e.g., strength and modulus) by controlling the cross-sectional shape of carbon fiber. The method includes preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer, preparing spinning products by spinning a spinning solution containing the polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer in a coagulation bath, and obtaining a carbon precursor fiber by drawing the spinning products through heat treatment. The coagulation bath includes an amount of about 60% to 90% by volume of methanol and an amount of about 10% to 40% by volume of dimethylformamide based on the total volume of the coagulation bath.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method for same
abstract:
To provide a carbon fiber bundle capable of suppressing winding due to ring-shaped fuzzes, which occurs when the carbon fiber bundle is rolled out for advanced processing, and a production method for producing the same. Disclosed is a carbon fiber bundle wherein an average single-fiber diameter B is 6.9 to 11.0 μm, a tensile modulus E of resin-impregnated strands is 230 to 310 GPa, the number of fuzzes inherent in the carbon fiber bundle is 40 fuzzes/m or less, and a proportion of fuzzes with a structure having a difference between skin and core is 1 to 25% of fuzzes inherent in the carbon fiber bundle. Such a carbon fiber bundle is preferably obtained by a method including, in a process of heat-treating a polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber bundle with a single-fiber fineness of 0.9 to 2.2 dtex in an oxidizing atmosphere at 200 to 300° C., heat-treating the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber bundle so that a heat generation rate Q, which is the left side of the formula (3), is 150 to 500 J/m 2 /s until the density is 1.22 to 1.24 g/cm 3 , when q (J/g/s) is the heat generation rate of the single fiber, N is the number of filaments, d (dtex) is a single-fiber fineness of the stabilized fiber bundle and W (mm) is a yarn width, heat-treating the fiber bundle while applying a tension of 1.6 to 4.0 mN/dtex until the density is 1.38 to 1.50 g/cm 3  to obtain a stabilized fiber bundle, and heat-treating the stabilized fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere at 1,200 to 1,600° C.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and stabilizing method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a stabilizing method thereof, wherein the stabilizing method comprises the following steps: sequentially carrying out stabilization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber precursor at low temperature, medium temperature, high temperature and ultrahigh temperature to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based stabilized fiber; the oxygen concentration at the low temperature is less than or equal to the oxygen concentration at the medium temperature and is less than or equal to the oxygen concentration at the high temperature; the stabilizing method effectively reduces the thermal degradation of the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber precursor in the stabilizing process, improves the size and the perfection of a graphite zone in the fiber, reduces the skin-core effect, and lays a foundation for preparing high-performance carbon fiber. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber treated by the stabilizing method has high thermal stability and tensile strength and wide application prospect.

title: Carbon fiber precursor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: A carbon fiber precursor, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, which mainly solves the problems of more filaments and low strength, modulus and elongation of carbon fiber in the preoxidation process in the prior art. The invention adopts a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, adopts dry-jet wet spinning, and comprises the steps of steam drafting, wherein the crystallinity of fiber before steam drafting is 60-75%, the orientation degree is 0.65-0.9, the residence time of a drafting section is 2-6 s under the steam pressure of 0.2-0.7 MPa, the drafting multiple is 2-5 times, the crystallinity of fiber is improved to 68-90%, and the orientation degree is improved to 0.9-0.99.

title: High-strength high-modulus high-toughness carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application discloses a high-strength high-modulus high-toughness carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber production. The preparation method comprises the following steps: before pre-oxidation treatment, oiling and drafting pretreatment is carried out on the polyacrylonitrile precursor; an auxiliary agent solution with specific composition and concentration is used in the pretreatment process; the draft ratio is 0.1-2%; the tension of the fiber is 0.5-3CN, and the water content is 5-20%. By carrying out oiling and drafting pretreatment, the orientation and structure differences of different batches of precursor wires caused by different storage periods and different environments can be eliminated, and the batch-to-batch and batch-to-batch stability of the carbon fiber performance can be improved. The auxiliary agent solution is adopted to treat the precursor, so that water molecules can penetrate into the precursor, the plasticity of the precursor is improved, the draft ratio of the precursor at the initial stage of pre-oxidation is improved, the fiber orientation, strength and modulus are improved, the pre-oxidation high-power draft yarn breakage phenomenon is improved, and the physicochemical properties and the appearance state of the high fiber are comprehensively improved.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber comprises the following steps: performing first oiling treatment on the fiber to be oiled to obtain the fiber subjected to the first oiling treatment; and (3) carrying out drying densification treatment, steam drafting treatment, relaxation heat setting treatment and rolling on the fiber subjected to the first oiling to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber. Before the step of relaxation heat setting treatment, performing secondary oiling treatment on the fiber subjected to steam drawing treatment; the oil agent used in the first oiling treatment and the second oiling treatment is different. The polyacrylonitrile-based fiber is subjected to pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The preparation method is mainly used for preparing the high-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based fiber and the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with excellent performance.

title: Pre-oxidation reaction control method of large-tow PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a pre-oxidation reaction control method of a large tow PAN precursor, which belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and comprises the steps of firstly measuring the thermal stress of a small tow PAN precursor with a stable pre-oxidation process, then carrying out continuous pre-oxidation treatment on the large tow PAN fiber, wherein the pre-oxidation temperature is 180-300 ℃, and regulating and controlling the temperature of each pre-oxidation temperature zone on the basis of the small tow pre-oxidation process, so that the deviation of the thermal stress of each pre-oxidation temperature zone of the large tow and the thermal stress of the corresponding small tow is within plus or minus 5%. The tensile strength of the large-tow carbon fiber prepared by the method is equivalent to that of the corresponding small-tow carbon fiber, and the ratio of the tensile strength of the large-tow carbon fiber to the tensile strength of the corresponding small-tow carbon fiber is 0.90-1.20.

title: Method of ionizing irradiation of textile polyacrylonitrile fibres and use thereof as carbon fibre precursor
abstract: What is described is a method of irradiating and oxidatively thermally stabilizing PAN fibres for production of a precursor fibre of carbon fibres. This method is characterized in that PAN fibres that are especially intended for textiles are subjected to ionizing irradiation and then specifically to an oxidative thermal stabilization. The thermal stabilization should preferably be effected as quickly as possible after the irradiation. The lowered Tonset-Z temperature (Tonset-Z E-PAN) of the E-PAN fibres obtained by irradiation is determined and then the oxidative thermal stabilization is initiated at a starting temperature corresponding to Tonset-Z E-PAN ± 30°C. The oxidative thermal stabilization is conducted with rising temperature up to a minimum density of the oxidatively thermally stabilized PAN fibres of 1.30 g/cm³. The method described is inexpensive and leads to advantageous precursor fibres of carbon fibres. The resultant carbon fibres show particularly favourable tensile strength values. Thus, inexpensive starting fibres, especially of PAN for textiles, are used to produce carbon fibres having good mechanical properties comparable to commercial carbon fibres.

title: Preparation method of high-modulus high-thermal-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-modulus high-heat-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing ethylene tar asphalt with a softening point of 80-90 ℃ by a normal-pressure nitrogen bubbling purging method, then adding triethyl borate into the ethylene tar asphalt, and preparing boron-containing spinnable mesophase asphalt by a pressurized thermal polymerization and reduced pressure devolatilization method; and then melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization are carried out to prepare a high-modulus high-heat-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber sample, wherein the tensile modulus is 800-900 GPa, and the heat conductivity is 800-1000W/m.K. According to the invention, boron is introduced into the intermediate phase spinning asphalt by a chemical reaction method, so that the uniform and controllable addition of the boron is realized, and the problem of non-uniform addition of the boron in the conventional method is solved; the boron element effectively plays a role in catalyzing graphitization in the subsequent preparation process of the asphalt-based carbon fiber, so that the graphitization treatment temperature is reduced, the service life of the graphitization furnace is prolonged, and the production cost is reduced.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor polymer and preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor polymer and a preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon materials. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor polymer provided by the invention is prepared from the following raw materials: the monomer comprises a first monomer, a second monomer, a third monomer, an initiator, methanol, a molecular weight regulator and an acidified water solvent. By optimizing the raw material composition, the invention improves the radial structural uniformity of the fiber in the preoxidation process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, avoids the generation of a skin-core structure in the preoxidation process, and fundamentally improves the mechanical property of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The embodiment result shows that the tensile strength of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber provided by the invention is 5.28-6.55 GPa.

title: Method for manufacturing carbon fiber bundle
abstract: In order to provide a method for suppressing the generation of fluff during conveying by a drive roller when producing a carbon fiber bundle having a high total fineness, a high elastic modulus, and a large yarn width with twisting added, provided is a method for manufacturing a carbon fiber bundle, the method comprising: performing a flame retardant treatment for heat-treating a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle in an oxidizing atmosphere at 200-300°C to obtain a flame retardant fiber bundle; then performing a pre-carbonization treatment for heat-treating the flame retardant fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere, in which the maximum temperature is controlled to be 500-1200°C, to obtain a pre-carbonized fiber bundle; and then performing a carbonization treatment for heat-treating the pre-carbonized fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere, in which the maximum temperature is controlled to be 1200-3000°C, to obtain a carbon fiber bundle, wherein the fiber bundle is moved in contact with the drive roller before and after the carbonization treatment, the obtained carbon fiber bundle has a total fineness A of 6000-40000 dtex and a maximum twist angle B of 1-10°, the tension C of the fiber bundle in the carbonization treatment is 50-500 N/bundle, and the diameter D of the drive roller before and after the carbonization treatment is 200-1000 mm.

title: Preparation method of high-modulus high-thermal-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber continuous filament
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-modulus high-heat-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber continuous filament, which comprises the steps of firstly, unwinding a primary-spun asphalt fiber continuous filament bundle to an oxidation carbonization mesh belt furnace through a filament returning mechanism for continuous oxidation carbonization treatment, realizing regulation and control of a molecular structure of the primary-spun asphalt fiber continuous filament bundle by regulating oxygen concentrations of different temperature areas in an oxidation process, and rewinding after the fiber obtains certain strength; and then, the high-modulus high-heat-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber continuous filament product is prepared through the processes of uncoiling, high-temperature carbonization, graphitization, sizing, drying, rolling and the like, wherein the tensile modulus is 900-950 GPa, the heat conductivity is 900-1100W/m.K, the tensile strength is 2-3.5 GPa, and the continuous length can reach more than 20000 m. On the premise of realizing the continuous preparation of the asphalt fibers, the modulus and the heat conductivity of the asphalt fibers are greatly improved by adjusting the pre-oxidation process, the production efficiency is high, and the industrial production is easy to realize.

title: Preparation method of high-strength electrostatic spinning polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofiber felt
abstract: A preparation method of a high-strength electrostatic spinning polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofiber felt belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. In the process of pre-oxidizing the electrospun polyacrylonitrile fiber felt, severe cyclization reaction and oxidation reaction in the pre-oxidation stage are avoided through at least three-stage (multi-temperature zone) short-time pre-oxidation, so that the phenomenon that the fiber is partially broken and loosened due to excessive structural defects in the fiber in the carbonization process is reduced, and the tensile strength of the carbon fiber felt is greatly improved. Further, the carbon fiber structure is prevented from being damaged due to serious decarburization caused by too long oxidation reaction caused by long-time preoxidation in the carbonization process, and the tensile strength of the carbon nanofiber felt is improved. The method can effectively improve the mechanical property of the electrostatic spinning acrylonitrile carbon nanofiber felt and improve the production efficiency.

title: High-tensile-modulus graphite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high tensile modulus graphite fiber and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: and carrying out heat treatment on the precursor fiber to obtain a heat crosslinking fiber, selecting the heat crosslinking fiber with the cyclization degree within the range of 55-100% by taking the cyclization degree as a structure control index of the heat crosslinking fiber, and continuously and sequentially passing the selected fiber through a seven-temperature-zone low-temperature carbonization furnace, a three-temperature-zone high-temperature carbonization furnace and a single-temperature-zone graphitization furnace to prepare the high-tensile-modulus graphite fiber. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the treatment processes of low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization are reasonably designed by controlling the cyclization degree of the raw material fiber, so that the high modulus performance of the carbon fiber is realized, and the tensile modulus of the carbon fiber prepared by the method is higher than 500 GPa.

title: Modified compound carbon fiber of graphene and the preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses modified compound carbon fibers of a kind of graphene and the preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method of the modified compound carbon fiber of the graphene includes: to be uniformly mixed functionalization graphene, carbon fiber precursor and solvent, the modified carbon fiber precursor solution of graphene is formed, as spinning solution；The modified carbon fiber precursor precursor of graphene is made through spinning technique with the spinning solution；Pre-oxidation treatment is carried out to the modified carbon fiber precursor precursor of the graphene, carries out carbonization treatment in protective atmosphere later, the modified compound carbon fiber of graphene is made.The excellent combination property of the modified compound carbon fiber of graphene of the present invention, wherein tensile strength up to 7.4GPa, stretch modulus up to 980GPa, conductivity up to 2.1 × 10 6 S·m ‑1 , thermal coefficient is up to 68.7Wm ‑1 ·K ‑1 , broad application prospect is all had in fields such as space flight, machinery, electronics, medical treatment, sport, while its preparation process is simple, controllability is good, is suitable for large-scale production.
