title: A method of carbon fiber is prepared by polyacrylonitrile fibril carbonization
abstract: The present invention provides a kind of method for preparing carbon fiber by polyacrylonitrile fibril carbonization, comprising the following steps: 1, pre-oxidized using multi-temperature zone, 160-310 DEG C of temperature range, degree of draft 0.5-10%, time 60-120min；2, using multi-temperature zone low-temperature carbonization, temperature is 400-1000 DEG C, time 60s-120s, and total draft rate is 1%-8%；3, using multi-temperature zone high temperature cabonization, temperature is 800-1600 DEG C, time 60s-120s, and degree of draft is -8%--1%.By rationally designing each phase temperature gradient of carbonisation, temperature range, the parameters such as draft ratio and wire travelling speed carry out pre-oxidation and carbonisation steadily, and oxidization fiber heat resistance is good, degree of molecular orientation is high, molecular arrangement more densifies, and carbon fiber structural is uniform, fracture of wire and simultaneously silk is few, tensile strength reaches 5000MPA or more, achievees the purpose that improve carbon fiber product quality.

title: A kind of preparation method of PAN base high-strength and high-modulus type carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to carbon fiber manufacturing technology field, specifically a kind of preparation method of PAN base high-strength and high-modulus type carbon fiber prepares 6K polyacrylonitrile fibril using wet spinning mode, uses 6 sections of gradient increased temperature modes that density is made as 1.35 ± 0.02g/cm 3 Pre-oxidized fibers；Under -2 ~ 2% draw ratio, 2 ± 0.5min of low-temperature carbonization at 300 ~ 900 DEG C；Under -4 ~ 0% draw ratio, at 1000 ~ 1800 DEG C, 3 ± 0.5min is handled through 6 ~ 8 sections of gradient increased temperature high temperature cabonizations；Under 5~10% draw ratio, at 2500 ~ 2800 DEG C, through 5 ~ 7 sections of gradient increased temperature 2 ± 0.5min of high temperature graphitization, graphite fibre is obtained；Gained graphite fibre is surface-treated 2 ± 0.5min through anodizing, obtains modified graphite fiber, and modified graphite fiber handles to obtain PAN base high-strength and high-modulus type carbon fiber using washing, starching.

title: High-strength high-modules carbon fibre and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses high-strength high-modules carbon fibre and preparation method thereof, this method is realized according to the following steps: (1) successively pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile fibril, low-temperature carbonization and high temperature cabonization, obtain carbon fiber；(2) carbon fiber is subjected to Infra Red laser radiations processing under an inert atmosphere, obtains radiation treatment carbon fiber；(3) the radiation treatment carbon fiber is subjected to gamma-ray irradiation processing, obtains high-strength high-modules carbon fibre.Polyacrylonitrile fibril is successively being pre-oxidized, is carrying out Infra Red laser radiations processing after low-temperature carbonization and high temperature cabonization again by this method, the random graphits structure of carbon fiber can be made to reset, form ordered structure, namely graphitization, and laser heating rate is fast, graphitization time can be shortened, improve throughput rate, then the carbon fiber further progress gamma-ray irradiation processing handled through Infra Red laser radiations can be made to crosslink between carbon fiber sheet layer, to further increase the intensity and modulus of carbon fiber.

title: A kind of high density flexible carbon/carbon composite friction material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of high density flexible carbon/carbon composite friction material and preparation method thereof, passes sequentially through polyacrylonitrile fibre, viscous glue based fibre, pitch-based fiber etc. through carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, preoxided thread yarn is woven into fabric later；Then the fabric worked out progress carbonization treatment is obtained into carbon fibre fabric；Finally, carbon fibre fabric is put into gaseous state C x H y In, in N 2 Protection under prepared high density flexible carbon/carbon composite friction material is obtained after chemical vapor deposition process.Finally obtain carbon fibre fabric enhancing C-base composte material of the filling yarn curvature greater than 30 °.The present invention is low by utilizing preoxided thread modulus, is easily woven into the high product of warp and weft curvature, easily reaches design thickness, while having excellent flexibility, after being carbonized and CVD deposition carbon is handled, can obtain flexible preferably carbon/carbon-carbon friction material.

title: A kind of PAN based graphite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of PAN based graphite fibers and preparation method thereof.The technical solution mainly used are as follows: a kind of PAN based graphite fiber, wherein the tensile strength of PAN based graphite fiber is 4.01~4.46GPa, stretch modulus is 541~547GPa, volume density is 1.89~1.91g/cm 3 ；The line density of 6K PAN based graphite fiber is 215~218g/km.The preparation method of above-mentioned PAN based graphite fiber includes the following steps: successively to pre-oxidize precursor, low-temperature carbonization, high temperature cabonization, graphitization and post-processing, obtains PAN based graphite fiber；Wherein, precursor is polyacrylonitrile fibre；The filament diameter of precursor is 9~11 μm；0.2~0.5 μm of the groove mean depth of precursor, groove mean breadth are 0.1~0.4 μm, surface roughness average Ra is 0.0182~0.0201 μm.Present invention is mainly used for prepare the more excellent PAN based graphite fibers of mechanical performance indexs such as a kind of intensity, modulus.

title: A kind of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors polymer and preparation method thereof, a kind of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present invention provides a kind of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors polymer and preparation method thereof and a kind of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibres and preparation method thereof, belong to polyacrylonitrile carbon-based material field.Polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors polymer provided by the invention is by including that the raw material of following components is prepared: the first monomer, second comonomer, Third monomer, initiator, methanol, molecular weight regulator, acidification aqueous solvent.The present invention improves the structural homogeneity of fiber radial direction during PAN-based carbon fiber precursor pre-oxidation, avoids and generate skin-core structure in preoxidation process, fundamentally improve the mechanical property of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre by the optimization formed to raw material.Embodiment the result shows that, the tensile strength of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre provided by the invention is 5.28~6.55GPa.

title: The preparation method of dry-jet wet-spinning high-strength and high-modulus wear-resisting polypropene itrile group carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of preparation methods of dry-jet wet-spinning high-strength and high-modulus wear-resisting polypropene itrile group carbon fiber.The carbon fibre that dry-jet wet-spinning polyacrylonitrile fibril is pre-oxidized and be carbonized by the present invention carries out graphitization hot-stretch processing at 2300~2500 DEG C, then anodic oxidation electrochemical treatments are used, graphitized carbon fibre is surface-treated, last starching, it is dry, starching agent content is 1.0~1.5%, obtains high-strength and high-modulus wear-resisting polypropene itrile group carbon fiber.The carbon fiber strength that the present invention obtains reaches 5000MPa or more, modulus reaches 380GPa or more, with compared with modulus grade products have higher elongation at break, elongation is 1.3% or more, product filoplume is few, with excellent processing performance, it is suitable for the fields such as high-grade Leisure Sport and space equipment.

abstract: The invention discloses a kind of preparation methods of high-modulus high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber continuous filament yarn, the first pitch fibers continuous long strand that spins is unwound to progress continuous oxidation carbonization treatment on oxidation carbonization meshbeltfurnace by hard waste mechanism first, the regulation and control for realizing its molecular structure by adjusting the oxygen concentration of different warm areas in oxidation process re-start winding again after fiber obtains some strength；Then high-modulus high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber continuous filament yarn product is made by processes such as uncoiling, high temperature cabonization, graphitization, starching, drying and windings again, stretch modulus is 900~950GPa, thermal conductivity is 900~1100W/mK, tensile strength is 2~3.5GPa, continuous length is up to 20000m or more.The present invention realizes the significantly promotion of its modulus and heat conductivility by adjusting pre-oxidation process, and production efficiency is high, it is easy to accomplish industrialized production under the premise of realizing prepared by pitch fibers serialization.

abstract: The invention discloses graphene carbon composite fibres and preparation method thereof, wherein the method is that graphene carbon composite fibre is made by ultrasonic wave added in-situ polymerization, spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization using cyano functional graphene oxide and acrylonitrile as raw material.There is excellent mechanical performance using graphene carbon composite fibre obtained by this method, and compared with existing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre preparation method, intensity is stretched using graphene carbon composite fibre obtained by the application method and improves 7%~86%, stretch modulus improves 6.8%~47%, the features such as preparation method has simple for process simultaneously, easy industrialized production.

title: A kind of preparation method of high intensity electrostatic spinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre felt
abstract: A kind of preparation method of high intensity Static Spinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre felt, belongs to technical field of carbon fiber preparation.During Static Spinning polyacrylonitrile fibre felt is pre-oxidized, it is pre-oxidized in short-term by least three stages (multi-temperature zone), avoid the cyclization and oxidation reaction that pre-oxidizing the stage is violent, fault of construction excessive in fiber is caused to cause fiber portion fractures and relaxation occur in carbonisation to reduce so that the tensile strength of carbon fiber felt increases substantially.Further avoided because of long-time pre-oxidation in carbonisation so that oxidation reaction is long, caused by decarburization it is serious and cause carbon fiber structural impaired, improve the tensile strength of carbon nanofiber felt.This method can effectively improve the mechanical property of Static Spinning acrylonitrile carbon nanofiber felt, and improve production efficiency.

title: The method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre polymer using mixed solvent
abstract: It the present invention relates to the use of the method that mixed solvent prepares polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre polymer.Using inorganic peroxide as initiator, itaconic acid is comonomer.Initiator and itaconic acid are dissolved in deionized water, be re-dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) or is dissolved in n,N-Dimethylformamide or is dissolved in n,N-dimethylacetamide or is dissolved in sodium thiocyanate solution.Acrylonitrile monemer polymerisation is added at 30 DEG C~90 DEG C 1~15 hour, obtains acrylonitrile polymer.The present invention is by adjusting regulation and control of the proportioning realization to polyacrylonitrile molecular weight.The product obtained using preparation method of the present invention, number-average molecular weight is 5~250,000, molecular weight distribution index < 1.5, yield > 90%, polymer obtained obtains carbon fiber through spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization, and tensile strength has reached 7.0GPa or more.The present invention is conducive to the control and the de- list after reaction, the deaeration that control temperature of reaction system by the way that deionized water is added in system.Pollution can be reduced, cost is reduced.

abstract: The present invention relates to organic polymer field, specifically a kind of method for preparing high strength and modulus graphite fibre, it is characterised in that comprise the following steps：By polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibre in air atmosphere in being pre-oxidized in 180~280 DEG C of temperature ranges, 60~110min is heat-treated using 6 sections of gradient increased temperature modes, it is 1.34 ± 0.02g/cm that density, which is made, 3 Pre-oxidized fibers, then by conventional silicon carbide condition：Under nitrogen protection; under 0~4% draw ratio; in 3 ± 1.5min of low-temperature carbonization at 300~900 DEG C, by gained fiber at 1000~2000 DEG C 3 ± 1.5min of high temperature cabonization, draw ratio be 4~0%; phosphorus content is made and is more than 98%; a diameter of 5 μm of carbon fiber, by gained carbon fiber under inert gas shielding, in 2 ± 1min of graphitization at 2200~2500 DEG C; draw ratio is 1~5%, obtains graphite fibre.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: 1. weighing various raw materials; 2. carrying out polymerization reaction to obtain a polymer solution; 3. vacuumizing to remove unreacted monomers; 4. vacuumizing to perform static degassing, thereby obtaining a spinning stock solution; 5. carrying out solidification treatment on the spinning stock solution, and drawing to obtain a filament bundle; and 6. sequentially carrying out water washing, oiling and drying treatment, and drawing the dried filament bundle in pressurized steam to obtain the carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method has the obvious characteristics of simple raw materials and stable properties of the polymer solution. The carbon fiber precursor has the advantages of favorable section shape, moderate tensile strength, high density and good quality, and can obtain a high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with the tensile strength of 5.5-5.8 GPa and the tensile modulus of 295-305 GPa after being subjected to preoxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment.

title: Preparation method of compound glassfiber filter felt
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a compound glassfiber filter felt, and belongs to the technical field of filter felt materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly taking acrylonitrile, acrylamide and the like to carry out a water bath reaction, carrying out reconcentration on a petroleum ether extraction organic layer, adding dimethylformamide to carry out spinning, carrying out oxidation and carbonization to obtain standby carbon fiber, taking a liquid supernatant after activated sludge and smashed lotus leaf powder are fermented, then adding nanosilicon dioxide, gamma-aminopropyltriethoxysilane and the like for stirring to obtain wetting fluid, then carrying out needling on a carbon fiber layer and base cloth to prepare the filter felt, then soaking in the wetting fluid, drying and cooling to obtain the compound glassfiber filter felt. According to the preparation method, the carbon fiber is obtained by carbonizing polyacrylonitrile fiber, so that the intrinsic characteristics of a traditional carbon material are maintained, and the high performances such as high strength and high temperature resistance are also improved, and the filter felt prepared through staggered spinning with the glassfiber is more compact in surface; and living examples indicate that the obtained filter felt can work under high temperature for a long period of time, and is high in temperature resistance, high in tensile strength and good in stripping quality for dust.

title: A kind of pre-oxidation furnace
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of pre-oxidation furnace, including body of heater shell, roller, circulating fan and air exhauster, described circulating fan is connected with body of heater shell by connecting pipeline with air exhauster, stove end damping device it is provided with at the two ends of body of heater shell, it is provided with humidifier tube inside stove end damping device, humidifier tube is provided with and adds wet hole, and humidifier tube is connected with humidification liquid basin by connecting pipeline.The present invention is provided with stove end damping device at pre-oxidation furnace two ends, in pre-oxidation production process, the mechanical friction damage of carbon fiber can be greatly reduced, greatly reduce the lousiness amount of carbon fiber surface, the oxidization fiber of this pre-oxidation furnace pre-oxidation carbon fibre precursor gained, substantially without skin-core structure or there is the slightest skin-core structure, there are raising, carbon fiber not easy fracture greatly through its hot strength of carbon fiber prepared by this oxidization fiber carbonization and tensile modulus of elasticity.

abstract: The invention discloses a mesophase-pitch-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of conducting mesophase pitch polymerization, modification and visbreaking, conducting centrifugal spinning, conducting hot jetting drafting, conducting oxidation, carbonization and graphitization, and obtaining the mesophase-pitch-based carbon fiber. Realize the synchronous promotion of carbon fiber tensile modulus and intensity, solved well mould carbon fiber tensile strength and descend and the key problem that the cost is high at home.

title: Preparation method of continuous high-performance intermediate-phase asphalt-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of continuous high-performance intermediate-phase asphalt-based carbon fiber. The preparation method includes: winding spun carbon fiber precursor into a microporous graphite crucible through a garnett, disposing the graphite crucible in a pre-oxidation furnace, and feeding air to pre-oxidize the carbon fiber precursor in the pre-oxidation furnace; after pre-oxidation is finished, feeding inert gas, and performing low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization on pre-oxidized carbon fiber; cooling the pre-oxidation furnace to normal temperature, taking out the graphite crucible, and disposing the same in an intermittent high-temperature graphitizing furnace for graphitizing to obtain continuous high-strength high-modulus high-heat-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber. The preparation method is simple and high in controllability and yield, and the defect that a domestic continuous graphitizing furnace cannot be heated to higher than 2800 DEG C is overcome; tensile strength of the high-performance intermediate-phase asphalt-based carbon fiber is 2.2-3.5GPa, modulus of elasticity is 650-750GPa, and heat conductivity is 900-1050 W/m*K.

title: A kind of island spinning spinning pack and utilize its preparation method preparing ultrafine carbon fiber
abstract: A kind of island spinning spinning pack and utilize its preparation method preparing ultrafine carbon fiber, it relates to the preparation method of spinning pack and superfine fibre.It is intended to solve the technical problem that the intensity of existing carbon fiber is low.Island spinning spinning pack includes that component pond, island, island component go out fiber tube, sea component pond, sea component go out fiber tube and island synthesizer；Island component goes out fiber tube and stretches into sea component and go out in fiber tube and centrage overlaps, and island component goes out fiber tube and sea component and goes out fiber tube and be placed in the synthesizer of island.The method preparing ultrafine carbon fiber: add after polyacrylonitrile is dissolved in component pond, island, polymethyl methacrylate is joined in sea component pond, spinning, coagulating bath is entered in atmosphere after drawing-off, then room temperature drawing-off, high temperature drawing-off are carried out, remove sea component again, after obtain ultrafine carbon fiber through pre-oxidation and carbonization.This has ultrafine carbon fiber hot strength to be higher than 324GPa higher than 6.6GPa, stretch modulus.Can be used for Aero-Space, automobile, building and chemical field.

title: Electrically conductive carbon fiber with excellent spun and weaving property and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Electrically conductive carbon fiber of the present invention has the surface conductivity specific resistance of 10^-^5-10^1^0 Ωm and the modulus of 5-50 Gpa. According to a method for manufacturing electrically conducive carbon fiber of the present invention, when the carbon fiber is manufactured by performing flame retardant treatment and carbonization treatment for precursor fiber for carbon fiber manufactured by spinning a spinning solution including a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer, the carbonization treatment is performed at 450-800°C. The electrically conductive carbon fiber of the present invention has a low surface conductivity specific resistance and thus has excellent antistatic performance. At the same time, the electrically conductive carbon fiber has excellent flexibility. Therefore, when yarn is manufactured, mixed spinning properties with respect to a different kind of fiber staple and spinning properties are significantly enhanced, and weaving properties and knitting properties can be enhanced.

abstract: The invention relates to a process method for preparing intermediate phase lignin and carbon fibers thereof. The process method is characterized in that a condensing agent is added for carrying out heat treatment reaction modification and further condensation polymerization on various lignin to obtain a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon substance with an intermediate phase, the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon substance is prepared into the intermediate phase lignin, and the intermediate phase lignin can be used for preparing various carbon materials. title: Manufacturing method of high-modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a high-modulus carbon fiber. The obtained product comprises the following contents: a pre-oxidized precursor fiber is made into a flat shape, a high-performance preoxidized fiber is obtained by a catalysis, oxidation and intermittent temperature control method, a tensile force is uniformly distributed by splitting and spreading, fiber graphitization is achieved through micro-wave auxiliary heating, in the whole preparation way, the graphitization temperature is as high as 3000 DEG C, the fiber strength can reach 3-6.5 GPa, and the modulus can reach 300-650 GPa.
assignee: 杨军
inventors: YANG JUN

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: 1. weighing various raw materials; 2. carrying out polymerization reaction to obtain a polymer solution; 3. vacuumizing to remove unreacted monomers; 4. vacuumizing to perform static degassing, thereby obtaining a spinning stock solution; 5. carrying out solidification treatment on the spinning stock solution, and drawing to obtain a filament bundle; and 6. sequentially carrying out water washing, oiling and drying treatment, and drawing the dried filament bundle in pressurized steam to obtain the carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method has the obvious characteristics of simple raw materials and stable properties of the polymer solution. The carbon fiber precursor has the advantages of favorable section shape, moderate tensile strength, high density and good quality, and can obtain a high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with the tensile strength of 5.5-5.8 GPa and the tensile modulus of 295-305 GPa after being subjected to preoxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment.

title: Carbon fiber and method for producing the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide carbon fiber that gives a composite material having excellent impact resistance, has high tensile strength in a fiber axis direction and has excellent compressive stress in a fiber cross-sectional direction.SOLUTION: Carbon fiber of the present invention has a carbon fiber density of 1.92 g/cmor more, when measured by a helium filling method after being crushed into pieces having a volume average particle diameter of 0.5 μm, and has a crystal orientation degree of 80% or less. In a carbon fiber production method of the present invention, flame resistant fiber, which is obtained by subjecting polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber to flame resistant treatment, is subjected to carbonization treatment. The flame resistant fiber is subjected to first carbonization treatment at a treatment temperature of 350-550°C and at a draw ratio of more than 1.00 to obtain first carbonized fiber. The first carbonized fiber is subjected to second carbonization treatment at a treatment temperature of 650-850°C and at a draw ratio of less than 1.00, and then further subjected to third carbonization treatment at a treatment temperature of 1,000°C or higher.
assignee: 東邦テナックス株式会社; Toho Tenax Co Ltd
inventors: OBATA MASAKO; YOSHIKAWA HIDEKAZU

title: Carbon fiber sheet production device
abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber sheet production device which comprises a weaving device, a two-level pre-oxidation treatment device, a carbonization treater, a graphitization treater, an epoxy resin treatment bath device and a solvent dryer in sequential connection, wherein the weaving device comprises a stock solution storage tank, a filter, a metering pump, a coagulating bath device, a plying device and a weft knitting machine in sequential connection; waste gas outlets are formed in the two-level pre-oxidation treatment device and the carbonization treater; a carbonization decomposition product outlet is also formed in the carbonization treater; a nondestructive test device is arranged between the graphitization treater and the epoxy resin treatment bath device; a nondestructive test device is also arranged at the output end of the solvent dryer. According to the device disclosed by the invention, by adopting an organic fiber carbonization method, the reaction extent difference between the surface layer and interior of fiber in the pre-oxidation process is reduced, the pre-oxidation process is accelerated, the production cost is reduced, and the oxidation resistance and mechanical properties and particularly the tensile strength and modulus of the carbon fiber are improved.
assignee: 张月婵
inventors: ZHANG YUECHAN

title: Production device for carbon fiber cloth
abstract: The utility model provides a production device for carbon fiber cloth. The production device comprises a cloth weaving device, a two-stage pre-oxidization treatment device, a carbonization treating device, a graphitization treating device, an epoxy resin treating bath device and a solvent dryer which are connected in sequence, wherein the cloth weaving device comprises a raw liquid storage groove, a filtering machine, a metering pump, a condensing bath device, a plying device and a weft knitting machine which are connected in sequence; each of the two-stage pre-oxidization treatment device and the carbonization treating device is provided with a waste gas exhausting opening; the carbonization treating device is further provided with a carbonized decomposition product exhausting opening; a nondestructive inspection device is arranged between the graphitization treating device and the epoxy resin treating bath device; the output end of the solvent dryer is also provided with the nondestructive inspection device. The production device adopts a method for carbonizing organic fibers to reduce a reaction degree difference of the surface layer and the inner part of the fibers in a pre-oxidization process, accelerate the pre-oxidization process, reduce the production cost and improve anti-oxidation and mechanical properties of the carbon fibers, particularly, the tensile strength and the modulus are improved.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method thereof
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a carbon fiber which has excellent tensile elasticity and adhesion strength and exerts excellent mechanical strength in carbon fiber reinforced composite materials using the carbon fiber in a very small amount used.SOLUTION: A method of producing a carbon fiber bundle comprises: subjecting polyacrylonitrile based precursor fiber bundle to a flame resistance imparting treatment and preliminary carbonization to obtain a preliminarily carbonized fiber bundle; and carbonizing the preliminarily carbonized fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere of 1,200-2,000°C under a tensile force of 13-18 mN/dtex. The trial length dependency coefficient mof the bundle strength of the preliminarily carbonized fiber bundle during carbonization is 10-40, or the carbon fiber bundle has a crystallite size Lc (nm) of 1.7-5.6, a crystal orientation π(%) meeting the condition 3.1×Lc+82<π<3.1×Lc+83 and a trial length dependency coefficient mof the bundle strength of 12-40.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method thereof
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a carbon fiber which has excellent tensile elasticity and adhesion strength and exerts excellent mechanical strength even in carbon fiber reinforced composite materials using the carbon fiber in a very small amount used.SOLUTION: A method of producing a carbon fiber bundle comprises: subjecting a polyacrylonitrile based precursor fiber bundle to a flame resistance imparting treatment and preliminary carbonization to obtain a preliminarily carbonized fiber bundle of a trial length dependency coefficient mof the bundle strength of 2-9; and carbonizing the preliminarily carbonized fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere of 1,200-2,000°C under a tensile force of 13-18 mN/dtex, and the distance between drive rollers before and after the carbonization oven is set to be 50-500 mm. The carbon fiber bundle has a crystallite size Lc (nm) of 1.7-5.6, a crystal orientation π(%) meeting the condition 3.1×Lc+82<π<3.1×Lc+83 and a trial length dependency coefficient mof the bundle strength of 2-11.

title: Method for producing carbon fiber bundle, and carbon fiber bundle
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a carbon fiber which has both of high strand strength and high strand elastic modulus simultaneously and excellent quality and allows even the CFRP (carbon fiber-reinforced plastic) obtained by using an extremely small amount thereof to exhibit excellent mechanical strength.SOLUTION: A carbon fiber bundle has 300-600 mm of an average splittable distance, 5,900 MPa or higher strand strength, 320 GPa or higher strand elastic modulus, and 0.5-3 pieces/m of a single fiber breaking number. A method for producing the carbon fiber bundle comprises the steps of: flame-proofing a polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber bundle to obtain a flame-proofed fiber bundle; pre-carbonizing the flame-proofed fiber bundle to obtain a pre-carbonized fiber bundle which is untwisted substantially and has 150-500 mm of the average splittable distance; and carbonizing the pre-carbonized fiber bundle in an inert gas atmosphere and in a predetermined temperature range while exerting predetermined carbonization tension thereon to obtain the substantially-untwisted carbon fiber bundle.

title: Dry-jet wet-spinning method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor. The method comprises the following steps of: copolymerizing acrylonitrile and copolymerization components in multicomponent solution so as to form polymer spinning stock solution which has a relatively uniform and controllable molecular structure, performing demonomerization on the spinning stock solution, defoaming, filtering, and preparing the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor by a dry-jet wet-spinning process. The key technology of the method is that: a gas storage box is arranged on a dry wet spinning pack, the gas storage box and the liquid level of coagulating bath fluid form a dry-jet wet-spinning air layer into a confined space, and ammonia is persistently aerated into the space to carry out gas-liquid reaction with spinning solution trickle in the air layer. The polyacrylonitrile precursor prepared by the method has regular sections and few defects, the density is not less than 1.187g/cm<3>, the density after carbonization is not less than 1.79g/cm<3>, the strength is not less than 5.1GPa, and the modulus of elasticity is 280 to 300GPa.

title: Process method for preparing intermediate phase lignin and carbon fibers thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a process method for preparing intermediate phase lignin and carbon fibers thereof. The process method is characterized in that a condensing agent is added for carrying out heat treatment reaction modification and further condensation polymerization on various lignin to obtain a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon substance with an intermediate phase, the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon substance is prepared into the intermediate phase lignin, and the intermediate phase lignin can be used for preparing various carbon materials. The high-intensity and high-modulus lignin carbon fibers can be prepared by melt spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization of the intermediate phase lignin prepared by the method, and is comparable with high-performance pitch-based carbon fibers and high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers.

title: Preparation method of high-carbon fiber woven filler
abstract: A preparation method of a high-carbon fiber woven filler relates to a preparation method of a woven filler. Sequentially carrying out constant-temperature filament discharge, multi-section pre-oxidation, medium-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization protected by a micro-aerobic carbon corrosion method on polyacrylonitrile fiber bundles: wherein the pre-oxidation temperature of the low section is 238-: the micro-oxygen carbon etching method uses nitrogen as carbon wire protective gas, and the temperature of high-temperature carbonization is 1450-1700 ℃; the prepared high-carbon fiber woven filler has good self-lubricating property, high strength, high modulus, high and low temperature resistance, corrosion resistance and heat conducting property, can be used for a long time in a medium containing particle fluid and in high linear speed rotation, and can be used for replacing all the existing filler products made of various materials.

title: Method for preparing high performance carbon fiber by controlling tensile force
abstract: A method for preparing high performance carbon fiber by controlling tensile force is characterized in that polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber is placed in a thermal treatment furnace at the temperature ranging from 120 to 200 DEG C, 5 to 30 MPa of tensile force is exerted, and low temperature synchronous modification treatment is conducted for 2 to 10 minutes in the presence of air dielectric. Processed fiber is processed through thermal oxidation stabilization and carbonization to obtain carbon fiber. Tensile strength of the obtained carbon fiber is higher than 3.5 GPa.

title: Carbon fiber, process for production of polyacrylonitrile-base precursor fiber for carbon fiber production, and process for production of carbon fiber
abstract: A process for producing polyacrylonitrile-base precursor fibers for production of carbon fibers, which comprises spinning a spinning dope containing 10 to 25 wt % of a polyacrylonitrile-base polymer having an intrinsic viscosity of 2.0 to 10.0 by extruding the spinning dope from a spinneret by a wet spinning or a dry wet spinning method, drying and heat-treating fibers obtained by the spinning, and then steam drawing the resulting fibers, wherein the linear extrusion rate of the polyacrylonitrile-base polymer from the spinneret is 2 to 15 m/min. Carbon fibers which are produced by stabilizing-carbonizing treatment of the polyacrylonitrile-base precursor fibers and which have a strand tensile modulus of 320 to 380 GPa and a conduction electron density of 3.0×10 19  to 7.0×10 19  spins/g as determined by electron spin resonance.

title: Method for preparing carbon fibre braided packing
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing braided packing, in particular to a method for preparing carbon fiber braided packing, which mainly aims to solve problems of causing equipment to be frequently shutdown for inspection and affecting the normal operation of the production due to low tensile strength, easy scouring during the use, short service life, and the need of frequent replacement existing in the prior art. The method also solves the technical problems that certain materials with better strength have no electric conductivity and heat conductivity and can be overheated and burnt when the materials are used under working conditions of high pressure, high temperature and high speed, thereby easily producing dielectric leakage, frequently causing process shutdown, bringing great loss to the production and economy and so on. The method comprises the steps: the adoption of a polyacrylonitrile fiber, constant-temperature filament unwinding, multi-stage pre-oxidation, middle-temperature carbonization, the protection of high temperature carbonization by a micro-oxygen carbon corrosion method, sizing, filament winding, one-step carbon filament pretreatment, pipe inversion, the adjustment of spindle tension, fixed temperature constant control braiding, negative pressure filling and soaking, drying, shaping, inspection, packing and warehouse entry.

title: Method for preparing high strength carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for high strength carbon fibers, wherein, after preoxidation, polyacrylonitrile fibers are immersed into 2 to 20 weight percent of polyethylene glycol aqueous solution modifier for modification, and then the high strength carbon fibers are prepared after water scrubbing, drying and carbonization, thereby a method for preparing the high strength carbon fibers, which has the advantages of convenient operation, simple equipment, basic nonpollution to the environment and low cost, is obtained, and tensile strength of the carbon fibers prepared after modification is significantly improved.

title: Hybrid yard for the fabrication of fiber preforms of composite parts, and method for its preparation
abstract: A yarn is formed from discontinuous parallel fibers which are not twisted and which are held together by a covering yarn of sacrificial material wound around the fibers. The fibers comprise an intimate mixture of fibers of at least two different natures selected from carbon fibers or pre-oxidized polyacrylonitrile based carbon precursor fibers, or anisotropic or isotropic pitch based carbon precursor fibers, or phenolic or cellulosic based carbon precursor fibers, and ceramic fibers or ceramic precursor fibers. The mixture of fibers comprises, in its carbon state, at least 15% by weight of high strength fibers, having a tensile strength of at least 1500 MPa and a modulus of at least 150 MPa, and at least 15% by weight of fibers with a low Young's modulus of at most 100 GPa.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and method for producing same
abstract: Provided are a carbon fiber bundle and a method for producing the same, wherein entanglement caused by annular fluff generated when unwinding the carbon fiber bundle for high-order processing can be suppressed by suppressing specific fluff contained in the carbon fiber bundle. The average single fiber diameter B is 6.9-11.0 mu m, the tensile elastic modulus E of the resin impregnation wire bundle is 230-310 GPa, the internal fluff in the carbon fiber bundle is below 40/m, and the proportion of fluff with a double structure in the section among the internal fluff in the carbon fiber bundle is 1-25%. In the step of heat-treating a polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber bundle having a single fiber fineness of 0.9 to 2.2dtex under an oxidizing atmosphere at 200 to 300 ℃, a flame-retardant fiber bundle is obtained by heat-treating the fiber bundle while applying a tensile force of 1.6 to 4.0 mm/dtex until the density becomes 1.38 to 1.50g/cm  3 , and then heat-treating the flame-retardant fiber bundle in an inactive atmosphere at 1,200 to 1,600 ℃ when the single fiber fineness of the flame-retardant fiber bundle is d (dtex) and the yarn width is W (mm), wherein the heat-generating rate Q on the left side of formula (3) becomes 150 to 500J/m  2 /s, until the density becomes 1.22 to 1.24g/cm  3 . Q=q×N×d/W/10· (3).

title: High-performance polyacrylonitrile precursor, high-performance carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a high-performance polyacrylonitrile precursor, a high-performance carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The section of the carbon fiber prepared from the high-performance polyacrylonitrile precursor is tested by GB/T3362-2017, the carbon fiber comprises fibers with concave areas and fibers with grooves, the number of the fibers with the concave areas is not more than 25% of the total number of the fibers, and the number of the fibers with the grooves is not more than 20% of the total number of the fibers. The preparation method of the high-performance polyacrylonitrile precursor comprises the steps of solidification forming and solidification drawing, wherein the relation of 0.4 (V  S -V E )≤(V E -V C )≤1.1(V S -V E ) is satisfied in the steps of solidification forming and solidification drawing. The prepared carbon fiber has high tensile strength, high tensile modulus, high elongation and low CV value.

title: Hollow carbon fiber, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a hollow carbon fiber, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of heating mesophase pitch to obtain molten pitch, heating thermoplastic polymer to obtain molten polymer, taking the molten pitch as molten pitch external liquid, taking the molten polymer as molten polymer internal liquid, carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning to obtain fiber precursor, and carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, carbonization treatment and graphitization treatment on the fiber precursor in sequence to obtain the hollow carbon fiber. The invention adopts a coaxial melt spinning mode, and adopts intermediate phase pitch as an external liquid raw material and a high polymer with easy pyrolysis and low carbonization yield as an internal liquid raw material, thereby achieving the purposes of completely volatilizing and decomposing the internal liquid raw material in the subsequent high-temperature treatment process and forming a stable shell layer by the external liquid raw material, and further realizing the preparation of the intermediate phase pitch carbon fiber with controllable hollowness, stable structure and obviously improved specific strength.

title: Bio-based carbon fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application provides a biobased carbon fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of dissociating biobased raw materials into carbon fiber precursors, spinning the carbon fiber precursors to form biobased monofilaments, and sequentially performing preoxidation, carbonization and graphitization on the biobased monofilaments to obtain the carbon fiber monofilaments; weaving and needling the carbon fiber monofilaments to form a carbon fiber felt, and densifying the carbon fiber felt to fill amorphous carbon and/or pyrolytic carbon in the carbon fiber felt to obtain the bio-based carbon fiber composite material. The bio-based carbon fiber composite material has higher heat conduction performance and wear resistance.
assignee: 诸暨市幄肯中智新材料有限公司

title: High-strength high-modulus fiber reinforced composite rod and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a high-strength high-modulus fiber reinforced composite rod and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of fiber reinforced composite materials, and comprising the following steps of (a) directionally arranging and bundling high-strength fibers and high-modulus carbon fibers to obtain fiber bundles; the high-strength fiber comprises polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the high-strength fiber is high-strength fiber subjected to anodic oxidation surface treatment, the high-modulus carbon fiber is high-modulus carbon fiber subjected to plasma surface treatment, and the high-strength high-modulus fiber reinforced composite material rod is obtained by impregnating fiber bundles with resin glue solution, carrying out pultrusion and coating with a polymer protective layer. The invention solves the technical problem of uneven stress transmission caused by large difference of tensile modulus and/or strength and different interface bonding performance with a matrix, and achieves the technical effects of high strength and high modulus performance of the composite rod, low production difficulty of a pultrusion process and high overall interface shear strength.

title: Electrode material with gradient pore structure and doped with hetero elements, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a doped electrode material with a gradient pore structure and a hetero element, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of energy storage of all-vanadium redox flow batteries. The method comprises the steps of performing pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on a precursor fiber felt to obtain a carbon fiber felt, immersing the carbon fiber felt in an activating solution, drying and calcining the carbon fiber felt, performing graphitization treatment on a porous carbon felt to obtain a porous graphite felt, sequentially performing activation treatment on the porous graphite felt in a carbon dioxide atmosphere and an air atmosphere to obtain a gradient Kong Huohua felt, immersing the gradient Kong Huohua felt in a hetero element solution, and calcining the impregnated carbon fiber felt to obtain the electrode material with a gradient pore structure and a hetero element doping. The method of the invention obtains the electrode material doped with the mixed elements and the gradient pore structure, which has good hydrophilicity, high specific surface area, gradient pore structure, high energy efficiency and long cycle stability.

title: Polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber and carbon fiber, and preparation methods therefor
abstract: The present invention provides a polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber and a carbon fiber, and preparation methods therefor. A carbon fiber bundle comprises fibers having indented/protruded cross sections and fibers having grooved cross sections after testing according to GB/T 3362-2017, wherein the proportion X% of the number of the fibers having indented/protruded cross sections relative to the total number of fibers in the carbon fiber bundle is not greater than 25%; and the proportion Y% of the number of the fibers having grooved cross sections relative to the total number of fibers in the carbon fiber bundle is not greater than 20%. The carbon fiber has high tensile strength, high tensile modulus, high elongation and a low CV value. A preparation method for the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber comprises the steps of coagulation molding and coagulation drawing. In the coagulation molding step, the following relational expression is satisfied: 0.4(V S -V E )≤(V E -V C )≤1.1(V S -V E ), wherein when a polyacrylonitrile spinning dope is 2 cm away from the surface of a spinneret plate, the flow rate of a coagulating liquid at the central point of a fiber bundle is V C , the flow rate of the coagulating liquid at the upper edge of the fiber bundle is V E , and the flow rate of the surface layer of the coagulating liquid is V S .

title: Preparation method of viscose-based fiber heat-insulation composite material
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a viscose-based fiber heat-insulation composite material, which comprises the following steps of taking viscose precursor as a raw material, carrying out densification treatment, pre-oxidation and surface coating to obtain high-strength viscose-based carbon fiber, compounding the viscose-based carbon fiber with a carbon source precursor, and carrying out carbonization and graphitization treatment to prepare the heat-insulation composite material.

title: Method for preparing superfine diameter high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and product
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of novel high-molecular carbon materials, in particular to a method for preparing superfine diameter high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers and a product thereof, comprising the steps of preparing low-viscosity high-purity mesophase pitch by a three-step method; the preparation method comprises the steps of adopting a melt extrusion spinning process to obtain mesophase pitch-based precursor fibers, carrying out a pre-oxidation process, adopting a mesh belt furnace process in a low-temperature carbonization process, carrying out graphite treatment, carrying out electrolytic water washing and sizing reel treatment. The invention adopts a three-step method to prepare low-viscosity high-purity mesophase pitch, is convenient for fine diameter spinning and controlling fine diameter yarn breakage, reduces the defect that a yarn spraying port is easy to cool and cannot be drawn for a long distance in the fine diameter spinning process by adding two sections of cooling gas, avoids the defect that the fiber strength is low and the diameter is nonuniform, uses a mesh belt furnace for pre-oxidation and low-temperature carbonization treatment, omits a high-temperature carbonization process, directly enters graphitization treatment, avoids the risk of low-strength easy yarn breakage of fine diameter fibers in the carbonization process, and reduces the quantity of broken yarns and abrasion process.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers, and particularly relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the tensile modulus of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is improved, the tensile modulus is 200-780 GPa, and the tensile strength is more than 2.4 GPa. According to the invention, through the gasification reaction of the metal catalyst, the formation of a graphite-like structure of the carbon fiber and the improvement of the regularity of the graphite-like structure are promoted, elements except carbon elements are removed, through low-temperature graphitization, the plane of a graphite layer is further oriented along the fiber axis, the rigidity of a molecular chain is increased, the modulus is improved, and meanwhile, the problems of large filament quantity and high energy consumption of the carbon fiber during graphitization are effectively solved. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber provided by the invention has high tensile modulus, is suitable for scenes with high mechanical property requirements, such as aerospace, automobile materials, sports equipment or wind power generation, and has wide application prospect.

abstract: The invention discloses a composite graphite felt electrode and a preparation method thereof, at least comprising the following steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile in a solvent, adding a metal source, performing ultrasonic dispersion to form uniform spinning solution, preparing composite fiber precursor through wet spinning, preparing the fiber precursor into a composite white felt through a needle punching forming process, and obtaining the composite graphite felt electrode with high stability through pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization and high-temperature steam activation processes. All the steps can be compatible with the existing graphite felt production line and graphite felt high-temperature activation line, complicated equipment transformation is not needed, and the preparation of the metal oxide in-situ modified composite graphite felt electrode is synchronously realized in the graphite felt production and activation process. The composite graphite felt electrode prepared by the invention greatly improves the electrochemical activity of the electrode by utilizing the synergistic catalysis of the metal oxide and the oxygen-containing functional group.

title: Low-resistivity carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers, and provides a low-resistivity carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of mixing acrylonitrile, itaconic acid, soluble asphalt powder and an organic solvent, mixing the mixture with azodiisoheptanenitrile, carrying out polymerization reaction on the obtained mixed solution, filtering the mixed solution to obtain a spinning solution, carrying out phase separation on the spinning solution in a coagulating bath after spinning the spinning solution, sequentially carrying out water washing, hot water drawing, drying densification and steam drawing on formed primary fibers to obtain composite fiber precursors, and sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment on the composite fiber precursors. The invention adopts an in-situ polymerization method to quickly and uniformly introduce the soluble asphalt into an acrylonitrile copolymer reaction system, regulates the ratio of the soluble asphalt in the reaction system to prepare low-resistivity carbon fibers with different asphalt contents, and can induce the graphitization transformation of fiber matrixes by virtue of the characteristic that polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon and alkyl side chains are easy to graphitize in the high-temperature carbonization process, so that the conductivity of the corresponding carbon fibers is flexibly controlled.

title: Method for preparing spinnable mesophase pitch and pitch-based carbon fiber by free radical initiated induced polycondensation
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing spinnable mesophase pitch and pitch-based carbon fibers by free radical initiation induced polycondensation, and relates to the technical field of petroleum deep processing. The method comprises the steps of (1) taking aromatic hydrocarbon-rich heavy oil as a raw material, selecting a CuO/CeMnO  3  composite catalyst, carrying out catalytic oxidation polycondensation to prepare an asphalt precursor, (2) regulating and controlling aromatic hydrocarbon composition of the asphalt precursor through supercritical extraction and removing catalyst particles, (3) taking an extraction component as the raw material, introducing a free radical initiator, and carrying out free radical initiation induced polycondensation to obtain the spinnable mesophase asphalt. And carrying out melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment on the mesophase pitch to obtain the pitch-based carbon fiber. According to the invention, the composition of raw materials is regulated and controlled through catalytic oxidation polycondensation and supercritical extraction, aromatic hydrocarbon molecules are induced by a free radical initiator to generate a semi-rigid structure, the fluidity of mesophase pitch is improved, the content of the mesophase pitch mesophase obtained is high (> 95%), the softening point is low (250-290 ℃), and the spinnability is good.

abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-heat-conductivity C/C composite material, which comprises the following steps: performing thermal cutting and thermal polymerization on the FCC slurry oil to obtain an isotropic pitch precursor I; carrying out thermal polymerization II on the isotropic pitch precursor I to obtain mesophase pitch; taking the mesophase pitch as a raw material to perform melt spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization to obtain mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers, and performing three-dimensional braiding on the mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers to obtain a three-dimensional mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber preform; and (3) taking the isotropic pitch precursor I as an impregnant, and performing impregnation, mesophase transformation, pressurized carbonization and graphitization on the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber preform to obtain the high-heat-conductivity C/C composite material.

title: Lignocellulose-based carbon fiber with excellent electrochemical performance, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to lignocellulose-based carbon fiber with excellent electrochemical performance, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. In order to solve the problem that morphology collapse is easy to occur when lignin and cellulose are mixed to prepare carbon fibers, the invention provides a preparation method of lignocellulose-based carbon fibers with excellent electrochemical performance, which comprises the steps of extracting lignin, preparing lignocellulose-based precursors, and preparing the lignocellulose-based carbon fibers through electrostatic spinning, drying, pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment. The invention overcomes the limitation of weak intermolecular interaction of lignin and cellulose in the physical mixing process, prepares the lignocellulose-based carbon fiber with excellent fiber morphology, high graphitization degree and excellent electrochemical performance, and realizes the potential application of the lignocellulose-based carbon fiber in the fields of flexible carriers, electrodes, textiles, sensor equipment and the like.

title: Hollow carbon fiber with multiple nanometer pore canals and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a hollow carbon fiber with multiple nanometer pore channels and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber, wherein a plurality of communicated longitudinal hollow pore channels are arranged in the carbon fiber, the total volume of the pore channels accounts for 20-80% of the total volume of the carbon fiber, the carbon content is more than 98%, the diameter of the carbon fiber is 5-50 mu m, and the graphitization degree is 80-100. The preparation method of the carbon fiber comprises the steps of melting and mixing asphalt and a pore-forming agent, spinning, pre-oxidizing and carbonizing to obtain the hollow carbon fiber with the multi-nano-pore-channel structure. The invention takes asphalt as raw material, takes asphalt and polymer material after being melt mixed as spinning raw material, obtains precursor through melt spinning and then carries out preoxidation and carbonization processes, and the prepared carbon fiber has a through nano pore canal, has higher specific surface area and highly ordered pore structure, and simultaneously maintains the flexibility, high mechanical strength and high conductivity of the carbon fiber. The invention simplifies the preparation process, does not need activation or post-treatment, reduces the production difficulty, reduces the production cost and is extremely easy to industrialize.

title: Round section high heat conduction mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: A circular section high heat conduction mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof belong to the field of carbon fibers. The method comprises the following steps: and taking spinnable mesophase pitch with the mesophase content of more than or equal to 98% as a raw material, adopting a spinneret plate with Y-shaped spinning holes to perform melt spinning to obtain pitch fiber precursor, and then performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber with a circular cross-section structure. The prepared carbon fiber has a circular cross section, radial graphite crystallites are arranged in a Y-shaped radial manner, and the carbon fiber has higher orientation and graphitization degree and high heat conductivity coefficient. Compared with the prior art, the method solves the problems that the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber has high heat conduction but takes a split-shaped or strip-shaped cross section structure or has a circular cross section structure but relatively low heat conduction, and has simple preparation process and high controllability without adding other components.

title: High-thermal-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber production, and discloses a high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out flash evaporation treatment on the petroleum heavy residual oil, conveying the petroleum heavy residual oil residue at the bottom of the flash evaporation tower into a polymerization kettle, and adding aromatic oil into the polymerization kettle; carrying out high-temperature high-pressure thermal polycondensation reaction in a self-pressurizing mode; pumping the product after polycondensation into a high-precision filter for separation, then conveying the product into a mesophase pitch reaction device, and further carrying out high-temperature normal-pressure polycondensation and nitrogen purging to prepare high-purity spinnable mesophase pitch; finally, the high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber is obtained through melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization and other treatments. Under the preoxidation condition that the oxidation temperature is 265-280 ℃ and the oxidation time is 2-3 hours, the method can realize the homogeneous preoxidation of the mesophase pitch fiber precursor, greatly shortens the preoxidation cost and achieves the aim of improving the efficiency.

title: Preparation method of high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and precursor thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of high-performance carbon material preparation, and discloses a preparation method of high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber and a precursor thereof. The preparation method of the high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber comprises the following steps of adding a hydrogenation modifier into high-aromatic raw material pitch, and fully and uniformly mixing to obtain modified pitch; crushing modified asphalt, placing the crushed modified asphalt into a reaction kettle for thermal polycondensation reaction, introducing inert gas for bubbling in the reaction process, transferring the crushed modified asphalt into a continuous thin-layer evaporation device for curing treatment after the bubbling is finished, and granulating to obtain mesophase asphalt; continuously melt-spinning the mesophase pitch to obtain mesophase pitch precursor; and performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-heat-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber. The preparation process uses ethylene tar and hydrogenolysis oil as hydrogenation modifier to carry out hydrogenation modification, thereby saving cost and improving operation safety, and simultaneously having excellent mechanical property and heat conducting property.

abstract: The application relates to an anodic oxidation method of high-strength medium-mode polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers and the carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber surface treatment. An anodic oxidation method of high-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, wherein the tensile strength of the high-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is 4500-7500MPa, and the tensile modulus is 260-350MPa; the anodic oxidation method comprises the following steps: performing primary anodic oxidation treatment on the carbonized high-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in an inorganic electrolyte, and performing secondary anodic oxidation treatment in the organic electrolyte; wherein the current density of the primary anodic oxidation treatment is not more than 15A/m  2 . The method can avoid the great reduction of the strength of the carbon fiber on the basis of improving the interface performance of the high-strength medium-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method for same
abstract: To provide a carbon fiber bundle capable of suppressing winding due to ring-shaped fuzzes, which occurs when the carbon fiber bundle is rolled out for advanced processing, and a production method for producing the same. Disclosed is a carbon fiber bundle wherein an average single-fiber diameter B is 6.9 to 11.0 um, a tensile modulus E of resin-impregnated strands is 230 to 310 GPa, the number of fuzzes inherent in the carbon fiber bundle is 40 fuzzes/m or less, and a proportion of fuzzes with a structure having a difference between skin and core is 1 to 25% of fuzzes inherent in the carbon fiber bundle. title: Efficient thermal stabilization method for polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a high-efficiency thermal stabilization method for polyacrylonitrile fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. S1, setting an initial thermal stability temperature range, and carrying out an initial thermal stability process on polyacrylonitrile fibers at different heating rates in the initial thermal stability temperature range; s2, acquiring a temperature range with better thermal stability: s3, finishing the thermal stabilization process of the polyacrylonitrile fiber by using a gradient heating method in the temperature range with better thermal stability determined in the S2 to obtain better thermal stability fiber; and S4, preserving the heat of the heat stable fiber obtained in the step S3 at a temperature above the ending temperature in the initial heat stable temperature to obtain the efficient heat stable polyacrylonitrile fiber. abstract: [Problem] To provide: a carbon fiber bundle that, as a result of specific fluff inside the carbon fiber bundle being suppressed, can suppress catching caused by ring-shaped fluff produced when the carbon fiber bundle is unwound for higher-order processing; and a production method for the carbon fiber bundle. [Solution] A carbon fiber bundle that has an average single fiber diameter B of 6.9–11.0 μm and a resin-impregnated strand tensile elastic modulus E of 230–310 GPa, there being no more than 40 pieces of fluff per m inside the carbon fiber bundle, and the fraction of the fluff inside the carbon fiber bundle that is fluff that has a two-layer cross-section being 1%–25%. It is suitable to obtain the carbon fiber bundle by heat treating a polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber bundle that has a single-fiber fineness of 0.9–2.2 dtex in a 200°C–300°C oxidizing atmosphere to obtain a flame-resistant fiber bundle and then heat treating the flame-resistant fiber bundle at 1,200°C–1,600°C in an inert atmosphere, the heat treatment of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber bundle being performed such that the heat generation rate Q on the left side of expression (3) (in which q (J/g/s) is the single-fiber heat generation rate, N (strands) is the filament count, d (dtex) is the single-fiber fineness of the flame-resistant fiber bundle, and W (mm) is the thread width) is 150–500 J/m2/s until the density is 1.22–1.24 g/cm3 and then the heat treatment being continued while the tension of the flame-resistant fiber bundle applies 1.6–4.0 mN/dtex until the density is 1.38–1.50 g/cm3. (3) Q=q×N×d/W/10.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and method for producing same
abstract: The carbon fiber bundle of the present invention satisfies a predetermined strand elastic modulus, a predetermined strand strength, a predetermined knot strength, and a predetermined average single fiber diameter, and when a single fiber tensile test is performed with a test length of 10mm, the probability that a defect having a size of 50nm or more is present at a fracture surface of a recovered fiber is a predetermined ratio. Such a carbon fiber bundle is suitably obtained as follows: the fiber bundle is obtained by filtering a spinning solution obtained by dissolving a polyacrylonitrile copolymer in a solvent using a filter medium having a predetermined filtration accuracy and a predetermined basis weight at a predetermined filtering speed, spinning the filtered spinning solution to obtain a carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, heat-treating the obtained carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle in an oxidizing atmosphere at an appropriate temperature profile until a predetermined density is achieved to obtain a flame-resistant fiber bundle, and heat-treating the flame-resistant fiber bundle in an inert atmosphere at a predetermined temperature. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a carbon fiber bundle that exhibits excellent strand strength and strand elastic modulus in a well-balanced manner and has excellent knot strength, and a method for producing the same.

title: Quasi-isotropic high-thermal-conductivity C/C composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of barrier materials for nuclear fusion, in particular to a quasi-isotropic high-thermal-conductivity C/C composite material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of forming a web of asphalt fibers, and then sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment to obtain carbon fiber non-woven fabrics; coating a carbon quantum dot modified solution on the carbon fiber non-woven fabric, drying, and performing lamination and needling to obtain a modified carbon fiber non-woven fabric; and sequentially carrying out chemical combination, gas-phase permeation, precursor impregnation pyrolysis densification, carbonization treatment and graphitization treatment on the modified carbon fiber non-woven fabric to obtain the quasi-isotropic high-thermal-conductivity C/C composite material. The quasi-isotropic high-thermal-conductivity C/C composite material prepared by the method not only has a good interface bonding state, but also obviously improves the anisotropic characteristic of the composite material, and has good strength and thermal conductivity.

title: Graphitized carbon fiber with high carbon element content and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and particularly discloses graphitized carbon fiber with high carbon element content and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, performing preoxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment on precursor fibers in sequence to obtain carbon fibers; step 2, carrying out graphitization treatment on the carbon fiber obtained in the step 1 to obtain a graphitized carbon fiber; the invention provides a graphitized carbon fiber for an electric heating material with carbon content of more than 99 percent, which can be obtained by graphitizing treatment at the temperature lower than 2000 ℃, through the whole-line process coupling design in the fiber preparation process, particularly the optimal design of a high-temperature carbonization stage formed by a graphite structure, and is beneficial to controlling the cost of the final graphitized carbon fiber, and the product has low resistivity and good conductivity.

title: Preparation method of carbon paper with gradient pore structure
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbon paper with a gradient pore structure, which comprises the following steps: after degumming and oxidation treatment are respectively carried out on carbon fibers with different length-diameter ratios, the carbon fibers are respectively dispersed in a dispersant solution to form carbon fiber slurry with different length-diameter ratios; sequentially carrying out gradient layering on the carbon fiber slurry according to the length-diameter ratio of the carbon fibers from high to low, and forming an inclined net to obtain a carbon felt precursor with a three-dimensional network structure; dipping the carbon felt precursor into a resin solution, taking out and drying to obtain a carbon felt; and (3) hot-pressing the carbon felt into raw paper of the carbon paper, and then carrying out carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the carbon paper with the gradient pore structure. According to the invention, the carbon fibers are sequentially layered in a gradient manner from high to low in length-diameter ratio according to the slurry, so that the prepared carbon paper has a gradient pore structure, communicated pores are formed in the carbon paper, the pore diameter is changed in a gradient manner along the normal direction on the plane of the carbon paper, and a pressure gradient is formed in a diffusion channel, so that the gas conveying efficiency can be improved, and the mass transfer and heat transfer performances of the carbon paper can be effectively improved.

title: Fullerene-doped high-regularity carbon nanofiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance fibers and preparation and composite materials, and relates to a fullerene-doped high-regularity carbon nanofiber and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a fullerene material is mainly used as a carbon element additive for preparing the carbon nanofiber, specifically, acrylonitrile and the carbon element additive are polymerized through aqueous phase precipitation to form a precursor raw material compounded by the carbon element additive and polyacrylonitrile, and the precursor raw material is sequentially subjected to spinning, hot drawing, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization to obtain the fullerene-doped high-regularity carbon nanofiber; the carbonaceous element additive is a fullerene material. The invention can prevent the agglomeration of the carbon element additive, reduce the defects of the carbon nanofiber, and enable the composite carbon nanofiber to have higher strength and toughness, light weight and excellent thermal stability.

title: Preparation method of low-cost carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-cost carbon fiber precursor, relating to the technical field of novel carbon materials and fiber materials, comprising the following steps: screening raw materials: screening plant carbon crystals and polyacrylonitrile raw materials; purifying and blending raw materials: purifying and blending the raw materials by using the purification and blending processes of the plant carbon crystal and the polyacrylonitrile; crosslinking modification: carrying out cross-linking modification operation on the purified and blended raw materials by using a cross-linking modification process to obtain a spinning solution; spinning: and (3) carrying out spinning operation on the spinning solution by using a spinning process to prepare the carbon fiber precursor. The invention uses plant carbon crystal and polyacrylonitrile as raw materials, and dimethyl sulfoxide as a solution of a solvent, and the low-cost spinning solution which has good viscoelasticity, good uniformity and full crosslinking of cyano and plant carbon crystal is obtained through crosslinking modification. The spinning solution has low cost, and has high elasticity modulus of carbon fiber based on pitch and high tensile strength of carbon fiber based on polyacrylonitrile.

title: Method for preparing super carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing super carbon fiber, which comprises the step of preparing a nanometer precursor polymer, and specifically comprises the following steps: dissolving acrylonitrile monomer raw materials in a solvent, adding nano graphite or nano carbon black, uniformly mixing through high-speed shearing, adding an initiator or a catalyst, and carrying out polymerization reaction in a solution state to generate a polyacrylonitrile solution which can be dissolved in the solvent, wherein one part of the structure of the polyacrylonitrile contains the nano graphite or the nano carbon black. The method solves the problem of matching modulus and strength by improving the performance of polyacrylonitrile, and greatly improves the axial tensile property of the carbon fiber and the strength and modulus of the fiber due to the introduction of chemical bonds in the axial direction of the fiber.

title: Hemp-based hierarchical porous carbon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a hemp-based hierarchical porous carbon material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein hemp-based biomass material is pretreated to prepare hemp-based powder, then the hemp-based powder is subjected to preoxidation treatment to obtain preoxidation precursor powder, the preoxidation precursor powder is further subjected to heat preservation for 0.5-1.5 h at the temperature of 300-400 ℃ with an in-situ hard template activating agent according to a certain ratio, the temperature is raised to 700-900 ℃ for carbonization for 2-4 h, and finally the hemp-based hierarchical porous carbon material is prepared by water washing; the mesoporous and microporous composite material has mesoporous and/or microporous with good uniformity and a specific surface area of 200-2000 m 2 The carbon fiber/carbon fiber composite material has the advantages of high porosity, high specific surface area, high graphitization degree and good conductivity. In addition, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, the preparation method does not damage equipment, the environment is protected, the production cost is saved, and the prepared hemp-based hierarchical porous carbon material can be applied to energy storage devices and has excellent performances such as high specific capacity and good cycle performance.
