title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with ultrahigh strength and medium-high modulus property and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with ultrahigh strength and medium-high modulus property and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) taking dimethyl sulfoxide or dimethyl acetamide as a solvent, and copolymerizing acrylonitrile and itaconic acid or acrylonitrile, methyl acrylate and itaconic acid; (2) spinning, drafting, washing, oiling, drying and heat setting are carried out on the polymer spinning solution in sequence; (3) the method comprises the following steps of pre-oxidizing and carbonizing polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the ultrahigh-strength and medium-high-modulus carbon fiber, wherein components of a coagulation bath system in the spinning process cannot permeate into a spinning trickle formed by a polymer spinning solution, and a solvent in the spinning trickle formed by the polymer spinning solution can diffuse into the coagulation bath system. The method can reduce the defects of precursor fiber hole type and skin-core structure heterogeneity formed in the traditional wet or dry-wet solidification forming process, the high-orientation precursor fiber can be easily obtained from the initial fiber structure, and the carbon fiber prepared from the precursor fiber has the tensile strength of 5500-7000 MPa and the tensile modulus of 310-390 GPa.

title: Method for manufacturing high-thermal-conductivity mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers at low temperature
abstract: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing high-thermal-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fibers at low temperature, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: (1) adding carbon nanotube powder into the mesophase pitch, and uniformly stirring the pitch in a molten state to prepare the carbon nanotube-containing mesophase pitch; (2) carrying out melt spinning on the carbon nanotube-containing mesophase pitch prepared in the step (1) to prepare fiber precursor; (3) and (3) carrying out preoxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment on the fiber protofilaments prepared in the step (2) to obtain the high-thermal-conductivity asphalt-based carbon fiber. The invention discloses adding carbon nanotube powder into mesophase pitch for the first time, and then processing the mesophase pitch under a series of specific conditions such as spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization and the like to obtain high-thermal-conductivity pitch-based carbon fiber; the addition of the carbon nano tube enables the mesophase pitch to be difficult to pre-oxidize and easy to carbonize and graphitize, can ensure that the carbon fiber prepared at a lower temperature has excellent heat-conducting property, greatly reduces the temperature condition in the production process and the strict requirement on equipment, can also reduce the use of expensive high-purity argon, and obviously reduces the production cost.

abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a two-dimensional high-thermal-conductivity C/C-ZrC-SiC composite material. title: Carbon fiber bundle and method for manufacturing same
abstract: The carbon fiber bundle of the present invention is a carbon fiber bundle that satisfies a predetermined elastic modulus of strands, a predetermined tensile strength of strands, a predetermined knot strength, and a predetermined average single fiber diameter, in which the probability that a flaw with a size of 50 nm or more exists on the collected fracture surface when performing a single fiber tensile test with a gauge length of 10 mm is a predetermined ratio. Such a carbon fiber bundle is suitably obtained by filtering a spinning dope solution in which a polyacrylonitrile copolymer is dissolved in a solvent, at a predetermined filtration speed, using a filter medium having a predetermined particle retention and a filter basis weight, then spinning the filtered spinning dope solution to obtain a precursor fiber bundle for carbon fiber, and heat-treating the obtained precursor fiber bundle for carbon fiber at an appropriate temperature profile in an oxidizing atmosphere until reaching a predetermined density to obtain an oxidized fiber bundle, and then heat-treating the oxidized fiber bundle at a predetermined temperature in an inert atmosphere. An object of the present invention is to provide a carbon fiber bundle that exhibits excellent tensile strength of strands and elastic modulus of strands in a well-balanced manner and also has excellent knot strength, and a method for manufacturing the same.

abstract: The invention discloses major diameter polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers and preparation method thereof, method, which includes: (1), successively to be carried out spinneret spinneret for acrylonitrile and itaconic acid bipolymer or acrylonitrile, itaconic acid and methyl acrylate terpolymer spinning solution, solidification, a drawing-off, washes, oils, dries, secondary drawing-off and thermal finalization, and major diameter polyacrylonitrile fibril is obtained；(2) major diameter precursor is pre-oxidized and is carbonized, obtain major diameter polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, in process of setting, the diameter of control solidification strand is 90~155 μm, in water-washing process, the diameter of control washing fiber is 32~54 μm, and in the drying process, the diameter of control compacting by drying fiber is 25~42 μm.The major diameter polyacrylonitrile fibril of 252~716tex of fiber number, 16~30 μm of diameter are obtained using this method, then after the precursor being pre-oxidized and is carbonized, the major diameter polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber of 10~20 μm of diameter, 3.8~4.6GPa of tensile strength, 230~260GPa of stretch modulus is finally prepared.

title: Preparation method for lignin-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method for a lignin-based carbon fiber. The preparation method comprises the following steps: a, pretreatment of lignin; b, preparation a spinning solution; c, generation of a carbon fiber precursor; d, pre-oxidation of a fiber; e, carbonization of the fiber; and f, graphitization of the fiber. According to the invention, the step of pretreatment is increased before preparation of the carbon fiber from the lignin, so the spinning performance of the lignin is improved; an alcohol organic solvent is employed in the process of spinning, so low pollution and environmental protection are realized compared with usage of an organic solvent in the prior art; all the treatment except pre-oxidation of the fiber is carried out in a protective atmosphere formed by inert gas during the whole preparation process; and the method is simple in process and easy to control, enables the prepared lignin-based carbon fiber to have excellent performance and the utilization rate of a lignin fiber to be greatly increased, has low investment cost and increases economic benefits and social benefits.

abstract: A continuous carbonization method for the carbonization of a continuous, oxidized polyacrylonitrile (PAN) precursor fiber, wherein the precursor fiber exiting the carbonization system is a carbonized fiber which has been exposed to an atmosphere comprising 5% or less, preferably 0.1% or less, more preferably 0%, by volume of oxygen during its passage from a high temperature furnace to the next high temperature furnace. title: Use, stabilization and carbonization of polyacrylonitrile/carbon composite fibers
abstract: In a method of making a carbon fiber, carbon nanotubes (CNT) are mixed into a solution including polyacrylonitrile (PAN) so as to form a CNT/PAN mixture. At least one PAN/CNT fiber is formed from the mixture. A first predetermined electrical current is applied to the PAN/CNT fiber until the PAN/CNT fiber is a stabilized PAN/CNT fiber. A heatable fabric that includes a plurality of fibers that each have an axis. Each of the plurality of fibers includes polyacrylonitrile and carbon nanotubes dispersed in the polyacrylonitrile in a predetermined weight percent thereof and aligned along the axes of the plurality of fibers. The plurality of fibers are woven into a fabric. A current source is configured to apply an electrical current through the plurality of fibers, thereby causing the fibers to generate heat.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to the field of organic polymer, and in particular to a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor. Acrylonitrile and comonomer are subjected to solution copolymerization to form a polymer spinning dope with a relatively even and controllable molecular structure; the spinning dope is subjected to demonomerization, deaeration and multistage filtering, so as to prepare the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor through a wet or dry-wet spinning technology. The key technique of the method is to add a buffer on a pipe from an outlet of a spinning metering pump to an entrance of a spinneret plate assembly; and the buffer is provided with an elastic rubber body, so as offset 50-70% of flow pulsation of the spinning metering pump. The polyacrylonitrile precursor prepared by the invention has small long-range linear density dispersion coefficient; carbonized carbon fiber has substantially reduced long-range linear density dispersion coefficient, so as to lower long-range dispersion coefficient of mechanical properties of carbon fiber (such as tensile strength, elongation at break and tensile modulus, etc.) and improve stability of the batch.

title: Middle-modulus high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and preparation method thereof
abstract: A middle modulus high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method of the carbon fiber belong to the technical field of fibers. The tensile strength of the fiber is 4.2GPa to 6.0GPa, and the tensile modulus is 260GPa to 310GPa. A proto-filament is prepared by wet spinning technique or dry-wet spinning technique and then subjected to pre-oxidizing and carbonizing treatments, so as to obtain the middle-modulus high-strength carbon fiber; in the polyacrylonitrile wet or dry-wet spinning process, the solvent content in the fiber is gradually controlled and the fiber is drawn effectively under the solvent condition to adjust the crystalline area and non-crystalline area orientation degree of the proto-filament, so as to obtain the polyacrylonitrile proto-filament with high orientation degree and high compactness, and finally the middle modulus high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared by pre-oxidization and carbonization. The fiber drawing condition is controlled by the solvent content gradual control method to gradually draw the solidified filament, so the fiber has a good orientation structure while heterogeneously solidified, and the method provided by the invention is a novel method.

title: Method for preparing high-performance carbon fiber by controlling structure of preoxidized fiber
abstract: The invention relates to the carbon fiber processing field, and concretely relates to a method for preparing a high-performance carbon fiber. The invention provides a method for preparing a carbon fiber having a high tensile strength and a high tensile modulus by controlling the regularity Ro of the structure of the preoxidized fiber. The method comprises the following steps: preoxidizing polyacrylonitrile protofilaments in a heat treatment furnace at 180-275DEG C under a total draft degree of 4-12%, allowing the above obtained fiber at 245-255DEG C to stay for 18-23min to prepare the preoxidized fiber, and carrying out subsequent low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization treatment of the fiber having an Ro value of 34-42% to finally prepare the carbon fiber. The tensile strength and the tensile modulus of the prepared carbon fiber are 3.6GPa or more and 250GPa or more respectively.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based polymer for preparation of carbon fiber using microwave and method for preparing carbon fiber using the same
abstract: Disclosed therein is a method for preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer for preparation of carbon fiber having a melting point controlled by selecting an optimal energy of microwave, and a method for preparing a carbon fiber through melt spinning using the preparation method for polyacrylonitrile-based polymer. The present invention uses microwave to control the properties of the polyacrylonitrile-based polymer in a simplified way and prepare the polymer optimized for preparation of carbon fiber precursor through melt spinning for a short polymerization time, and provides a means for mass production of the polyacrylonitrile-based polymer being suitable for melt spinning at a temperature lower than the stabilization temperature and acquiring properties adequate to preparation of carbon fiber through stabilization. Hence, the present invention is expected to contribute to mass production of high-performance carbon fibers at reduced cost.

title: Production method of carbon fibers
abstract: The invention discloses a production method of carbon fibers. The method comprises the following steps of dissolving a water-soluble boron-containing chemical in water to form boron-containing solution, and dipping PAN (polyacrylonitrile) yarns in the boron-containing solution to form boron-containing PAN yarns; measuring the content of boron element in the boron-containing PAN yarns, and selecting the boron-containing PAN yarns of which the mass of the boron element takes up 0.01 to 0.1 percent that of the boron-containing PAN yarns for later use; analyzing the boron-containing PAN yarns for later use by using a secondary ion mass spectrum analyzer to obtain the mass of the boron element in the surface layer which is 50nm from the surface to the interior of the boron-containing PAN yarns for later use, and taking the yarns of which the mass of the boron element in the surface layer takes up over 60 percent that of all the boron elements as PAN-base carbon fibers; and oxidizing and carbonizing the PAN-base carbon fibers to obtain the carbon fibers. By the method, the reaction degree difference between the surface layer and the interior of the fibers in a pre-oxidizing process can be reduced, the pre-oxidizing process is accelerated, the cost is reduced, the oxidation resistance and the mechanical property of the carbon fibers are obviously improved, and particularly the tensile strength and the modulus are improved.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber protofilament by dry and wet methods
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber protofilament by dry and wet methods. The method comprises the steps of polymerization, demonomerization and defoaming, filtration, coagulation, washing and drafting, oiling densification, steam drafting, heat setting and drying. Three-level coagulating baths at the temperature of between 10 DEG C below zero and 70 DEG C and with dimethyl sulfoxide with concentration of 10 to 60 mass percent are adopted in the coagulation step, and the first coagulating bath contains aqueous ammonia accounting for 0.05 to 1 percent of the mass of the first coagulating bath; and a spinning head is subjected to 1.5 to 5 times positive drafting in the first coagulating bath, and the drafting is 0 in the second and third coagulating bathes. According to the method for preparing the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber protofilament, the spinning process is stable, the broken filament is little, the spinning speed is high, the spinning is stable, the prepared protofilament has few defects, the density is not less than 1.180g/cm<3>, and the tensile strength is not less than 7cN/dtex. The protofilament can be prepared into a high-performance carbon fiber with tensile strength of more than 4.9GPa and elastic modulus of between 260 and 280GPa by high-temperature carbonization.

title: Method for producing a case-divergent assembly
abstract: The process of manufacturing a crankcase-nozzle set to constitute components for a rocket exhaust pipe or outlet cone, comprises forming a fibrous reinforcement (150), maintaining the fibrous reinforcement in a form same as crankcase-nozzle set to be prepared, and impregnating the fibrous reinforcements with a thermohardening resin and polymerization of the resin. The step of forming the fibrous reinforcement comprises preparing a first fibrous preform (50) with a first fiber and a second fibrous preform (100) with a second fiber. The process of manufacturing a crankcase-nozzle set to constitute components for a rocket exhaust pipe or outlet cone, comprises forming a fibrous reinforcement (150), maintaining the fibrous reinforcement in a form same as crankcase-nozzle set to be prepared, and impregnating the fibrous reinforcements with a thermohardening resin and polymerization of the resin. The step of forming the fibrous reinforcement comprises preparing a first fibrous preform (50) with a first fiber and a second fibrous preform (100) with a second fiber. The first preform is corresponding to nozzle part of crankcase-nozzle set. The second preform is corresponding to the crankcase part of crankcase-nozzle set, and is placed on the first preform. The first fibrous preform is made of fibers having a thermal conductivity of less than 50 W.m -> 1>.K -> 1>, and is made of pitch precursor carbon fibers, polyacrylonitrile carbon precursor fiber or carbon fiber with rayon precursor. The second fibrous preform is made of fibers having a tensile strength of 3000 MPa and a Young's modulus of 200 Gpa, and of polyacrylonitrile carbon precursor fiber or carbon fiber with pitch precursor. The thermosetting resin is a polyaddition resin having structural characteristics and coke-metal ratio of 50%. The first fibrous preform is made of annular fibrous layers having a first series of directed fibers in an angle alpha and a second series of directed fibers at an angle -alpha . The first fibrous preform is made by stack of annular fibrous layers on an egg cup or conical shaped tool, where each layer is placed on the tools at an angle beta with respect to an axis of the tool. The first and second series of fibers having annular fibrous layer are produced by placing and automatic sewing of fibers between two frameworks defining an annular space, where each layer is extracted from the frameworks by cutting after making a circular link in the layer. The second preform is made from first and second fibrous superimposed layers. The first fibrous superimposed layer having fibers is oriented in a determined direction. The second fibrous superimposed layer is made of a fiber layer, which is placed on the first layer, and is made by filament winding on the first layer maintained as a conical tool. The second preform is placed on the first preform to form the fibrous reinforcements. The fibrous reinforcement made of first and second superimposed fibrous preforms is placed in a tool, which is heated by circulating a thermal control fluid. The tool comprises a mold, a counter-mold defining an internal space in which the reinforcement is maintained, and heating units to maintain the fibrous reinforcement at substantially uniform temperature. The thermohardening resin is injected at a base of reinforcement, and a pressure gradient is established in the internal space of the counter-mold to circulate the resin injected at the base of reinforcement towards a tip of the reinforcement.

title: Oxidation oven
abstract: An oxidation oven for use in the production of carbon fibers from a polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber. The oven has an oven chamber formed by sides and ends. At least one of the ends has a first opening and a second opening. The product passes through the openings for treatment in the oven chamber. The oven is also provided with a first nozzle adjacent the first opening, a second nozzle adjacent the second opening, and respective first and second diffusers adjacent the first and second openings. The diffusers cooperate with the first and second nozzles respectively to provide first and second inductors. Each nozzle is effective for discharging air from an air flow pathway into the throat of the associate diffuser to thereby induce a positive pressure inducted air flow of ambient air toward the opening to which it is adjacent. The flowrate of the inducted air is adjustable to ensure a zero pressure gradient condition, or a low but positive flux of ambient air into the opening in order to prevent the elution of dangerous gases from the oven chamber during product manufacture.

title: Nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of oxygen reduction electrocatalyst preparation. According to the invention, polyacrylonitrile (PAN) and boric acid are dissolved in an organic solvent to obtain spinning slurry. The spinning slurry is made into a catalyst precursor of a fiber structure by using an electrostatic spinning machine, and then the catalyst precursor is subjected to high-temperature crosslinking treatment in air and high-temperature carbonization treatment by reducing gas to obtain the nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber which can be used as an electrocatalyst for catalyzing and producing hydrogen peroxide. The fiber network structure provides higher specific surface and good conductivity, and is beneficial to improving the electrochemical performance of the material. The nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst prepared by the invention has higher hydrogen peroxide selectivity, simple process and mild condition.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out wet spinning or dry spraying-wet spinning on a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, controlling the solvent content in a polyacrylonitrile fiber in the spinning process to obtain a polyacrylonitrile precursor containing the solvent, S2, carrying out supercritical treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor in a supercritical carbon dioxide atmosphere to obtain a porous polyacrylonitrile fiber, S3, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the porous polyacrylonitrile fiber to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber, and S4, carbonizing the pre-oxidized fiber under the protection of inert gas to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber. The method has the advantages of environmental protection, controllable reaction, high temperature avoidance, chemical reagent avoidance and the like. The method can prepare the active carbon fiber with large surface and rich holes.

abstract: The invention provides lignin-based metal oxide composite carbon nanofiber and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon nanofiber materials, and comprising the following steps of preparing spinning solution containing lignin, polyacrylonitrile, polyvinylpyrrolidone and transition metal salt by taking dimethylformamide as a solvent; the transition metal salt is any one of manganese acetate, a composite salt of manganese acetate and zinc acetate and a composite salt of manganese acetate and nickel acetate, and is prepared into composite fibers through electrostatic spinning, and then hydrothermal treatment, vacuum freeze drying, pre-oxidation and carbonization are carried out. abstract: The application discloses a preparation method of a wave-absorbing heat-dissipating carbon fiber membrane and the wave-absorbing heat-dissipating carbon fiber membrane. Cobalt salt and nickel salt are added into a first solvent to obtain a first mixed solution. Adding the 2-methylimidazole solution into the first mixed solution, standing, centrifuging to obtain a first precipitate, and drying the precipitate to obtain first powder. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile fibers in dimethylformamide to obtain spinning solution, dispersing first powder in the dimethylformamide, adding the spinning solution, stirring to obtain first emulsion, and obtaining a carbon fiber film precursor from the first emulsion through an electrostatic spinning method. And (3) carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment on the carbon fiber film precursor to obtain the Co/Ni carbon fiber film. Providing a reduced graphene oxide dispersion liquid, using a Co/Ni carbon fiber film as a filter medium, carrying out suction filtration on the reduced graphene oxide dispersion liquid by a vacuum suction filtration method to obtain a Co/Ni/rGO carbon fiber film, and carrying out drying treatment on the Co/Ni/rGO carbon fiber film to obtain the wave-absorbing heat-dissipating carbon fiber film. The wave-absorbing and heat-dissipating carbon fiber membrane has good wave-absorbing performance and heat-dissipating performance.

title: Preparation method of compatibilized carbon nanofiber catalytic and protective layer electrode and application of compatibilized carbon nanofiber catalytic and protective layer electrode in all-vanadium redox flow battery
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of battery materials and energy storage, in particular to a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber catalysis and protection layer electrode capable of increasing capacity and application of the carbon nanofiber catalysis and protection layer electrode in an all-vanadium redox flow battery. The preparation method comprises the steps of collecting polyacrylonitrile-based electrostatic spinning fibers into a potassium permanganate aqueous solution for surface pretreatment, preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based nanofiber membrane with planar fiber orientation and potassium permanganate loaded on the surface by utilizing a freeze drying technology, respectively performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain a carbon nanofiber catalysis and protection layer electrode, applying the carbon nanofiber catalysis and protection layer electrode to a vanadium battery, placing the catalysis layer between a diaphragm and a carbon felt electrode when the battery is assembled, providing more electrocatalytic active sites and more capacity for a main reaction zone on the diaphragm side by manganese-based oxides generated on the carbon fiber surface, and effectively blocking the vertical fibers in the carbon felt from penetrating the diaphragm by the planar fiber orientation structure of the catalysis layer so as to effectively protect the diaphragm, thereby effectively improving the battery efficiency and the cycling stability.
assignee: 辽宁大学

title: Porous composite material for sulfur dioxide trapping and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a porous composite material for sulfur dioxide capture and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of porous adsorption materials, wherein aluminum salt is firstly introduced into a polyacrylonitrile solution, an aluminum-doped carbon fiber skeleton with a multi-stage pore structure is constructed through electrostatic spinning and pre-oxidation-carbonization processes, the specific surface area is remarkably improved, meanwhile, excellent mechanical strength and structural stability are given to the material, then iron and calcium hydrate particles are loaded on the surface of the fiber in situ to form a multi-metal synergistic active site, so that the enhanced adsorption and fixation of sulfur dioxide are realized, silane modified fly ash, red mud, diatomite, water glass and alkaline components are further utilized to compound, and through pore channels are constructed through aluminum powder foaming and roasting, so that the material still maintains excellent mechanical properties under the condition of high sulfur dioxide capture capacity, and the stability requirements of high flow rate impact and long-term circulating operation in an industrial desulfurization tower can be met.
assignee: 北京交通大学

title: In-situ growth Na of carbon nanofiber2Ti3O7Preparation method of nanosheets and capacitive deionization performance of nanosheets
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber in-situ grown Na  2 Ti 3 O 7  nanosheet and capacitance deionization performance thereof, and belongs to the field of capacitance deionization. The preparation method of the carbon nanofiber membrane with the Na  2 Ti 3 O 7  nano-sheets grown in situ comprises the steps of mixing oxidized coal and polyacrylonitrile in a solvent to obtain a mixed solution, adding a titanium source to obtain a spinning solution, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution to obtain a nanofiber membrane, carrying out pre-oxidation on the nanofiber membrane to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber membrane, carrying out carbonization treatment on the pre-oxidized fiber membrane to obtain a TiO  2 /carbon fiber membrane, immersing the TiO  2 /carbon fiber membrane in a NaOH solution, and carrying out heating reaction to obtain the carbon nanofiber membrane with the Na  2 Ti 3 O 7  nano-sheets grown in situ. The prepared Na  2 Ti 3 O 7 /carbon fiber self-supporting film has excellent electrochemical performance and good capacitance deionization effect on saline water.
assignee: 新疆大学

title: Vanadium tetrasulfide nano-sheet embedded in nitrogen-sulfur co-doped carbon fiber composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a vanadium tetrasulfide (V  3 S 4 ) nano-sheet embedded in a nitrogen-sulfur co-doped carbon fiber composite material. Firstly, preparing mixed solution of vanadyl acetylacetonate, sublimed sulfur, polyacrylonitrile (PAN), polypyrrole (PPy) and N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF) according to a certain proportion, and preparing the vanadium precursor fiber film through electrostatic spinning. And then, through pre-oxidation and high-temperature calcination and vulcanization processes, the fiber film is in situ converted into the vanadium tetrasulfide nano-sheet and the nitrogen-sulfur co-doped carbon fiber. In the process, PAN and PPy are carbonized into carbon fiber co-doped with nitrogen and sulfur at high temperature. The shape of the carbon fiber is further adjusted by adding the PPy, and the conversion of the vanadium precursor into the carbon-coated vanadium tetrasulfide nano-sheet is promoted to be separated out from the inside of the fiber. The vanadium tetrasulfide nano-sheet is embedded in the nitrogen-sulfur co-doped carbon fiber composite material, has low cost of raw materials, good repeatability, good ion diffusion and electron transmission capacity, and is used as a lithium ion battery anode material, and high reversible capacity, good multiplying power performance and excellent cycle stability are shown.
assignee: 南通蠃鹏科技有限公司

title: Device for preventing fire spreading after ignition of carbon fiber oxidation furnace
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production equipment, and particularly relates to a device for preventing fire from spreading after a carbon fiber oxidation furnace fires, which comprises a horizontal driving machine body and a fire retarding mechanism, wherein a guide roller for guiding carbon fibers is arranged on the horizontal driving machine body, the fire retarding mechanism is arranged on the horizontal driving machine body, and the fire retarding mechanism comprises a white steel tank which is arranged on the horizontal driving machine body and surrounds the side edge of the guide roller, and a white steel plate which is fixed on the upper part of the white steel tank. The device for preventing the fire spreading after the carbon fiber oxidation furnace fires has simple structure and low cost, the water level in the pool is raised through the instantaneous air expansion of the air bag, so that water quickly passes through the guide roller, flame spreads along the polyacrylonitrile precursor after the oxidation furnace fires, the flame is soaked out when the flame spreads to the water tank, the polyacrylonitrile precursor on the filament placing frame is prevented from being completely ignited, and new water is continuously supplemented by the water supplementing pipe to reduce the temperature of the water, so that the safety is improved.
assignee: 吉林国鑫碳纤维有限公司

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fibers, which solves the problems of concentrated heat release, easy fiber breakage, aggregation of carbon fiber products, poor spreading effect and difficult application in the preoxidation process in the prior art. The preparation method comprises the steps of performing pre-oxidation treatment of a four-temperature zone on polyacrylonitrile fibers by using a pre-oxidation furnace, controlling the tow width of the pre-oxidized fibers by virtue of drafting matching, preparing the pre-oxidized fibers, performing low-temperature carbonization treatment of a three-temperature zone by using a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and performing high-temperature carbonization treatment of the three-temperature zone by using a high-temperature carbonization furnace to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based large tow carbon fibers. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the continuous preparation of the large-tow carbon fiber is realized by matching the temperature, the draft ratio and the residence time of pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization and controlling the running width of the fiber, so that the problems are well solved, and the method can be used in the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber preparation process.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石油化工股份有限公司上海石油化工研究院

title: Pre-oxidation method of carbon fiber
abstract: The application relates to a preoxidation method of carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. A preoxidation method of carbon fiber comprises preoxidizing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor prepared by dry spray wet spinning process in three continuous preoxidation temperature regions to obtain preoxidized fiber with a bulk density of 1.33-1.35g/cm  3  and cyclization degree of 85-92%. The pre-oxidation method provided by the application is used for the dry-jet wet precursor pre-oxidation reaction, and the pre-oxidation can reach the qualified standard only by performing pre-oxidation treatment in three continuous pre-oxidation temperature areas. Has the advantages of reducing reaction time, reducing energy consumption, improving production efficiency and the like.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: In (In)2O3Preparation method and application of @ CNF material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an In  2 O 3  @CNF material, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving polyacrylonitrile In N, N-dimethylformamide, heating and stirring to obtain a polyacrylonitrile solution, (2) adding indium nitrate into the polyacrylonitrile solution, heating and stirring until the indium nitrate is completely dispersed to obtain a mixed dispersion liquid, (3) spinning the mixed dispersion liquid by using electrostatic spinning equipment, stripping the collected spinning, and drying to obtain carbon fibers, (4) carrying out low-temperature pre-oxidation treatment on the carbon fibers In an air environment to obtain pre-oxidized carbon fibers, and (5) carrying out high-temperature carbonization on the pre-oxidized carbon fibers In an argon atmosphere to obtain a target product. The In  2 O 3  @CNF material prepared by the method is used as the middle layer of the lithium-sulfur battery, so that the shuttle effect of polysulfide In the lithium-sulfur battery can be relieved, and the cycle life of the battery can be prolonged.
assignee: 内蒙古大学

title: Dispersed heat-dredging ceramic matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a dispersion type heat-dredging ceramic matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of dispersing mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber bundles through mechanical vibration and/or ultrasonic vibration, fixing the bundles by using a thermal fuse to obtain unidirectional pitch-based carbon fiber cloth, laminating the unidirectional pitch-based carbon fiber cloth, sewing by using polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers to obtain pitch-based carbon fiber preforms, preparing a carbon interface layer on the fiber surfaces of the pitch-based carbon fiber preforms by using a chemical vapor deposition method, performing graphitization treatment to obtain carbon fiber intermediate blanks, and reacting a ceramic precursor solution with the carbon fiber intermediate blanks by using a precursor dipping and cracking process to obtain the dispersed heat-dredging ceramic-based composite material. The invention can prepare large-area heat-conducting ceramic matrix composite material by near net-size molding, the fiber proportion and matrix components can be regulated and controlled, and the prepared material has the characteristics of low density, thin thickness, high specific strength, uniform and compact internal tissue structure, rapid in-plane large-area heat conduction and the like.
assignee: 航天特种材料及工艺技术研究所

title: Dry-jet wet-spinning large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based precursor filament synthesizing device and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber precursor production, in particular to a dry-jet wet-spinning large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based precursor filament synthesizing device and a preparation method thereof. The device comprises a movable yarn combining wheel combination device, a yarn expanding wheel, a fixed yarn combining wheel and a yarn guiding roller group. Two strands of filaments are respectively vertically arranged at two movable filament combining wheels at two sides of the filament combining device, are spread at the two filament spreading wheels through filament combining angle adjustment to form the same widening width, and then four strands of filaments are combined into a large strand of filament at the two fixed filament combining wheels to form a cross point. And folding and interlacing the yarn path through two yarn guide rollers of the yarn guide roller group I, forming a interlacing point at the two fixed yarn combining wheels again after the yarn path passes through the yarn path, folding the yarn path again through the yarn guide roller group II, and obtaining the large yarn bundle precursor after increasing the interlacing degree. The invention realizes the spinning of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor of the large tow by dry-jet wet spinning, and the obtained large tow precursor has good interlacing property and is not easy to disperse in the subsequent carbonization process.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The application relates to a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and a preparation method thereof, and a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber manufacturing. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out copolymerization reaction on acrylonitrile and a modifier to obtain a polyacrylonitrile polymer solution, wherein the modifier is a vinyl phenol compound, spinning the polyacrylonitrile polymer solution to obtain a polyacrylonitrile precursor, and carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized filament. By introducing vinyl phenol compounds and acrylonitrile for copolymerization modification, the preoxidation cyclization reaction of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber can be promoted, the initial exothermic temperature of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber can be reduced, the skin-core phenomenon of the polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fiber can be improved, and the strength of the carbon fiber can be further improved.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of super-drawn carbon fiber, carbon fiber and application
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a super-drawn carbon fiber, the carbon fiber and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of inorganic materials. The method comprises the steps of preparing a spinning solution with 10-40wt% of polyacrylonitrile, adding 2,4, 6-triaminopyrimidine and barbituric acid into the spinning solution, wherein the total weight of the 2,4, 6-triaminopyrimidine and barbituric acid is 1-20wt% of the polyacrylonitrile, obtaining a spinning solution, performing dry spraying and preforming of the spinning solution, entering a coagulating bath solution at 0-10 ℃, performing low-temperature coagulating bath treatment at a draft ratio of 1-10, obtaining primary fibers, preparing the primary fibers into filaments, and preparing the carbon fibers from the filaments through a pre-oxidation and carbonization process. The spinning dope can be rapidly gelled in the coagulation bath by adding the supermolecule gel accelerator, so that high-multiple drafting can be applied to the nascent fiber. The carbon fiber prepared by the ultra-drawing gel spinning technology has the advantages of perfect internal graphite structure, good orientation, reduced defects and improved fiber strength.

title: Preparation method of super-drawn carbon fiber, carbon fiber and application
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a super-drawn carbon fiber, the carbon fiber and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of inorganic materials. The method comprises the steps of preparing a spinning solution with 10-40wt% of polyacrylonitrile, adding 2,4, 6-triaminopyrimidine and barbituric acid into the spinning solution, wherein the total weight of the 2,4, 6-triaminopyrimidine and barbituric acid is 1-20wt% of the polyacrylonitrile, obtaining a spinning solution, performing dry spraying and preforming of the spinning solution, entering a coagulating bath solution at 0-10 ℃, performing low-temperature coagulating bath treatment at a draft ratio of 1-10, obtaining primary fibers, preparing the primary fibers into filaments, and preparing the carbon fibers from the filaments through a pre-oxidation and carbonization process. The spinning dope can be rapidly gelled in the coagulation bath by adding the supermolecule gel accelerator, so that high-multiple drafting can be applied to the nascent fiber. The carbon fiber prepared by the ultra-drawing gel spinning technology has the advantages of perfect internal graphite structure, good orientation, reduced defects and improved fiber strength.

title: Method for preparing carbon fiber by utilizing acrylonitrile and ice crystal grade acrylic acid
abstract: A method for preparing carbon fiber by utilizing acrylonitrile and ice crystal grade acrylic acid belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The main production steps are 1) preparing ice crystal grade acrylic acid from industrial grade acrylic acid, 2) mixing 2 monomers according to a certain proportion, carrying out aqueous phase precipitation polymerization under a certain oxidation-reduction initiation system, 3) centrifugally washing and drying powder, 4) crushing the powder, and 5) dissolving the powder to prepare spinning stock solution. According to the invention, acrylonitrile and ice crystal grade acrylic acid are used as monomers, and high-performance powder for dry spinning of carbon fiber precursor is prepared at a lower temperature of 45-50 ℃ by a water phase precipitation polymerization method. The prepared precursor monofilament has high strength, high modulus and high crystallinity, and the heat release in the carbonization process is gentle and stable and concentrated in the range of 230-260 ℃, thereby being beneficial to heat dissipation in the carbonization process.

title: Carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon fiber surface modification, and the preparation method of the carbon fiber comprises the following steps of taking polyacrylonitrile precursor as a raw material to prepare graphitized fiber, and then sequentially carrying out electrochemical oxidation surface treatment and sizing on the graphitized fiber to obtain the carbon fiber; the electrochemical oxidation surface treatment comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out primary surface treatment and secondary surface treatment on graphitized fibers, wherein the primary surface treatment adopts alkaline electrolyte with hydroxyl groups, and the secondary surface treatment adopts composite electrolyte of ammonium acetate and monoammonium phosphate.

title: High-performance carbon fiber material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of carbon fibers, and particularly discloses a high-performance carbon fiber material and a preparation method thereof; according to the invention, after the preliminary fiber is manufactured by polyacrylonitrile, the preliminary fiber is placed in an oxidation furnace for oxidation treatment to obtain the oxidized fiber, then the oxidized fiber is placed in a high-temperature furnace for carbonization treatment to obtain the high-performance carbon fiber, finally the high-performance carbon fiber is subjected to improvement treatment, the surface property of the carbon fiber is improved, the adhesive force between the carbon fiber and a base material is enhanced, and the functional high-performance carbon fiber is obtained after the anti-corrosion coating is added.

title: Hollow-structure manganese dioxide nanofiber catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of pollutant catalysis, and provides a hollow manganese dioxide nanofiber catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of mixing manganese acetylacetonate, N-dimethylformamide and polyacrylonitrile, carrying out electrostatic spinning on a precursor solution, drying to obtain a metal-polymer nanofiber membrane, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the nanofiber membrane, carrying out high-temperature pyrolysis, mixing Mn/N-carbon nanofibers and potassium permanganate, grinding, and reacting the mixture, water and concentrated sulfuric acid to obtain the hollow-structure manganese dioxide nanofiber catalyst. The Mn/N-carbon nanofiber template has the characteristics of uniform structure, uniform element distribution and the like, is favorable for further chemical modification, and the MnO  2  @Mn-CNF catalyst has a vivid hollow structure, and generates a state that MnO  2  nanorods grow directionally along the property of carbon fibers, so that the defect that manganese dioxide nanoparticles are easy to agglomerate is overcome.
assignee: 武汉纺织大学

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile fiber fabric for hydrogen energy galvanic pile diffusion layer electrode cloth
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of a gas diffusion layer of a hydrogen fuel cell, and relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile fiber fabric for electrode cloth of a hydrogen energy galvanic pile, which comprises four steps of cutting-off spinning treatment of PAN fiber, knitting and forming the fabric by the PAN yarn, pre-oxidizing treatment of the PAN fiber fabric and carbonization and activation treatment. The high-strength PAN fibers are utilized to carry out weaving treatment of various fabric structures, and through specific pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation treatment, the activated carbon fiber cloth for the hydrogen energy pile diffusion layer with uniform in-plane distribution and controllable performance distribution is formed, so that the porous adsorption characteristic of the carbon fiber fabric layer and the uniformity of a surface substrate are improved.

title: Room-temperature chemical preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber for carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a method for realizing room-temperature chemical preoxidation of polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber based on a functionalized nano carbon material and a nitrogen-bonded compound, which realizes cyclization of polyacrylonitrile by means of an active substance generated by the reaction of the functionalized nano carbon material and the nitrogen-bonded compound. Namely, the composite fiber is obtained by co-spinning the functionalized nano carbon material and the polyacrylonitrile, and the composite fiber is treated by a nitrogen-binding compound to realize the room-temperature chemical pre-oxidation of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber. The cyclizing degree of the preoxidized fiber obtained by the room temperature chemical preoxidation method of the invention can be equivalent to that of the preoxidized fiber obtained by the traditional heat treatment method.

title: Special production equipment for carbon fiber spinning composite material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber spinning composite material production, and discloses special production equipment for carbon fiber spinning composite materials, which comprises a pre-oxidation furnace and a carbonization furnace, wherein the pre-oxidation furnace is positioned at the left side of the carbonization furnace, the horizontal left side of the pre-oxidation furnace is provided with a winding roller, a plurality of groups of polyacrylonitrile tows on the winding roller penetrate through the inner drum seat and enter the oxidation chamber of the pre-oxidation furnace, and the middle positions of the left end face and the right end face of the carbonization furnace are respectively provided with an inlet and an outlet. The special production equipment for the carbon fiber spinning composite material comprises a pressure wheel on an anti-shrinkage structure, wherein the lower end face of a polyacrylonitrile filament bundle is contacted with the pressure wheel, and the polyacrylonitrile filament bundle is expanded by utilizing the sequential action of a tension spring on the pressure wheel, so that the shrinkage of the polyacrylonitrile filament bundle is counteracted, meanwhile, air outlet short pipes are uniformly distributed on two sides of the anti-shrinkage structure, and air is blown upwards to directly act on the lower end face of the polyacrylonitrile filament bundle, so that the linear expansion and expansion of the polyacrylonitrile filament bundle are assisted.

title: Method for preparing flow battery electrode by activating and carbonizing pre-oxidized fiber woven fabric
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing a flow battery electrode by activating and carbonizing pre-oxidized fiber woven cloth, which belongs to the field of electrode material preparation and comprises the steps of carrying out ultrasonic impregnation and primary drying on the pre-oxidized fiber woven cloth in phosphoric acid solution to obtain pre-oxidized fiber cloth loaded with an activating agent; and (3) carbonizing and activating the pre-oxidized fiber cloth loaded with the activating agent under the protection of inert atmosphere to obtain activated carbon fibers, washing the activated carbon fibers with water, drying for the second time, and carbonizing under the inert atmosphere to obtain the activated carbon fiber woven cloth. The invention uses pre-oxidized fiber woven cloth (including biomass-based and polyacrylonitrile-based knitted cloth and woven cloth) as a precursor, adopts ultrasonic-assisted phosphoric acid activation and carbonization processes to prepare the active carbon fiber cloth for the liquid-flow battery electrode, has simple process and is suitable for industrial production. Meanwhile, the activated carbon fiber cloth prepared by the invention achieves the aims of high specific surface area, high conductivity, high air permeability and good mechanical self-supporting performance.
assignee: 山东宽原新材料科技有限公司

title: Ammoniation method of polyacrylonitrile powder
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, and provides an ammonification method of polyacrylonitrile powder. The method comprises the steps of removing single carboxyl-containing polyacrylonitrile material liquid obtained by precipitation polymerization, and then drying for the first time to obtain carboxyl-containing polyacrylonitrile powder, wherein the carboxyl-containing polyacrylonitrile powder is soaked in an aqueous solution of an ammoniation reagent for ammoniation, and the ammoniation reagent is ammonium salt. The method starts from the source of the spinning solution, the method is simple to operate, has high ammoniation efficiency, can effectively improve the hydrophilicity of the polyacrylonitrile, overcomes the defects of large smell and high toxicity of common liquid amine and gas ammonia, ensures that an ammoniated system is pure and environment-friendly, and further avoids the influence of impurities generated by post-pre-oxidation and carbonization on the performance of the final carbon fiber because the special ammoniated reagent does not introduce miscellaneous elements into the system.

title: Red phosphorus-loaded carbon fiber material and application thereof in preparation of potassium ion battery
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a carbon fiber material loaded with red phosphorus and application thereof in preparation of a potassium ion battery. The method comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile, ferric acetylacetonate and ZIF-8 in N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare a shell solution, dissolving potassium hydroxide in dimethyl sulfoxide to obtain a core solution, spinning the shell solution and the core solution into a nano composite fiber membrane through coaxial electrostatic spinning, performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the nano composite fiber membrane, obtaining a uniform porous carbon nanofiber membrane loaded with iron metal clusters under proper atmosphere and temperature, and introducing red phosphorus into pores of the carbon nanofiber membrane by an evaporation-condensation method to obtain the red phosphorus anode material loaded with the iron metal clusters. According to the invention, the red phosphorus is nanocrystallized and embedded into the porous carbon fiber matrix, so that the problem of volume change of the red phosphorus is effectively solved, meanwhile, the coaxial electrostatic spinning technology is utilized to simplify the activation process, and the metal clusters are introduced to remarkably improve the potassium storage electrochemical performance of the red phosphorus cathode.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out unwinding treatment, pre-oxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment, high-temperature carbonization treatment and surface treatment on the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and before the pre-oxidation treatment, sequentially carrying out first steering treatment on fiber tows after the unwinding treatment through a first steering roller and carrying out second steering treatment through a second steering roller, wherein the parameters of the first steering treatment are as follows, the steering angle is 10-40 m, the fiber tows are operated in the first direction for 5-20 m, the applied tension to the fiber tows is 500-1500 cN, the parameters of the second steering treatment are as follows, the steering angle is 10-40, the fiber tows are operated in the second direction for 5-20 m, and the applied tension to the fiber tows is 1000-1500 cN, and the first direction and the second direction are opposite. The invention is mainly used for avoiding fiber strand abrasion and improving tension control precision.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out unwinding treatment, pre-oxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment, high-temperature carbonization treatment and surface treatment on the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and before the pre-oxidation treatment, sequentially carrying out first steering treatment on fiber tows after the unwinding treatment through a first steering roller and carrying out second steering treatment through a second steering roller, wherein the parameters of the first steering treatment are as follows, the steering angle is 10-40 m, the fiber tows are operated in the first direction for 5-20 m, the applied tension to the fiber tows is 500-1500 cN, the parameters of the second steering treatment are as follows, the steering angle is 10-40, the fiber tows are operated in the second direction for 5-20 m, and the applied tension to the fiber tows is 1000-1500 cN, and the first direction and the second direction are opposite. title: Method for efficiently preparing modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile-based fibers, and relates to a method for efficiently preparing modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which comprises the steps of carrying out solution polymerization on a carboxyl-containing comonomer and acrylonitrile, and then mixing the solution with guanidine carbonate solution to obtain modified spinning solution; spinning, heat treatment, oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Compared with the prior art, the invention can improve the defect of insufficient heat resistance of the core layer when the fiber adopts an inert atmosphere pretreatment process by adding the guanidine salt modifier into the acrylonitrile copolymer solution containing carboxyl, and improve the carbon yield from unmodified 48.4% to more than 52.5%. Meanwhile, the invention can realize the uniform distribution of the modifier in the fiber, and compared with the impregnation modification, the invention can lighten the skin-core structure and improve the mechanical property of the fiber. Especially for large tows above 24k, the invention can significantly reduce the single fiber cv value in the tows.

title: Low-carbon production method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a low-carbon production method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, and relates to the technical field of carbon fibers. The technical scheme is that when polyacrylonitrile fiber tows are subjected to pre-oxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment in sequence to prepare polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, a transmission device for the pre-oxidation treatment is started, the polyacrylonitrile fiber tows sequentially enter K pre-oxidation temperature areas for the pre-oxidation treatment after being subjected to filament removal, when the heads of the polyacrylonitrile fiber tows enter the N pre-oxidation temperature areas and stay for 1/2 tn+/-5 min, a circulating fan of the N pre-oxidation temperature areas is started, wherein tn is the stay time of the polyacrylonitrile fiber tows in the N pre-oxidation temperature areas, N is not less than 1 and not more than K, and N is an integer. The method is mainly used for reducing energy consumption and carbon emission in the production process of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The invention further improves the qualification rate of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber product.

title: Microwave pre-oxidation method based on cyanated carbon nanotube modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention provides a microwave pre-oxidation method based on a cyanated carbon nanotube modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out surface modification on a carbon nanotube, introducing the cyanated carbon nanotube into a polyacrylonitrile matrix through in-situ polymerization, providing certain wave absorption performance for the carbon nanotube, enabling the carbon nanotube to absorb microwave energy in a microwave reactor and convert the microwave energy into heat energy, and controlling the power and time of the microwave reactor so as to realize the microwave pre-oxidation of the polyacrylonitrile precursor. The microwave pre-oxidation can finish the pre-oxidation in a short time, and the production cost of the pre-oxidation stage in the preparation of the carbon fiber can be greatly reduced in industry. In addition, the interaction of cyano groups on the cyano carbon nano tube and the polyacrylonitrile chain can effectively improve the dispersibility of the carbon nano tube and the mechanical property of the precursor.

title: Carbon fiber paper, preparation method thereof and proton exchange membrane fuel cell
abstract: The invention discloses carbon fiber paper, a preparation method thereof and a proton exchange membrane fuel cell, and relates to the technical field of fuel cells. The preparation method comprises the steps of filtering carbon fiber slurry containing chopped polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, performing wet forming to obtain a wet carbon fiber layer, adding a modified reinforcing agent solution into the wet carbon fiber layer, heating, drying and pressing to obtain carbon fiber base paper, immersing the carbon fiber base paper in a resin solution, drying, performing hot press curing, carbonization and graphitization treatment, and preparing the carbon fiber paper for the fuel cell. According to the invention, the modified reinforcing agent and the functional filler can be more easily adhered to the cross-connection part of the carbon fibers, so that on one hand, the electrified network is enhanced, the electric conductivity and the heat conductivity of the product are improved, and on the other hand, the void filling caused by adding the conventional functional filler in the resin impregnation stage can be avoided, and the void and the air permeability of the product are negatively influenced.

title: Pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile fiber and pre-oxidized fiber
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of preoxidation methods of carbon fibers, and discloses a preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile fibers and preoxidized fibers. The method comprises the steps of S1, pretreating polyacrylonitrile fiber precursors to obtain pretreated fibers, S2, oxidizing the pretreated fibers to obtain pre-oxidized fibers, wherein the cyclization ratio of the pretreated fibers is 2-12%, and the pretreatment and oxidation processes are respectively carried out on the polyacrylonitrile fibers by the pretreatment method, and meanwhile, the cyclization ratio of the pretreated fibers obtained after pretreatment is ensured to be 2-12%, so that the pre-oxidation time is obviously reduced, and meanwhile, the performance of the fibers is not reduced.

title: High-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the oiling agent comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 5-40% of phenyl silicone oil, 5-60% of polyether/amino polysiloxane segmented copolymer, 3-35% of quaternary ammonium salt polysiloxane, 0.01-0.50% of antioxidant, 1-10% of emulsifier and 5-80% of deionized water; the invention provides a novel structure which is easy to firmly combine with polyacrylonitrile fiber, has good softness and antistatic property, improves the hand feeling of the fiber and yellowing resistance, remarkably improves the heat resistance of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, reduces the generation of oil dirt in a drying process, eliminates the phenomenon of sticking rollers, effectively prevents the condition of broken filaments, doubling, adhesion and the like of precursor filaments in the pre-oxidation process, has better irradiation resistance, oxidation stability, ultraviolet resistance and chemical resistance, has extremely strong hydrophilicity and self-emulsifying capability, and has less consumption of emulsifying agent and environmental friendliness.

title: Device for synchronously measuring preoxidation temperature and tension of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The application discloses a device for synchronously measuring preoxidation temperature and tension of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber precursors, which comprises a sample preparation die (1) and a tension measuring device (2), wherein the sample preparation die consists of a pin 1 (3), a pin 2 (4), a lower frame (5) and an upper frame (6), and the tension measuring device consists of a dynamometer module (7), a dynamometer module fixing module (8), a connecting piece (9), a die fixing block (10) and a hook extension rod (11). The pre-oxidation temperature and tension are measured in real time by winding polyacrylonitrile precursor on a sample preparation die and installing the sample preparation die on a tension measuring device, and feeding the device into a pre-oxidation furnace. The device can synchronously measure the temperature and the tension of large tows with different specifications, and can realize measurement in different environments by adjusting the length of the tension measuring device and the length of the hook extension rod.

title: Numerical simulation method for exothermic performance of filament bundle based on DSC curve
abstract: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method of heat release performance of a filament bundle based on a DSC curve, which belongs to the field of preparation of PAN-based carbon fibers and comprises the steps of performing DSC test on 6K polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor under nitrogen and air atmosphere by using a differential scanning calorimeter, obtaining DSC curves under different atmospheres, and recording temperature and heat flow data in detail. The method utilizes CurveFittingTool of MATLAB software to carry out Gaussian function fitting on DSC curves, extracts key characteristic parameters such as initial temperature, peak value, width and the like of exothermic peaks through operations such as image processing, data point extraction and resampling, provides basic data for subsequent neural network training, and can accurately capture complex thermal reaction rules in the pre-oxidation process by utilizing the nonlinear fitting capability of the BP neural network, and the decision coefficient R2 can reach more than 0.99, thereby remarkably improving the exothermic prediction precision.

title: Carbon fiber-based water treatment agent and preparation method thereof
abstract: The scheme relates to a carbon fiber-based water treatment agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein acrylamide, methyl acrylate and a crosslinking monomer are added in the preparation process of polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, then carbon fiber is obtained through electrostatic spinning, preoxidation and carbonization treatment, acid-base activation is carried out, and zinc oxide particles are grown in situ after being coated by polydopamine, so that the carbon fiber-based water treatment agent is obtained. The invention has the advantages that acrylamide, methyl acrylate and cross-linking monomers containing amino groups and benzene rings are added in the polypropylene polymerization process to crosslink, a molecular chain cross-linking network structure is formed, the spinnability is greatly improved in the electrostatic spinning process, the prepared fiber has higher chemical stability and mechanical strength, the subsequent carbonization yield is effectively improved, the carbon fiber is coated by polydopamine after being activated by alkali and acid in sequence, meanwhile, zinc oxide particles are grown in situ to obtain antibacterial property, the carbon fiber formed after carbonization has large specific surface and more surface adsorption sites, and heavy metal ions in wastewater can be effectively adsorbed, and the regeneration is good.

title: Preparation method and application of oriented carbon fiber self-supporting electrode
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of an oriented carbon fiber self-supporting electrode and application thereof, wherein S1 is prepared by dissolving CoCl  2 ·6H 2  O in methanol to obtain anhydrous CoCl  2 , mixing polyacrylonitrile, phytic acid solution and anhydrous CoCl  2 , dissolving in N, N-dimethylformamide to obtain spinning solution, S2 is prepared by electrochemically spinning PAN fiber felt, loading the spinning solution into a spinning module for electrochemical spinning to obtain fiber felt, S3 is pre-oxidized, heating the fiber felt by adopting a gradient heating method for pre-oxidation, and in the pre-oxidation process, the fiber felt is always kept in a stretching state to obtain oriented pre-oxidized PAN fiber felt which is directionally stretched into orientation, S4 is carbonized and phosphorylated, the pre-oxidized PAN fiber felt is placed at the upstream of a tubular furnace, a sample to be carbonized is placed at the downstream of the tubular furnace, and after high-temperature carbonization, the highly oriented carbon fiber felt electrode material with Co  2  P nano particles uniformly embedded is obtained.

title: Method for evaluating preoxidation reaction result of polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: The application provides a method for evaluating a preoxidation reaction result of polyacrylonitrile fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber manufacturing. The method for evaluating the preoxidation reaction results OF the polyacrylonitrile fibers comprises the following steps OF S1 providing a polyacrylonitrile precursor before preoxidation treatment and a preoxidation fiber after preoxidation treatment, wherein the pre-oxidation reaction results are respectively recorded as PANF and OF, S2 adopting a differential scanning calorimeter to test cyclization reaction heat OF PANF and OF under an inert gas atmosphere and respectively recorded as Q  1PANF  and Q  1OF , S3 adopting the differential scanning calorimeter to test first total reaction heat OF PANF and OF under an air atmosphere and respectively recorded as Q  2PANF  and Q  2OF  under the same test condition, and S4 calculating according to a formula I to obtain oxidation reaction degrees.

title: Graded porous hollow carbon fiber catalyst with coordinated monoatomic iron and ferric oxide clusters, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic nitrate radical reduction catalysts, and particularly relates to a hierarchical porous hollow carbon fiber catalyst with synergic monoatomic iron and ferric oxide clusters, and a preparation method and application thereof. The spinning preparation method comprises the steps of stirring polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate in an organic solvent to obtain a spinning precursor solution, stirring ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and 1, 10-phenanthroline serving as ligands in the organic solvent to obtain a metal organic ligand, stirring the spinning precursor solution and the metal organic ligand, obtaining composite fibers loaded with the metal precursor through an electrostatic spinning technology, and then performing pre-oxidation and high-temperature pyrolysis. The carbon fiber prepared by the invention has good conductivity and a unique hollow hierarchical porous structure, and greatly promotes the transmission of reactants while exposing more active sites, and the carbon fiber is used as a single-atom cooperative cluster catalyst carrier, thereby being beneficial to the rapid transmission of electrons and effectively improving the electrocatalytic efficiency.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber precursor film based on electrostatic spinning and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber precursor film based on electrostatic spinning and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functionalized carbon fibers. According to the method, PAN and PAA are mixed according to a certain proportion and dissolved in DMF solvent to prepare electrostatic spinning precursor solution, the conditions and parameters of electrostatic spinning are regulated and controlled to prepare a nascent fiber membrane, the nascent fiber membrane is subjected to low-temperature water washing to remove the solvent, the washed nascent fiber is subjected to hydrothermal reaction to remove the PAA, then the PAA is subjected to low-temperature water washing to regulate and control the stability of a porous structure, and the damage rate of the porous structure and the yarn breakage rate during pre-oxidation are reduced through a drying process. The precursor film prepared by the method has ductility, multiple pore structures and uniform pores, and can be used for simplifying the next procedure.

title: Silicon-carbon composite material, preparation method thereof, silicon-based negative electrode for lithium ion battery and lithium ion battery
abstract: The invention provides a silicon-carbon composite material, a preparation method thereof, a silicon-based negative electrode for a lithium ion battery and the lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, mixing silicon powder, a surfactant and a first organic solvent to obtain silicon powder dispersion liquid; s2, drying the silicon powder dispersion liquid to obtain a silicon source precursor; step S3, mixing a silicon source precursor, polyacrylonitrile and a second organic solvent to obtain mixed spinning slurry; step S4, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the mixed spinning slurry to obtain a silicon carbon fiber precursor; and S5, carbonizing the silicon carbon fiber precursor to obtain a silicon carbon composite material, wherein the surfactant is one or more of the group consisting of a silane coupling agent, polypropylene pyrrolidone and tetrachloroethylene. The agglomeration of silicon powder is effectively avoided by using the surfactant, a carbon fiber structure with rich pores is left after the carbonization of the surfactant, the damage to the structure caused by the volume expansion of the silicon is effectively buffered, and the wiped electrical property is improved.
assignee: 银隆新能源股份有限公司

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor special for carbon paper and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor special for carbon paper and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of organic polymer materials. The method comprises the following steps: taking water as a solvent, ammonium persulfate-ammonium sulfite or ammonium persulfate-ammonium bisulfate as a redox initiator, taking acrylonitrile as a first monomer, itaconic acid as a second monomer, and vinyl unsaturated ester with a large side group as a third monomer, and reacting at 50-60 ℃ for 8-14 h to obtain PAN polymer powder; preparing PAN polymer powder into slurry to obtain spinning solution; setting the temperature of the coagulating bath at 30-60 ℃ and the drafting multiple of the coagulating bath at-30% -5%; and (3) adopting two sections of hot water drafting, gradually increasing the densification temperature, and then carrying out steam drafting to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor special for the carbon paper. After carbonization, the carbon fiber precursor of the invention has carbon content more than or equal to 95.6 percent and resistivity less than or equal to 1.6mΩ cm, and meets the technical index of carbon paper for a diffusion layer of a fuel cell.
assignee: 长春工业大学

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber, pre-oxidized fiber and application of pre-oxidized fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber, and a pre-oxidized fiber and application thereof, which mainly solve the problems of poor strength of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and poor strength of carbon fiber in the production process of the carbon fiber in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of oiling precursor fibers, drying and densifying, steam drafting, filament collecting and preliminary pre-oxidizing to obtain the polyacrylonitrile preliminary pre-oxidized fibers; wherein, the precursor fiber is treated for 5-20 seconds by infrared drying at 100-120 ℃ before oiling treatment; the primary pre-oxidation temperature is not higher than 250 ℃, so that the problem is solved well, and the prepared pre-oxidized fiber has high strength and stable process and can be used in industrial production of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and carbon fiber.
