title: Method for joining polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors
abstract: The invention relates to a method for linking polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors, which comprises the following steps: knotting the tail end of the first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor tow and the head end of the second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor tow to form a fixed knot, and leaving a spinneret at one side of the fixed knot; a first yarn braiding part is formed by braiding a yarn head of a first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor yarn bundle into a second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor yarn bundle positioned at the other side of the fixed knot; a first yarn braiding part is formed by braiding a first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor yarn bundle positioned at the other side of the fixed knot into a yarn head of a second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor yarn bundle; the first braiding part, the fixed knot and the second braiding part form a joint; an adhesive is applied to the joint. The invention is mainly used for making the joint have certain strength and not heat accumulation and overheat, so that the joint can directly pass through a pre-oxidation furnace, a low-carbon furnace and a high-carbon furnace from a yarn-withdrawing creel to a yarn collecting machine, thereby reducing the stop time and improving the production efficiency.
assignee: 山西钢科碳材料有限公司

title: Pre-oxidation process of carbon fiber precursor and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber pre-oxidized precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a preoxidation process of carbon fiber precursor and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber preoxidized filament, wherein the carbon fiber precursor is preoxidized in an oxidation furnace with the oxygen content of 25-90%. According to the invention, the carbon fiber precursor is pre-oxidized in the oxidizing furnace with the oxygen content of 25-90%, so that the running speed of the carbon fiber precursor is improved, the pre-oxidation time of the carbon fiber precursor is shortened, the pre-oxidation efficiency of the carbon fiber precursor is effectively improved on the premise that the density and mechanical property of the pre-oxidized precursor are kept unchanged or increased, and the production cost is reduced; in addition, the pre-oxidized fiber prepared by the pre-oxidation process has less sheath-core structure, further, the carbon fiber prepared by the pre-oxidized fiber with less sheath-core structure has greatly reduced surface hairline quantity, uniform internal and external properties and greatly improved mechanical properties.
assignee: 吉林碳谷碳纤维股份有限公司; 吉林化纤集团有限责任公司

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and obtained polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for improving polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fibers, which mainly solves the problems of poor drawability, more broken filaments and more broken filaments of polyacrylonitrile precursor in the preoxidation process in the prior art. According to the invention, a circulating medium is adopted as a drying densification unit of heat conduction oil, and polyacrylonitrile fibers with the crystallinity of 45-70%, the grain size of 3-9 nm and the crystal region orientation degree of 60-80% are subjected to drying densification, the circulating flow of the heat conduction oil is controlled to be 10-40 m  3 /h, the drying densification temperature is 70-180 ℃, the surface temperature CV value of a drying densification hot roller is less than or equal to 7%, and then saturated steam drafting and heat setting are sequentially carried out, so that polyacrylonitrile precursor is subjected to pre-oxidation, and the technical scheme for preparing polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fibers is adopted, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used in the preparation process of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fibers and/or polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石油化工股份有限公司上海石油化工研究院

title: Oil solution for ultrahigh-strength carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an oil solution for an ultrahigh-strength carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof. The oil agent comprises the effective components of 100 parts of amino modified silicone oil compound, 20-50 parts of epoxy modified silicone oil compound and 30-50 parts of surfactant, and is prepared by mixing the components, adding water, emulsifying and phase inversion to obtain stable emulsion with the particle size distribution of 100-300 nm. The modified silicone oil compounds used in the invention all contain polyether hydrophilic groups, the emulsified particle size distribution is small, the surface tension is low, and the oiling uniformity of the oiling agent on the surface and in the precursor is effectively ensured; meanwhile, the modified silicone oil compound has the functions of low-temperature self-crosslinking and high-temperature cross-linking, so that the bundling property and the surface protection effect on the precursor in the drying and drafting processes are ensured, the heat resistance of the oiling agent in the pre-oxidation and carbonization stages is improved, the uniformity of the structural transformation process of the precursor of the carbon fiber in the pre-oxidation and carbonization stages is effectively ensured, and the tensile strength of the obtained carbon fiber reaches more than 6400 MPa.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-performance graphene-based carbon fibers, which comprises the following steps: (1) Dispersing graphene oxide powder in an organic solvent to form a uniform dispersion liquid, adding an ammonia source into the dispersion liquid to form a corresponding mixed liquid, and obtaining an aminated graphene powder; (2) Dissolving the amination graphene powder in an organic solvent to form a dispersion liquid, and fully soaking polyacrylonitrile fibers in the formed dispersion liquid to obtain polyacrylonitrile fibers infiltrated with the amination graphene; (3) Pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile fibers infiltrated with the aminated graphene to form nitride composite fibers; (4) And continuously performing cross-linking carbonization on the nitride composite fiber at a high temperature of 1000-1300 ℃ to form a composite carbon fiber material, and then further raising the temperature to 1400-1800 ℃ to perform graphitization treatment to form the graphene-based carbon fiber with high crystallinity. The graphene-based carbon fiber preparation scheme provided by the invention can be used for preparing the high-performance graphene-based carbon fiber, and the graphene-based carbon fiber has high strength and high conductivity.

inventors: TIAN SUYUN; SHEN FUQIANG

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion with polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to obtain composite spinning solution; s2, spinning the composite spinning solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile/polytetrafluoroethylene composite fibers; s3, performing pre-oxidation treatment on the composite fiber to obtain pre-oxidized fiber; and S4, carbonizing the pre-oxidized fiber under the protection of inert gas to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber. The preparation method only carries out the procedures required by the preparation of the carbon fiber, combines the activation reaction and carbonization, omits pretreatment before activation and single activation procedures, and has the advantages of environmental protection, controllable reaction, simple operation, avoidance of secondary high-temperature activation and the like.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out wet spinning or dry-jet-wet spinning on a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, and controlling the solvent content in a polyacrylonitrile fiber in the spinning process to obtain a polyacrylonitrile precursor containing a solvent; s2, carrying out supercritical treatment on the polyacrylonitrile precursor under the supercritical carbon dioxide atmosphere to obtain porous polyacrylonitrile fibers; s3, performing pre-oxidation treatment on the porous polyacrylonitrile fiber to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber; and S4, carbonizing the pre-oxidized fiber under the protection of inert gas to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based activated carbon fiber. The method has the advantages of environmental protection, controllable reaction, high temperature avoidance, chemical reagent avoidance and the like. The method can prepare the active carbon fiber with large surface and rich holes.

title: Preparation method of high-strength high-temperature-resistant isotropic graphite
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-strength high-temperature-resistant isotropic graphite, which comprises the steps of firstly, boiling, refluxing and oxidizing chopped Carbon Fibers (CF) in nitric acid for pretreatment, and adding the pretreated chopped CF into a certain amount of ethanol for ultrasonic dispersion; then adding the Mesophase Carbon Microspheres (MCMB) into an ultrasonic bath, stirring and uniformly mixing, and mechanically crushing the dried mixture into powder with the average granularity of 10-50 mu m; then, performing isostatic compaction to obtain a green body of the CF/MCMB composite material, and then performing carbonization and graphitization treatment; finally, the graphitized sample is put into prepared boric acid/borax/potassium chromate impregnating solution for repeated impregnation, and crystal water is removed at 450 ℃, so that high-strength high-temperature-resistant isotropic graphite is obtained. According to the preparation method of the high-strength high-temperature-resistant isotropic graphite, the boron antioxidant is introduced, the protective layer is formed at high temperature, the oxidation resistance of the graphite is improved, and the defect of poor MCMB interface bonding performance is overcome by utilizing the characteristic of high CF modulus.
assignee: 湖南元墨科技有限公司
inventors: YANG JIANXIAO; SU ZHANPENG; ZHANG JIBIN

title: Preparation method of hollow activated carbon fiber and filter screen material containing hollow activated carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of air purification materials, and discloses a preparation method of hollow activated carbon fibers and a filter screen material containing the hollow activated carbon fibers. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving polyacrylonitrile, ethylenediamine, melamine and polyethylene glycol in a solvent to prepare spinning solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution to obtain PAN amination nanofiber; and then the hollow activated carbon fiber is prepared through pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation. The filter screen material comprises a hollow activated carbon fiber layer and a composite non-woven fabric layer. The hollow activated carbon fiber provided by the invention has the advantages of abundant holes, large specific surface area, strong adsorption capacity and extremely slow release speed after adsorption saturation, and provides sufficient time for the catalytic degradation process of the composite non-woven fabric. The filter screen material provided by the invention can efficiently adsorb, catalyze and degrade various VOCs gases, has a long-acting adsorption and purification effect, and can be widely applied to various in-vehicle and indoor air purifiers.

title: Dry-jet wet-spinning large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based precursor filament synthesizing device and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber precursor production, in particular to a dry-jet wet-spinning large-tow polyacrylonitrile-based precursor filament synthesizing device and a preparation method thereof. The device comprises a movable yarn combining wheel combination device, a yarn expanding wheel, a fixed yarn combining wheel and a yarn guiding roller group. Two strands of filaments are respectively vertically arranged at two movable filament combining wheels at two sides of the filament combining device, are spread at the two filament spreading wheels through filament combining angle adjustment to form the same widening width, and then four strands of filaments are combined into a large strand of filament at the two fixed filament combining wheels to form a cross point. And folding and interlacing the yarn path through two yarn guide rollers of the yarn guide roller group I, forming a interlacing point at the two fixed yarn combining wheels again after the yarn path passes through the yarn path, folding the yarn path again through the yarn guide roller group II, and obtaining the large yarn bundle precursor after increasing the interlacing degree. The invention realizes the spinning of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor of the large tow by dry-jet wet spinning, and the obtained large tow precursor has good interlacing property and is not easy to disperse in the subsequent carbonization process.

title: Raw filament transportation system and method in polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production
abstract: The invention discloses a precursor transporting system in polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production, which comprises circulating conveyor line track equipment arranged between a precursor workshop winding section and a carbonization workshop stereoscopic warehouse; the circulating conveyor line track equipment comprises a primary wire transferring and conveying device, a primary wire loading device, a loading device and a unloading device, wherein the primary wire transferring and conveying device comprises an overhead track to form a circulating conveyor line connected end to end; the primary yarn carrying device comprises a roller arranged on the overhead rail, a sliding frame connected with the roller, and a carrying platform arranged at the lower end of the sliding frame; the loading device comprises a stacker arranged at a winding section of the precursor workshop; the unloading device comprises a stacker arranged at the unloading point of the stereoscopic warehouse of the carbonization workshop. The automatic continuous conveying mode is used for conveying the PVC winding drums from the precursor workshop to the carbonization workshop three-dimensional warehouse, and after the three-dimensional warehouse is taken out of the warehouse, the empty PVC winding drums are returned to the precursor production workshop for continuous use, so that the working efficiency is improved, and the manual transfer cost and loss are reduced.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber manufacturing, and discloses a carbon fiber precursor pre-oxidation method and a pre-oxidized carbon fiber prepared by the same. The method comprises the following steps: and carrying out modification pretreatment, drying, cyclization and oxidation on the carbon fiber precursor to obtain the preoxidized carbon fiber. title: High-strength carbon fiber hub and manufacturing process thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength carbon fiber hub and a manufacturing process thereof, which relate to the technical field of hub manufacturing, and the high-strength carbon fiber is obtained by stepwise carbonization of polyacrylonitrile fiber; step carbonization comprises the steps of pre-oxidation and carbonization; then, carrying out impregnation treatment on the high-strength carbon fiber, then, carrying out curing molding in a hub die, and finally, polishing to obtain a finished hub; compared with the traditional aluminum alloy hub, the carbon fiber hub prepared by the method has the advantages of being lighter in weight, higher in strength, capable of avoiding the defect of metal fatigue, obvious in noise reduction and the like, and along with the continuous development of new energy automobiles, the application space of the carbon fiber hub is wider than that of the traditional aluminum alloy hub, and the market potential is huge.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber and obtained carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of concentrated heat release, easy fiber breakage and poor carbon fiber product performance in the preoxidation process in the prior art. The method comprises the following specific steps: pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile fiber in at least four temperature areas to obtain pre-oxidized fiber by controlling the tension of the fiber in each temperature area; and performing low-temperature carbonization treatment in at least three temperature areas and high-temperature carbonization treatment in at least three temperature areas to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the continuous preparation of the large-tow carbon fiber is realized by controlling the tension of each temperature zone in the pre-oxidation stage and matching with the temperature, the draft ratio and the residence time of low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization, so that the problems are well solved, and the method can be used in the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber preparation process.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, pre-oxidation method and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application relates to a preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers and a preparation method of carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fibers. The pre-oxidation method comprises the following steps: pretreating polyacrylonitrile precursor in an inert atmosphere, and then performing pre-oxidation treatment in an oxidation atmosphere; the volume fraction of oxygen in the oxidizing atmosphere is 20% -40%; the pretreatment temperature is 200-300 ℃, and the pretreatment time is 20-60min; the temperature of the pre-oxidation treatment is 180-250 ℃, and the time of the pre-oxidation treatment is 30-120min. The preoxidation method can improve the cyclization degree of the fiber, and enable the oxygen heterocyclic structure to be formed, so that the thermal stability of the fiber is improved.

title: Preparation method of high-performance carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of high-performance carbon fibers, and relates to the field of carbon fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly preparing polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, after spinning the spinning solution, sequentially carrying out alternating low-temperature water washing on nascent fibers formed through coagulating bath through a cold tank with the temperature of 40-55 ℃ and a hot tank with the temperature of 45-60 ℃, carrying out high-temperature water washing on the cold tank with the temperature difference of 2-10 ℃ and the temperature of 60-85 ℃ and the total traction multiple of water washing being 0.9-1.9 times, and sequentially carrying out blow drying, oiling, high-temperature drying and steam drafting to finally obtain polyacrylonitrile precursors, wherein the carbon fibers are obtained after carbonization of the precursors. The water washing process is carried out by adopting a mode of cold-hot alternating low-temperature water washing and then high-temperature water washing, and the grain orientation and grain growth inside the fiber are obviously affected by precisely controlling the water washing temperature and the drawing multiple, so that a precursor with high grain orientation degree and compact structure is obtained, and finally the T800-level high-performance carbon fiber with excellent mechanical property and mechanical property is obtained.

title: Flexible carbon paper-based lithium ion battery negative electrode material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible carbon paper-based lithium ion battery anode material, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of self-supporting electrodes and energy storage devices. Fibrillating polyacrylonitrile fibers (PAN) by a pulping and papermaking equipment PFI pulping machine, screening the fibrillated fibers by a pall screening instrument, and mixing the screened nanofibers with Carbon Fibers (CFs) to form paper; the flexible carbon paper electrode (FCP) is obtained after pre-oxidation and carbonization, the material shows good flexibility, mechanical strength and electrochemical performance when being used for the negative electrode of the flexible lithium ion battery, and is suitable for being applied to flexible electronic devices, and the material preparation has the advantages of simplicity, greenness, high efficiency and low consumption, provides guidance for the production of the flexible electrode, and improves the feasibility of the carbon paper-based material in the industrial application of the flexible battery.

title: Low-heat-conductivity polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of ablative heat insulation composite material preparation, and particularly relates to a low-heat-conductivity polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: sequentially carrying out spinning, solidification forming, washing, oiling and hot roller drying treatment on the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile fibers rich in pore structures; and (3) sequentially performing preoxidation and carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fiber rich in the pore structure to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with low heat conductivity. The method has the following advantages: 1) The preparation process is simple and convenient, the cost is low, and the industrial production is convenient. 2) The low-heat-conductivity polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber obtained by the method has higher retention rate of mechanical properties, has heat conductivity reduced by about 46% compared with commercial carbon fiber, and can be applied to the field of ablation and heat insulation integrated composite materials.

title: High-conductivity C/C composite bipolar plate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a high-conductivity C/C composite bipolar plate, and a preparation method and application thereof, comprising the following steps: s1, preparing a carbon fiber preform from a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber net tire and asphalt carbon fiber cloth through a needling process; s2, taking alkane gas as a raw material, and carrying out pyrolytic carbon matrix preparation on the carbon fiber preform by a chemical vapor infiltration process to form a low-density C/C composite material plate; s3, performing asphalt impregnation carbonization densification treatment on the low-density C/C composite material plate to obtain a high-density C/C composite material plate; s4, performing high-temperature graphitization treatment on the high-density C/C composite material plate to obtain a graphitized C/C composite material plate; s5, preparing a surface high-conductivity coating on the graphitized C/C composite material plate through a chemical vapor deposition process, and cutting to obtain the C/C composite material bipolar plate, wherein the preparation is completed. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of improving the conductivity and the density of the C/C composite bipolar plate and the like.

title: Fuel cell gas diffusion layer carbon paper and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a fuel cell gas diffusion layer carbon paper and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of fuel cells. When the carbon paper of the fuel cell gas diffusion layer is prepared, the chopped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber is mixed with phenolic resin after paper making, and the carbon paper base layer is obtained through solidification, carbonization and graphitization; sealing the carbon paper base layer with calcium carbonate to obtain a pre-modified carbon paper base layer; reacting carbon black with N- (3-trimethoxysilylpropyl) pyrrole to obtain modified carbon black; carrying out irradiation activation on polytetrafluoroethylene, and reacting with 3-butene triethoxysilane to obtain modified polytetrafluoroethylene and prepare modified polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion; uniformly mixing modified carbon black, modified polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion and calcium carbonate, and then spraying the mixture on a pre-modified carbon paper base layer to obtain a modified carbon paper base layer; and then the modified carbon paper base layer and pyrrole react to prepare the carbon paper of the fuel cell gas diffusion layer. The fuel cell gas diffusion layer carbon paper prepared by the invention has excellent gas diffusivity, thermal stability, electrical conductivity and mechanical property.

title: High-performance PI fiber/PAN-based carbon fiber battery felt and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber felt preparation, and discloses a high-performance PI fiber/PAN-based carbon fiber battery felt and a preparation method thereof, wherein Polyimide (PI) fibers and Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) -based pre-oxidized fibers are used as raw materials, short fibers obtained by mixing polyimide and polyacrylonitrile are subjected to opening, carding and spreading into fiber webs, and then reinforcing the fiber net into cloth through a needle, wherein the needle is provided with a hook needle, repeatedly penetrating the fiber net, reinforcing the hook belt fiber to form a needle-punched carbon fiber felt, and preparing the carbon fiber felt into a battery felt through carbonization, graphitization and steam activation, and using the battery felt as an electrode of the all-vanadium redox flow battery. The addition of polyimide fiber can increase the graphite carbon content of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, increase the graphitization degree, and the material with higher graphitization degree has better conductivity and chemical stability, and reduces the performance attenuation of the electrode material in the charge-discharge cycle process.

title: Lignin-based carbon fiber spinel catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a lignin-based carbon fiber spinel catalyst material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention is characterized in that lignin, polyacrylonitrile, ferric acetylacetonate and copper acetylacetonate are dissolved in N, N-dimethylformamide, and the spinning solution is filled into a syringe with a stainless steel needle for electrostatic spinning. The resulting lignin-based spinel fiber precursor was thermally stable in a muffle furnace. And carbonizing the heat-stable fiber in nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the lignin-based carbon fiber spinel catalyst material. The electrocatalytic oxidation of the pentahydroxymethyl furfural prepared from the lignin-based carbon fiber spinel catalyst material prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention shows excellent catalytic activity.

title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of carbon fiber and comprise the following steps: pre-oxidizing polyacrylonitrile fibers in at least six pre-oxidizing temperature areas to obtain pre-oxidized fiber bodies; after the pre-oxidation treatment of each pre-oxidation temperature zone, the volume density, the oxygen content and the cyclization degree of the corresponding fiber body meet the set conditions; carbonizing the pre-oxidized fiber body at a low temperature to obtain a low-temperature carbonized fiber body; high-temperature carbonization is carried out on the low-temperature carbonized fiber body to obtain a high-temperature carbonized fiber body; and carrying out surface treatment on the high-temperature carbonized fiber body to obtain the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber. The invention sets the pre-oxidation treatment of a plurality of pre-oxidation temperature areas, controls the fiber body structure of each pre-oxidation temperature area by adjusting the drawing multiplying power and the pre-oxidation temperature applied to the fiber in each pre-oxidation temperature area, prepares the pre-oxidation fiber body with full cyclization and compact structure, and provides a structural basis for the subsequent preparation of high-strength carbon fiber.

title: Polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The application relates to a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and a preparation method thereof, and a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, belonging to the technical field of carbon fiber manufacturing. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out copolymerization reaction on acrylonitrile and a modifier to obtain a polyacrylonitrile polymer solution; wherein the modifier is vinyl phenol compound; spinning the polyacrylonitrile polymer solution to obtain polyacrylonitrile precursor; and (3) pre-oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile precursor to obtain the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized precursor. By introducing vinyl phenol compounds and acrylonitrile for copolymerization modification, the preoxidation cyclization reaction of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber can be promoted, the initial exothermic temperature of the polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber can be reduced, the skin-core phenomenon of the polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fiber can be improved, and the strength of the carbon fiber can be further improved.

title: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped carbon fiber-loaded Ni-MoC nano particles for full pH range electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of nitrogen-doped carbon fiber loaded Ni-MoC nano particles for electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution in a full pH range, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. The method comprises the following steps of taking the prepared Ni-ZIF as a Ni source and taking the molybdenum acetylacetonate oxide as a Mo source. Ni-ZIF, molybdenum acetylacetonate and polyacrylonitrile are dissolved in N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare spinning solution. And obtaining a spinning film by adopting an electrostatic spinning method, and obtaining the nitrogen-doped carbon fiber loaded Ni-MoC nanoparticle hybrid material by adopting a pre-oxidation and high-temperature carbonization method. The preparation method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low cost, simple process and the like. In addition, the hybrid material prepared by the method has a hierarchical porous structure, which is beneficial to improving the mass transfer rate in the catalysis process, and the electron-rich property of Ni and the synergistic effect with MoC are beneficial to the adsorption and desorption of the hydrogen intermediate on the surface of the catalyst, so that the material has high-efficiency electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution performance in the full pH range.

title: Acrylonitrile terpolymer high-strength spinning solution and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a high-performance polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises (1) taking dimethyl sulfoxide or N, N-dimethylformamide as a solvent, and azo-bis-isobutyronitrile as an initiator to initiate copolymerization of acrylonitrile, a second difunctional monomer, namely 3-ammonium carboxylate-3-methyl butyrate and a third monomer, namely methyl acrylate at 50-70 ℃. Wherein the mass ratio of acrylonitrile/3-ammonium carboxylate-3-methyl butyrate/methyl acrylate is 99-98.2:0.2-1:0.8, the azodiisobutyronitrile accounts for 0.1-1.5wt% of the total mass of the monomers, and the total concentration of the monomers is 16-30wt%. (2) And (3) defoaming, removing monomers, filtering the spinning solution obtained in the step (1) to obtain spinning stock solution, and then carrying out dry-jet wet spinning, stretching, oiling, drying densification, hot steam drafting and heat setting to obtain the carbon fiber precursor. The invention adopts the double functional group comonomer of 3-ammonium carboxylate-3-methyl butyrate, which not only can reduce the consumption of the comonomer and save the production cost, but also can improve the molecular weight and the structural regularity of the polyacrylonitrile polymer, and the prepared carbon fiber precursor has uniform structure, small fineness and high strength. The polyacrylonitrile copolymer prepared by the method can effectively improve the thermal stabilization performance of the polyacrylonitrile copolymer in the pre-oxidation stage, and has a certain practical application prospect.

title: Preparation method for high-performance, low-cost carbon fiber
abstract: The present disclosure provides a preparation method for high-performance, low-cost carbon fiber, relating to the technical field of carbon fiber and carbon fiber manufacturing. The preparation method for high-performance, low-cost carbon fiber comprises: providing raw polyacrylonitrile filament; passing the raw polyacrylonitrile filament through multiple temperature zones in sequence, performing pre-oxidation treatment to obtain pre-oxidized fiber, and an aromatization index of the raw polyacrylonitrile filament increasing with equal magnitude as the polyacrylonitrile raw filament passes through the multiple temperature zones; and performing a carbonization process on the pre-oxidized fiber, to obtain carbon fiber.

title: Method for manufacturing high-performance wet-spun polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, which mainly solves the problems of easy generation of broken filaments and poor mechanical properties of carbon fiber in the preoxidation process in the prior art. The invention adopts a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, adopts wet spinning, and comprises the steps of steam drafting, wherein each fiber bears tension of at least 1mN in the steam drafting process, and the tension borne by the fiber is less than or equal to 10% of the breaking strength of the fiber, so that the problem is better solved, and the method can be used in industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor.

title: Polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity and a preparation method thereof. The invention prepares the polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity by a reversible addition/fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) free radical polymerization process and by selecting trithiocarbonate (TRIT) with carboxyl at two ends as an RAFT reagent through a polymerization reaction. The polyacrylonitrile resin has high molecular weight, narrow distribution, high molecular chain structure regularity and few molecular structure defects. The polyacrylonitrile resin prepared by the method has obviously improved hydrophilicity and oxidation cyclization activity, and is suitable for preparing high-performance precursor fibers for carbon fibers.

title: Precursor stabilization process
abstract: The present invention relates to an improved process for forming a stabilized precursor suitable for the manufacture of carbon materials such as carbon fibers. The process can convert a precursor comprising polyacrylonitrile to a stabilized precursor with greater efficiency. The invention also relates to a process for preparing carbon fibers using the stabilized precursor.
assignee: 迪肯大学

title: Composite carbon fiber electrode material with adjustable and controllable structure function, preparation method thereof and application thereof in flow battery
abstract: The invention discloses a composite carbon fiber electrode material with adjustable and controllable structure and function, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a flow battery. Adding the synthesized elastic carbonaceous microspheres into a mixed solution of Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) and N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF), and uniformly mixing to obtain a spinning solution; spinning by using the spinning solution to obtain original polyacrylonitrile nano-fibers; and carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on the obtained original polyacrylonitrile nano-fiber to obtain a target product. The active polarization caused by charge transfer resistance, ohmic polarization caused by contact resistance and concentration polarization caused by mass transfer can be effectively reduced by applying the active polarization to the electrode material of the flow battery, so that the energy efficiency, the power density and the cycle life of the battery are improved. The method is simple, easy to operate, universal, capable of carrying out targeted design on material structures and functions according to different requirements, and wide in application.
assignee: 辽宁大学

title: Carbon fiber bundle and method for producing same
abstract: The object is to obtain a carbon fiber which is suitable for a carbon fiber reinforced composite material using a resin with high heat resistance as a matrix, has reduced molding processing cost and improved performance, and has bundling property and thermal stability in a high balance. The carbon fiber bundle of the present invention has a crystallite size L obtained by measuring a bulk of the whole fiber bundle, wherein the carbon fiber bundle has a fixed end at one end and a free end at the other end, and has a twist of 2 twists/m or more, a predetermined single fiber diameter, and a predetermined heating reduction rate  c  And the degree of crystal orientation pi  002  Meets the prescribed formula. The present invention also relates to a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle having a predetermined diameter of single fibers and a predetermined heating reduction rate, wherein a flame-retardant treatment, a pre-carbonization treatment, and a carbonization treatment are sequentially performed on a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, wherein the twist of the fiber bundle during the carbonization treatment is set to 2 turns/m or more and the tension is set to 1.5mN/dtex or more. And a carbon fiber bundle having a twist angle of 0.2 DEG or more and a predetermined diameter of single fibers and a predetermined heating reduction rate, wherein the carbon fiber bundle has a crystallite size L measured by a bulk of the whole fiber bundle   c  With the degree of crystal orientation pi  002  Meets the prescribed formula. The present invention also relates to a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle having a predetermined single fiber diameter and a predetermined heating loss rate, wherein a flame-retardant treatment, a pre-carbonization treatment, and a carbonization treatment are sequentially performed on a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, and the tension in the carbonization treatment is set to 1.5mN/dtex or more, wherein the fixed end is one end and the free end is the other end, and the lay angle remaining on the surface layer of the fiber bundle is 0.2 DEG or more.
assignee: 东丽株式会社

title: Method for preparing self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material based on electrostatic spinning technology
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material based on an electrostatic spinning technology, and relates to the field of lithium-sulfur battery electrode materials. The low-content polymethacrylic acid and polyacrylonitrile are mixed to form a shell solution for coaxial electrostatic spinning, and the high-content polymethacrylic acid and the polyacrylonitrile are mixed and a small amount of hydroxyl-based multi-wall carbon nano-tubes are added to form a core solution for coaxial electrostatic spinning. And (3) a coaxial electrostatic spinning technology is used for obtaining a non-woven fabric film, and pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment are carried out on the non-woven fabric film, so that a self-supporting shell is porous, and an inner core is a multi-channel carbon fiber structure. And carrying sulfur on the obtained material to obtain the self-supporting lithium sulfur battery anode material. The self-supporting system can be directly used as an electrode material without preparing the electrode material like a traditional pulping method, effectively improves the shuttle effect in the lithium sulfur battery, and improves the cycle life of the lithium sulfur battery and the utilization rate of an active material, thereby improving the electrochemical performance of the lithium sulfur battery as a whole.
assignee: 太原理工大学

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber resin matrix composite material for umbrella ribs
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of composite materials, and provides a preparation method of a carbon fiber resin-based composite material for umbrella ribs, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer; s2, preparing polyacrylonitrile-based precursor; s3, immersing the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor in an ethanol solution of phthalic acid for 30-60 min; s4, pre-oxidation treatment; s5, carbonizing treatment; s6, acidizing for 3-5 hours; s7, modifying the surface of the carbon fiber; s8, compression molding. The application realizes the application of the carbon fiber resin matrix composite material on the umbrella ribs, and solves the problems that the existing carbon fiber and resin interface has weak adhesion and the preparation of products with excellent mechanical properties is difficult.
assignee: 福建优安纳伞业科技有限公司

title: Preparation method of fireproof and heat-insulation multilayer combined type portable firefighter uniform
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a fireproof heat-insulation multilayer combined type portable firefighter uniform, and particularly relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment. According to the invention, the outer layer fabric is prepared by modifying the high-molecular carbon fiber pre-oxidized filaments and the modified aramid fibers through a textile process; the interlayer is made into a heat insulation felt by processing pure modified carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber through a non-woven spunlace process; the inner layer is made into a close-fitting layer fabric by adopting a technology of adding PTFE filament base cloth and a PTFE film; the multifunctional novel fire-fighting rescue suit is produced by cutting, sewing and processing; in the preparation process, the polyacrylonitrile precursor can be effectively subjected to multiple pre-oxidation modification treatment by adopting ultrasonic, microwave heating modification and gamma ray irradiation modification, the modified polyacrylonitrile precursor can reach a proper pre-oxidation degree in a short time, and the uniformity of the radial structure of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber is improved, so that the modified carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber with higher thermal stability is obtained.
assignee: 盐城创能新屏蔽材料有限公司

title: High-performance binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of preparation of carbon fiber precursors and comprising the following steps: under the protection of nitrogen, dissolving acrylonitrile in N, N-dimethylformamide, adding an initiator azo isobutyl cyano formamide, reacting a second comonomer N-vinylpyridine amide in a continuous dropwise adding manner to obtain an acrylonitrile polymer, and then filtering, vacuum-demonomerizing and defoaming to obtain a spinning solution; and (3) carrying out processes of dry-jet wet spinning, water washing, drafting, heat setting and the like on the spinning solution to obtain the carbon fiber precursor. According to the invention, N-vinylpyridine amide is used as a comonomer, and amide groups can increase the compactness of protofilaments; meanwhile, the amino in the amide can promote the cyclization reaction, reduce the pre-oxidation temperature and reduce the production cost; the N atoms in the pyridine group and the initiator azo isobutyl cyano formamide are beneficial to crosslinking reaction, the transformation of the preoxidized fiber ring-shaped aromatic structure to a two-dimensional aromatic condensed ring layer structure is promoted, and the carbon yield is improved.
assignee: 东华大学; 广东蒙泰高新纤维股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of high-electric-conductivity and high-heat-conductivity graphite fiber paper
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-conductivity and high-heat-conductivity graphite fiber paper, which comprises the following steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with superfine diameter mesophase pitch-based graphite fiber with average diameter smaller than 5 mu m and diameter of 2-5 mu m accounting for more than 50%, wherein the superfine diameter mesophase pitch-based graphite fiber comprises 20-95% of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber=5-80%, and preparing base paper by a wet papermaking process; the base paper is impregnated with thermosetting resin, and then is subjected to hot pressing and carbonization treatment to prepare the graphite fiber paper. The graphite fiber paper prepared by the invention has the following advantages: excellent electric conduction and heat conduction performance, large air flux, good drainage performance, good flexibility and strength and excellent processing performance; graphitization is not needed after paper forming, and the preparation cost is reduced.
assignee: 易高碳材料控股(深圳)有限公司

title: Preparation method of hollow carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of hollow carbon fiber, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a spinning solution: dissolving polyacrylonitrile powder in a spinning solvent, and uniformly stirring to obtain a polyacrylonitrile solution; the solution is defoamed and then used as an outer layer solution; s2, preparing fibers: extruding the inner and outer layer solutions at a certain speed ratio by using oil with certain viscosity as an inner layer solution and using a high-temperature oil bath as a coagulating bath through a coaxial spinning method to obtain spinning trickles; then the spinning trickle firstly passes through an air section, then passes through a high-temperature oil bath, and finally is washed by water; s3, pre-oxidation treatment: pre-oxidizing by adopting a gradient heating mode; s4, carbonizing treatment. According to the invention, polyacrylonitrile is used as a raw material by a coaxial spinning method, the polyacrylonitrile is respectively used as an inner layer solution and a coagulating bath of the fiber, the components are the same, and the viscosity is different, so that the filament forming process is regulated and controlled, the structure of the surface of the precursor is effectively improved, and finally the polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber with compact structure and high fiber strength is prepared.
assignee: 武汉纺织大学

title: Modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof. A process for preparing a modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber comprises adding dicyandiamide and phosphoric acid sequentially to a solution of an acrylonitrile polymer to obtain a modified spinning solution; spinning the modified spinning solution to obtain modified protofilaments; and carrying out heat treatment on the modified protofilament in an inert atmosphere, and then carrying out air oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The method for preparing the modified polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber improves the carbon yield while realizing high-efficiency preparation.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fibers, which solves the problems of concentrated heat release, easy fiber breakage, aggregation of carbon fiber products, poor spreading effect and difficult application in the preoxidation process in the prior art. The method comprises the following specific steps: performing four-temperature-zone pre-oxidation treatment on the polyacrylonitrile fiber by using a pre-oxidation furnace, and controlling the tow width of the pre-oxidized fiber through drafting matching to prepare the pre-oxidized fiber; and (3) performing low-temperature carbonization treatment in a three-temperature area by using a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and performing high-temperature carbonization treatment in the three-temperature area by using a high-temperature carbonization furnace to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber. In the continuous preparation process of the fiber, the continuous preparation of the large-tow carbon fiber is realized by matching the temperature, the draft ratio and the residence time of pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization and controlling the running width of the fiber, so that the problems are well solved, and the method can be used in the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber preparation process.

title: Heat-resistant and high-compatibility carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a heat-resistant and high-compatibility carbon fiber precursor oiling agent and a preparation method thereof. Comprises modified siloxane, an emulsifying agent, a nonionic antistatic agent, an antioxidant and deionized water; the modified siloxane is prepared by modifying polyvinyl polysiloxane through thioglycollic acid ethanolamine ester. The modified siloxane grafts carboxyl, amino and hydroxyl through the addition reaction of sulfhydryl and double bond, has strong heat resistance, reduces the content of silicon and has high compatibility. The carbon fiber precursor oil prepared from the modified siloxane has heat resistance, greatly reduces broken wires and knitting wool in the pre-oxidation process, has high compatibility, can enhance the adhesion capability and the adhesion uniformity of polyacrylonitrile fibers, and can prepare carbon fibers with higher linear density and higher bundle wire strength.

title: Preparation method of nanoparticle embedded N-doped carbon fiber composite film material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nano-particle embedded N-doped carbon fiber composite film material. The invention firstly condenses and returns cobalt acetate and nickel acetate compound for 4 hours at 80 ℃ to obtain prismatic Ni-Co precursor nano particles, then evenly mixes the nano particles with Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) spinning solution, and synthesizes three-dimensional fiber complex through electrostatic spinningThe composite structure is then obtained by further high temperature carbonization and selenization treatment (NiCo)  3  Se  4  The N-CF nano particles are embedded in the carbon fiber composite film material. This particular three-dimensional structure not only mitigates volume expansion, maintains structural integrity, but also has a higher specific surface area and conductivity. The method is simple to operate and high in repeatability, provides a new way for designing and preparing the novel composite film material, and has good application prospects in various fields such as batteries, catalysis and the like.

title: Oil solution for ultrahigh-strength carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an oil solution for an ultrahigh-strength carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof. The oil agent comprises the effective components of 100 parts of amino modified silicone oil compound, 20-50 parts of epoxy modified silicone oil compound and 30-50 parts of surfactant, and is prepared by mixing the components, adding water, emulsifying and phase inversion to obtain stable emulsion with the particle size distribution of 100-300 nm. The modified silicone oil compounds used in the invention all contain polyether hydrophilic groups, the emulsified particle size distribution is small, the surface tension is low, and the oiling uniformity of the oiling agent on the surface and in the precursor is effectively ensured; meanwhile, the modified silicone oil compound has the functions of low-temperature self-crosslinking and high-temperature cross-linking, so that the bundling property and the surface protection effect on the precursor in the drying and drafting processes are ensured, the heat resistance of the oiling agent in the pre-oxidation and carbonization stages is improved, the uniformity of the structural transformation process of the precursor of the carbon fiber in the pre-oxidation and carbonization stages is effectively ensured, and the tensile strength of the obtained carbon fiber reaches more than 6400 MPa.

title: Nickel-plated carbon fiber paper for electromagnetic shielding material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application discloses nickel-plated carbon fiber paper for an electromagnetic shielding material and a preparation method thereof, wherein polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber is adopted, is added into deionized water after being subjected to gas phase oxidation surface treatment, and is added with a surfactant and a dispersing agent to be stirred into a uniformly dispersed suspension, and is subjected to vacuum filtration to form a film by adopting a wet papermaking technology; then impregnating the paper with thermosetting phenolic resin solution, performing hot pressing, curing and carbonization, performing CVD secondary treatment to deposit pyrolytic carbon, and finally forming the substrate pure black carbon fiber paper; then, nickel-phosphorus alloy is deposited on the surface of the carbon fiber paper by adopting a chemical nickel plating mode, so that the carbon fiber paper presents silver, and the conductivity, electromagnetic shielding effectiveness and mechanical property of the material are effectively improved under the condition of not changing the thickness; and finally, carrying out PTFE treatment on the nickel-plated carbon fiber paper to prepare the nickel-plated hydrophobic carbon fiber paper for electromagnetic shielding, which is light in weight, porous, high in conductivity and high in strength.

title: Preparation method of carbon-based self-supporting fiber membrane and application of carbon-based self-supporting fiber membrane in sodium ion battery
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon-based self-supporting fiber membrane and application of the carbon-based self-supporting fiber membrane in a sodium ion battery, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Heating the precursor in water bath with mixed acid solution of concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated nitric acid, wherein the volume mass ratio (mL/g) of the mixed acid solution to the precursor powder is 20-50; followed by washing and drying to obtain a pretreated precursor powder. (2) Taking pretreated precursor powder as a raw material, taking polyacrylonitrile as a spinning aid, and carrying out static reactionPreparing carbon fiber film by electrospinning and high-temperature carbonization, wherein the carbon layer spacing is 0.368-0.378nm, and the specific surface area is 30-70m  2  g  ‑1  . The carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method does not need a current collector, a conductive agent, a binder and other inactive substances, can be self-supported and shaped, has a larger carbon layer spacing, and can provide more sodium storage sites, so that the carbon fiber membrane can be directly used as a negative electrode of a sodium ion battery, has high capacity performance and strong long-cycle stability, and is convenient for promoting the commercialization process of a negative electrode material of the low-cost sodium ion battery.

title: Precursor stabilization process
abstract: The present application relates to a precursor stabilization process. The present application relates to an improved process for forming a stabilized precursor suitable for the manufacture of carbon materials such as carbon fibers. The process can convert a precursor comprising polyacrylonitrile to a stabilized precursor with greater efficiency. The application also relates to a process for preparing carbon fibers using the stabilized precursor.

title: Method for preparing antioxidant carbon fiber solid felt by adopting metal ion purifying agent
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing an antioxidant carbon fiber solid felt by adopting a metal ion purifying agent, belonging to the field of carbon fiber materials. Specifically, the invention prepares the carbon fiber solid felt by swelling, electrostatic spinning, pre-oxidation, microwave heating carbonization, water vapor activation and purification of polyacrylonitrile; the carbon fiber solid felt prepared by the invention has the special forms of extremely large specific surface area, small holes on the surface of the fiber and the like, and the characteristics lead the carbon fiber solid felt to have wide application in the fields of wastewater, waste gas treatment, water purification and the like; the carbon fiber solid felt prepared by the invention is tested by cyclic utilization: the fiber felt can be recycled after being desorbed for 1h at 300 ℃ by electric heating, the quality of the fiber felt is over 96 percent after 5 times of recycling, and the removal rate can still be kept at about 90 percent, which indicates that the regeneration recycling property is good and the adsorption effect is also good, thereby providing technical support for the application of the active superfine carbon fiber felt adsorbent in water treatment.

title: Pre-oxidation method of carbon fiber
abstract: The application relates to a preoxidation method of carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. A method of pre-oxidizing carbon fibers, comprising: the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor prepared by the dry-jet wet spinning process is subjected to pre-oxidation treatment through three continuous pre-oxidation temperature areas, so that the pre-oxidation degree of the finally obtained pre-oxidized fiber meets the following conditions: the bulk density is 1.33-1.35g/cm  3  The cyclizing degree is 85-92%. The pre-oxidation method provided by the application is used for the dry-jet wet precursor pre-oxidation reaction, and the pre-oxidation can reach the qualified standard only by performing pre-oxidation treatment in three continuous pre-oxidation temperature areas. Has the advantages of reducing reaction time, reducing energy consumption, improving production efficiency and the like.

title: Carbon fiber, preparation method thereof and composite material
abstract: The application relates to a carbon fiber, a preparation method thereof and a composite material, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: placing the carbonized fiber body obtained through the pre-oxidation reaction and the carbonization reaction in a boride solution, and sequentially carrying out soaking and drying treatment to coat the boride on the surface of the carbonized fiber body; then sequentially carrying out graphitization heat treatment and surface treatment on the carbonized fiber body after the drying treatment to obtain carbon fibers; the surface treatment includes: and sequentially carrying out first-stage electrochemical anodic oxidation treatment and second-stage electrochemical anodic oxidation treatment on the carbonized fiber body subjected to graphitization heat treatment, so that the fiber surface is etched and oxygen-containing functional groups are generated. According to the preparation method, the boron catalyst is introduced into the carbonized fiber body, and then graphitization heat treatment and surface treatment are carried out, so that the carbon fiber with higher modulus and interface performance can be obtained at a low graphitization heat treatment temperature, meanwhile, the graphitization heat treatment time is shortened, the equipment loss is reduced, and the production cost is reduced.

title: Preparation method of self-supporting catalytic electrode material
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electrode materials for electrolyzing waste hydrochloric acid, in particular to a self-supporting catalytic electrode material for recycling industrial byproduct hydrochloric acid and a preparation method thereof. The invention carries out preoxidation and carbonization treatment on waste catkin and polyacrylonitrile, the prepared carbon fiber is used in an electrode material to improve the conductivity of the electrode, then the carbon fiber is fully mixed with a catalyst, plant fiber, a binder, a cross-linking agent and water, the mixture is put into an evaporation dish to be dried for film formation, and finally the dried electrode is subjected to conductive reinforcement treatment to obtain the self-supporting catalytic electrode with good conductivity. The binder and the cross-linking agent can be cross-linked with the plant fiber, so that the use of a conductive substrate with high price is avoided, and the falling-off of the catalyst can be effectively prevented. The self-supporting catalytic electrode provided by the invention has good conductivity and can effectively prevent the catalyst from falling off, and a novel method can be provided for realizing the recycling of industrial byproduct waste hydrochloric acid.

title: Porous carbon film, preparation method thereof, gas diffusion layer, battery and power utilization device
abstract: The application relates to a porous carbon film and a preparation method thereof, a gas diffusion layer, a battery and an electric device, wherein the preparation method of the porous carbon film comprises the following steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile, a diluent, alcohol and carbon fiber, preserving heat at 120-180 ℃, cooling to 10-20 ℃, cooling, solidifying and vacuumizing to obtain a polyacrylonitrile porous material; the diluent comprises at least one of dimethyl sulfoxide and N, N-dimethylformamide; sequentially performing pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on the polyacrylonitrile porous material to obtain a porous carbon film intermediate; and graphitizing the porous carbon film intermediate in chlorine atmosphere to obtain the porous carbon film. The preparation method of the porous carbon film can effectively improve the air permeability, flexibility, electric conductivity and bending strength of the porous carbon film, and can reduce the preparation energy consumption and cost.

title: Dispersed heat-dredging ceramic matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a dispersion type heat-dredging ceramic matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: dispersing the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber bundles through mechanical vibration and/or ultrasonic vibration, and then fixing the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber bundles by using a thermal fuse to obtain unidirectional pitch-based carbon fiber cloth; laminating unidirectional pitch-based carbon fiber cloth, and then sewing by adopting polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers to obtain a pitch-based carbon fiber preform; preparing a carbon interface layer on the fiber surface of the asphalt-based carbon fiber preform by a chemical vapor deposition method and carrying out graphitization treatment to obtain a carbon fiber intermediate blank; and (3) reacting the ceramic precursor solution with the carbon fiber intermediate blank by adopting a precursor dipping and cracking process to prepare the dispersed heat-conducting ceramic matrix composite material. The invention can prepare large-area heat-conducting ceramic matrix composite material by near net-size molding, the fiber proportion and matrix components can be regulated and controlled, and the prepared material has the characteristics of low density, thin thickness, high specific strength, uniform and compact internal tissue structure, rapid in-plane large-area heat conduction and the like.
