title: Nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of oxygen reduction electrocatalyst preparation. According to the invention, polyacrylonitrile (PAN) and boric acid are dissolved in an organic solvent to obtain spinning slurry. The spinning slurry is made into a catalyst precursor of a fiber structure by using an electrostatic spinning machine, and then the catalyst precursor is subjected to high-temperature crosslinking treatment in air and high-temperature carbonization treatment by reducing gas to obtain the nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber which can be used as an electrocatalyst for catalyzing and producing hydrogen peroxide. The fiber network structure provides higher specific surface and good conductivity, and is beneficial to improving the electrochemical performance of the material. The nitrogen-boron doped carbon fiber catalyst prepared by the invention has higher hydrogen peroxide selectivity, simple process and mild condition.
assignee: 中国科学院大连化学物理研究所
inventors: YU HONGMEI; JIA SENYUAN; SUN SHUCHENG; Na Jingchen; SHAO ZHIGANG

title: Polyacrylonitrile precursor homogenizing pre-oxidation equipment
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber material preparation, in particular to polyacrylonitrile precursor homogenizing pre-oxidation equipment; through all being equipped with at the preliminary heat unit in the preliminary heat oxidation stove both ends, the supplementary hot unit including connect the supplementary hot box on the preliminary heat oxidation stove, be equipped with the trompil of a plurality of confession protofilament business turn over on assisting the hot box, the lower extreme of assisting the hot box be equipped with assist the hot air inlet, still include a hot air supply unit, hot air supply unit provides clean hot-air for two air inlets of assisting the hot unit simultaneously, the utility model discloses add supplementary hot unit at the both ends of preliminary heat oxidation stove, preheat the protofilament that gets into before the preliminary heat oxidation stove through assisting the hot unit, make the hot-air in advance to the inside infiltration of protofilament, carry out homogeneity preliminary heat reaction at once after getting into the preliminary heat oxidation stove, prevent that the protofilament from getting into the production that causes the skin-core structure untimely because of the inside technological condition response of fibre in-process of preliminary heat oxidation stove to the effect of preliminary heat oxidation has been guaranteed.
assignee: 中简科技股份有限公司
inventors: YANG YONGGANG; XIA LIN; CAI HENG

title: Method for improving strength of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a method for improving the strength of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is immediately fed into an environment with temperature and humidity control after the tow is discharged from an oxidation furnace and a low-temperature carbonization furnace, so that a series of moisture absorption effects generated after the tow enters a humid environment are avoided, water absorbed by the tow after entering a high-temperature carbonization furnace opening is instantly gasified and is combined with carbon atoms in the fiber to release CO and other gases, defects or holes are left on the surface or inside of the tow, and the strength and other properties of the fiber are reduced. The method can avoid the fluctuation of the carbon fiber strength and other properties caused by the change of the environmental temperature and humidity, so that the prepared carbon fiber has the advantages of small number of holes, uniform quality, small dispersion, excellent strength and other properties.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石化上海石油化工股份有限公司

title: Method for preparing activated carbon fiber based on centrifugal spinning method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing activated carbon fibers based on a centrifugal spinning method, which comprises the steps of injecting a prepared polyacrylonitrile-based N, N-dimethylformamide spinning solution into a planar receiving type centrifugal spinning device to prepare polyacrylonitrile-based micro-nano long fibers with fine diameters and uniform size distribution; then carrying out segmented temperature rise and heat preservation for pre-oxidation to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based micro-nano pre-oxidized fibers; then the pre-oxidized fiber is subjected to preliminary carbonization treatment at high temperature, so that the adsorption rate of an activating agent during the pre-activation treatment can be improved, and the defect of micropore collapse caused by severe carbonization process when the pre-oxidized fiber is directly subjected to high-temperature activation carbonization can be overcome; and finally, dipping by using an activating agent solution for pre-activation treatment, drying and then carbonizing at high temperature, so that the activation process is mild, and the pore diameter and porosity of the micropores are easy to control. The active carbon fiber prepared by the method has the advantages of high specific surface area, high porosity and small pore diameter, and is suitable for large-scale mass production.
assignee: 武汉纺织大学

title: Easily-conductive metal-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an easily conductive metal-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which is characterized in that a metal chromium water dispersoid is prepared and doped into a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to be spun to obtain fibril, and the fibril is subjected to pre-oxidation, pre-carbonization, carbonization and other processes to prepare the metal chromium-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber. Compared with the common polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, the carbon fiber has lower resistivity, which shows that the conductivity is better. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber containing the metal chromium is simple and has no pollution to the environment.
assignee: 武汉纺织大学

title: Preparation method of composite lithium-sulfur battery electrode material with three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a composite lithium-sulfur battery electrode material with a three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure, which comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile in an N, N-dimethylformamide solvent to serve as a sheath solution; dissolving iron disulfide and polyvinylpyrrolidone into an N, N-dimethylformamide solvent to be used as core liquid; the method comprises the steps of respectively placing injectors filled with core liquid and sheath liquid on two injection pumps of an electrostatic spinning device for coaxial electrostatic spinning, collecting electrospun and ejected precursor fibers on a roller, placing the obtained precursor fibers in an air atmosphere muffle furnace for pre-oxidation, then carbonizing in an inert gas protective atmosphere to obtain the core-shell structure iron disulfide/carbon @ carbon fiber composite material, then immersing the obtained iron disulfide/carbon @ carbon fiber composite material in dilute nitric acid, stirring, filtering, and drying to finally prepare the three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure carbon @ carbon fiber/sulfur composite lithium sulfur battery electrode material. The lithium-sulfur electrode material obtained by the invention has the characteristics of high capacity and good cycle stability.
assignee: 上海理工大学

title: Preparation method of Si-C-O ceramic antioxidant coating on surface of carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a Si-C-O ceramic antioxidant coating on the surface of carbon fiber, and relates to a preparation method of a carbon fiber antioxidant coating. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the material performance is reduced due to the fact that an oxidation-resistant coating on the surface of carbon fiber prepared by a precursor impregnation cracking method has pores and cracks. The method comprises the following steps: adding a mixed monomer of propyl trimethoxy silane and phenyl trimethoxy silane into a potassium hydroxide aqueous solution for reaction, then filtering and drying a filter cake to obtain a precursor; dissolving the precursor in xylene to obtain a precursor solution; and repeatedly dipping and drying the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in the precursor solution, then sintering in an argon atmosphere, and then repeatedly dipping, drying and sintering to obtain the antioxidant Si-C-O ceramic coating on the surface of the carbon fiber. The anti-oxidation Si-C-O ceramic coating obtained on the surface of the carbon fiber by the method has no cracks and pores, and can be used in the fields of high temperature resistant and anti-oxidation materials.
assignee: 哈尔滨工业大学

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of more carbon fiber broken filaments, poor mechanical property and large coke discharge amount of a low-carbon furnace in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of oiling, drying densification, steam drafting, heat setting, heat stabilization and carbonization; the method is characterized in that oiling and drying densification are carried out at least twice, at least one step is carried out before the steps of steam drafting and heat setting, and at least one step is carried out after the steps of steam drafting and heat setting, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used for producing high-performance carbon fibers.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石油化工股份有限公司上海石油化工研究院

title: Method for manufacturing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, which mainly solves the problems that broken filaments are easy to generate in a pre-oxidation process and the mechanical property of carbon fibers is poor in the prior art. The invention adopts a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, adopts wet spinning, and comprises the step of steam heat setting, wherein, the technical proposal that the bearing tension of each fiber is 0.5-2.1mN in the process of steam heat setting better solves the problem, and can be used in the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石油化工股份有限公司上海石油化工研究院

title: Preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped porous carbon fiber material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped porous carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of porous carbon fiber materials. Firstly, preparing polyacrylonitrile/polyvinylpyrrolidone spinning precursor solution, then obtaining porous polyacrylonitrile fiber by a wet spinning method by utilizing different solubilities (phase separation) of polyacrylonitrile and polyvinylpyrrolidone in an aqueous solution, soaking and activating the obtained porous polyacrylonitrile fiber in a potassium hydroxide solution, taking polyacrylonitrile as a carbon source and a nitrogen source, and carrying out one-step high-temperature carbonization activation treatment in an inert atmosphere to obtain the nitrogen-doped porous carbon fiber. The porous carbon fiber material has a hierarchical porous carbon skeleton structure with high specific surface area, high nitrogen content and mutual crosslinking, provides a fast channel for electron transmission, shortens ion diffusion distance, increases wettability and conductivity of the material, and shows very good electrochemical performance. The preparation process is simple, the equipment dependence is low, and the method is suitable for large-scale industrial production.
assignee: 北华大学

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material, which comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile by using a solvent to obtain a spinning solution; adding isopropyl titanate, boric acid, melamine and nano diamond into the spinning solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed spinning solution; preparing the mixed spinning solution into spinning fibers by adopting wet spinning; and the spinning fiber is subjected to thermal stabilization and carbonization to prepare the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material prepared by the invention is a fibrous photocatalytic material, is convenient to recover after water treatment, and does not generate the problems of difficult recovery and secondary pollution. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material has wider application range, and is suitable for water bodies under different illumination conditions for water treatment.
assignee: 中原工学院

title: PEM fuel cell, carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a PEM fuel cell, a carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of new energy and new materials, and solves the problems of poor conductivity, complex structure and high cost of the existing composite bipolar plate. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing a unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film by using polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers and polyvinyl butyral; step 2, extracting and grading the coal tar pitch by using a toluene-benzyl alcohol mixed solvent, and performing high-temperature telomerization polymerization on the extracted polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon mixture in the presence of elemental iodine to obtain a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon polycondensate; step 3, arranging the unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film in an oriented manner and carrying out hot-press molding on the unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film and the condensed-ring aromatic condensation polymer; and 4, carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment on the carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate precursor obtained by hot press molding to obtain the carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate. The carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate has the advantages of high strength, high electric and heat conducting performance, good chemical stability and air tightness and low preparation cost.
assignee: 中国科学院化学研究所

title: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst, belonging to the technical field of electrocatalysis. The preparation method of the nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst comprises the following steps: s1, firstly dissolving polyacrylonitrile in an organic solution, and then sequentially dissolving diisopropyl azodicarboxylate, cobalt acetate tetrahydrate and ferric acetylacetonate in the organic solution in which the polyacrylonitrile is dissolved to obtain a precursor solution; s2, performing electrostatic spinning on the precursor solution to obtain a spinning precursor; and S3, sequentially carrying out curing treatment and carbonization treatment on the spinning precursor to obtain the nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst. The carbon nanofiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst has a positive half-wave potential for oxygen reduction reaction and a small overpotential for oxygen evolution reaction.
assignee: 宁波工程学院

title: Preparation method of high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane, which comprises the following steps: the coke powder is treated by the mixed acid solution of concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated nitric acid in a refluxing way, and is washed and dried to obtain coke oxide powder, and the high-flexibility integral type carbon nanofiber membrane is prepared by electrostatic spinning, preoxidation and carbonization by taking the coke oxide powder as a raw material and PVB and/or PVP as a spinning aid and a pore-forming agent. The carbon nanofiber membrane prepared by the method has the characteristics of high flexibility, integral type, adjustable specific surface area, high conductivity and the like. The invention uses cheap and easily obtained coke as a carbon source to produce the flexible carbon nanofiber membrane, thereby realizing high-value utilization of the coke. Compared with the method for preparing the carbon nanofiber membrane by polyacrylonitrile electrostatic spinning, the method has the advantages of cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, good product flexibility, high specific surface area and the like. The high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the fields of electrochemical energy storage, adsorption separation, catalysis and the like.
assignee: 大连理工大学

title: Extreme-high-temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an extremely high temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: high-thermal-conductivity carbon fibers and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers are mixed and woven into a high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preform, or high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preforms are woven by using high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber rods; preparing a carbon interface layer on the fiber surface of the high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preform by sequentially adopting a chemical vapor deposition method and a high-temperature graphitization treatment method to obtain a thermal-dredging composite material preform; sequentially taking a polycarbosilane ceramic precursor and a hafnium-tantalum ceramic precursor as impregnation liquids to enable the heat dredging composite material preform to be subjected to PIP (poly-p-phenylene-bisphenol-imide) process to prepare a heat dredging ultrahigh-temperature ceramic-based composite material; and preparing an anti-ablation ceramic coating on the surface of the thermal dredging ultrahigh-temperature ceramic-based composite material to prepare the extremely-high-temperature anti-ablation thermal dredging composite material. The extremely-high-temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material prepared by the invention has the characteristics of high thermal conductivity, high density, excellent mechanical property, excellent high-temperature ablation-resistant property and the like.
assignee: 航天特种材料及工艺技术研究所

title: Manganese dioxide/carbon film composite material with core-shell structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a manganese dioxide/carbon film composite material with a core-shell structure, which is characterized in that a polyacrylonitrile film is prepared through electrostatic spinning, the polyacrylonitrile carbon film is prepared through high-temperature carbonization, and rapid-growth MnO is obtained through quenching treatment in potassium permanganate solution  2  Nanosheets to obtain a core-shell structure; the shell-core structure takes carbon fiber as a core, mnO is adopted  2  The nanosheet array is a shell. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing a polyacrylonitrile membrane; 2) Preparing a polyacrylonitrile carbon film; 3) And (3) preparing the birnessite/carbon film composite material with high potassium content. The material is used as an electrode material of a super capacitor, and can be charged and discharged in a range of 0-1.3V and at a current density of 4 mA cm  –2  The specific capacity reaches 700-800 mF cm  –2  . The present invention uses KMnO  4  As a precursor solution, the KMnO can be captured in situ through quenching treatment  4  The potassium ions in the solution omit the pre-embedding process of the potassium ions, so that the specific capacitance of the material is greatly improved; is beneficial to industrial large-scale production and preparation and realizes the development of flexible devices.
assignee: 桂林电子科技大学

title: Microporous layer material for water/gas separation and transmission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a microporous layer material for water/gas separation and transmission, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing sheath-core composite nano-fiber with a mixture of polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate as a sheath layer and a mixture of polymethyl methacrylate and butyl titanate as a core layer, then carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, then carrying out carbonization treatment, and finally carrying out hydrophobic treatment on the outer surface of a product obtained by carbonization treatment; the finally prepared material is nano carbon fiber with a hollow structure, the inner surface of the nano carbon fiber has hydrophilicity, the outer surface of the nano carbon fiber has hydrophobicity, and micropores communicated with the inner surface and the outer surface are distributed on the nano carbon fiber; the finally prepared material can be used for preparing a microporous layer of a membrane electrode of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell. The invention solves the problems of cell flooding, serious mass transfer polarization and the like caused by low water management level of the membrane electrode material of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell in the prior art, and can separate and transmit product water and reactant gas in the membrane electrode.
assignee: 东华大学
inventors: LI GUANG; ZHANG JINGJING; WANG BIAO; JIN JUNHONG; YANG SHENGLIN

title: Microporous layer material for water/gas separation and transmission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a microporous layer material for water/gas separation and transmission, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing sheath-core composite nano-fiber with a mixture of polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate as a sheath layer and a mixture of polymethyl methacrylate and butyl titanate as a core layer, then carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, then carrying out carbonization treatment, and finally carrying out hydrophobic treatment on the outer surface of a product obtained by carbonization treatment; the finally prepared material is nano carbon fiber with a hollow structure, the inner surface of the nano carbon fiber has hydrophilicity, the outer surface of the nano carbon fiber has hydrophobicity, and micropores communicated with the inner surface and the outer surface are distributed on the nano carbon fiber; the finally prepared material can be used for preparing a microporous layer of a membrane electrode of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell. The invention solves the problems of water flooding of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell membrane electrode material, serious mass transfer polarization and the like caused by low water management level in the prior art, and can separate and transmit product water and reactant gas in the membrane electrode.
assignee: 东华大学

title: Process method for quickly and efficiently producing and preparing 25K large-tow carbon fibers
abstract: The invention discloses a process method for quickly and efficiently producing and preparing 25k large-tow carbon fibers, which comprises the following process steps: pre-oxidizing 25K large-tow polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber raw materials; drawing wires in an oxidation furnace; taking out the oxidized fiber in the oxidation furnace, and carrying out secondary temperature control and low-temperature carbonization; after the low-temperature carbonization is finished, carrying out third temperature control and high-temperature carbonization; then cooling and sizing the fiber filaments; drying to finish the production of 25K large-tow carbon fibers; and performing sampling inspection and packaging. According to the process method for quickly and efficiently producing and preparing 25k large-tow carbon fibers, the pre-oxidized filament density of the large-tow carbon fibers and the excellent performance of the carbon fibers are ensured by improving the adjustment of the temperature of each pre-oxidation furnace, the performance of the large-tow carbon fibers is effectively improved at a high speed, the unit energy consumption of production is reduced, and the large-scale production benefit of enterprises is improved.
assignee: 吉林宝旌炭材料有限公司
organization: JILIN BAOJING CARBON MAT CO LTD
inventors: NING CHEN; HU XIAOJIN; ZHOU DONGFU

title: Method for preparing self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery cathode material based on electrostatic spinning technology
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material based on an electrostatic spinning technology, and relates to the field of lithium-sulfur battery electrode materials. The method comprises the steps of mixing low-content polymethacrylic acid and polyacrylonitrile to form a shell solution for coaxial electrostatic spinning, mixing high-content polymethacrylic acid and polyacrylonitrile, and adding a small amount of hydroxyl poly-walled carbon nanotubes to form a core solution for coaxial electrostatic spinning. And (3) obtaining a non-woven fabric film by using a coaxial electrostatic spinning technology, and carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment on the non-woven fabric film to obtain a self-supporting carbon fiber structure with a porous shell and a multi-channel inner core. And carrying out sulfur loading on the obtained material to obtain the self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material. The self-supporting system does not need to be used for preparing an electrode material like a traditional pulping method, can be directly used as the electrode material, effectively improves the ground shuttling effect in the lithium-sulfur battery, and improves the cycle life of the lithium-sulfur battery and the utilization rate of active materials, thereby integrally improving the electrochemical performance of the lithium-sulfur battery.
assignee: 太原理工大学
inventors: MIAO YANQIN; WU YUCHENG; CAO HAILIANG; WU CHENSHAN

title: Preparation method of coal-based porous carbon fiber negative electrode material of lithium/sodium ion battery
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a low-cost coal-based porous carbon fiber negative electrode material of a lithium/sodium ion battery. The coal-based porous carbon fiber is prepared by using coal produced in Xinjiang Heishan as a carbon source, dissolving the carbon source and polyacrylonitrile in N, N-dimethylformamide after mixed acid treatment to prepare a spinning solution, and then performing processes such as electrostatic spinning technology, pre-oxidation, carbonization, chemical activation treatment and the like. The prepared material has large specific surface area and abundant pore structures, and shows high discharge capacity and excellent cycle stability when being used as the negative electrode material of lithium ion batteries and sodium ion batteries. The invention establishes a method for preparing the porous carbon fiber negative electrode material by using Xinjiang coal, realizes high value-added utilization of coal, and has important research significance.
assignee: 新疆大学
inventors: WANG XINGCHAO; GAO JUNTING; SUN YING; ZHANG FEI; HUANG YUDAI; JIA DIANZENG

title: High-performance carbon fiber material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance carbon fiber material and a preparation method thereof, which are prepared by a method of high-temperature carbonization treatment of polyacrylonitrile fiber precursors. The high-performance carbon fiber material is obtained by controlling the molecular weight composition of the polyacrylonitrile fiber protofilament and combining the surface treatment after carbonization treatment. The carbon fiber material obtained by the invention has excellent performance, has good compatibility with resin materials, plays a good role in improving the performance, can be used as a toughening agent of the resin materials, and has wide market popularization prospect.
assignee: 杭州金州高分子科技有限公司
organization: HANGZHOU JINZHOU MACROMOLECULE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY
inventors: ZHOU ZHANCHUAN

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber, pre-oxidized fiber and application
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber, the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and application thereof, and mainly solves the problems of poor strength of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and poor strength of carbon fiber in the production process of carbon fiber in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of oiling precursor fibers, drying and densifying, steam drafting, filament winding and primary pre-oxidation to obtain polyacrylonitrile primary pre-oxidized fibers; wherein the precursor fiber is subjected to 100-120 ℃ infrared drying before oiling treatment, and the treatment lasts for 5-20 seconds; the initial pre-oxidation temperature is not more than 250 ℃, the problem is better solved, the prepared pre-oxidized fiber has high strength and stable process, and the pre-oxidized fiber can be used in the industrial production of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber and carbon fiber.
assignee: 中国石油化工股份有限公司; 中国石油化工股份有限公司上海石油化工研究院
organization: CHINESE PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LTD COMPANY; SHANGHAI PETROCHEMICAL RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LIMITED COMPANY
inventors: LI LEI; SHEN ZHIGANG; XIAO SHIJIE; WANG HETUAN

title: Preparation method of low-defect polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with low structural defect. The method comprises the steps that protofilaments are unwound and then sequentially subjected to carbonization procedures such as a pre-oxidation furnace, a low-temperature carbonization furnace, a high-temperature carbonization furnace, surface treatment, washing, sizing, drying, winding and the like to obtain finished carbon fibers, and low-temperature carbonization waste gas is discharged out of a furnace chamber more instantly and efficiently in a low-temperature carbonization process by the low-temperature carbonization furnace of a high-efficiency coke discharge system, so that the damage of byproducts such as tar and the like to the fibers is reduced; meanwhile, the high-temperature carbonization furnace is provided with a tow dehumidification device, so that the damage of water vapor to fibers in the high-temperature carbonization process is reduced; and finally, combining with the refined allocation of drafting in each stage of the carbonization process, the preparation of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with low structural defects is realized.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司
organization: ZHONGSHENG EAGLE CARBON FIBER CO LTD
inventors: ZHANG GUOLIANG; CHEN QIUFEI; GUO PENGZONG; LIU GAOJUN; PEI HUAIZHOU

title: 35k large-tow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a 35k large tow carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: in the air atmosphere, 35K large tow polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber is placed in an oxidation furnace for pre-oxidation treatment to prepare 35K large tow carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber, the 35K large tow carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber is subjected to low-temperature carbonization treatment, the 35K large tow carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber subjected to low-temperature carbonization treatment is subjected to high-temperature carbonization treatment, the 35K large tow carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber subjected to high-temperature carbonization treatment is subjected to surface treatment, sizing, drying and other treatment to prepare 35K large tow polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, and a prepared 35K large tow polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber sample is placed in a detection reagent for dip curing and mechanical property testing. The 35k large-tow carbon fiber and the preparation method thereof can effectively solve the problems of large-tow pre-oxidation and pre-oxidized skin-core structure, improve the production efficiency of the carbon fiber composite material application and reduce the production cost.
assignee: 吉林宝旌炭材料有限公司
inventors: LI HONGLONG; ZHOU DONGFU; HU XIAOJIN

title: Preparation method of fireproof and heat-insulation multilayer composite type portable firefighter uniform
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a fireproof and heat-insulation multilayer combined type portable firefighter uniform, and particularly relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment. According to the invention, the outer layer fabric is prepared by modifying the high-molecular carbon fiber pre-oxidized filaments and the modified aramid fibers through a textile process; the interlayer is made into a heat insulation felt by processing pure modified carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber through a non-woven spunlace process; the inner layer is made into a close-fitting layer fabric by adopting a technology of adding PTFE filament base cloth and a PTFE film; the multifunctional novel fire-fighting rescue suit is produced by cutting, sewing and processing; in the preparation process, the polyacrylonitrile precursor can be effectively subjected to multiple pre-oxidation modification treatment by adopting ultrasonic, microwave heating modification and gamma ray irradiation modification, the modified polyacrylonitrile precursor can reach a proper pre-oxidation degree in a short time, and the uniformity of the radial structure of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber is improved, so that the modified carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber with higher thermal stability is obtained.
assignee: 盐城创能新屏蔽材料有限公司
organization: YUNNAN CITY ENERGY CREATING NEW SHIELDING MAT CO LTD
inventors: CHENG BINGYING; QIAN KUN; XU YANG; WU HUANLING; WANG TINGTING; XU GUOHUA

title: Device for preventing fire spreading after ignition of carbon fiber oxidation furnace
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production equipment, and particularly relates to a device for preventing fire spreading after a carbon fiber oxidation furnace catches fire, which comprises: a horizontal driving machine body and a fire retardant mechanism; wherein the horizontal driving machine body is provided with a guide roller for guiding carbon fibers; fire relief mechanism set up in on the horizontal drive organism, fire relief mechanism including install in the horizontal drive organism just centers on the white steel basin of deflector roll side, be fixed in the white steel board on white steel basin upper portion. The device for preventing the fire from spreading after the carbon fiber oxidation furnace is ignited has a simple structure and low cost, the water level in the tank is lifted by the instant gas expansion of the gas bag, so that water quickly passes through the guide roller, the flame spreads along the polyacrylonitrile precursor after the oxidation furnace is ignited, the flame is extinguished by water when the flame spreads to the water tank, the polyacrylonitrile precursor on the filament placing frame is prevented from being ignited completely, new water is continuously supplemented by the water supplementing pipe to reduce the temperature of the water, and the safety is improved.
assignee: 吉林宝旌炭材料有限公司
organization: JILIN BAOJING CARBON MAT CO LTD
inventors: HU MINGYANG; HU XIAOJIN; YAN XUEJUN; HAN YUNHENG; YAN PENGYU

title: Carbon fiber paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber paper, and provides carbon fiber paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fibers from the acrylonitrile-N-vinylformamide copolymer by a dry spraying wet method, and carrying out short-cut treatment to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based short-cut fiber precursor fibers; carrying out forward and reverse spunlace and drying winding on polyacrylonitrile-based chopped fiber protofilaments in sequence to obtain a polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt; pre-oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile-based non-woven felt to obtain a polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized felt; and (3) soaking the polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidation felt in a resin solution, and then sequentially drying, hot-pressing curing, carbonizing and graphitizing to obtain the carbon fiber paper. The invention also provides application of the carbon fiber paper. The preparation method can obviously improve the conductivity and the air permeability of the carbon fiber paper, expands the preparation process of the carbon paper for the gas diffusion layer of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell, and provides a new design idea for the practical industrial production of the carbon paper.
assignee: 东华大学
inventors: JU ANQI; NI XUEPENG

title: PAN-based carbon fiber for display bracket and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of PAN-based carbon fiber for a display bracket, which relates to the technical field of PAN-based carbon fiber and comprises the following steps; pretreating polyacrylonitrile powder, mixing the polyacrylonitrile powder with a comonomer, an RAFT reagent and a solvent, and mixing nano boron carbide in a mixed solution; then mixing the polyacrylonitrile solution and the phosphoric acid solution to obtain phosphorylated modified polyacrylonitrile precursor; the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber has the advantages that polyacrylonitrile powder is pretreated, the density of polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber is improved, the defects inside and outside the fiber are reduced, the polyacrylonitrile is modified through phosphoric acid, thermal degradation in the carbonization process is reduced, the carbon yield is improved, the defect of micropores inside the carbon fiber is reduced, and the mechanical property of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is improved.
assignee: 泰州市创新电子有限公司
inventors: XIA YONG; TANG ZHENGYONG; LI RISHENG; HAN QI; YANG ZONGYOU; LING JUE; HUANG YU

title: High-performance binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance binary polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of preparation of carbon fiber precursors and comprising the following steps: under the condition of nitrogen protection, dissolving acrylonitrile in N, N-dimethylformamide, adding an initiator azo iso-butylcyano formamide, reacting a second comonomer N-vinylpyridine amide in a continuous dropwise manner to obtain an acrylonitrile polymer, and then filtering, vacuum-demonomerizing and defoaming to obtain a spinning solution; and (3) carrying out dry-jet wet spinning, washing, drafting, heat setting and other processes on the spinning solution to obtain the carbon fiber precursor. According to the invention, N-vinylpyridine amide is used as a comonomer, and amide groups can increase the compactness of protofilaments; meanwhile, the amino in the amide can promote the cyclization reaction, reduce the pre-oxidation temperature and reduce the production cost; the pyridine group and the N atom in the initiator azo isobutyl cyano formamide are favorable for crosslinking reaction, promote the conversion of the pre-oxidized fiber ring-shaped aromatic structure to a two-dimensional aromatic condensed ring layer structure and improve the carbon yield.
assignee: 东华大学; 广东蒙泰高新纤维股份有限公司
organization: UNIV NATIONAL DONG HWA; GUANGDONG MODERN HIGH TECH FIBER CO LTD
inventors: JU ANQI; Dang Yanjin; GUO QINGHAI; JIANG JIANPING; GUO QIAOHE; GUO PINHUA

title: Method for joining polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a method for joining polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilaments, which comprises the following steps: knotting the tail end of the first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor tow and the head end of the second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor tow to form a fixed knot, and reserving a tow head on one side of the fixed knot; weaving the filament head of the first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilament tow into a second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilament tow positioned on the other side of the fixed knot to form a first weaving part; weaving the filament head of the second polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilament tow into the first polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilament tow positioned on the other side of the fixed knot to form a second weaving part; the first knitting silk part, the fixed knot and the second knitting silk part form a joint; an adhesive is applied to the joint. The invention is mainly used for ensuring that the joint has certain strength and can not accumulate heat or overheat, so that the joint can directly pass through the pre-oxidation furnace, the low-carbon furnace and the high-carbon furnace from the yarn withdrawing creel to the yarn collecting machine, the shutdown time is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.
assignee: 山西钢科碳材料有限公司
organization: SHANXI GANGKE CARBON MATERIAL CO LTD
inventors: WANG SISI; ZHANG RUITING; CHANG CHUNBAO; LIU NAXIN

title: Preparation method of high-conductivity and high-thermal-conductivity graphite fiber paper
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-conductivity and high-heat-conductivity graphite fiber paper, which comprises the following steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with superfine diameter mesophase asphalt-based graphite fibers with the average diameter of less than 5 microns and the diameter of 2-5 microns accounting for more than 50%, and preparing base paper by a wet papermaking process after mixing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with the superfine diameter mesophase asphalt-based graphite fibers according to the proportion of the superfine diameter mesophase asphalt-based graphite fibers with the diameter of = 5-80% to 20-95%; the raw paper is impregnated with thermosetting resin, and then is subjected to hot pressing and carbonization treatment to prepare the graphite fiber paper. The graphite fiber paper prepared by the invention has the following advantages: the conductive and heat-conducting performance is excellent, the air flux is large, the drainage is good, the flexibility and the strength are good, and the processing performance is excellent; and graphitization is not needed after paper forming, so that the preparation cost is reduced.
assignee: 易高环保能源科技(张家港)有限公司
organization: ECO ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY TECH ZHANGJIAGANG CO LTD
inventors: ZHAO HONGMEI; JIA YALONG; LI ZHENGQIU; LI ZHENGGUANG; LI YAMING; HE JIANRONG; ZHANG TIANLI

title: Pre-oxidation process of carbon fiber precursor and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber pre-oxidized fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preoxidation process of carbon fiber precursors and polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber preoxidized fibers, wherein the carbon fiber precursors are preoxidized in an oxidation furnace with oxygen content of 25-90%. According to the invention, the carbon fiber precursor is pre-oxidized in the oxidation furnace with the oxygen content of 25-90%, so that the running speed of the carbon fiber precursor is increased, the pre-oxidation time of the carbon fiber precursor is shortened, the pre-oxidation efficiency of the carbon fiber precursor is effectively increased on the premise that the density and the mechanical property of the pre-oxidized filament are kept unchanged or increased, and the production cost is reduced; in addition, the skin-core structure of the pre-oxidized fiber prepared by the pre-oxidation process is less, further, the amount of broken filaments on the surface of the carbon fiber prepared by the pre-oxidized fiber with less skin-core structure is greatly reduced, the internal and external properties are uniform, and the mechanical property is greatly improved.
assignee: 吉林碳谷碳纤维股份有限公司; 吉林化纤集团有限责任公司
organization: JILIN CARBON VALLEY CARBON FIBER CO LTD; JILIN CHEMICAL FIBER GROUP CO LTD
inventors: SONG DEWU; LU MING; ZHANG HAI'OU; LI KAI; JIANG YANBO; CHEN HAIJUN; ZHAO YUNFENG; QI WEI; SUN ZHENFENG; Ju Zhanhui; GUO JIADONG; WANG HUI; Mao Bingqi; CHEN HAO; WANG XIAOJIE

title: Pervious concrete containing porous hybrid fiber modified recycled aggregate and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses porous hybrid fiber modified recycled aggregate-containing pervious concrete which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: 1000-1200 parts of porous hybrid fiber modified recycled aggregate, 280-320 parts of cement, 90-100 parts of water, 300-320 parts of silica fume and 6.5-7 parts of water reducing agent; the preparation method of the porous hybrid fiber modified recycled aggregate comprises the following steps: dissolving polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate in N, N-dimethylformamide, heating and stirring until the solid is dissolved to prepare spinning solution, preparing fibers by adopting an electrostatic spinning process, and sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the fibers in a muffle furnace to prepare porous carbon fibers; mixing porous carbon fibers and graphene oxide dispersion liquid, carrying out ultrasonic treatment, adding recycled aggregate, carrying out stirring treatment, and then drying to obtain the graphene oxide/graphene composite material. The method provided by the invention is simple to operate, and the prepared concrete has good water permeability and good mechanical property.
assignee: 绍兴职业技术学院
inventors: TANG WEI; JIANG XIAOYAN; CAI LILI; HONG FENG

title: Preparation method of tin-loaded carbonaceous microsphere anchored carbon nanofiber electrode material and application of tin-loaded carbonaceous microsphere anchored carbon nanofiber electrode material in vanadium battery
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber electrode material anchored by tin-loaded carbonaceous microspheres and application of the carbon nanofiber electrode material in a vanadium battery. Firstly, preparing tin-loaded carbon microspheres loaded with a tin-based catalyst in situ by using a green and simple two-step hydrothermal synthesis method, then introducing the tin-loaded carbon microspheres into polyacrylonitrile-based electrospun nanofibers by using an electrostatic spinning technology, and finally obtaining the tin-loaded microsphere-carbon fiber yarn ternary structure electrode material which is loose and porous, and has high specific surface area, high catalytic activity and high mass transfer performance through subsequent pre-oxidation and carbonization processes. The material is used for the cathode electrode material of the vanadium battery, the synergistic effect among all the components is fully exerted, and the energy conversion efficiency of the vanadium battery can be further improved. The method is easy to operate, simple in preparation process, and can be applied to other technical fields by changing the size of the microspheres and the type of the supported catalyst, thereby having wide application prospect.
assignee: 辽宁大学
inventors: FANG DAWEI; LI XI; JING MINGHUA; QI XIAOCHEN; ZHANG ANG; LIU ZHULING

title: Spinneret plate for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The utility model provides a spinneret plate for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which is provided with a spinneret plate body, wherein a circular groove is formed in the middle of the spinneret plate body, spinneret holes are uniformly distributed in the circular groove and comprise an outlet part, a neck part and a flow guide part, the upper part of the flow guide part is a cylindrical hole, the lower part of the flow guide part is a conical hole, the outlet part is connected with the flow guide part through the neck part, and the outlet part is provided with an outlet groove. The method solves the technical problems that the surface of the protofilament produced by a circular spinneret hole of the existing high-quality polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber protofilament is smooth, but the kiss-coating is low, and when the cohesion force is not enough to cause carbonization, the processes are required to be added to improve the kiss-coating and cohesion force of the filament, and the application field is influenced. The utility model can be widely applied to the production of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor.
assignee: 荣成碳纤维科技有限公司

title: Head lifting tool for polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor penetrating into oxidation furnace
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers, and discloses a head lifting tool for polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor to penetrate into an oxidation furnace, which comprises a nylon cloth body, wherein the right side of the nylon cloth body is uniformly provided with a wire connecting harness, the right side of each wire connecting harness is provided with a clamping rod, the outer wall of each clamping rod is provided with a limiting ring, the top surface of the left end of the nylon cloth body is provided with a wire penetrating rod, a clamping plate is arranged below the wire penetrating rod, the clamping plate is positioned below the nylon cloth body, and a nylon belt is movably sleeved on the central outer wall of the wire penetrating rod.

title: Device for preventing fire spreading after ignition of carbon fiber oxidation furnace
abstract: The utility model particularly relates to a device for preventing the intensity of a fire from stretching after carbon fiber oxidation furnace catches fire, include: a horizontal driving machine body and a fire retardant mechanism; wherein the horizontal driving machine body is provided with a guide roller for guiding carbon fibers; fire relief mechanism set up in on the horizontal drive organism, fire relief mechanism including install in the horizontal drive organism just centers on the white steel basin of deflector roll side, be fixed in the white steel board on white steel basin upper portion. The utility model discloses a prevent device that carbon fiber oxidation furnace fires back intensity of a fire and stretchs, simple structure, it is with low costs, through gasbag gas that rises in the twinkling of an eye, promote the water level in the pond, make water pass through the deflector roll fast, flame stretchs along polyacrylonitrile precursor after the oxidation furnace takes place to fire, flame is gone out by the water logging when stretching the basin, prevents to put the whole ignition of polyacrylonitrile precursor on the silk shelf to by the continuous temperature that the water supply of mending of moisturizing pipe reduces water, improve the security.

title: Manufacture of intermediate modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity, as well as a process for the manufacture of such carbon fiber. The process comprises spinning a polymer/solvent solution into a solvent/water bath in the range of 78%-85% solvent, thereby producing a dense fiber structure, and subsequently carbonizing the polymer precursor fiber at a lower than typical carbonization temperature to form carbon fibers.
assignee: Cytec Industries Inc.
inventors: COOK, JOHN DESMOND; TAYLOR, THOMAS; DESHPANDE, GIRISH VISHNUKANT; TANG, LONGGUI; MEECE, BARRY DEWAYNE; CRAWFORD, Suzanne; CHIU, SHAO C.; HARMON, BILLY D.; THOMAS, ALAN

title: Hydrogen evolution material of nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber and preparation method therefor
abstract: A hydrogen evolution material of a nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber. Polyacrylonitrile reacts with ethanolamine to obtain oxazoline polyacrylonitrile and then reacts with diphenylphosphinic acid to obtain phosphorus-containing polyacrylonitrile, and spinning, activation, pre-oxidation, and carbonization are performed to obtain a hydrogen evolution material of a nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber. The porous hollow carbon fiber has an ultrahigh specific surface area that facilitates the exposure of multiple catalytic active sites, nitrogen doping improves the electrical conductivity of the porous hollow carbon fiber, the radius of P atoms is large, and after doping, rich mesoporous structures are introduced, the specific surface area is further increased, and the release of surface electrons is accelerated, such that the electrical conductivity of the porous hollow carbon fiber is further improved; moreover, P doping improves the content of graphitic nitrogen and pyridine nitrogen in the porous hollow carbon fiber, such that the nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber has excellent hydrogen evolution performance.
assignee: 广州睿喑科技有限公司
inventors: QIU, Shibao

title: Pre-oxidation accelerator for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors and use method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor preoxidation accelerant and a use method thereof, the accelerant is one or more of dicumyl peroxide, cumene hydroperoxide, tert-butyl hydroperoxide, di-tert-butyl peroxide and other peroxides with half-life period of 1-60 minutes at 200 ℃, and the polyacrylonitrile precursor preoxidation temperature is reduced by more than 10 ℃ and the preoxidation time is reduced by more than 16.7 percent by adding the accelerant into or soaking the accelerant in any one or more of the processes of preparation of polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, spinning of precursor and preoxidation treatment, so that the energy consumption in the process of preparing carbon fibers is effectively reduced, the production efficiency is improved, and the accelerant has the advantages of simple operation process, low cost, less investment, compatibility with the existing carbon fiber production equipment and the like.
assignee: 北京化工大学; 威海拓展纤维有限公司

title: Preparation method of high-strength coal-based isotropic pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a production method of high-strength isotropic pitch-based carbon fibers, which comprises the following steps: taking ashless coal as a pitch precursor, removing volatile components by adopting a thin-layer evaporation method, controlling the softening point of pitch to be 180-260 ℃ to obtain spinning pitch, and then preparing carbon fibers by melt spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization processes; mixing coal and 1-methylnaphthalene according to a mass ratio of 1: 2-1: 10, carrying out solvent extraction reaction at a temperature of 350-410 ℃ and a pressure of 1-5 MPa for 1-5 h, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation, hot-pressing filtration and solvent recovery to obtain the ashless coal. Finally, the carbon fiber is prepared by the processes of melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and the like. The invention takes coal as raw material to produce general-purpose pitch-based carbon fiber with excellent performance index, the tensile strength of the general-purpose pitch-based carbon fiber is up to 1500MPa, and the general-purpose pitch-based carbon fiber has great market prospect and economic benefit.
assignee: 湖南大学

title: Composite material based on melt siliconizing process, carbon/carbon porous body and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a composite material based on a melt siliconizing process, a carbon/carbon porous body and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of manufacturing of thermostructural composite materials. The method for preparing the carbon/carbon porous body comprises the following steps: preparing carbon cloth into a carbon fiber reinforcement by adopting a lamination sewing process; pretreating the obtained carbon fiber reinforcement; forming a pyrolytic carbon layer on the fiber surface of the pretreated carbon fiber reinforcement by a chemical vapor deposition method to obtain a pyrolytic carbon-based carbon/carbon porous body; adding a pore-forming agent and a curing agent into the phenolic resin, and stirring and mixing to obtain pore-forming resin; and immersing the pyrolytic carbon-based carbon/carbon porous body into the pore-forming resin, and carrying out curing, carbonization and graphitization treatment together with the pore-forming resin to remove resin carbon formed by the pore-forming resin on the surface, thereby obtaining the carbon/carbon porous body suitable for the melt siliconizing process. The tensile strength of the material prepared by the carbon/carbon porous body after the melting siliconizing is more than or equal to 300MPa, the bending strength is more than or equal to 300MPa, and the weight loss rate of the material after the static oxidation at 1500 ℃ for 20min is less than 1.5 percent.
assignee: 航天材料及工艺研究所; 中国运载火箭技术研究院

title: Preparation method of lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a lithium-sulfur battery anode material. The method comprises the steps of using N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF) as a solvent, dissolving in-situ Polyacrylonitrile (PAN)/Graphene Oxide (GO) in a certain proportion in the DMF to prepare a spinning precursor solution, using an electrostatic spinning process to prepare a continuous nanofiber membrane, carrying out carbonization treatment on electrostatic spinning PAN/GO fibers to prepare an in-situ nitrogen-doped carbon fiber/reduced graphene oxide composite material, and finally carrying out a sulfur doping process to prepare a nitrogen-doped carbon fiber/reduced graphene oxide/sulfur composite positive electrode material.
assignee: 河北工业大学; 河源广工大协同创新研究院

title: Composite reinforced material with interpenetrating network structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of composite materials, and discloses a composite reinforced material with an interpenetrating network structure and a preparation method thereof. Dissolving polyacrylonitrile in an organic solvent, adding a metal-based material, stirring and mixing uniformly to obtain a cortex solution; dissolving a water-soluble high polymer material in deionized water, adding a ceramic-based material, and uniformly stirring and mixing to obtain a core layer solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning on the skin layer solution and the core layer solution to obtain a composite fiber material with a skin-core structure; and finally, carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment in an inert atmosphere to obtain the composite reinforced material with the interpenetrating network structure. According to the invention, the carbon fiber is formed by subsequent high-temperature treatment after the water-soluble high polymer material is formed, and forms an interpenetrating network structure with the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, so that the infiltration of a metal-based material and a ceramic-based material is facilitated, and the mechanical property of the composite reinforced material is greatly improved.
assignee: 华南理工大学

title: Preparation method of high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers, which is characterized in that a constant potential electrolysis method is used for preparing phosphorus-doped carbene quantum dots, the anode of an electrolysis system is a graphite rod, the cathode is a Pt electrode, the electrolysis system is filtered by a microporous filtering membrane to obtain filtrate, and deionized water is used for washing, drying and vacuum drying to obtain the solid of the phosphorus-doped carbene quantum dots. Modifying the intermediate phase asphalt by using phosphorus-doped carbene quantum dots, dispersing the configured concentration of the phosphorus-doped carbene quantum dots by using toluene, stirring the intermediate phase asphalt and the intermediate phase asphalt in a mixed inert atmosphere at the temperature of 280-350 ℃, and then spinning. And (3) carrying out preoxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization treatment and continuous graphitization treatment after spinning to obtain the mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber. The prepared carbon fiber has the modulus of 800-960GPa, the thermal conductivity of 600-900W/m.K, a typical radial structure at the fiber interface, no splitting and good process performance, and is a good carbon roller reinforcing material.
assignee: 湖南东映碳材料科技有限公司

title: Manufacturing method of flexible conductive carbon cloth
abstract: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of flexible conductive carbon cloth, and belongs to the technical field of functional carbon fiber preparation. The flexible conductive carbon cloth is prepared by pre-oxidizing Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) base or viscose base precursor to obtain pre-oxidized fibers, then chopping or breaking the pre-oxidized fibers into short fibers, spinning and weaving, and performing high-temperature carbonization through special procedures. According to the invention, the process parameters are optimized, so that the prepared flexible conductive carbon cloth is suitable for different use environments, can be widely applied to the fields of military affairs, medical care, environmental protection, automobiles and the like, is economical in cost, environment-friendly in process and beneficial to industrial popularization.
assignee: 潘魏豪

title: Hollow carbon fiber composite material filled with nano particles, preparation method and application
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a hollow carbon fiber composite material filled with nano particles, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, a coaxial electrostatic spinning method is utilized, a polyacrylonitrile solution with high carbon forming rate is used as a shell solution, a polymer solution with low carbon yield is used as a core solution, and nano particles are dispersed in the core solution; after coaxial electrostatic spinning, forming composite fiber with a core-shell structure; and carrying out subsequent oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain the hollow carbon fiber filled with the nano particles. The method is simple, environment-friendly and high in operability, and the hollow carbon fiber composite material is formed, can be used as a sulfur anode carrier in a lithium-sulfur battery, and shows high capacity and long cycle stability.
assignee: 深圳石墨烯创新中心有限公司

title: Large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with surface groove structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with a surface groove structure and a preparation method thereof. The fiber has a surface groove structure, the average diameter is 8.5-11 μm, the strength is 4.9-6.0 GPa, and the modulus is 270-310 GPa. Preparing precursor by adopting a wet spinning technology, controlling the skin-core ratio of pre-oxidized fibers to be more than or equal to 0.85 by regulating the pre-oxidation time ratio of each temperature zone in the pre-oxidation stage, and preparing the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers with the surface groove structures through low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization. The prepared large-diameter high-strength medium-mode carbon fiber with the surface groove structure not only improves the collimation of the fiber, but also improves the wettability of resin in the preparation of the composite material, and finally improves the mechanical properties such as compression strength and the like in the application of the composite material.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material has a basic unit of a core-shell structure, a core is a carbon material, a shell is a polyacrylonitrile layer, and the polyacrylonitrile layer is a single layer or multiple layers; the carbon material is a carbon material having a graphite lattice structure. The polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene oxide composite material realizes the tight coating of the graphene by the polymer while realizing the uniform introduction of the graphene into a spinning system, isolates the interaction between the graphene, reduces the accumulation tendency, greatly shortens the time required by the uniform mixing of the graphene and the polyacrylonitrile, and improves the production efficiency. Moreover, the introduced graphene can play the role of a nucleating agent and a template agent in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, so that a more complete graphite lattice structure of the carbon fiber is obtained, and various performances of the carbon fiber are improved.
assignee: 山东大学

title: Preparation method of mesophase pitch and high-modulus pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of high-grade novel carbon materials, and provides a preparation method of mesophase pitch and high-modulus pitch-based carbon fibers. The method comprises the steps of treating heavy oil by liquid-solid adsorption chromatography (LSAC) and Gel Permeation Chromatography (GPC) to obtain modified raw materials with proper molecular weight and polarity, and then performing thermal polycondensation on the modified raw materials at the reaction temperature of 360-480 ℃, the reaction pressure of 0-10MPa and the reaction time of 1-15h to prepare high-quality mesophase pitch; and (3) carrying out melt spinning on the mesophase pitch, and carrying out pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-modulus pitch-based carbon fiber. The method has the advantages of strong raw material compatibility, excellent quality of the obtained mesophase pitch, 170-350 ℃ softening point and wide-area streamline optical anisotropic structure, good spinnability and suitability for preparing high-modulus mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers, and the content of the mesophase is more than or equal to 97%.
assignee: 中国石油大学(华东)

title: Copper-based powder metallurgy friction material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a copper-based powder metallurgy friction material, which comprises the following steps: s1, taking polyacrylonitrile and lignin as carbon sources, compounding the carbon sources with a solvent, carrying out electrostatic spinning treatment, collecting spinning fibers, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, collecting pre-oxidized fibers, and carrying out carbonization treatment to obtain composite carbon fibers; s2, taking foamy copper as a matrix, taking molybdenum trioxide and sulfur powder as modified materials to perform modification treatment, and collecting the modified foamy copper material; s3, mixing the composite carbon fibers and the modified foamy copper material, and collecting composite matrix particles; and S4, taking the composite matrix particles, carbonyl iron powder, silicon oxide, chromium powder, aluminum oxide and graphite particles, performing powder metallurgy, and firing and forming to obtain the copper-based powder metallurgy friction material. The powder metallurgy friction material prepared by the method has excellent bonding performance and mechanical property, and can effectively meet the long-acting use requirement of the existing powder metallurgy friction material.
assignee: 山东科邦威尔复合材料有限公司

title: P, N doped porous carbon fiber-TiO2Preparation method of lithium ion battery cathode material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses P, N doped porous carbon fiber-TiO 2 According to the lithium ion battery negative electrode material, phenyl dichlorophosphate is subjected to substitution reaction to obtain acrylic acid hydroxypropyl phosphate derivatives, the acrylic acid hydroxypropyl phosphate derivatives are copolymerized with acrylonitrile to obtain nitrogen-phosphorus-containing polyacrylonitrile copolymers, and P, N doped porous carbon fiber-coated flower-shaped nano titanium dioxide is obtained through electrostatic spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization, so that the reversible specific capacity, the rate capability and the conductivity are improved, the volume expansion of the titanium dioxide is inhibited, and the flower-shaped nano titanium dioxide has ultrahigh contentThe specific surface area is increased, the contact area with electrolyte is increased, the diffusion of lithium ions is accelerated, the N atom has a pair of lone pair electrons and is used as an electron donor to enhance the conductivity of the porous carbon fiber, the radius of the P atom is large to cause structural defects, and the specific surface area is increased, so that the lithium ion battery cathode material has excellent conductivity, specific capacity, rate capability and cycling stability.

organization: TONGXIANG RONGHANG TECH PARTNERSHIP ENTERPRISE LIMITED PARTNERSHIP
