title: P, N doped porous carbon fiber-TiO2Preparation method of lithium ion battery cathode material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses P, N doped porous carbon fiber-TiO 2 According to the lithium ion battery negative electrode material, phenyl dichlorophosphate is subjected to substitution reaction to obtain an acrylic acid hydroxypropyl phosphate derivative, the acrylic acid hydroxypropyl phosphate derivative is copolymerized with acrylonitrile to obtain a nitrogen-phosphorus-containing polyacrylonitrile copolymer, P, N doped porous carbon fiber coated flower-shaped nano titanium dioxide is obtained through electrostatic spinning, pre-oxidation and carbonization, the reversible specific capacity, the rate capability and the conductivity are improved, the volume expansion of the titanium dioxide is inhibited, the flower-shaped nano titanium dioxide has an ultrahigh specific surface area, the contact area with an electrolyte is increased, the diffusion of lithium ions is accelerated, an N atom has a pair of lone pair electrons and serves as an electron donor to enhance the conductivity of porous carbon fibers, the P atom has a large radius, the structural defect is caused, and the specific surface area is increased, so that the lithium ion battery negative electrode material has excellent conductivity, specific capacity, rate capability and cycling stability.
assignee: 上海彤程电子材料有限公司; 彤程新材料集团股份有限公司

title: Hydrogen evolution material of nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water, and discloses a hydrogen evolution material of nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber, wherein polyacrylonitrile reacts with ethanolamine to obtain oxazoline polyacrylonitrile, and then reacts with diphenyl phosphoric acid to obtain phosphorus-containing polyacrylonitrile, and the hydrogen evolution material of the nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber is obtained through spinning, activation, pre-oxidation and carbonization, the porous hollow carbon fiber has ultrahigh specific surface area, is favorable for exposing more catalytic active sites, the nitrogen doping improves the conductivity of the porous hollow carbon fiber, the P atomic radius is larger, rich mesoporous structures are introduced after doping, the specific surface area is further increased, and the surface electron escape is accelerated, therefore, the conductivity of the porous hollow carbon fiber is further enhanced, and the content of graphite nitrogen and pyridine nitrogen in the porous hollow carbon fiber is improved by P doping, so that the nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous hollow carbon fiber has excellent hydrogen evolution performance.
assignee: 广州睿喑科技有限公司
inventors: Qiu Shibao

title: ZnS-FeCo2S4Porous carbon fiber flexible supercapacitor electrode material and preparation thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of super capacitors, and particularly relates to ZnS-FeCo 2 S 4 A porous carbon fiber flexible supercapacitor electrode material and a preparation method thereof are provided, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding polymethyl methacrylate into a dimethylacetamide solution of polyacrylonitrile as a raw material to form pores, preparing a fiber membrane by using an electrostatic spinning device, and preparing porous carbon nanofibers by pre-oxidation and carbonization; then using Fe (NO) 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 O, Urea and Co (NO) 3 ) 2 ·6H 2 FeCo grown on the surface of carbon fiber by substances such as O and the like 2 S 4 (ii) a The sample was then dipped in zinc sulfate and Na 2 S·9H 2 Preparation of ZnS-FeCo in O solution 2 S 4 Porous carbon fiber electrode material. The ZnS-FeCo of the invention 2 S 4 The porous carbon fiber flexible supercapacitor electrode material effectively improves the specific capacitance and increases the energy density of the capacitor.
assignee: 郭绍香
inventors: GUO SHAOXIANG; MA GUANGWEI

title: Rapid preoxidation method for polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid pre-oxidation method of polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: soaking polyacrylonitrile protofilament in 1-5 wt% ammonium dihydrogen phosphate solution at room temperature for 10-60min to obtain modified polyacrylonitrile protofilament; drying the modified polyacrylonitrile precursor for 10-30 min; in a flowing air atmosphere, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment on the modified polyacrylonitrile precursor, wherein the temperature rise rate of the pre-oxidation process is controlled to be 2-5 ℃/min, and when the temperature rises to 180-240 ℃, preserving the heat for 10-30 min; and naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber. The rapid preoxidation method of the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor provided by the invention realizes rapid preoxidation of the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor, shortens the preparation time of the carbon fiber and reduces the production cost of the carbon fiber; and the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber obtained by pre-oxidation treatment has high cyclization degree and aromatic index, the pre-oxidized fiber is uniform and compact, and the surface defect and the crack are less.
assignee: 中南大学
inventors: SU ZHE'AN; ZHI HUAN; HUANG QIZHONG

title: Method for treating waste gas generated by oxidation and carbonization in polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber production
abstract: The invention discloses a method for treating waste gas generated by oxidation and carbonization in polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber production, wherein the waste gas from a low-temperature and high-temperature carbonization furnace passes through a cooling separation tower, tar is gradually separated out and the waste is removed to form finished tar; comprehensively recycling heat energy; the waste gas and the waste gas from which the tar is removed enter an acid liquor spraying absorption tower to be deaminated; the waste gas after deamination enters a spray tower to absorb hydrocyanic acid, and alkali liquor or weak acid salt reacts with the hydrocyanic acid to generate cyanide; waste gas generated by the oxidation furnace is subjected to heat exchange, tar is gradually separated and is merged into tar separated by the carbonization furnace for treatment; waste gas enters an acid liquor spray tower for deamination, then enters a second spray absorption tower for recovering hydrocyanic acid, and the hydrocyanic acid can be absorbed by cold water and distilled for recycling; the waste gas after the treatment reaches the standard and is discharged; the invention reduces carbon emission, and the substance recycling generates good economic benefit; the engineering heat balance base number is reduced, and comprehensive energy conservation is realized.
assignee: 郝小生
inventors: HAO XIAOSHENG; CHENG RUNXIANG; LIANG YUN

title: PAN-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a PAN-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of protofilament preparation, pre-oxidation, carbonization treatment and the like. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the polyacrylonitrile is modified by using the phosphoric acid, so that the heat resistance of the PAN-based carbon fiber can be effectively improved, and the thermal degradation in the carbonization process is reduced, thereby improving the carbon yield; the PAN-based carbon fiber prepared by the preparation method has the advantages of higher carbon yield, less internal micropore defects and better mechanical property.
assignee: 金发科技股份有限公司
inventors: YANG ZHIJUN; HUANG XIANBO; YE NANBIAO; CHANG HUAN; HUANG YOUPING; MA LEI; XIN WEI

title: N, P double-doped carbon fiber loaded CoP composite catalytic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides an N, P double-doped carbon fiber loaded CoP composite catalytic material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of aluminum-air batteries. Mixing the ZIF-67 organic solution and the polyacrylonitrile organic solution to obtain a spinning precursor solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning precursor solution to obtain a flexible film; pre-oxidizing the flexible film to obtain a pre-oxidized product; and mixing the pre-oxidation product with red phosphorus, and pyrolyzing in a protective atmosphere to obtain the CoP @ G/NP-PCNFs composite material. In the invention, the ZIF-67 particles have a domain-limited dispersion effect on Co at an atomic level, are combined with electrostatic spinning, and are carbonized and phosphated in a pyrolysis process to form carbon fibers with high conductivity, and carbon spheres derived from the ZIF-67 particles wrap CoP particles to promote ORR reaction to react in a 4-electron path, so that the battery efficiency is improved.

title: PEM fuel cell, carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a PEM fuel cell, a carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of new energy and new materials, and solves the problems of poor conductivity, complex structure and high cost of the existing composite bipolar plate. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing a unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film by using polyacrylonitrile carbon fibers and polyvinyl butyral; step 2, extracting and grading the coal tar pitch by using a toluene-benzyl alcohol mixed solvent, and performing high-temperature telomerization polymerization on the extracted polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon mixture in the presence of elemental iodine to obtain a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon polycondensate; step 3, arranging the unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film in an oriented manner and carrying out hot-press molding on the unidirectional PAN carbon fiber prefabricated film and the condensed-ring aromatic condensation polymer; and 4, carrying out high-temperature carbonization treatment on the carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate precursor obtained by hot press molding to obtain the carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate. The carbon-carbon composite bipolar plate has the advantages of high strength, high electric and heat conducting performance, good chemical stability and air tightness and low preparation cost.
assignee: 中国科学院化学研究所
inventors: LI FENGBO; YUAN GUOQING; SONG YANLIN

title: High-performance lithium ion battery polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber negative electrode material of a high-performance lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps: dissolving polyacrylonitrile in a DMF solvent, and fully stirring to obtain a spinning solution; spinning the spinning solution to obtain stable nano-fiber yarns, and continuously spinning to obtain polyacrylonitrile protofilaments; placing polyacrylonitrile precursor in a porcelain boat, heating in a tube furnace in an oxygen atmosphere for pre-oxidation, and cooling to room temperature to obtain pre-oxidized fiber; carbonizing the pre-oxidized fiber in a tubular furnace in the atmosphere of nitrogen, and naturally cooling the pre-oxidized fiber to room temperature to obtain polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber; and (3) fully grinding the carbonized polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber in an agate mortar, and drying to obtain the superfine electrostatic spinning polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber material. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber negative electrode material for the lithium ion battery has the characteristics of high performance, high capacity, high cycling stability, high charging specific capacity and long cycle life.
assignee: 江西理工大学
inventors: Rao Xianfa; ZHONG SHENGWEN; CHEN JUN; LOU YITAO; LI BAOBAO; QIU YUPING; WU TINGTING; ZHONG XIAOHUI; CHENG BIN

title: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst, belonging to the technical field of electrocatalysis. The preparation method of the nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst comprises the following steps: s1, firstly, dissolving polyacrylonitrile in an organic solution, and then sequentially dissolving diisopropyl azodicarboxylate, cobalt acetate tetrahydrate and ferric acetylacetonate in the organic solution dissolved with polyacrylonitrile to obtain a precursor solution; s2, performing electrostatic spinning on the precursor solution to obtain a spinning precursor; and S3, sequentially carrying out curing treatment and carbonization treatment on the spinning precursor to obtain the nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon fiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst. The carbon nanofiber-based non-noble metal electrocatalyst has a positive half-wave potential for oxygen reduction reaction and a small overpotential for oxygen evolution reaction.
assignee: 宁波工程学院
inventors: HOU HUILIN; YU HAO; YANG WEIYOU

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based fiber, a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber comprises the following steps: performing first oiling treatment on the fiber to be oiled to obtain the fiber subjected to the first oiling treatment; and (3) carrying out drying densification treatment, steam drafting treatment, relaxation heat setting treatment and rolling on the fiber subjected to the first oiling to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based fiber. Before the step of relaxation heat setting treatment, performing secondary oiling treatment on the fiber subjected to steam drafting treatment; the oil agent used in the first oiling treatment and the second oiling treatment is different. The polyacrylonitrile-based fiber is subjected to pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The invention is mainly used for preparing high-strength medium-mode polyacrylonitrile-based fibers and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers with excellent performance.

title: Preparation method of high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane, which comprises the following steps: the coke powder is treated by the mixed acid solution of concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated nitric acid in a reflux way, and is washed and dried to obtain coke oxide powder, and the high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane is prepared by electrostatic spinning, preoxidation and carbonization by taking the coke oxide powder as a raw material and PVB and/or PVP as a spinning aid and a pore-forming agent. The carbon nanofiber membrane prepared by the method has the characteristics of high flexibility, integral type, adjustable specific surface area, high conductivity and the like. The invention uses cheap and easily obtained coke as a carbon source to produce the flexible carbon nanofiber membrane, thereby realizing high-value utilization of the coke. Compared with the method for preparing the carbon nanofiber membrane by polyacrylonitrile electrostatic spinning, the method has the advantages of cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, good product flexibility, high specific surface area and the like. The high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the fields of electrochemical energy storage, adsorption separation, catalysis and the like.
assignee: 大连理工大学
inventors: LI WENCUI; CHEN JING; LU ANHUI

title: Extreme-high-temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an extremely high temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: high-thermal-conductivity carbon fibers and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers are mixed and woven into a high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preform, or high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preforms are woven by using high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber rods; preparing a carbon interface layer on the fiber surface of the high-thermal-conductivity carbon fiber preform by sequentially adopting a chemical vapor deposition method and a high-temperature graphitization treatment method to obtain a thermal-dredging composite material preform; sequentially taking a polycarbosilane ceramic precursor and a hafnium-tantalum ceramic precursor as impregnation liquid to enable the heat dredging composite material preform to be subjected to PIP (poly-p-phenylene-bisphenol-co-polyamide) process to prepare the heat dredging ultrahigh-temperature ceramic-based composite material; and preparing an anti-ablation ceramic coating on the surface of the thermal dredging ultrahigh-temperature ceramic-based composite material to prepare the extremely-high-temperature anti-ablation thermal dredging composite material. The extremely-high-temperature ablation-resistant thermal dredging composite material prepared by the invention has the characteristics of high thermal conductivity, high density, excellent mechanical property, excellent high-temperature ablation-resistant property and the like.

title: Acrylic fiber and preparation method thereof, and preparation method of carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to acrylic fibers, a preparation method thereof and a preparation method of carbon fibers, wherein the acrylic fibers are copolymerized with a second monomer and/or a third monomer and have the following structural formula: wherein X and Y are compounds containing one group of carboxyl, amido, amino, hydroxyl, sulfonic acid group, ester group or halogen and corresponding salts thereofX and Y are the same or different, and the mole percentage of m is 85-99.5%; the mol percentage of n is 0.5 to 15 percent; the mol percentage of p is 0-14.5%. The preparation of the acrylic fiber comprises the following steps: and (3) performing solidification molding, water washing, oiling, drying and post-drawing treatment on the stock solution to obtain the acrylic fibers. When the carbon fiber is prepared, the acrylic fiber is subjected to roller feeding, pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment to obtain the carbon fiber. Compared with polyacrylonitrile protofilament, the invention has lower cost and higher cost performance; compared with commercial acrylic fiber, the cost for producing the carbon fiber is equivalent, but the manufacturability is stronger, and the mechanical property performance is better, so the application field is wider, and the competitiveness is promoted.
assignee: 远景能源有限公司
inventors: Wu hansen; SUN JIANXU; MA HAO; ZHANG XIANGYANG; LIANG YUAN

title: Manganese dioxide/carbon film composite material with core-shell structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a manganese dioxide/carbon film composite material with a core-shell structure, which is characterized in that a polyacrylonitrile film is prepared through electrostatic spinning, the polyacrylonitrile carbon film is prepared through high-temperature carbonization, and rapid-growth MnO is obtained through quenching treatment in potassium permanganate solution 2 Nanosheets to obtain a core-shell structure; the shell-core structure takes carbon fiber as a core, MnO 2 The nanosheet array is a shell. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing a polyacrylonitrile membrane; 2) preparing a polyacrylonitrile carbon film; 3) and (3) preparing the birnessite/carbon film composite material with high potassium content. AsThe super capacitor electrode material is applied to charge and discharge in the range of 0-1.3V and has the current density of 4 mA cm –2 When the specific capacity reaches 700- –2 . The present invention uses KMnO 4 As a precursor solution, the KMnO can be captured in situ through quenching treatment 4 The potassium ions in the solution omit the pre-embedding process of the potassium ions, so that the specific capacitance of the material is greatly improved; is beneficial to industrial large-scale production and preparation and realizes the development of flexible devices.

title: Waste gas treatment device in polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production
abstract: The utility model discloses a waste gas treatment device in polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber production, which comprises an air inlet chamber, an incinerator, a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, an induced draft fan, a spray tower and a chimney which are sequentially communicated through pipelines; the first heat exchanger is also communicated with an oxidation furnace and an air inlet chamber through pipelines, an inlet of the first heat exchanger from materials of the oxidation furnace is communicated with a material outlet of the oxidation furnace, an outlet of the first heat exchanger from materials of the oxidation furnace is communicated with an air inlet of the air inlet chamber, and the air inlet of the air inlet chamber is also respectively connected to air outlets of the high-temperature carbonization furnace and the low-temperature carbonization furnace; the second heat exchanger is also communicated with a fresh air fan through a fresh air inlet and is communicated to the oxidation furnace through a fresh air outlet. The utility model relates to a rationally, compact structure, make full use of heat energy has effectively improved exhaust-gas treatment efficiency, and the treatment effect is good.
assignee: 李月香
inventors: LI YUEXIANG

title: Carbon fiber manufacturing method and carbon fiber using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a carbon fiber capable of providing only a small amount of a smoothing agent composed of a specific component to a surface of the carbon fiber before the carbon fiber is wound by using a carbon fiber precursor fiber manufactured by a polymer with a narrow distribution of molecular weight. The present invention stably produces the carbon fiber with excellent dispersibility, and dignity and quality which not deteriorated in a state of not attaching a sizing agent to the surface of the carbon fiber. The manufactured carbon fiber is suitable for a high-temperature processing composite material using thermoplastic resin. The method for manufacturing a carbon fiber comprises a flame-resistant process for a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber, a preliminary carbonization process, and a carbonization process.
assignee: 효성첨단소재 주식회사
inventors: JUNG HEE ROK; KIM CHEOL

title: Preparation methods for mesophase pitch and high modulus pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of the preparation of advanced novel carbon materials. Provided are preparation methods for mesophase pitch and a high modulus pitch-based carbon fiber. The present methods comprise: treating heavy oil by means of liquid-solid adsorption chromatography (LSAC) and gel permeation chromatography (GPC) to obtain a modified raw material having a proper molecular weight and polarity; then performing thermal polycondensation on the modified raw material for 1-15 hours at the reaction temperature of 360-480°С and under the reaction pressure of 0-10 MPa to prepare high-quality mesophase pitch; and performing melt spinning on the mesophase pitch, and performing pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high modulus pitch-based carbon fiber. The methods of the present invention are strong in raw material compatibility; the obtained mesophase pitch is excellent in quality, the mesophase content of the mesophase pitch is greater than or equal to 97%, and the softening point of the mesophase pitch is 170-350°С; the mesophase pitch has a large-area wide-area streamline optically anisotropic structure, and is good in spinnability and suitable for preparing a high modulus mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber.
assignee: 中国石油大学(华东)
inventors: LIU, DONG; LOU, BIN; YU, RAN; GONG, Xin; DU, HUI

title: Rapid preoxidation process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid pre-oxidation process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors. The process comprises the step of enabling polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor to be at a higher initial temperature of 240-260 DEG CControlling the total time of pre-oxidation to be 33-40 min by a temperature rise gradient of 10-15 ℃, raising the temperature to 270-290 ℃, and controlling hot air to be 7000-12000 m in the pre-oxidation process 3 The circulation volume/h is blown down perpendicular to the running direction of the tow. The method adopts hot air circulation treatment, greatly shortens the pre-oxidation time, shortens the traditional pre-oxidation time of more than 60min to within 40min, and effectively reduces the energy consumption. The method realizes low-cost high-yield rapid pre-oxidation under the condition of ensuring the quality of the carbon fiber, reduces the industrial production cost, and has wide application value in the field of carbon fiber production.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维有限责任公司

title: Preparation method of low-ash polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-ash polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. In the preparation process of the polyacrylonitrile protofilament, the oiling treatment is carried out by adopting a high heat resistance silicone-oil-free agent. The high-heat-resistance silicone-oil-free agent is prepared from a macromolecular saturated linear monoester with a carbon atom number of more than or equal to 15, a hindered phenol antioxidant and a surfactant according to the weight ratio of (90-100): (10-15): (23-30). All the components are mixed, stirred and dispersed uniformly to obtain the high heat resistance silicone oil-free agent. According to the invention, the high-heat-resistance silicone-oil-free agent is adopted for oiling treatment in the production process of the carbon fiber precursor, the oil content of the precursor is reasonably controlled through the heated volatilization rate of the oil agent in the subsequent carbonization working section, and instantaneous waste discharge is realized in the carbonization working section, so that the ash content in the fiber and on the surface of the fiber is effectively controlled, and the ash content of the carbon fiber can be controlled below 25 ppm. The method is suitable for spinning by a wet method or a dry-jet wet method, and is suitable for different K-bundle carbon fibers.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维有限责任公司

title: High-strength high-heat-conductivity high-modulus asphalt-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses high-strength high-heat-conductivity high-modulus asphalt-based carbon fibers and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: 1) the intermediate phase pitch is used as a raw material, and the pitch-based precursor with the fiber diameter of 10-30 mu m is prepared by melt spinning; 2) after winding and collecting the filaments of the asphalt-based precursor prepared in the step 1), sequentially carrying out active filament unwinding, hot roller drying treatment, infusible treatment, three-stage carbonization treatment, pre-graphitization treatment, sizing drying and final winding and collection to prepare the high-strength high-heat-conductivity high-modulus asphalt-based carbon fiber. According to the method, the graphitization final temperature is reduced by introducing hot roller drying, upgrading and optimizing the infusibility process, reclassifying the carbonization process and introducing pre-graphitization, the graphitization temperature required by the method is lower when the asphalt-based graphite fiber with the same heat conductivity is prepared, the service life of a graphite heating body is greatly prolonged, and the industrialization of the high heat conductivity asphalt-based graphite fiber is realized.
assignee: 陕西天策新材料科技有限公司

title: Method for preparing mesophase pitch and carbon fiber by deep oxidation-catalytic polycondensation
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing mesophase pitch and carbon fibers by deep oxidation-catalytic polycondensation. The method takes naphthenic base crude oil or intermediate base crude oil as raw material, and adopts an air blowing method to carry out deep oxidation crosslinking modification on the raw material to obtain modified raw material; with ZrO 2 The modified raw material is mixed with a catalyst to prepare mesophase pitch as the catalyst. And carrying out melt spinning on the prepared mesophase pitch to prepare the high-modulus carbon fiber. The method has simple process flow, the used catalyst has no corrosion to reaction equipment, the reaction is carried out at lower temperature, and the requirement on the equipment is not harsh; the prepared mesophase pitch has proper softening point and can simultaneously meet the requirements of spinnability and preoxidation reaction temperature: 220-260 ℃ of mesophase content>98 percent, has a large-area streamline optical texture, and the spun protofilament has excellent mechanical properties after being subjected to preoxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment.
assignee: 中国石油大学(华东)

title: Electrostatic spinning technology-based TiO preparation2Method for preparing carbon fiber composite material and preparation and application of modified electrode
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon nanofiber composite material and a construction method of a modified electrode thereof, which apply electrostatic spinning and high-temperature carbonization technologies to a titanium dioxide-carbon fiber nanocomposite (TiO) 2 CNFs) from TiO 2 The preparation method has the advantages that the nano-particles and Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) are used as raw materials, N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF) is used as a solvent, the blending spinning is carried out, the operation process is simple, the fiber appearance is controllable, the structure is uniform, the specific surface area is large, and the TiO can be prepared by high-temperature carbonization 2 -CNFs composite materials. The modified electrode prepared from the modified electrode has good stability and operability, and can effectively promote the transfer of electrons on an interface. The modified electrode has good electrocatalytic oxidation performance on Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP), and shows lower detection limit, wider linear range and higher sensitivity.
assignee: 海南师范大学

title: Graphene/carbon composite micro-nanofiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a graphene-carbon composite micro-nanofiber and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber materials. The method mainly comprises the following steps: (1) and preparing a spinning solution. A certain amount of Graphene Oxide (GO) is dissolved in N, N Dimethylformamide (DMF). Adding a certain amount of polyacrylonitrile powder into GO/DMF solution, and magnetically stirring until PAN is completely dissolved to prepare spinning solution. (2) And (4) centrifugal spinning. And (4) placing the spinning solution into a centrifugal container, and regulating the rotating speed to carry out centrifugal spinning. The collected PAN/GO fibers are placed in a drying oven at 60 ℃ to be dried for 30 min. (3) Pre-oxidation and carbonization. And placing the PAN/GO fiber in a tubular furnace for pre-oxidation in air atmosphere, and preserving heat at 280 ℃ for 3 h. And then high-temperature carbonization is performed under a nitrogen atmosphere. The carbonization temperature is 900 ℃, and the temperature is kept for 2 h. And continuously introducing nitrogen and cooling to room temperature to obtain the graphene-carbon composite micro-nano fiber. The fiber has the advantages of large specific surface area, high specific capacitance, large yield, low cost and the like.
assignee: 中国地质大学（北京）

title: Nanofiber-based flexible array structure electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemical materials, in particular to a nanofiber-based flexible array structure electrode and a preparation method thereof. The electrode is prepared from an inner spinning solution and an outer spinning solution through electrostatic spinning, carbonization, hydrothermal growth and electrodeposition, wherein the inner spinning solution comprises Polyacrylonitrile (PAN), Purified Terephthalic Acid (PTA), acidified carbon nanotubes (AC-MWNTs) and a solvent, and the outer spinning solution comprises polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP), inorganic zinc salt, purified terephthalic acid and a solvent. The preparation method increases the flexibility of the carbon fiber, and ZnO can be directly added into the precursor in the coaxial spinning process, so that nano ZnO is uniformly and firmly loaded on the outer surface of the carbon nanofiber, and the seed crystal coating process is omitted, so that the method is simple, efficient, high in universality, low in cost and environment-friendly, and the obtained product integrates the flexible characteristics and the bimetallic pseudocapacitance performance and can be an independent electrode.
assignee: 河北科技大学

title: Polyacrylonitrile fiber, preparation method and preparation method of carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) fiber, a preparation method thereof and a preparation method of carbon fiber. According to the invention, the heat setting temperature in the PAN fiber preparation process is raised to 170-240 ℃, the heat setting drafting ratio is 0-20%, the physical heat shrinkage of the fiber is inhibited, and the fiber is subjected to weak cyclization oxidation reaction, so that the polyacrylonitrile precursor with weak cyclization and high orientation is prepared. The fiber prepared by the method has the characteristics that the relative cyclization ratio is 5-30%, and the full orientation of a fiber molecular chain is 0.60-0.88. The carbon fiber is prepared by pre-oxidizing and carbonizing the precursor subsequently, so that the pre-oxidizing time is shortened, the energy consumption is reduced, the process flow is shortened, the production efficiency is improved, and the carbon crystallite orientation and the mechanical property of the carbon fiber in the carbon fiber are also improved.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Preparation method of impact-resistant carbon fiber material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of an impact-resistant carbon fiber material, which comprises the following operation steps: weighing a proper amount of polyacrylonitrile fibers according to a certain amount, and carrying out pre-oxidation reaction in a temperature gradient heating mode; then carrying out high-temperature carbonization in a gradient heating mode to form a carbon fiber raw material; weighing polyvinyl chloride, dichloroethane, a composite stabilizer and a sodium hydroxide solution, uniformly mixing, heating for reaction, evaporating to remove water, adding a plasticizer and a compatilizer, and uniformly mixing to obtain a modified resin material; weighing a proper amount of silicon oxide powder and zirconium oxide powder, mixing, adding a halogen solvent, mixing and stirring, then adding glass fiber, mixing and drying to form a reinforcing auxiliary agent; weighing the treated modified resin and the reinforcing auxiliary agent, adding the carbon fiber raw material, mixing, adding into a double-screw extruder, extruding, granulating to obtain a carbon fiber raw material; and (3) putting the carbon fiber material raw material into an injection molding machine for injection molding to obtain the impact-resistant carbon fiber material.

title: Easily-conductive metal-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an easily conductive metal-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, which is characterized in that a metal chromium water dispersoid is prepared and doped into a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution to be spun to obtain fibril, and the fibril is subjected to pre-oxidation, pre-carbonization, carbonization and other processes to prepare the metal chromium-doped polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber. Compared with the common polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, the carbon fiber has lower resistivity, which shows that the conductivity is better. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber containing the metal chromium is simple and has no pollution to the environment.

title: Preparation method of composite lithium-sulfur battery electrode material with three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a composite lithium-sulfur battery electrode material with a three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure, which comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile in an N, N-dimethylformamide solvent to serve as a sheath solution; dissolving iron disulfide and polyvinylpyrrolidone into an N, N-dimethylformamide solvent to be used as core liquid; the method comprises the steps of respectively placing injectors filled with core liquid and sheath liquid on two injection pumps of an electrostatic spinning device for coaxial electrostatic spinning, collecting electrospun and ejected precursor fibers on a roller, placing the obtained precursor fibers in an air atmosphere muffle furnace for pre-oxidation, then carbonizing in an inert gas protective atmosphere to obtain the core-shell structure iron disulfide/carbon @ carbon fiber composite material, then immersing the obtained iron disulfide/carbon @ carbon fiber composite material in dilute nitric acid, stirring, filtering, and drying to finally prepare the three-dimensional conduction core-shell structure carbon @ carbon fiber/sulfur composite lithium sulfur battery electrode material. The lithium-sulfur electrode material obtained by the invention has the characteristics of high capacity and good cycle stability.

title: Preparation method of Si-C-O ceramic antioxidant coating on surface of carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a Si-C-O ceramic antioxidant coating on the surface of carbon fiber, and relates to a preparation method of a carbon fiber antioxidant coating. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the material performance is reduced due to the fact that an oxidation-resistant coating on the surface of carbon fiber prepared by a precursor impregnation cracking method has pores and cracks. The method comprises the following steps: adding a mixed monomer of propyl trimethoxy silane and phenyl trimethoxy silane into a potassium hydroxide aqueous solution for reaction, then filtering and drying a filter cake to obtain a precursor; dissolving the precursor in xylene to obtain a precursor solution; and repeatedly dipping and drying the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in the precursor solution, then sintering in an argon atmosphere, and then repeatedly dipping, drying and sintering to obtain the antioxidant Si-C-O ceramic coating on the surface of the carbon fiber. The anti-oxidation Si-C-O ceramic coating obtained on the surface of the carbon fiber by the method has no cracks and pores, and can be used in the fields of high temperature resistant and anti-oxidation materials.

title: Preparation method of nano carbon fiber negative electrode material electrode plate embedded with silicon particles
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a silicon particle-embedded nano carbon fiber negative electrode material electrode plate, which comprises the steps of dissolving silicon particles, polymethyl methacrylate and polyacrylonitrile in N, N-dimethylformamide, preparing a polymer solution with the mass fraction of 10% of polyacrylonitrile, adding the polymer solution into an electrostatic spinning device, controlling the time of the electrostatic spinning process through the electrostatic spinning device, obtaining a silicon particle-embedded nano carbon fiber film with a certain thickness on a collecting plate, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on the silicon particle-embedded nano carbon fiber film, mixing the silicon particle-embedded nano carbon fiber film with a conductive agent and a binder, coating the conductive agent and the binder on a copper foil, finally drying the copper foil coated with an active material, and slicing the dried copper foil to obtain the silicon particle-embedded nano carbon fiber negative electrode material electrode plate. The negative electrode material electrode plate prepared by the invention has the capacity of 974mAh g-1 under the current density of 100mA g-1, and does not have obvious attenuation after being circulated for 100 times.

abstract: The invention provides a method for reducing ash content of high-strength polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers and application thereof, which can effectively remove ash content in the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, simultaneously does not reduce the heat resistance of an oil agent, is beneficial to homogenization reaction of the carbon fibers in the pre-oxidation carbonization process, and keeps the body performance of the carbon fibers.

title: Bamboo-like nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber-coated transition metal alloy nanoparticle catalytic material for efficient bifunctional electrocatalysis
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bamboo-like nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber-coated transition metal alloy nanoparticle electrocatalytic material and efficient electrocatalytic oxygen reduction and oxygen evolution performances of the electrocatalytic material. By electrospinning technique, PS fiber or PAN fiber is mixed with Co X Ni Y -BTC binding ofThe preparation method is characterized in that MOFs @ PS or MOFs @ PAN nano-fibers are designed and synthesized, and the electric catalytic material of the bamboo-like nitrogen-doped carbon nano-fiber coated transition metal alloy nano-particles is synthesized through high-temperature carbonization. By controlling different Co/Ni molar ratios, nano-scale precursor Co is prepared X Ni Y BTC, Co formation by coating with polystyrene or polyacrylonitrile X Ni Y -BTC @ PS or Co X Ni Y -BTC @ PAN nanofibers. The PS fiber or PAN fiber is used as a template and is converted into carbon fiber with good conductivity in the high-temperature carbonization process, the Co/Ni bimetallic alloy avoids the corrosion of electrolyte and slows down the agglomeration of the electrolyte in the reaction process under the coating of a uniform carbon-nitrogen structure, and the electrocatalytic oxygen reduction and oxygen evolution activity of the material are obviously enhanced under the synergistic action of the metal phase and the carbon fiber.

title: Method for preparing high-performance thermal stabilization fiber by controlling chemical structure of polyacrylonitrile carbon
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing high-performance thermal stabilization fibers by controlling a chemical structure of polyacrylonitrile carbon, which mainly solves the problems of structural control of polyacrylonitrile thermal stabilization fibers and influence on the performance of carbon fibers in the prior art. The invention provides a preparation method of a high-performance thermal stabilization fiber, which comprises the steps of carrying out thermal stabilization treatment on a polyacrylonitrile copolymer precursor for 30-60 min at the temperature of 180-280 ℃, wherein the total draft ratio is 0-6%, so as to obtain the high-performance thermal stabilization fiber; the technical scheme that the thermal stabilization fiber takes a cyclization index CI and an oxidation index OI as quality control indexes, the CI value is 50-70%, and the OI value is 6-20% better solves the problem, and can be used for production of high-performance thermal stabilization fibers and carbon fibers.

title: Method for manufacturing high-performance wet-spun polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, which mainly solves the problems that broken filaments are easy to generate in a pre-oxidation process and the mechanical property of carbon fibers is poor in the prior art. The invention adopts a manufacturing method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, adopts wet spinning, and comprises the step of steam drafting, wherein, the tension born by each fiber in the steam drafting process is at least 1mN, and the tension born by the fiber is less than or equal to 10% of the breaking strength of the fiber, thereby better solving the problem and being applicable to the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor.

abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing high-performance carbon fiber by controlling a polyacrylonitrile thermal stabilization fiber structure, which mainly solves the problems of controlling the polyacrylonitrile thermal stabilization fiber structure and influencing the performance of the carbon fiber in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-performance carbon fibers, which comprises the steps of carrying out thermal stabilization treatment on a polyacrylonitrile copolymer precursor for 30-60 min at the temperature of 180-280 ℃, wherein the total draft is 0-6%, so as to obtain thermal stabilization fibers; and carbonizing the heat-stabilized fibers to obtain the high-performance carbon fibers; the technical scheme that the thermal stabilization fiber takes a cyclization index CI and an oxidation index OI as quality control indexes in thermal stabilization treatment, the CI value is 50-70%, and the OI value is 6-20% better solves the problem, and can be used for production of high-performance carbon fibers.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of more carbon fiber broken filaments, poor mechanical property and large coke discharge amount of a low-carbon furnace in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of oiling, drying densification, steam drafting, heat setting, heat stabilization and carbonization; the method is characterized in that oiling and drying densification are carried out at least twice, at least one step is carried out before the steps of steam drafting and heat setting, and at least one step is carried out after the steps of steam drafting and heat setting, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used for producing high-performance carbon fibers.

title: Preparation method of low-silicon-content polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of low-silicon polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, which mainly solves the problems of more carbon fiber broken filaments, poor mechanical property and large coke discharge of a low-carbon furnace in the prior art. The invention adopts a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, and adopts a preparation method of low silicon-containing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises at least two steps of oiling, drying densification, thermal stabilization and carbonization; the oiling and the drying densification are carried out at least twice, the first oiling adopts an ultra-low silicon oiling agent or a silicon-free oiling agent, and the second oiling adopts a technical scheme of a general silicon-containing oiling agent, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used for preparing high-performance carbon fibers.

title: Hollow carbon fiber composite material filled with nano particles, preparation method and application
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a hollow carbon fiber composite material filled with nano particles, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, a coaxial electrostatic spinning method is utilized, a polyacrylonitrile solution with high carbon forming rate is used as a shell solution, a polymer solution with low carbon yield is used as a core solution, and nano particles are dispersed in the core solution; after coaxial electrostatic spinning, forming composite fiber with a core-shell structure; and carrying out subsequent oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain the hollow carbon fiber filled with the nano particles. The method is simple, environment-friendly and high in operability, and the hollow carbon fiber composite material is formed, can be used as a sulfur anode carrier in a lithium-sulfur battery, and shows high capacity and long cycle stability.

title: Polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity and a preparation method thereof. The invention prepares the polyacrylonitrile resin with controllable molecular weight and distribution and high regularity by a reversible addition/fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) free radical polymerization process and by selecting trithiocarbonate (TRIT) with carboxyl at two ends as an RAFT reagent through a polymerization reaction. The polyacrylonitrile resin has high molecular weight, narrow distribution, high molecular chain structure regularity and few molecular structure defects. The polyacrylonitrile resin prepared by the method has obviously improved hydrophilicity and oxidation cyclization activity, and is suitable for preparing high-performance precursor fibers for carbon fibers.

title: Low-defect and high-strength polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with low defect and high strength and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) polymerization technology and trithiocarbonate (TRIT) with carboxyl functional groups as RAFT reagent to control the molecular weight and the distribution of polyacrylonitrile on the one hand, and prepare polyacrylonitrile with carboxyl at the tail end on the other hand, and simultaneously carry out copolymerization reaction by adopting a second monomer with double functional groups and close to the reactivity ratio of acrylonitrile, thereby obtaining polyacrylonitrile with higher chain structure regularity and uniform distribution of copolymerization units, preparing high-quality protofilaments, and further preparing the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with low defect and high strength by pre-oxidation, carbonization and post-treatment.

title: Preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped porous carbon fiber material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped porous carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of porous carbon fiber materials. Firstly, preparing polyacrylonitrile/polyvinylpyrrolidone spinning precursor solution, then obtaining porous polyacrylonitrile fiber by a wet spinning method by utilizing different solubilities (phase separation) of polyacrylonitrile and polyvinylpyrrolidone in an aqueous solution, soaking and activating the obtained porous polyacrylonitrile fiber in a potassium hydroxide solution, taking polyacrylonitrile as a carbon source and a nitrogen source, and carrying out one-step high-temperature carbonization activation treatment in an inert atmosphere to obtain the nitrogen-doped porous carbon fiber. The porous carbon fiber material has a hierarchical porous carbon skeleton structure with high specific surface area, high nitrogen content and mutual crosslinking, provides a fast channel for electron transmission, shortens ion diffusion distance, increases wettability and conductivity of the material, and shows very good electrochemical performance. The preparation process is simple, the equipment dependence is low, and the method is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title: Large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with surface groove structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with a surface groove structure and a preparation method thereof. The fiber has a surface groove structure, the average diameter is 8.5-11 μm, the strength is 4.9-6.0 GPa, and the modulus is 270-310 GPa. Preparing precursor by adopting a wet spinning technology, controlling the skin-core ratio of pre-oxidized fibers to be more than or equal to 0.85 by regulating the pre-oxidation time ratio of each temperature zone in the pre-oxidation stage, and preparing the large-diameter high-strength medium-modulus carbon fibers with the surface groove structures through low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization. The prepared large-diameter high-strength medium-mode carbon fiber with the surface groove structure not only improves the collimation of the fiber, but also improves the wettability of resin in the preparation of the composite material, and finally improves the mechanical properties such as compression strength and the like in the application of the composite material.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material has a basic unit of a core-shell structure, a core is a carbon material, a shell is a polyacrylonitrile layer, and the polyacrylonitrile layer is a single layer or multiple layers; the carbon material is a carbon material having a graphite lattice structure. The polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene oxide composite material realizes the tight coating of the graphene by the polymer while realizing the uniform introduction of the graphene into a spinning system, isolates the interaction between the graphene, reduces the accumulation tendency, greatly shortens the time required by the uniform mixing of the graphene and the polyacrylonitrile, and improves the production efficiency. Moreover, the introduced graphene can play the role of a nucleating agent and a template agent in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, so that a more complete graphite lattice structure of the carbon fiber is obtained, and various performances of the carbon fiber are improved.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based low-cost composite carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polyacrylonitrile-based low-cost composite carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein polyacrylonitrile powder is added into dimethyl sulfoxide and dissolved to obtain a uniform polyacrylonitrile solution; mixing SiO 2 Grinding inorganic raw materials to be dispersed in a nanometer level, adding polyvinyl alcohol, polyacrylamide and water to prepare inorganic glue solution which is easy to form threads; taking polyacrylonitrile solution as spinning solution A and inorganic glue solution as spinning solution B, and carrying out wet coaxial spinning to obtain coaxial composite fibers; and oxidizing the obtained coaxial fiber in an air atmosphere, and then performing low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization under the protection of nitrogen. According to the invention, through coaxial spinning, a glass precursor raw material is designed in the inner core, and the composite carbon fiber with the inner core being glass fiber and the outer layer being carbon fiber is formed in the post-stage high-temperature treatment and stretching processes, so that the cost of the carbon fiber is greatly reduced, and the defect of high preparation cost of the existing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is overcome.

title: Precursor stabilization process
abstract: The present invention relates to an improved process for forming a stabilized precursor suitable for making carbon materials such as carbon fibers. The process can convert polyacrylonitrile containing precursors to stabilized precursors with greater efficiency. The invention also relates to a process for preparing carbon fibers using the stabilized precursor.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material, which comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile by using a solvent to obtain a spinning solution; adding isopropyl titanate, boric acid, melamine and nano diamond into the spinning solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed spinning solution; preparing the mixed spinning solution into spinning fibers by adopting wet spinning; and the spinning fiber is subjected to thermal stabilization and carbonization to prepare the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material prepared by the invention is a fibrous photocatalytic material, is convenient to recover after water treatment, and does not generate the problems of difficult recovery and secondary pollution. The polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber hybrid composite photocatalytic material has wider application range, and is suitable for water bodies under different illumination conditions for water treatment.

title: Composite carbon fiber electrode material with adjustable and controllable structural function, preparation method thereof and application thereof in flow battery
abstract: The invention discloses a composite carbon fiber electrode material with adjustable and controllable structure and function, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a flow battery. Adding the synthesized elastic carbonaceous microspheres into a mixed solution of Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) and N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF), and uniformly mixing to obtain a spinning solution; spinning by using the spinning solution to obtain original polyacrylonitrile nano-fibers; and carrying out pre-oxidation treatment and carbonization treatment on the obtained original polyacrylonitrile nano-fiber to obtain a target product. The active polarization caused by charge transfer resistance, ohmic polarization caused by contact resistance and concentration polarization caused by mass transfer can be effectively reduced by applying the active polarization to the electrode material of the flow battery, so that the energy efficiency, the power density and the cycle life of the battery are improved. The method is simple, easy to operate, universal, capable of carrying out targeted design on material structures and functions according to different requirements, and wide in application.

title: Preparation method of mesophase pitch and high-modulus pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of high-grade novel carbon materials, and provides a preparation method of mesophase pitch and high-modulus pitch-based carbon fibers. The method comprises the steps of treating heavy oil by liquid-solid adsorption chromatography (LSAC) and Gel Permeation Chromatography (GPC) to obtain modified raw materials with proper molecular weight and polarity, and then performing thermal polycondensation on the modified raw materials at the reaction temperature of 360-480 ℃, the reaction pressure of 0-10MPa and the reaction time of 1-15h to prepare high-quality mesophase pitch; and (3) carrying out melt spinning on the mesophase pitch, and carrying out pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization treatment to obtain the high-modulus pitch-based carbon fiber. The method has the advantages of strong raw material compatibility, excellent quality of the obtained mesophase pitch, 170-350 ℃ softening point and wide-area streamline optical anisotropic structure, good spinnability and suitability for preparing high-modulus mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers, and the content of the mesophase is more than or equal to 97%.

title: Electric control type polyacrylonitrile precursor microwave pre-oxidation process
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fibers, in particular to an electric control type polyacrylonitrile precursor microwave pre-oxidation process, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving a hydrolyzed adhesive into deionized water to form an adhesive solution; s2: mixing a set amount of carbon black with deionized water to form a suspension; s3: immersing polyacrylonitrile protofilament in the bonding solution, and taking out the polyacrylonitrile protofilament before complete drying; s4: immersing polyacrylonitrile protofilament into the suspension, taking out the polyacrylonitrile protofilament after the polyacrylonitrile protofilament is immersed for a set time, and completely drying the polyacrylonitrile protofilament; s5: feeding polyacrylonitrile protofilament into a microwave oxidation furnace for oxidation under set conditions. According to the invention, the carbon material wave-absorbing substance is coated on the surface of the polyacrylonitrile protofilament which does not absorb waves, and the carbon black can absorb microwave quantity after entering a microwave oxidation furnace, so that the surface of the polyacrylonitrile protofilament obtains heat energy to realize pre-oxidation, the control of the pre-oxidation effect can be effectively realized by reasonably controlling the microwave power and the pre-oxidation time, and meanwhile, the cost of protofilament treatment can be effectively reduced in the pre-oxidation stage by reasonably controlling the power supply.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and method for producing same
abstract: The object is to obtain carbon fibers which are suitable for carbon fiber-reinforced composite materials using a resin with high heat resistance as a matrix, have reduced molding processing costs and improved performance, and have both bundling property and thermal stability in a high balance. The carbon fiber bundle of the present invention has a crystallite size L, which is measured from a bulk of the entire carbon fiber bundle, wherein the crystallite size L is a crystallite size obtained by measuring a single fiber diameter of the carbon fiber bundle and a predetermined heating reduction rate, wherein one end of the carbon fiber bundle is a fixed end and the other end of the carbon fiber bundle is a free end, and wherein 2 turns/m or more remain c And degree of crystal orientation pi 002 Satisfying the specified formula. Also relates to the diameter of the defined single fiber and is definedA method for producing a carbon fiber bundle having a heat reduction ratio, wherein a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle is subjected to a flame-resistant treatment, a pre-carbonization treatment and a carbonization treatment in this order, and the twist of the fiber bundle in the carbonization treatment is 2 turns/m or more and the tension is 1.5mN/dtex or more. And a carbon fiber bundle having a twist angle of 0.2 DEG or more remaining on the surface layer of the fiber bundle when one end is a fixed end and the other end is a free end, the carbon fiber bundle having a predetermined diameter of single fibers and a predetermined heat loss rate, wherein the carbon fiber bundle has a crystallite size L measured from the bulk of the entire fiber bundle c And degree of crystal orientation pi 002 Satisfying the specified formula. And a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle in which the twist angle remaining in the surface layer of the fiber bundle when one end is a fixed end and the other end is a free end is 0.2 DEG or more, the twist angle is a predetermined single fiber diameter, and the twist angle is a predetermined heating loss rate, wherein the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle is subjected to a flame resistance treatment, a pre-carbonization treatment, and a carbonization treatment in this order, and the tension in the carbonization treatment is 1.5mN/dtex or more.
assignee: 东丽株式会社
inventors: OKUDA HARUKI; WATANABE JUN; TANAKA FUMIHIKO

title: Carbon fiber and method for producing same
abstract: The problem is to obtain carbon fibers which exhibit excellent dispersibility in a molded article finally obtained during molding and processing into a carbon fiber-reinforced composite material. The carbon fiber of the present invention is a carbon fiber in which, when a single fiber is observed from a side surface within a range of a linear distance of 1mm, the fluctuation width of the fiber axis of the single fiber is 2.5 μm or more, and the fiber length of the single fiber in which the variation coefficient of the fluctuation width is 100% or less is 10cm or less. The carbon fiber is produced by a method for producing a carbon fiber, wherein a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle is subjected to a flame-resistant treatment, then subjected to a pre-carbonization treatment and a carbonization treatment in this order, and the obtained carbon fiber bundle in the form of a continuous fiber is cut, and the twist of the fiber bundle in the carbonization treatment is set to 16 turns/m or more or the twist angle of the surface of the fiber bundle is set to 2.0 ° or more.
assignee: 东丽株式会社
inventors: OKUDA HARUKI; TANAKA FUMIHIKO

title: Lignin/nano cellulose-based carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a lignin/nano cellulose-based carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1) preparing high-length-diameter ratio nano cellulose with negative surface charge through a TEMPO/NaBr/NaClO oxidation system, and mixing sodium lignin sulfonate and the nano cellulose in proportion to obtain lignin/nano cellulose composite spinning solution; 2) in the process of microfluid complex spinning, under the action of a stretching flow field, lignin and nanocellulose are assembled in a highly oriented manner along the flow direction, and simultaneously, positively charged chitosan is adopted to crosslink the lignin and the nanocellulose in situ to obtain lignin/nanocellulose precursor fibers; 3) and carrying out preoxidation and carbonization treatment on the precursor fiber in a tube furnace to obtain the high-strength and high-conductivity bio-based carbon fiber. The lignin/nano cellulose-based carbon fiber prepared by the method disclosed by the invention is perfect in crystallization, high in carbon crystal orientation degree, excellent in tensile strength and conductivity, and capable of solving the problems of poor mechanical property and low conductivity of the lignin-based carbon fiber.
assignee: 福建工程学院
inventors: GENG LIHONG; CAI YUHUA; PENG XIANGFANG; HUANG AN; LIU YANG; XIAO DAN

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofibers
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of carbon nanofibers, in particular to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofibers. The process comprises the following steps: dissolving polyacrylonitrile in a solvent to form a spinning solution, supplying the spinning solution to a spinning die head containing a series of spinning holes, and extruding the spinning solution from the spinning holes to form spinning solution trickle; simultaneously, at least one high-speed jet airflow with the temperature of 20-80 ℃ and the speed of 500-3000 times higher than the extrusion speed of the solution trickle is utilized to blow the solution trickle at the jet angle of 0-30 degrees, so that the solution trickle is refined and the solvent is promoted to volatilize to form the polyacrylonitrile nano-fiber; and then placing the polyacrylonitrile nano-fiber in an air atmosphere of 160-300 ℃ for pre-oxidation treatment and a nitrogen atmosphere of 900-1800 ℃ for carbonization treatment to obtain the nano-carbon fiber. The preparation method has the advantages of high production efficiency, simple process, uniform fiber diameter distribution and the like, and is suitable for large-scale production.
assignee: 天津工业大学
inventors: ZHUANG XUPIN; Cui Jinran; LIU YA

title: Copper-based powder metallurgy friction material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a copper-based powder metallurgy friction material, which comprises the following steps: s1, taking polyacrylonitrile and lignin as carbon sources, compounding the carbon sources with a solvent, carrying out electrostatic spinning treatment, collecting spinning fibers, carrying out pre-oxidation treatment, collecting pre-oxidized fibers, and carrying out carbonization treatment to obtain composite carbon fibers; s2, taking foamy copper as a matrix, taking molybdenum trioxide and sulfur powder as modified materials to perform modification treatment, and collecting the modified foamy copper material; s3, mixing the composite carbon fibers and the modified foamy copper material, and collecting composite matrix particles; and S4, taking the composite matrix particles, carbonyl iron powder, silicon oxide, chromium powder, aluminum oxide and graphite particles, performing powder metallurgy, and firing and forming to obtain the copper-based powder metallurgy friction material. The powder metallurgy friction material prepared by the method has excellent bonding performance and mechanical property, and can effectively meet the long-acting use requirement of the existing powder metallurgy friction material.

title: Precursor stabilisation process
abstract: The invention relates to an improved process for forming a stabilised precursor that is suitable for the manufacture of carbon materials, such as carbon fibre. The process can convert a precursor comprising polyacrylonitrile into a stabilised precursor with greater efficiency. The invention also relates to a process for preparing a carbon fibre that utilises the stabilised precursor.
assignee: Deakin University
inventors: Atkiss, Stephen Paul; Maghe, Maxime Robert

title: Method for producing precursor fiber for carbon fiber
abstract: To provide a method for producing a precursor fiber for a carbon fiber capable of inhibiting fusion of single yarns to produce carbon fibers having a high quality.SOLUTION: A method for producing a carbon fiber precursor fiber comprising a polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer, wherein a concentration of an acrylonitrile monomer in a spinning dope is controlled to less than 10 ppm, and then pH of the spinning dope is adjusted to 7.2 to 10.0, followed by using the spinning dope for spinning; the polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer is prepared preferably by copolymerizing a carboxy group-containing vinyl base compound; the polyacrylonitrile-based copolymer is obtained preferably by aqueous suspension polymerization; the spinning dope contains preferably moisture of 10 ppm or more; further, the spinning dope is adjusted preferably in pH with ammonia; the spinning method is preferably of a wet type or a dry wet type; the fibers after spun are dried preferably by a roller of 150°C or higher; the fibers after spun are subjected preferably to steam drawing; further, the present invention includes a method for producing a carbon fiber in which the carbon fiber precursor fibers obtained by the method described above are subjected to flame resistant treatment and carbonization treatment.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Carbon fiber bundle and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: To provide a carbon fiber bundle with improvements in warpage on composite material molding, high load resistance, and difficulty in fuzz formation and a manufacturing method thereof.SOLUTION: The carbon fiber bundle is a carbon fiber bundle which has a monofilament fineness of 1.0-3.5dtex and a cross section with a ratio of the major axis perpendicular to a fiber axis of the monofilament and a minor axis of 2.5-10.0, and involves a monofilament cross section free from a groove of a depth of 0.1 μm or under from a monofilament surface, and is manufactured by a manufacturing method of a carbon fiber bundle which employs a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer involving 91.0-95.0 mass% of an acrylonitrile unit and 5.0-9.0 mass% of at least one kinds selected from a group involving an acrylate-based monomer (A) unit represented by a structural formula CH=CHCOOCH(in the structural formula, n=2-4, alkyl chain is a normal chain) and a methacrylate-based monomer (B) unit represented by a structural formula CHC(=CH)COOCH(in the structural formula, n=2-4, an alkyl chain is a normal chain), and involves a flame-resistant step of, after obtaining a carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle having a monofilament fineness of 2.0 dtex or more and a shape of a cross section perpendicular to a monofilament fiber axis having a circularity of 0.30-0.60, flame-resistant treatment of the carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle in an oxidizing atmosphere of 200-300°C, a pre-carbonization step of pre-carbonization of the flame-resistant fiber bundle obtained in the flame-resistant step in an inert atmosphere with a maximum temperature of 500-1200°C, and a carbonization step of carbonization of the pre-carbonized fiber bundle obtained in the pre-carbonization step in an inert atmosphere of 1200-3000°C.SELECTED DRAWING: None
assignee: 東レ株式会社; Toray Ind Inc
inventors: ISHIKAWA TORU; SENDA TAKAHIRO; ONO KIMINORI; TANAKA FUMIHIKO

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method thereof
abstract: To produce a carbon fiber bundle having excellent quality by using a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution having a low iron content.SOLUTION: There is provided a method of manufacturing a carbon fiber bundle, the method comprising: a spinning process for obtaining a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle by spinning a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution; a flame-proofing process in which the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle is subjected to flame-proofing processing in an oxidizing atmosphere at 200 to 300°C to obtain a flame-resistant fiber bundle; a pre-carbonization process in which the flame-proofing fiber bundle is pre-carbonized in an inert atmosphere at 500 to 1200°C to obtain a pre-carbonized fiber bundle; and a carbonization process in which the pre-carbonized fiber bundle is carbonized in an inert atmosphere at 1200 to 3000°C to obtain a carbon fiber bundle, in which 1 pt.mass of a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution is diluted by adding 9 pts.mass of the same type of a solvent as the solvent in the polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution, and then 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoro-2-propanol is added thereto while stirring the solution at 17°C, and when 0.5 mass% of the total amount of polyacrylonitrile-based polymer contained in the polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution is precipitated, a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution having an iron content of 0.01 to 1.8 μg/g in the obtained precipitate is used.SELECTED DRAWING: None
