title: A kind of polybasic ion antibiotic carbon fiber filter core
abstract: The present invention relates to water purification material fields, disclose a kind of polybasic ion antibiotic carbon fiber filter core, the preparation method comprises the following steps: (A) mixes cerium oxide powder, feldspar powder, three four iron of oxidation with polyvinyl chloride or polypropylene, edible vegetable oil is then added；Granulation obtains A masterbatch；Polybasic ion anti-biotic material is added, granulation obtains polybasic ion high-molecular anti-bacteria masterbatch；(B) preparation of polyacrylonitrile copolymer；(C) preparation of polyacrylonitrile fibre；(D) by polyacrylonitrile fibre pre-oxidation, carbonization treatment, carbon fiber is formed；(E) prepared by filter core.Contain polybasic ion anti-biotic material in filter core of the invention, stability is good, and antibacterial activity is high, and has adsorption capacity；The problems such as anti-microbial property and service life that high molecular material can be effectively improved, antibiotic property, hydrolytic resistance, the inoxidizability for avoiding anti-biotic material in conventional polymer are low, not acid and alkali-resistance, and service life is low and temperature dependency is too strong.
assignee: 浙江水马环保科技有限公司

title: Blood filter based on polyacrylonitrile based activated carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention discloses the preparation method of polyacrylonitrile based activated carbon fiber, comprising the following steps: (1) polyacrylonitrile fibril is carried out to three-level heat treatment pre-oxidation in oxidation furnace；(2) the polyacrylonitrile silk after pre-oxidation is subjected to the processing of second level anaerobic carbonization.Invention additionally discloses the blood filters based on above-mentioned polyacrylonitrile based activated carbon fiber.The present invention has the advantages that absorption property is good, reduces in carbonisation to the harm of environment, circulation path easy to disassemble, increase blood is in filter device, extension filtration time.
assignee: 安徽佳力奇碳纤维科技股份公司

title: A kind of preparation method of porous petroleum coke base carbon fibre
abstract: The invention belongs to nano-carbon material technical fields, and in particular to a kind of preparation method of porous petroleum coke base carbon fibre.The following steps are included: the amphiphilic carbonaceous material and polyacrylonitrile that prepare using petroleum coke as raw material are dissolved in n,N-Dimethylformamide by (1), uniform spinning solution is stirred to get；(2) spinning solution obtained in step (1) is prepared into electrospun fibers film by electrostatic spinning technique；(3) electrospun fibers film obtained in step (2) is obtained into petroleum coke base carbon fibre successively by pre-oxidation, carbonisation；(4) petroleum coke base carbon fibre obtained in step (3) is passed through into activation process, porous petroleum coke base carbon fibre is prepared.Using cheap refinery industry byproduct petroleum coke, as carbon source, porous petroleum coke base carbon fibre is prepared, which can be used as the electrode material of supercapacitor, show excellent capacitive property, avoid the use of binder in the present invention.
assignee: 中国石油大学(华东)

title: A kind of preparation method for the mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers braided fabric loading carbon nano-fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of preparation methods of mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers braided fabric for loading carbon nano-fiber, are raw material with mesophase pitch, are spun into 12-16 μm of diameter of Mesophase Pitch Fiberss；After then passing through 260-300 DEG C of pre-oxidation, and the low-temperature carbonization for carrying out 500-800 DEG C is handled；Low-temperature carbonization silk is woven into carbon fiber two-dimensional fabric, in carbon fiber surface vapor phase growth carbon nano-fiber；1200-1500 DEG C of high temperature carbonization processing is carried out to the carbon fiber preform of load gas phase carbon fiber and 2600-3000 DEG C of graphitization processing obtains the mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers braided fabric of load carbon nano-fiber.The mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers braided fabric of load carbon nano-fiber produced by the present invention is that it is thermally conductive to take into account Z-direction while X-Y plane has high thermal conductivity high-modulus for the excellent presoma for preparing high thermal conductivity CFRP skin material.

title: A kind of high-specific surface area polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber non-woven fabrics and preparation method
abstract: A kind of specific surface area of high-specific surface area polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber non-woven fabrics is 400-800 m 2  g ‑1 , the microcellular structure for being 0.5-2nm with pore diameter range, carbon yield 40-70%, carbon fiber diameter is 200-600nm in non-woven fabrics.The spinning solution being made of pitch, polyacrylonitrile and organic solvent obtains after electrostatic spinning technique, pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment.The present invention has the advantages that there is preferable flexible and self-supporting, high-specific surface area.

title: A kind of lithium sulfur battery anode material and its lithium-sulfur cell
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of materials chemistry, it is specifically related to a kind of lithium sulfur battery anode material and its lithium-sulfur cell.This kind of lithium sulfur battery anode material, using being made following preparation method: utilizing N, dinethylformamide is as solvent, polyacrylonitrile and silica are dissolved in N in proportion, spinning precursor liquid is prepared in dinethylformamide solution, silicon dioxide-poly acrylonitril membrane is prepared using electrostatic spinning process, carbonization treatment is carried out to silicon dioxide-poly acrylonitril membrane and obtains carbon fiber-silicon dioxide composite material, then porous carbon fiber material is formed with hydrofluoric acid dips carbon fiber-silicon dioxide composite material, it finally carries out porous carbon fiber material and mixes sulphur, prepare situ Nitrogen Doping porous carbon sulphur positive electrode.The lithium sulfur battery anode material has porous structure, provides a large amount of ion channels and high-specific surface area, effectively improves the shuttle effect of polysulfide in lithium-sulfur cell, improve the utilization rate of active material in the cycle life and positive electrode of lithium-sulfur cell.

title: A kind of preoxidized polyacrylonitrile processing unit and method
abstract: Of the invention a kind of preoxidized polyacrylonitrile processing unit and method, belong to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation.Using moveable microwave oven (2), microwave oven (2) is synchronous with the wire travelling speed of polyacrylonitrile fibre (4) controllable, mobile heating furnace can form cross-ventilation with mobile polyacrylonitrile fibre, the reaction heat that side reaction can preferably be taken away, improves the quality of oxidization fiber.The controllable appearance sand hopper (3) of a rate of titration is fixed in the side of microwave oven (2), for titrating oxidizing agent solution on oxidization fiber, eliminates immersion and the complicated processes such as takes out again, avoid the artificial destruction to precursor structure.So that the oxygen molecule in oxidizing agent solution is participated in pre-oxidation in inside by the principle of microwave heating, preoxidation degree is made to reach the same outside and inside as far as possible, achievees the purpose that the present invention reduces skin and core effect.
assignee: 屈江妮
inventors: Qu Jiangni

title: A kind of composite reinforcing material and preparation method thereof with inierpeneirating network structure
abstract: The invention belongs to field of compound material, disclose a kind of composite reinforcing material and preparation method thereof with inierpeneirating network structure.Polyacrylonitrile is dissolved in organic solvent, metal_based material is then added and is uniformly mixed, obtains cortex solution；Water-soluble high-molecular material is dissolved in deionized water, ceramic based material is added and is uniformly mixed, obtains sandwich layer solution；By cortex solution and sandwich layer solution by electrostatic spinning, obtain with skin-core structure complex fiber material；Finally the composite reinforcing material with inierpeneirating network structure is obtained by pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment under an inert atmosphere.The present invention is by forming carbon fiber by subsequent high-temperature process after water-soluble high-molecular material molding, inierpeneirating network structure is formed with polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre, conducive to the infiltration of metal_based material and ceramic based material, the mechanical property of composite reinforcing material is greatly improved.
assignee: 华南理工大学
inventors: YAN YURONG; LI WEIPEI; WU SONGPING; HUANG CHUYUN; LIN CHAO; Zhang Shenkui; CHEN ZHUOWEN

title: A kind of preparation method of flexibility low softening point asphalt base nano carbon fibre non-woven fabrics
abstract: A kind of preparation method of flexibility low softening point asphalt base nano carbon fibre non-woven fabrics is that low softening point asphalt is carried out to liquid phase oxidation processing in oxidizing agent solution, low softening point asphalt after oxidation processes, polyacrylonitrile and the mixed liquor that is made of n,N-Dimethylformamide and tetrahydrofuran, which carry out electrostatic spinning, must come into being non-woven fabrics；As-spun fibre non-woven fabrics is subjected to pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment, obtains flexible low softening point asphalt base nano carbon fibre non-woven fabrics.The advantages of present invention has simple process and low cost, and flexible low softening point asphalt base nano carbon fibre non-woven fabrics can be realized through air curing and carbonization treatment.

title: A kind of preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-radical hollow mesoporous carbon fiber
abstract: A kind of preparation method the present invention provides polyacrylonitrile-radical hollow mesoporous carbon fiber is lignin and polyacrylonitrile to be dissolved in solvent in 25-80 DEG C of deaeration, obtained spinning solution passes through round spinneret and sprays into coagulating bath, heat is carried out in pure water to lead, hollow mesoporous as-spun fibre is obtained, obtains polyacrylonitrile-radical hollow mesoporous carbon fiber using washing, drying, pre-oxidation, carbonization.The advantages of present invention has centering macromolecular separation adsorption effect good, and solvent resistance is good, long service life.

title: A kind of electrode material for all-vanadium flow battery and its preparation and application
abstract: A kind of electrode material for all-vanadium flow battery after passing through mechanical carding networking or air lay by the polyacrylonitrile fibre oxidization fiber and pitch fibers oxidization fiber that will mix in proportion, is prepared through carbonization, graphitization and activation processing again through needle thorn.The mixed carbon fibre felt of preparation is due to the lower production cost of asphalt base carbon fiber, and compared with full Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber felt, electrode material cost can reduce by 1/3 or so；And there is lower bulk resistance and higher electro catalytic activity, and then reduce ohmic polarization and the activation polarization of all-vanadium flow battery, improve the voltage efficiency and energy efficiency of all-vanadium flow battery.

abstract: A kind of electrode material for all-vanadium flow battery after passing through mechanical carding networking or air lay by the polyacrylonitrile fibre oxidization fiber and pitch fibers oxidization fiber that will mix in proportion, is prepared through carbonization or graphitization processing again through needle thorn.The mixed carbon fibre felt of preparation is due to the lower production cost of asphalt base carbon fiber, and compared with full Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber felt, electrode material cost can reduce by 1/3 or so；And there is lower bulk resistance, and then reduce the internal resistance of cell of all-vanadium flow battery, improve the voltage efficiency and energy efficiency of all-vanadium flow battery.

title: A kind of positive electrode used for all-vanadium redox flow battery and its preparation and application
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of flow battery positive electrode and its preparation and application, the positive electrode is the mixed carbon fibre felt that porous polypropylene itrile group carbon fiber and porous asphalt base carbon fibre form, by being successively prepared through carbonization, activation and graphitization processing.The mixed carbon fibre felt of preparation is due to the lower production cost of asphalt base carbon fiber, and compared with full Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber felt, electrode material cost can reduce by 1/3 or so；And there is lower bulk resistance and higher electro catalytic activity and high inoxidizability, it is possible to reduce analysis oxygen side reaction improves the coulombic efficiency and cycle life of battery.

title: A kind of super-hydrophobic carbon-fiber film and preparation method thereof with nucleocapsid structure
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of super-hydrophobic carbon-fiber film and preparation method thereof with nucleocapsid structure.The present invention carries out liquid phase oxidation to raw coal using nitration mixture and obtains oxidized coal powder, and oxidized coal and polyacrylonitrile are dissolved in n,N-Dimethylformamide and are made into spinning solution；Spinning solution is spun by tunica fibrosa using method of electrostatic spinning, tunica fibrosa is pre-oxidized in air atmosphere；By chemical vapour deposition technique, pitch cracking is deposited on carbon fiber surface, the super-hydrophobic carbon-fiber film with nucleocapsid structure is obtained through high temperature carbonization.The water contact angle of gained carbon-fiber film is up to 159.5 °, and roll angle can keep ultra-hydrophobicity in strong acid, highly basic and organic solvent environment less than 3 ° for a long time.Gained carbon-fiber film of the invention has stronger oil and water separation capability, can be applied to the processing of oily waste water.
assignee: 新疆大学
inventors: WANG LUXIANG; Feng Shizhan; LUO WANXIA; JIA DIANZENG; JIA LIXIA

title: The preparation method and application of the continuous long yarns of electrospinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of preparation methods of the continuous long yarns of electrospinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre, comprising the following steps: a. prepares solution: polar solvent is added in raw material polyacrylonitrile, dissolution obtains uniform spinning polyacrylonitrile solution；B. electrostatic spinning: the solution that step a is obtained injects spinning appts, and the jet spinning in high voltage electric field is collected to obtain electrospinning polyacrylonitrile nanofiber felt with stainless (steel) wire band；C. it cuts drawing-off: the obtained nanofiber mats of step b being cut into elongate strip, and elongate strip is subjected to hot gas spring, obtain the height-oriented electrospinning polyacrylonitrile fibre beam of internal fiber；D. oxidation carbonization: the fibre bundle that step c is obtained is aoxidized 2~4 hours in air, is then carbonized 0.5~2 hour in argon gas, the height-oriented electrospinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre beam of internal fiber is obtained；E. twist yarns: the carbon nano-fiber beam that step d is obtained is twisted, and electrospinning polyacrylonitrile base nano carbon fibre continuously long yarns are obtained.

title: The cleaning method and fire resisting chemical fibre dimension, the manufacturing method of carbon fiber, graphitized fibre of resistance to cremator
abstract: Problem of the present invention is that the carbon fiber of high-quality can be obtained from after resistance to cremator is just restarted and become easy the cleaning in resistance to cremator, can shorten the cleaning method of resistance to cremator during stopping production by providing；With the manufacturing method with the manufacturing method and carbon fiber tieed up using this cleaning method come fire resisting chemical fibre the step of cleaning resistance to cremator.Solution of the invention is the cleaning method of resistance to cremator, it is the cleaning method that carbonized polyacrylonitrile fibre precursor fiber is carried out to the resistance to cremator of resistance to processing of cremating in oxidation atmosphere, aforementioned resistance to cremator is that have oxidizing gas in the resistance to cremator of the mechanism of inside circulation, after contacting liquid with the dust adhered on the wall surface of the resistance to cremator in such a way that the pressure in the direction vertical relative to wall surface reaches 2MPa or more, the liquid is discharged outside resistance to cremator, thus the dust removed from wall surface is discharged outside resistance to cremator, further, 40 DEG C of circulating temperature or more of the oxidizing gas in resistance to cremator.
assignee: 东丽株式会社
inventors: KUJI YUSUKE; YAMAMOTO WATARU; UCHIYAMA MASAOMI

title: A kind of preparation method of high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of preparation methods of high-performance mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers, phosphorus doping carbene quantum dot is prepared with potentiostatic electrolysis, the anode of electrolysis system is graphite rod, cathode is Pt electrode, it is filtered after electrolysis by micropore filtering film, filtrate is obtained, obtains the solid of phosphorus doping carbene quantum dot through deionized water washing and drying, vacuum drying.Mesophase pitch is modified by phosphorus doping carbene quantum dot, disperses phosphorus doping carbene quantum dot configuration concentration with toluene, then carry out spinning after stirring under 280-350oC mixed inert atmosphere with mesophase pitch.Pre-oxidation treatment, low-temperature carbonization processing and continuous graphitization is carried out after spinning to handle to obtain mesophase pitch-based carbon fibers.The modulus of the carbon fiber of Ben Faken preparation is 800-960GPa, and thermal conductivity 600-900W/mK, fiber interface is typical radial structure, and there is no splittings, and processing performance is good, is a kind of good " carbon transfer roller " reinforcing material.
assignee: 湖南东映碳材料科技有限公司

title: Manufacturing method of flexible conductive carbon cloth
abstract: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of flexible conductive carbon cloth, and belongs to the technical field of functional carbon fiber preparation. The flexible conductive carbon cloth is prepared by pre-oxidizing Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) base or viscose base precursor to obtain pre-oxidized fibers, then chopping or breaking the pre-oxidized fibers into short fibers, spinning and weaving, and performing high-temperature carbonization through special procedures. According to the invention, the process parameters are optimized, so that the prepared flexible conductive carbon cloth is suitable for different use environments, can be widely applied to the fields of military affairs, medical care, environmental protection, automobiles and the like, is economical in cost, environment-friendly in process and beneficial to industrial popularization.

title: Method for cleaning flameproofing furnace, method for manufacturing flameproof fiber, carbon fiber, and graphitized fiber
abstract: [PROBLEMS]It is to provide a method for cleaning an oxidation oven, which can obtain a high-quality carbon fiber immediately after re-operating the oxidation oven, can easily clean the inside of the oxidation oven, and can reduce a period in which production is stopped, a method for producing an oxidized fiber and a method for producing a carbon fiber including the step of cleaning the oxidation oven using the cleaning method.[SOLUTIONS]A method for cleaning an oxidation oven for subjecting a polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber to an oxidation treatment in an oxidizing atmosphere, wherein: the oxidation oven has a mechanism for circulating an oxidizing gas internally; and the method comprising the steps of: causing a liquid to come in contact with dust adhering to a wall surface of the oxidation oven so that pressure in a direction perpendicular to the wall surface is 2 MPa or more; discharging the liquid out of the oxidation oven to discharge the dust peeled off from the wall surface out of the oxidation oven; and circulating an oxidizing gas having a temperature of 40°C or higher in the oxidation oven.

title: Densification of polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: Provided herewith is a process for improving tensile strength of precursor PAN fiber during the spinning stage in the manufacturing process. According to the process of the present invention, precursor fiber is made denser as it enters each wash bath. This progressive densification approach is useful for all PAN precursor bath draw/wash processes where a need for careful control of fiber network density and structure is required for improved carbon fiber properties.

title: Precursor stabilisation process
abstract: The invention relates to an improved process for forming a stabilised precursor that is suitable for the manufacture of carbon materials, such as carbon fibre. The process can convert a precursor comprising polyacrylonitrile into a stabilised precursor with greater efficiency. The invention also relates to a process for preparing a carbon fibre that utilises the stabilised precursor.

title: Carbon fiber and method for manufacturing same
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of obtaining a carbon fiber that shows high dispersibility in a molding process for producing a carbon fiber-reinforced composite material and in a molded article obtained as a final product. The carbon fiber according to the present invention is a carbon fiber having a single fiber length of 10 cm or less wherein, when single fibers thereof are observed within a scope of a linear distance of 1 mm from the side surface thereof, the fluctuation width of the fiber axis is 2.5 μm or more and the coefficient of variation of the fluctuation width is not greater than 100%. This carbon fiber is manufactured by a method which comprises subjecting a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle successively to flame proofing, preliminary carbonization and carbonization treatments in this order and then cutting the thus obtained carbon fiber bundle in the form of a continuous fiber, wherein, in the carbonization treatment, the number of twists of the fiber bundle is adjusted to 16 turns/m or greater or the twist angle on the fiber bundle surface is adjusted to 2.0° or greater.

title: Carbon fiber bundle and production method therefor
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of obtaining carbon fibers, which are suitable for reducing molding costs and improving performance of carbon fiber-reinforced composite materials that have a highly heat-resistant resin as the matrix and in which bundling properties and heat stability coexist in a highly balanced manner. For this carbon fiber bundle: when one end is a fixed end and the other end is a free end, twisting of at least 2 turns/m remains; single fibers have a specified diameter; and the carbon fiber bundle has a specified weight loss on heating. In the carbon fiber bundle, the crystallite size L c  and the degree of crystal orientation π 002  obtained from bulk measurement of the fiber bundle as a whole satisfy a specified expression. The present invention is also a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle, in which single fibers have a specified diameter and which has a specified weight loss on heating, the method performing flameproofing, preliminary carbonization, and carbonization in order on a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, wherein the number of fiber bundle twists in the carbonization is at least 2 turns/m and tension is at least 1.5 mN/dtex. The present invention is also a carbon fiber bundle, for which, when one end is a fixed end and the other end is a free end, a twisting angle of at least 0.2° remains in the surface layer of the fiber bundle, in which single fibers have a specified diameter, and which has a specified weight loss on heating, wherein the crystallite size L c  and the degree of crystal orientation π 002  obtained from bulk measurement of the fiber bundle as a whole satisfy a specified expression. The present invention is also a method for producing a carbon fiber bundle, for which, when one end is a fixed end and the other end is a free end, a twisting angle of at least 0.2° remains in the surface layer of the fiber bundle, in which single fibers have a specified diameter, and which has a specified weight loss on heating, the method performing flameproofing, preliminary carbonization, and carbonization in order on a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor fiber bundle, wherein the tension in the carbonization is at least 1.5 mN/dtex.

title: A kind of preparation method for being copolymerized the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber that sequence is evenly distributed
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of preparation method for being copolymerized the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber that sequence is evenly distributed, including：Kettle number N of connecting determines；3rd comonomer subregion charge proportion determines；Precipitation polymerization is carried out by medium of water, dries obtained polyacrylonitrile powder；Then dissolving prepares spinning solution, and the spinneret after removing bubble and filtering, solidification forming is as-spun fibre, and polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors are made through washing and post-processing；Most afterwards through pre-oxidizing, carbonizing and high-performance carbon fibre is made in last handling process.The present invention uses CSTR in series formula polymer reactor, and by the 3rd comonomer subregion, feeding strategy, acquisition are copolymerized the PAN copolymer that sequence is evenly distributed in proportion.The copolymerization sequence distributing homogeneity of polyacrylonitrile fibril is better, fiber in preoxidation process " core-skin " structure can be more avoided to occur, be advantageous to diffusion of the oxygen in fiber radial direction, maintain pre-oxidation steadily progress and radiating control, the carbon fiber of final obtained excellent performance.

title: A kind of method that high-strength high-modules carbon fibre is prepared using precursor stretching technique
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of method that high strength high modulus carbon fiber is produced using precursor stretching technique, this method includes spinning solution preparation and wet spinning, as-spun fibre solidification are drawn into the steps such as protofilament, fiber preoxidation and carbonization with steam drafting processing, precursor.The present invention can efficiently reduce fiber again in precursor preparation process the defects of microstructure, and compared with not applying this process of fiber, pre-oxidation is further improved with fiber-wall-element model degree, and carbonized fiber mechanical property significantly improves；Because fiber stretches again more than glass transition temperature so that fibre number reduces, and specific surface area increases in high-temperature process, is effectively improved heat treatment efficiency；Handled by present invention process, it will be apparent that improve fiber quality.

title: A kind of flexibility carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of flexible carbon fibers and preparation method thereof, the carbon fiber is that graphite flake/polyacrylonitrile composite solution is made by solution-polymerized SBR, super-high power drawing-off, pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment, there is the carbon fiber graphite microcrystalline structure that height-oriented graphite flake and its induction generate, the graphite microcrystal to be orientated along graphite flake surface alignment；The carbon fiber has the characteristics that order degree is big, compact structure, average grain size is small and defect is few, and the rigid softness of flexible carbon fiber prepared by the present invention is 10 ‑4 ~10mNcm, resistivity 10 ‑3 ~100 Ω cm, intensity are 1000~5000MPa, and the thermal coefficient of fiber axial direction is 0.5~50W/mk.Flexible carbon fiber production cost prepared by the present invention is low, and raw material sources are extensive, and the structural behaviour of carbon fiber can be substantially improved, and has very high market application value, can be widely applied to the fields such as electrode material, functional material and energy and material.

title: Prepare the method for pre-oxidizing of large-tow carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to organic polymer field, specifically a kind of method for pre-oxidizing for preparing large-tow carbon fiber includes the following steps：Big tow polyacrylonitrile copolymer fibre is pre-oxidized in 180~280 DEG C of temperature ranges in air atmosphere, 60~90min is heat-treated using 3 sections of gradient increased temperature modes, temperature gradient is 15 ± 2 DEG C, oxidation furnace circulated air blast velocity control is in 6 ± 2m/s, under -2~2% draw ratio, it is 1.35 ± 0.02g/cm that density, which is made, 3 Pre-oxidized fibers.Using conventional silicon carbide condition：Under nitrogen protection, under -2~2% draw ratio, 3 ± 1.5min of low-temperature carbonization at 300~900 DEG C, by gained fiber, 3 ± 1.5min of high temperature cabonization, draw ratio are -5~0% at 1000~1500 DEG C.The present invention carrys out the perfect pre-oxidized fibers of preparation structure, to prepare high-performance large-tow carbon fiber by controlling Pre oxidation gradient, oxidation furnace circulation wind speed and obtained oxidization fiber density.

title: A kind of preparation method of high modulus pitch-based carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of preparation methods of high modulus pitch-based carbon fiber, include the following steps：(1) it is pre-processed by raw material high-pressure hydrogenation of catalytic slurry, Hydrogen Vapor Pressure is 12~18MPa, and reaction temperature is 420~450 DEG C, reacts 1~3h, obtains hydrogenation products；(2) >=400 DEG C of fractions, inert gas or nitrogen atmosphere are isolated in vacuum distillation, and 460~500 DEG C of reaction temperature reacts 6~8h, obtains a polycondensation product；(3) nitrogen, 5~8L/ of nitrogen flow rate (skg) are passed through under normal pressure, 450~500 DEG C of reaction temperature reacts 4~6h, obtains good mesophase pitch；(4) the mesophase pitch melt spinning that upper step obtains is obtained into high modulus carbon fiber through pre-oxidation, carbonization, graphitization.

title: Preparation method of low-ash polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-ash polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. In the preparation process of the polyacrylonitrile protofilament, the oiling treatment is carried out by adopting a high heat resistance silicone-oil-free agent. The high-heat-resistance silicone-oil-free agent is prepared from a macromolecular saturated linear monoester with a carbon atom number of more than or equal to 15, a hindered phenol antioxidant and a surfactant according to the weight ratio of (90-100): (10-15): (23-30). All the components are mixed, stirred and dispersed uniformly to obtain the high heat resistance silicone oil-free agent. According to the invention, the high-heat-resistance silicone-oil-free agent is adopted for oiling treatment in the production process of the carbon fiber precursor, the oil content of the precursor is reasonably controlled through the heated volatilization rate of the oil agent in the subsequent carbonization working section, and instantaneous waste discharge is realized in the carbonization working section, so that the ash content in the fiber and on the surface of the fiber is effectively controlled, and the ash content of the carbon fiber can be controlled below 25 ppm. The method is suitable for spinning by a wet method or a dry-jet wet method, and is suitable for different K-bundle carbon fibers.

title: A kind of preparation method of the fiber-loaded palladium catalyst of coal-based carbon
abstract: The present invention provides a kind of preparation method of the fiber-loaded palladium catalyst of coal-based carbon.This method is first using coal as carbon source, through pre-oxidation treatment, oxidized coal is made, oxidized coal and polyacrylonitrile are configured to certain density spinning solution, using method of electrostatic spinning, control voltage, spinning solution inject speed, receive the parameters such as distance, prepare carbon fiber precursor, then charing process is carried out, prepares the coal-based carbon fiber of size uniform；Again using the coal-based carbon fiber of preparation as carrier, using palladium bichloride as palladium source, ethylene glycol be reducing agent under conditions of prepare the fiber-loaded palladium catalyst of coal-based carbon.The obtained fiber-loaded palladium catalyst of coal-based carbon has good Oxidation of Formic Acid electrocatalysis characteristic.The present invention high-performance carbon fibre composite of preparation, not only has potential application prospect using the coal resources of rich reserves as carbon source in terms of fuel cell, and realizes the high value added utilization of coal, thus has important practical significance.

title: A kind of method for improving polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre intensity
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre intensity.This method is by polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre by going out oxidation furnace and going out to enter the environment for controlling humiture after low temperature carbonization furnace at once in tow, tow is avoided to enter a series of caused moisture absorption effects after wet environment, and tow is set the moisture transient evaporation that absorbs and to be combined after high temperature cabonization fire door is entered with the carbon atom in fiber, discharge the gases such as CO, so as to leave defect or hole on tow surface or inside, the performances such as low-fiber intensity drop.The method of the present invention can avoid the fluctuation that the change because of ambient temperature and humidity is brought to performances such as carbon fiber strengths, so that obtained carbon fiber pore quantity is few, quality is homogeneous, discrete small, the function admirable such as intensity.

title: For making the carbon fiber felt processing method of carbon fiber battery grid
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of for making the carbon fiber processing method of carbon fiber battery grid, this method is handled by following procedures realization：Make pre-oxidation treatment under the conditions of 220~240 DEG C first, then the carbonization treatment under the conditions of 1500~1600 DEG C, surface chemistry plating is finally carried out in 1~3 day before grid is made, the carbon fiber felt material is polyacrylonitrile-radical, and felt technique productions are pierced using needle.Carbon fiber felt surface chemical plating includes immersion, airing, drying, baking and cooling treatment.Using the carbon fiber battery that the present invention makes, dynamic charging receives current value ratio standard value and is higher by about 15%, and it is high by 100% that static state charging receives current value ratio standard value.In addition, the carbon fiber felt handled in grid using the present invention, it is relatively secured in the active material that carbon fiber surface bonds, on the one hand reduce cracking, the amount of coming off, on the other hand active material is also significantly slowed by sulfation rate, result significantly improves the service life of Accessory Battery.

abstract: The invention discloses methods and carbon fiber that a kind of biomass extract and polyacrylonitrile cospinning prepare carbon fiber.This method extracts biomass material using organic solvent, obtains soluble low molecular weight extract under room temperature, prepares spinning solution followed by high molecular weight extract, polyacrylonitrile and spin solvent, heating water bath simultaneously stirs, then electrostatic spinning；Finally, spun silk is subjected to oxidation and high temperature cabonization obtains carbon fiber.The present invention provides a kind of carbon fiber prepare path, cost of material it is cheap compared with traditional carbon fibres preparation process raw material and can the higher PAN precursor of partial alternative cost, preparation process is relatively simple, and environmental pollution is relatively small.Also, gained carbon fiber quality of the invention is good, possesses flourishing pore structure, specific surface area reaches as high as 836.82m 2 / g reaches as high as 188.41cm than volume 3 / g has good economic benefit and application prospect.

title: A kind of big tow PAN-based stabilized fiber, large-tow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of big tow PAN-based stabilized fibers, large-tow carbon fiber and preparation method thereof.Preparation method includes the following steps：1. after opening electron accelerator, big tow polyacrylonitrile fibre is made to carry out continous way irradiation reaction；Radiation absorber dose rate is 50 2 × 10 6 Gy/s, it is 20 3000kGy that irradiation, which absorbs accumulated dose,；2. irradiation after big tow polyacrylonitrile fibre carried out at 180 280 DEG C the pre-oxidation of 15 75min to get.Carbon fiber is made by PAN-based stabilized fiber through carbonization treatment.The preparation method of the present invention can substantially reduce thermal discharge of the polyacrylonitrile fibre in preoxidation process, reduce Pre oxidation, reduce energy consumption, while introducing oxygen element, solve the problems, such as that oxygen is spread, and reduce preoxidation time；The density of PAN-based stabilized fiber of the present invention is high, and fibre strength is high, and follow-up obtained carbon fibre material is had excellent performance.

title: A kind of electrostatic screen graphene-carbon fiber composite membrane and preparation method
abstract: The invention belongs to field of compound material, provide that there are less efficient defects for current graphene mutually overlapped conductive network, the present invention proposes a kind of electrostatic screen graphene carbon composite fiber membrane and preparation method, by polyacrylonitrile（PAN）Electrostatic spinning is carried out after being dissolved in dimethylformamide, PAN nanofibers are made；After gained PAN nanofibers are carried out pre-oxidation treatment, it is hybridly prepared into dispersion liquid 1 with oleic acid, graphene, water, glass micro mist, polyvinyl alcohol are configured to dispersion liquid 2；Dispersion liquid 1 is added in dispersion liquid 2; it is uniformly brushed after silicon nitride ceramic substrate on piece, standing, is further heated up under nitrogen protection so that PAN and oleic acid carbonization; glass micro mist is melted connects film forming by the Graphene powder of dispersion, finally obtained graphene carbon composite fiber membrane.

title: A kind of preparation method of high-modulus high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of preparation methods of high-modulus high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber, ethylene bottom oil pitch of the softening point at 80~90 DEG C is prepared by the method that normal pressure nitrogen is bubbled purging first, then triethyl borate is added thereto, then prepares boracic by pressurization thermal polymerization and the method for depressurizing devolatilization and can spin mesophase pitch；High-modulus high heat conduction pitch based carbon fiber sample is prepared through melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization and graphitization again, stretch modulus is 800~900GPa, thermal conductivity is 800~1000W/mK.Boron element is introduced by the method for chemical reaction in interphase spinning asphalt by the present invention, realizes the addition of boron element uniform, controllable, solves the problems, such as that the addition of conventional method boron element is uneven；Boron element effectively opens the effect of catalyzed graphitization in the preparation process of follow-up pitch based carbon fiber, to reduce graphitization processing temperature, extends the graphitizing furnace service life, reduces production cost.

title: A kind of preparation method of the carbon-fiber film of the N doping containing tin nanoparticles
abstract: The present invention provides a kind of preparation method of the carbon-fiber film of the N doping containing tin nanoparticles, includes the following steps：Stannic chloride is added in polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate and is uniformly mixed to transparent and homogeneous colloidal, spinning solution is formed and stanniferous carbon matrix precursor tunica fibrosa is prepared through electrostatic spinning；It is placed in stanniferous carbon matrix precursor tunica fibrosa stress in vacuum heating system, is passed through the mixed gas containing ammonia, after high temperature carbonization processing, pickling obtains the carbon fiber of the N doping containing tin nanoparticles；The carbon fiber of N doping containing tin nanoparticles is scattered in water under the action of ultrasonic wave and forms mixed solution, mixed solution is placed between the tablet moulded board containing filter screen, slow drainage carries out press curing, obtains the carbon-fiber film of the N doping containing tin nanoparticles.Carbon fiber prepared by the present invention has ideal specific surface area and nitrogen, and the carbon-fiber film of preparation is close, and fibre density is big, has excellent absorption property and catalytic performance.

abstract: The present invention relates to it is a kind of characterization polyacrylonitrile fibril for carbon fiber internal stress method, the specific steps are：Intercept 1 meter of long polyacrylonitrile fibril, heat treatment 2~60 minutes is carried out in air atmosphere with baking oven, heat treatment temperature is usually arranged as 140~280 DEG C, precursor both ends are marked before heat treatment, distance is indicated with L1 between label, distance is indicated with L2 between measuring both ends label after heat treatment ,/L1 × 100 percent thermal shrinkage %=(L1 L2).Be mainly characterized by solving the problems, such as polyacrylonitrile fibril boiling water shrinkage and the pre-oxidation process of the application can not efficient association, solves the problems, such as internal stress test from precursor internal stress principle, precursor index and the relevance of pre-oxidation process are established, solves the blindness sex chromosome mosaicism of technology establishment.

title: A kind of preparation method of high intensity coal measures isotropic pitch base carbon fibre
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of production methods of high intensity isotropic pitch base carbon fibre：Using ashless coal as pitch precursor, its fugitive constituent component is removed using the method for thin film evaporation, control asphalt softening point obtains spinning asphalt, carbon fiber then is prepared through melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonization technique at 180~260 DEG C；By coal and 1 methyl naphthalene in mass ratio 1:2~1:10 ratios mix, and are 350~410 DEG C in temperature, and pressure is to carry out solvent extraction under 1~5MPa to react 1~5h, then obtain ashless coal after separation of solid and liquid, thermal air pressure filtration, solvent recovery.Most its carbon fiber is prepared through techniques such as melt spinning, pre-oxidation, carbonizations afterwards.The present invention produces the universal pitch-based carbon fiber with excellent performance index, its tensile strength is up to 1500MPa using coal as raw material, has larger market prospects and economic benefit.

abstract: The present invention provides a kind of methods that deep oxidation-catalyzed polycondensation prepares mesophase pitch and carbon fiber.This method is cross-linking modified to raw material progress deep oxidation using air method is blown using naphthene base crude or intermediate base crude as raw material, obtains modified feedstock；With ZrO 2 For catalyst, modified feedstock and catalyst are mixed with mesophase pitch.By prepared mesophase pitch melt spinning, high modulus carbon fiber is prepared.This method technological process is simple, and used catalyst is corrosion-free to consersion unit, and reaction carries out at a lower temperature, not harsh to equipment requirement；Mesophase pitch softening point obtained is suitable, can meet the requirement of spinnability and pre-oxidation temperature simultaneously：220~260 DEG C, interphase content>98%, there is the streamlined optical texture of big wide area, the precursor of spinning to have excellent mechanical property after pre-oxidation, charing, graphitization processing.

title: A kind of preparation method of high antioxidant borosilicate doping carbon fiber
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of production methods of special fibre, and the preparation method of carbon fiber is adulterated more particularly, to a kind of high antioxidant borosilicate.Include the following steps：Step 1：It takes polyacrylonitrile powder to be dissolved in organic solvent, polyborosiloxane is then added into polyacrylonitrile solution, polyborosiloxane modified polyacrylonitrile solution is obtained after being uniformly dispersed；Step 2：The polyborosiloxane modified polyacrylonitrile solution obtained obtains polyborosiloxane modified polyacrylonitrile as-spun fibre as spinning solution, through dry spinning；Step 3：By as-spun fibre be placed in pre-oxidation furnace, low-temperature carbonization furnace and high temperature carbonization furnace pre-oxidized respectively, low-temperature carbonization and high temperature cabonization, obtain high antioxidant borosilicate doping carbon fiber.The present invention has the advantages that：（1）Reaction raw materials safety；（2）Byproduct of reaction is free from environmental pollution；（3）Reaction step is simple；（4）The fiber of gained has oxidation resistent susceptibility.

abstract: The present invention relates to a preparation method of precursor fibers for carbon fibers, and precursor fibers for carbon fibers produced thereby. More specifically, the present invention relates to a preparation method of precursor fibers for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, in which the surface of precursor fibers is treated with an aqueous ammonia solution prior to an application of an oiling agent, such that coating of the oiling agent on the surface of the precursor fibers is promoted upon the application of the oiling agent. According to the present invention, the preparation method promotes a crosslinking reaction of a silicon oiling agent and prevents the oiling agent from separating from the surface of the precursor fibers, thereby enabling high elongation. title: Carbon fibers having improved strength and modulus and an associated method and apparatus for preparing same
abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

title: Preparation method for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method for a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The third monomer of a protofilament spinning raw material, i.e., polyacrylonitrile resin, is itaconic acid; a spinning solution is prepared from the resin by using DMSO or DMAc, and spinning and solidification are carried out so as to prepare a nascent fiber. The nascent fiber successively undergoes the following procedures: water bath drafting in an aqueous solution of a spinning solvent; drip washing with deionized water; dipping in a buffer solution containing acid A and salt B, wherein A is sulfuric acid, hydrochloric acid or nitric acid, and B is a sodium salt or a sylvite of A; water bath drafting in pure water; dipping in an acidic aqueous solution; and hot bath rinsing with deionized water until rinsing liquid is neutral. A carbon fiber protofilament is prepared by subjecting the nascent fiber to post-processing procedures like oiling and dry densification. The protofilament undergoes pre-oxidation in an aerobic atmosphere under the condition of drafting and then undergoes carbonization in an anoxic atmosphere under the condition of drafting so as to obtain a finished product of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of morphology controllable metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a morphology controllable metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material, and relates to a preparation method of a combination electrode material, for solving the problem that the specific capacitance value of a composite material cannot be improved through changing morphology by use of a conventional metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material. The method comprises the following steps: taking polyacrylonitrile and nitrate with different mass ratios as raw materials, preparing metal iron-doped polyacrylonitrile fibers by use of electrostatic spinning, and preparing metal oxide/polyacrylonitrile-based active carbon fibers through pre-oxidation and carbonization. According to the invention, spinning is carried out by adding the nitrate, the nitrate forms the tadpole-like short fibers after being stretched, the morphology is continued through a pre-oxidation and carbonization process, the fibers are wound on the surfaces of the active carbon fibers or scattered among the active carbon fibers, the specific surface area of the active carbon fibers is increased, the surface utilization rate is enhanced, and the prepared active carbon fibers have quite high specific capacitance. The method provided by the invention is applied to preparation of metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode materials with different morphologies.

title: Method for preparing high-performance ZnO/asphalt carbon/carbon fiber composite material for lithium-ion-battery negative electrode
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of energy and chemical industry and carbon nanometer material crossing, and relates to a method for preparing a high-performance ZnO/asphalt carbon/carbon fiber composite material for a lithium-ion-battery negative electrode. The method includes the steps that mixed fibers of zinc acetate and polyacrylonitrile are prepared through electrostatic spinning, a fiber material is modified by dropwise adding petroleum asphalt rich in arene, and preoxidation and carbonization are carried out, and the ZnO/asphalt carbon/carbon fiber composite material is prepared. The ZnO/asphalt carbon/carbon fiber composite material has the high specific capacitance of metal oxide, the high conductivity of carbon fibers and coating and connecting functions of asphalt carbon, has the excellent performance of being high in specific capacitance, good in cycling stability and the like when being used as the lithium-ion-secondary-battery negative electrode material, and is a novel quite-potential high-performance lithium-ion-battery negative electrode. The method has the advantages that the advantages of ZnO, the carbon fibers and asphalt carbon are coupled, and the ZnO/asphalt carbon/carbon fiber composite material with the excellent electrochemical performance is built. Asphalt is low in cost and easy to obtain, the preparing method is simple, and a novel way is hopefully developed for high-value-added environment-friendly applications of petroleum asphalt.

title: Method used for preparing multilayer flexible polyacrylonitrile/bitumen carbon fiber composite material used for lithium ion battery negative electrodes via electrostatic spinning
abstract: The invention belongs to the crossing field of petrochemical engineering and carbon nano, and relates to a method used for preparing a multilayer flexible polyacrylonitrile/bitumen carbon fiber composite material used for lithium ion battery negative electrodes via electrostatic spinning. The method comprises following steps: firstly, electrostatic spinning is adopted to prepare polyacrylonitrile fiber, a mixed solution of deoiled bitumen and polyvinylpyrrolidone is subjected to electrostatic spinning so as to prepare a blend fiber which is collected on the polyacrylonitrile fiber, the former steps are repeated so as to obtain a polyacrylonitrile/bitumen composite fiber material with a multilayer structure, and pre-oxidation and carbonization are carried out so as to obtain the multilayer flexible polyacrylonitrile/bitumen carbon fiber composite material. According to the method, polyvinylpyrrolidone is capable of improving the spinnability of the deoiled bitumen solution, the polyacrylonitrile fiber is capable of supporting molten deoiled bitumen in heat processing process, so that the composite carbon material with excellent flexibility is prepared, and when the multilayer flexible polyacrylonitrile/bitumen carbon fiber composite material is taken as a lithium ion secondary battery negative electrode material, excellent performance such as high specific capacitance and excellent cycling stability is achieved. The major characteristics of the method are that: deoiled bitumen and polyvinylpyrrolidone are used for preparing the blend fiber via electrostatic spinning, and the multilayer flexible polyacrylonitrile/bitumen carbon fiber composite material is prepared based on the supporting effect of polyacrylonitrile fiber.

title: Rapid preoxidation process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid pre-oxidation process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors. The process comprises the steps of heating polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor to the initial temperature of 240-260 ℃ at the temperature of 10-15 ℃ in a heating gradient, controlling the total pre-oxidation time to be 33-40 min, heating to 270-290 ℃, and controlling hot air to be 7000-12000 m in the pre-oxidation process 3 The circulation volume/h is blown down perpendicular to the running direction of the tow. The method adopts hot air circulation treatment, greatly shortens the pre-oxidation time, shortens the traditional pre-oxidation time of more than 60min to within 40min, and effectively reduces the energy consumption. abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

abstract: The manufacture method of a kind of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre, the Third monomer of its precursor spinning material polyacrylonitrile resin is furoate clothing, and resin DMSO or DMAC is configured to spinning solution, prepares as-spun fibre through spray webbing and solidification forming.As-spun fibre passes through subsequently: carry out water-bath drawing-off in the aqueous solution of spin solvent；Use deionized water drip washing；It is placed in acidic aqueous solution dipping 2～10min；It is placed in sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide aqueous solution dipping 1～5min；Water-bath drawing-off is carried out in pure water；Carry out hot bath rinsing with deionized water, be further continued for rinsing 5～15min in neutrality and after not measuring sodium ion or potassium ion to rinsing liquid.As-spun fibre is again through oiling and the last handling process such as compacting by drying prepares carbon fibre precursor, precursor pre-oxidizes in having oxygen atmosphere when imposing drawing-off, carry out carbonization again when imposing drawing-off in an oxygen-free atmosphere, obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre finished product.

title: A kind of preoxidized polyacrylonitrile treating apparatus and method
abstract: A kind of preoxidized polyacrylonitrile treating apparatus of the present invention and method, belong to technical field prepared by carbon fiber.Adopt moveable microwave oven (2), the wire travelling speed of microwave oven (2) and polyacrylonitrile fibre (4) is synchronously controlled, the heating furnace of movement can form cross-ventilation with the polyacrylonitrile fibre of movement, the reaction heat of side reaction can be taken away better, improve the quality of oxidization fiber.The controlled appearance sand hopper (3) of a rate of titration is fixed in the side of microwave oven (2), is used for titration oxidizing agent solution on oxidization fiber, eliminates immersion and the complicated processes such as to take out again, avoid the artificial destruction to precursor structure.Make the oxygen molecule in oxidizing agent solution participate in pre-oxidation in inside by the principle of heating using microwave, make preoxidation degree reach the same outside and inside as far as possible, reach the object that the present invention reduces skin and core effect.

title: The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile-radical nanoporous carbon fiber being pore-foaming agent with caged silsesquioxane and goods thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to preparation method and the goods thereof of polyacrylonitrile (PAN) the base nanoporous carbon fiber that one is pore-foaming agent with caged silsesquioxane (POSS), its preparation method comprises the preparation of step (1) polyacrylonitrile and caged silsesquioxane blend solution; (2) electrostatic spinning prepares nanoporous carbon fibre precursor; (3) pre-oxidation of nanoporous carbon fibre precursor; (4) nanoporous carbon fiber is prepared in charing.The method simple process, energy consumption cost are low, the method gained nanoporous carbon fiber product size is controlled, average diameter is about 100 ~ 1000 nanometers, aperture is 5-200 nanometer, and can according to PAN/POSS content than regulation and control aperture size, have that specific area is large, chemical stability good, high length-diameter ratio, be applicable to continuous seepage.

abstract: The present invention relates to the preparation method of a kind of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors, after polyacrylonitrile spinning solution wire vent, adopt and be introduced into one section of non-condensable bath, then the combination coagulation forming technique entered in precipitation bath. Comprise the steps: that vinyl cyanide spinning solution is after combination coagulation forming technique coagulation forming specifically, successively through drawing-off, wash, oil, dry, steam drafting or boiling water drawing-off, heat setting type, baking step, finally receive silk. The present invention can overcome the shortcoming of conventional dry wet method and wet processing, is conducive to control precursor cortex construction. What adopt that this technique can realize being greater than 300m/min spins speed, and the precursor obtained has the surface groove structures of similar wet method precursor, and feel is soft, and fibrillation is good, and after carbonization, intensity is higher than 5.8GPa. title: A kind of preparation method of carbon fiber PAN polymer
abstract: The invention provides the preparation method of a kind of carbon fiber polyacrylonitrile (PAN) polymer.The method uses aqueous deposited polymerization reaction, using water solublity ammonium sulfate sodium sulfite ferrous sulfate as redox initiation system, using itaconic acid monoesters as difunctional comonomer, with sulphuric acid as pH adjusting agent；Difunctional comonomer and acrylonitrile use ammonia that reaction system carries out basification after carrying out precipitating copolyreaction in aqueous phase, then separating, washing is with dry, obtains PAN polymer powders.The method low cost, polymerization reaction time is short, production efficiency is high, and the PAN polymer purity height, spinnability and the pre-oxidation controllability that prepare are good, are therefore that one is applicable to large-scale production carbon fibre precursor, advantageously reduce the preparation method of carbon fiber production cost.

abstract: The present invention relates to the preparation method of a kind of carbon fibre precursor ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer; under nitrogen protective condition; acrylonitrile, itaconic acid, dispersant and water are mixed, is warming up to 60 75 DEG C, is added dropwise to initiator solution, acrylamide aqueous solution the most successively; clock reaction 3 24h after dropping; washing, de-single, filter; it is dried, to obtain final product.The present invention uses aqueous suspension polymerization method to be polymerized, and polymerization reaction heat is prone to get rid of, and polymerization temperature is easily controlled, and product mean molecule quantity is higher, narrow molecular weight distribution；Polyacrylonitrile copolymer prepared by the present invention can be effectively improved its thermal stability in the high temperature pre-oxidation stage, has certain actual application prospect.

title: Preparation method of composite carbon nanofibers with high specific surface area
abstract: A preparation method of composite carbon nanofibers with a high specific surface area relates to the technical field of preparation of electrode materials of super capacitors, and comprises the following steps: mixing cellulose acetate and polyacrylonitrile to obtain a spinning solution; carrying out electrospinning to obtain CA/PAN precursors; pre-oxidazing the CA/PAN precursors; carrying out carbonization and actification to obtain CA/PAN activated carbon fibers; mixing the CA/PAN activated carbon fibers with acetylene black, PTFE and ethanol to obtain a mixture; putting the mixture into an oven; drying the mixture into paste; smearing the paste on nickel foam; carrying out drying and tabletting to obtain the CA/PAN composite carbon fiber electrode material. As cellulose acetate contains a large quantity of oxygen-containing groups, and has double functions of pore-forming and chemical surface modification, the hole structure, the specific capacitance and the specific surface area are greatly improved.

title: Pre-carbonization device of high compactness polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to a pre-carbonization device of a high compactness polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and a preparation method, and mainly solves the technical problem of low compactness of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. By adopting a section of new heat treatment process between pre-oxidation and low temperature carbonization, the method is characterized by comprising the steps of: (1) protofilament preparation; (2) a pre-oxidation process; (3) a pre-carbonization process; (4) a low-temperature carbonization process; and (5) a high-temperature carbonization process. A section of pre-carbonization process is added at the end of the pre-oxidation process and before the low-temperature carbonization process, the pre-carbonization process is carried out in nitrogen atmosphere, the temperature is controlled in the range of 120DEG C-300DEG C, a first temperature zone is adopted, the treatment time is 1min-10min, or gradient warming from the second temperature zone to the fifth temperature zone is employed, the duration of each temperature zone is 1min-5min, and the draw ratio is controlled from -5% to 5%. The technical scheme well solves the problem, and can be used for the industrial production of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor by inorganic solvent method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor by an inorganic solvent method. The method employs an inorganic solvent for solution polymerization, and at the same time, a NaSCN aqueous solution is taken as a coagulating agent for spinning to prepare the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor. According to the method, by controlling concentration (total solid) of a polymer solution at a polymerization phase and using an appropriate molecular weight conditioning agent, the polymer solution with high molecular weight, low concentration and low viscosity can be obtained, then a homogeneous spinning stock solution with high concentration can be obtained through steps of multistage dehydrating under decompression and deaeration; finally the spinning stock solution is solidified through coagulation bath to form nascent fiber, and the nascent fiber is post-processed to prepare a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor finished product. The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor has the advantage of higher quality and stabilization.

title: Polyacrylonitrile mesoporous activated carbon fiber for super capacitor electrode and preparation method of fiber
abstract: The invention provides polyacrylonitrile mesoporous activated carbon fiber for a super capacitor electrode and a preparation method of the fiber. The preparation method comprises the steps that a pore-forming agent organic compound and/or a high polymer are/is added to a solvent, the mixture is mixed at the temperature of 50 DEG C to 80 DEG C by 3-24 hours, and a solution containing a pore-forming agent is obtained; polyacrylonitrile pulp is mixed with the solution containing the pore-forming agent, and a mixed spinning stock solution is obtained; spinning is performed with a wet spinning technology, and mixed protofilament is obtained; the mixed protofilament is soaked in a catalytic pore-expanding agent solution by 5-24 hours, the mixture is placed into an activating oven for pre-oxidation, activation and carbonization after being dried at the temperature of 80 DEG C to 120 DEG C, and the polyacrylonitrile mesoporous activated carbon fiber for the super capacitor electrode is obtained. The prepared polyacrylonitrile mesoporous activated carbon fiber has higher strength and is suitable for manufacturing the super capacitor electrode due to the appropriate mesoporous structure.

title: Preparation method of carbon fiber material with adjustable pore diameter and porosity and carbon fiber material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon fiber material with adjustable pore diameter and porosity and the carbon fiber material. The preparation method comprises following steps: SiO2-polyacrylonitrile fibers are prepared with an electrospinning technique; the SiO2-polyacrylonitrile fibers are soaked in a hydrofluoric acid solution, SiO2 in the SiO2-polyacrylonitrile fibers is removed, and the fibers are washed with absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water; the fibers are subjected to pre-oxidation for 1-6 h at the temperature of 150-400 DEG C under the air atmosphere, then an obtained product is subjected to carbonization for 0.5-8 h at the temperature of 600-1,500 DEG C under the inert gas atmosphere, and the carbon fiber material is obtained after cooling. According to the preparation method, the carbon fiber material with adjustable pore diameter and porosity is obtained through adjustment of grain size and mass fraction of SiO2 microspheres; the preparation method is simple, and the operation method is easy.

abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible carbon nanofiber film for a flexible positive electrode of a foldable lithium battery. abstract: The invention relates to a flexible carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The carbon fiber is prepared by carrying out spinning on a graphite flake/polyacrylonitrile complex solution and carrying out super-high drafting, pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment. The carbon fiber has highly oriented graphite flakes and graphite crystal structures generated through induction of the graphite flakes, wherein graphite crystallite is arranged and oriented along the surfaces of the graphite flakes. The carbon fiber has the characteristics of high order degree, compact structure, small average grain size and few defects. The rigidity/softness, resistivity, strength and axial thermal conductivity of the prepared flexible carbon fiber are respectively 10<-4>-10mN .cm, 10<-3>-100omega .cm, 1000-5000MPa and 0.5-50W/m .k. title: Carbon fiber using electron beam cross-linked polyacrylonitrile fiber and method for preparing the same
abstract: According to the present invention, heat resistance is improved by electron beam cross-linking before oxidation and stabilization during the use of polyacrylonitrile fiber for carbon fiber preparation. According to the present invention, energy consumption during the polyacrylonitrile fiber oxidation and stabilization process can be significantly reduced during the carbon fiber preparation, and thus the carbon fiber can be provided at a low cost. abstract: Processes for producing carbon fiber, the filament thereof and pre-oxidized fiber are provided. In one embodiment, the gel spinning of polyacrylonitrile filament is achieved by using small-molecule gelling agent, and the carbon fiber obtained thereby is increased by 15% to 40% in tensile strength and by 20% to 35% in toughness. In another embodiment, the melt spinning process of polyacrylonitrile is conducted by using imidazole type ion liquid as plasticizer, the process reduces environment pollution, is suitable for industrial production and the fiber produced thereby is improved in its strength. In yet another embodiment, polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber is produced by melt spinning, so low cost and controllable pre-oxidization of polyacrylonitrile can be achieved. In a further embodiment, high strength carbon fiber is manufactured by using polymer thickening agent. In another further embodiment, low cost and controllable pre-oxidization of polyacrylonitrile is achieved by conducting pre-oxidization before spinning, minimizing skin-core structure, so as to produce high performance carbon fiber, and reduce the production cost of carbon fiber greatly.

abstract: In a method of making a carbon fiber, carbon nanotubes (CNT) are mixed into a solution including polyacrylonitrile (PAN) so as to form a CNT/PAN mixture. At least one PAN/CNT fiber is formed from the mixture. A first predetermined electrical current is applied to the PAN/CNT fiber until the PAN/CNT fiber is a stabilized PAN/CNT fiber. A heatable fabric that includes a plurality of fibers that each have an axis. Each of the plurality of fibers includes polyacrylonitrile and carbon nanotubes dispersed in the polyacrylonitrile in a predetermined weight percent thereof and aligned along the axes of the plurality of fibers. The plurality of fibers are woven into a fabric. A current source is configured to apply an electrical current through the plurality of fibers, thereby causing the fibers to generate heat.

abstract: A continuous carbonization method for the carbonization of a continuous, oxidized polyacrylonitrile (PAN) precursor fiber, wherein the precursor fiber exiting the carbonization system is a carbonized fiber which has been exposed to an atmosphere comprising 5% or less, preferably 0.1 % or less, more preferably 0%, by volume of oxygen during its passage from a high temperature furnace to the next high temperature furnace. title: Preparation method of PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based carbon fiber for modifying protofilament through ammonification
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based carbon fiber for modifying protofilament through ammonification, wherein the ammonified PAN protofilament is subjected to pre-oxidation with total draft degree of -2% through 4 temperature zones. The final product of PAN-based carbon fiber is obtained through low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization. A low-temperature carbonization furnace is divided into 6 temperature zones in total, the total time of low-temperature carbonization is 90-150 seconds, and the draft degree of low-temperature carbonization is 7 per mill. A high-temperature carbonization furnace is divided into 4 temperature zones, the total time of high-temperature carbonization is 60-100 seconds, and the draft degree of high-temperature carbonization is -4 per mill. According to the invention, in the fixed temperature condition and technological conditions, different pre-oxidation times are realized by changing the operation speed of the whole production line. The average strength of the produced carbon fiber reaches 4,538MPa.

title: Preparation method of high-carbon-yield polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-carbon-yield polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Specifically, temperature conditions during a carbonization process are changed, such that fiber yield is improved. The method belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The method is characterized in comprising the steps of: (1) raw fiber preparation; (2) pre-oxidation process; and (3) carbonization process. The carbonization process is carried out under a nitrogen atmosphere. Constant-temperature pre-treatment is carried out upon polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber for 0.5-2min at a carbonization early stage, wherein a treatment temperature is 280-380 DEG C; two to seven-state gradient heating is adopted in low-temperature carbonization, wherein a temperature is controlled within a range of 300-900 DEG C; and two to five-stage temperature control is adopted in high-temperature carbonization, wherein a temperature range is controlled within 1200-1400 DEG C, such tat carbon fiber is obtained.

abstract: The invention belongs to PAN-based carbon fiber field, particularly a kind of preparation method of PAN-based carbon fiber.Comprising with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) is solvent, and polymerization single polymerization monomer acrylonitrile and itaconic acid carry out polymerisation in a solvent, after de-single, deaeration and filtration, obtain spinning solution; Design triangle shape hole spinnerets, is arranged on the exit of measuring pump by tri-angle-holed spinnerets, extruded by spinning solution enter coagulation forming in coagulating bath through measuring pump after air layer, after stretched, obtains triangle-section polyacrylonitrile as-spun fibre; By polyacrylonitrile as-spun fibre through washing, hot water drawing-off, oil, compacting by drying, saturated vapor drawing-off, obtain triangle-section polyacrylonitrile precursor after steam heat sizing and dry process; Polyacrylonitrile fibril is obtained cross section PAN-based carbon fiber triangular in shape after pre-oxidation and charing.The regular shape in the cross section of the PAN-based carbon fiber that the present invention obtains, size is even, surfacing and the defect of fiber is few.

title: polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The present invention discloses a kind of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre, preparation method and application thereof, and preparation method comprises the following steps: oxygen enrichment material, siloxanes and borate are dissolved in water and prepare dampening solution; Being immersed by polyacrylonitrile fibril is equipped with in the infiltration apparatus of dampening solution, obtains the polyacrylonitrile fibre after humidification; Polyacrylonitrile fibre after humidification is heat-treated in oxidation furnace; Cyclization after heat treatment is carried out carbonization, prepares polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre.The polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre that the present invention also provides above-mentioned preparation method to obtain and application thereof.Preparation method of the present invention decreases the formation of fracture of wire phenomenon and skin-core structure, improves the mechanical property of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre.
