title: Oxidation improved static Electrospun prepares the method for carbon nano-fiber base non-precious metal catalyst
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of method being oxidized improved static Electrospun and preparing carbon nano-fiber base non-precious metal catalyst of carbon nano-fiber and fuel cell catalyst technical field.Method of the present invention, at least one transition metal salt and polyacrylonitrile are dissolved in solvent, forms precursor solution; Precursor solution is obtained the polyacrylonitrile nanofiber of iron content by electrostatic spinning under certain Parameter Conditions; By the heat treatment under the atmosphere containing micro amount of oxygen voltinism gas of the polyacrylonitrile nanofiber of iron content, obtain the carbon nano-fiber containing transition metal and nitrogen element improved by micro amount of oxygen voltinism atmosphere.Cost of material of the present invention is lower, easy and simple to handle controlled, easy to operate, can regulate and control the surface texture of catalyst, the good catalytic activity of oxidation modified model carbon nano-fiber base non-precious metal catalyst performance to oxygen reduction reaction of preparation.Whole preparation process can combine with traditional carbon fiber technique, has prospect base metal cathod catalyst being realized scale, industrialization.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber with evenly distributed copolymerization sequence
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile precursor fiber with an evenly distributed copolymerization sequence. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out suspension polymerization in water among polymerization monomers: acrylonitrile, a second co-monomer with an improved traction performance, and a third co-monomer, which has been densified and stabilized; controlling the reaction temperature at 45-85 DEG C and the reaction time at 1-4 hours, then adding a water solution of NaSCN to prepare a spinning solution; removing the bubbles in the spinning solution, filtering, spraying, and curing to form primary fibers, washing, and subjecting the primary fibers to a post treatment so as to obtain a product of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon precursor fibers. A water-phase suspension polymerization technology is adopted, moreover, during the polymerization process, a third co-monomer is added through a special mode so as to evenly graft the third co-monomers to the PAN macromolecular chains in the reactor to obtain polyacrylonitrile resin with an evenly distributed copolymerization sequence. The polyacrylonitrile resin can be spun to prepare PAN precursor fibers with a good thermal effect, the heat radiation of the PAN precursor fibers is even during the oxidation and cyclization process, and thus the strength of carbon fibers is effectively improved.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with evenly distributed copolymerization sequence
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with an evenly distributed copolymerization sequence. The preparation method comprises the following steps: determining the number of serially connected reactors; determining the ratio of fed materials of different areas in the third co-monomer zone; carrying out precipitation polymerization by taking water as the medium, drying so as to obtain polyacrylonitrile powder; dissolving the polyacrylonitrile powder to prepare a spinning solution, removing the bubbles from the solution, filtering, spraying, and curing to form primary fibers, washing and subjecting the primary fibers to a post treatment so as to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based carbon precursor fibers; and finally subjecting the precursor fibers to pre-oxidation, carbonation, and a post treatment so as to obtain the high performance carbon fiber. The preparation method adopts multi-grade serially-connected stirred tank polymerization reactors, and raw materials are supplemented in the third co-monomer zone according to a certain ratio in different areas so as to obtain a PAN copolymer with evenly distributed copolymerization sequence. Because the distribution uniformity of the copolymerization sequence of polyacrylonitrile precursor fibers is high, the possibility that fibers with a shell-core structure appear during the pre-oxidation process is small. Moreover, the diffusion of oxygen gas in the radical direction of fibers is also promoted, thus the pre-oxidation reactions can be stably carried out and the heat dissipation can be controlled so as to obtain carbon fiber with an excellent performance.

title: Electrostatic spinning preparation method of vanadium-oxygen-carbon supercapacitor electrode material
abstract: The invention discloses an electrostatic spinning preparation method of a vanadium-oxygen-carbon supercapacitor electrode material, and belongs to the technical field of a supercapacitor. The method comprises steps as follows: polyacrylonitrile fiber and vanadyl acetylacetonate for industrial spinning are taken as raw materials and dissolved in dimethylformamide to prepare virgin fiber through electrostatic spinning; and vanadium, oxygen and carbon contained flexible carbon fiber mat is obtained through pre-oxidation and carbonization under the protection of nitrogen. According to the electrostatic spinning preparation method of the vanadium-oxygen-carbon supercapacitor electrode material, the doping content of a vanadium source is simply adjusted, so that the flexible supercapacitor electrode material which has good performance and does not require any adhesion agents is obtained; the cost is low, the operation is simple and convenient, and the adhesion agents and conductive auxiliaries are not required when an electrode plate is manufactured; and prominently, the prepared vanadium-oxygen-carbon fiber has good electrochemical performance and high specific capacity.

title: Preparation method of morphology controllable metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a morphology controllable metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material, and relates to a preparation method of a combination electrode material, for solving the problem that the specific capacitance value of a composite material cannot be improved through changing morphology by use of a conventional metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode material. The method comprises the following steps: taking polyacrylonitrile and nitrate with different mass ratios as raw materials, preparing metal iron-doped polyacrylonitrile fibers by use of electrostatic spinning, and preparing metal oxide/polyacrylonitrile-based active carbon fibers through pre-oxidation and carbonization. According to the invention, spinning is carried out by adding the nitrate, the nitrate forms the tadpole-like short fibers after being stretched, the morphology is continued through a pre-oxidation and carbonization process, the fibers are wound on the surfaces of the active carbon fibers or scattered among the active carbon fibers, the specific surface area of the active carbon fibers is increased, the surface utilization rate is enhanced, and the prepared active carbon fibers have quite high specific capacitance. The method provided by the invention is applied to preparation of metal oxide/active carbon fiber combination electrode materials with different morphologies.

title: Pre-oxidation method for preparing high-strength medium-model carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to the field of organic polymers and particularly relates to a pre-oxidation method for preparing a high-strength medium-model carbon fiber. The pre-oxidation method comprises the following steps of pre-oxidizing a polyacrylonitrile copolymer fiber bundle at the air atmosphere within the temperature range of 180-280 DEG C; carrying out heat treatment in a six-stage gradient heating way for 80-120 minutes, and controlling the temperature gradients at the fifth stage and the sixth stage to 14+/-2 DEG C to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber with the density of 1.34+/-0.02g/cm<3>; and then, carrying out conventional carbonization, namely carbonizing at the low temperature of 300-900 DEG C and the drawing ratio of 0-4% under the protection of nitrogen gas for 3+/-1.5 minutes, and carbonizing the obtained fiber at the high temperature of 1000-1800 DEG C and the drawing ratio of -4-0% for 3+/-1.5 minutes. According to the pre-oxidation method, the phenomenon of excessive pre-oxidization or insufficient pre-oxidization is avoided, the cyclization reaction and oxidization reaction of the fiber in the pre-oxidization process are reasonably controlled, a skin-core structure is effectively avoided, the pre-oxidized fiber with a perfect structure is prepared, the mechanical property of the fiber is improved, and furthermore the high-strength medium-model carbon fiber is prepared.

title: Method for preparing ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer applicable to carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing a ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer applicable to a carbon fiber precursor; the method comprises the steps: under the protection of nitrogen gas, mixing acrylonitrile, itaconic acid, dispersant and water and heating to 60-75 DEG C; dropwise adding initiator aqueous solution and acrylamide aqueous solution in sequence; after dropwise adding, timing and reacting for 3-24h, washing, denitrifying, filtering, drying and obtaining the ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer. A water-phase suspension polymerization process is adopted to polymerization; the polymerization heat is easy to be removed and the polymerization temperature is easily controlled; the average molecular weight of the ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer is higher and the molecular weight distribution is narrow; the prepared ternary polyacrylonitrile copolymer is capable of effectively improving thermal stability performance at a high-temperature pre-oxidation stage and has certain actual application prospects.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with gamma ray irradiation
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber with gamma ray irradiation. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out appropriate doses of gamma ray irradiation for polyacrylonitrile fiber in air, vacuum or inert atmosphere, and thus generating part of cyclization and crosslinking structure; carrying out thermal oxidation stabilization for 0-100 min in air atmosphere to achieve full cyclization and crosslinking; carrying out low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization so as to prepare the high-performance carbon fiber. The method carries out pre-irradiation treatment before thermal stabilization, so that the thermal stabilization time can be shortened, the production efficiency can be improved, and polyacrylonitrile molecules can form a rigid structure with a regular structure and strong heat resistance. Higher rigid drafting can be applied in the thermal stabilization process, the orientation degree graphite-like sheets in the carbon fiber is facilitated, and the high-performance carbon fiber is prepared.

title: Method for preparing high-modulus carbon fibers at low temperature
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-modulus carbon fibers at low temperature. The method includes the steps that carbon fibers produced from a carbonization furnace are soaked in a water solution of a nitrogen-containing boride or a mixed water solution of boride and nitrogen-containing compounds for 0.50-10 minutes; water on the surfaces of the fibers is removed in air at 105-150 DEG C through drying; the dried fibers are subjected to graphitization treatment at 2000-2500 DEG C under nitrogen protection, and then through electrochemistry anodic oxidation treatment, sizing, drying and other technologies, the high-modulus carbon fibers can be obtained at the low temperature.

title: Graphene porous electrode material for seawater desalting and preparation method therefor
abstract: The invention relates to a graphene porous electrode material for seawater desalting and a preparation method therefor. Graphene/polyacrylonitrile composite nonwoven felt cloth is employed as a raw material, pre-oxidation heat processing and high-temperature carbonization are carried out, and a porous electrode material with nano carbon fibers and graphene distributed uniformly and continuously is obtained. The porous electrode material is composed of graphene and nano carbon fibers with a diameter of 150-400nm, the specific surface area is 120-437m<2>/g, and the hole diameter is 2-100nm. The graphene/polyacrylonitrile composite nonwoven felt cloth is prepared through a static spinning method, the technological process is simple, and the manufacturing cost is lowered. The prepared electrode material has a high ion capacity and good conductivity and corrosion resistance, and is especially suitable for seawater desalination desalting.

title: Filament leading method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor dry-jet wet-spinning spinning nozzle
abstract: The present invention relates to a filament leading method of a polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor dry-jet wet-spinning spinning nozzle, and belongs to the field of high polymer material manufacturing. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of a first step of connecting a pre-treated spinning nozzle and a material pipeline, starting a metering pump and feeding materials into the spinning nozzle; a second step of observing spinneret plate till the materials come out of the spinneret plate; a third step of rapidly immersing the spinneret plate 1 mm-5 mm below a liquid level of a solidification liquid at a constant speed; a fourth step of when strands sprayed out of the spinneret plate reach a required length, tying the strands with cotton threads, and leading the tied strands out of a coagulating tank; a fifth step of leading the strands out of the coagulating tank and onto a filament leading roller, after stabilization, the height of the spinning nozzle is gradually raised till the spinning nozzle leaves the liquid level to an assigned height, then the spinning nozzle is fixed.

abstract: A method for manufacturing a polyacrylonitrile fiber for a carbon fiber, according to the present invention, comprises: a process of manufacturing a polyacrylonitrile polymer solution; a spinning process of releasing a spinning solution including a polyacrylonitrile polymer into a coagulation tub with multi-filaments through a spinneret; a hot water stretching process of primarily stretching washed polyacrylonitrile multi-filaments in a hot water draw frame including hot water of 70 to 100°C; a heat solvent stretching process for secondarily stretching the polyacrylonitrile multi-filaments in a heat solvent draw frame including an organic or an inorganic solvent of 110 to 130°C; and a winding process of winding the polyacrylonitrile multi-filaments. A method for manufacturing a carbon fiber according to the present invention is configured to manufacture a carbon fiber by passing a precursor fiber, manufactured by the method for manufacturing a polyacrylonitrile fiber for a carbon fiber, through a preliminary flame-retardant process, a flame-retardant process, a preliminary carbonization process, and a carbonization process.

title: Method of manufacturing polyacrylonitrile type precursor fiber for carbon fiber and polyacrylonitrile type precursor fiber manufactured thereby
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber. When manufacturing an acrylonitrile-based copolymer into polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber by passing acrylonitrile-based filament through the processes of washing with water, hot water stretching, primary drying, hot-steam stretching, secondary drying and winding, secondarily dried polyacrylonitrile-based filament is irradiated. The polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber manufactured by the method of the present invention has a specific gravity of 1.2-1.4 and is thermally stabilized as the cyclization reaction is conducted in a portion of pyridine in the molecular structure by the irradiation. As a result, the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber manufactured according to the present invention can shorten the heat stabilization treatment time for the manufacture of carbon fiber, and can perform the oxidation process for the manufacture of carbon fiber only for a short period of time at a relatively lower temperature compared to the past due to a decreased heating value in the oxidation process, thereby simplifying the manufacture process of carbon fiber and enhancing the productivity.

title: Carbon Fibers Having Improved Strength And Modulus And An Associated Method And Apparatus For Preparing Same
abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

title: Carbon Fiber Bundle and Method of Producing Carbon Fibers
abstract: Provided are carbon fibers which have a thicker single fiber fineness of the polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber bundles and lower production costs, and which have excellent mechanical properties. Also provided are: carbon fiber bundles having a single fiber fineness of 0.8-2.1 dtex, a strand strength of 4.9 GPa or greater, and a strand elastic modulus of 200 GPa or greater; carbon fiber bundles having a single fiber fineness of 0.8-2.5 dtex, a strand strength of 3.0 GPa or greater, and a strand elastic modulus of 240 GPa or greater; and an optimal method for producing said carbon fiber bundles. carbon fiber bundles having a single fiber fineness of 0.8-2.5 dtex, a strand strength of 3.0 GPa or greater, and a strand elastic modulus of 240 GPa or greater; and an optimal method for producing said carbon fiber bundles.

title: Carbon Fibers Having Improved Strength And Modulus And An Associated Method And Apparatus For Preparing Same
abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

title: Preparation method of activated carbon fiber membrane with hierarchical pore structure
abstract: A preparation method of an activated carbon fiber membrane with a hierarchical pore structure belongs to the field of preparation and application of novel carbon materials. The method is based on an electrostatic spinning technology, a carbon material with high mesopore content is uniformly dispersed in an organic solution of polyacrylonitrile, and is subjected to electrospinning to form a film; then, the carbon fiber membrane is prepared through the steps of pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation; the material has the characteristics of good integrity, small fiber diameter, strong electric conductivity and the like, and contains hierarchical micropore-mesopore-macropore aperture distribution. The invention realizes the electrostatic spinning technical synthesis route of the layered carbon fiber, and has the characteristics of simple operation, low cost and the like compared with the synthesis of porous carbon by a hard template route. The novel carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the fields of adsorption, separation, electrode materials, restoration of environmental pollutants and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title: Preparation method for graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for a graphene oxide-modified PAN (Polyacrylonitrile) carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing graphene oxide in solvent, carrying out uniform ultrasonic dispersion and further preparing a PAN spinning solution containing the graphene oxide; carrying out monomer removing and de-aeration on the spinning solution and then spinning by a wet-method spinning process; and finally, washing with water and drying to obtain the graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of simple process, low cost and suitability for industrial production; and the obtained graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor has the characteristics of high orientation degree, high strength and low possibility of generating disorientation in the thermostabilization process.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and a carbon fiber, belonging to the technical field of fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of: enabling polyacrylonitrile protofilament to pass through a continuous pre-oxidization device at a constant speed in a normal pressure and an air medium and carrying out pre-oxidization treatment, wherein the temperature rises by adopting 2-4 temperature zone gradients, and the total time is controlled within 30-45 min; in the low temperature stage of the pre-oxidization process, the reaction temperature is 200-240 DEG C, positive drafting accounting for 0%-8% of the total drafting is added, and the total time is 15-25 min; and in the high temperature stage, the reaction temperature is 240-275 DEG C, negative drafting accounting for 0%-3% of the drafting  is added, the total time is 15-20min, the low temperature stage is divided into one or two temperature zones, and the high temperature stage is divided into one or two temperature zones, and the temperature of the 2-4 temperature zones rises in sequence, therefore the pre-oxidization fiber is obtained; furthermore, performing a regular carbonization treatment in the atmosphere of nitrogen for 5-8 min to obtain the carbon fiber. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and the carbon fiber, disclosed by the invention, has the advantages of improving production efficiency of the pre-oxidization and shortening the pre-oxidization heat treatment time.

title: Pretreatment method of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and particularly relates to a pretreatment method of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor. In the method, the polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor needing pre-oxidation is soaked for a certain time in an amino acid solution with concentration of 7-30% by mass, wherein the amino acid comprises lysine and arginine, and the soaking temperature is 25-85 DEG C. Through the invention, the technical problems of complicated operation, environmental pollution and the like of the existing precursor pretreatment technology are solved. The method provided by the invention is simple to operate and pollution-free, can effectively reduce the starting temperature of the cyclization reaction, reduces the heat discharge in the pre-oxidation process, and avoids the fusion bonding of the precursor in the subsequent treatment processes.

title: Efficient preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers
abstract: The invention relates to an efficient preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, belonging to the technical field of preparation of carbon fibers. The invention is characterized in that the technical link of the polyacrylonitrile solvent spinning process is reduced, i.e. a single-channel drawing is adopted instead of the high-temperature drawing technique at higher than 100 DEG C, the drawing temperature is controlled at 80-100 DEG C, the drawing multiple is 3.0-8.0, and the drying densification and thermoforming are completed synchronously; and the subsequent heat treatment process adopts the normal preoxidation and carbonization techniques, thereby achieving the goals of low-cost production of carbon fibers on the premise of not changing the properties of the carbon fibers. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple, and has the advantages of shorter production time and lower production cost.

title: Method for preparing carbon nanofiber based non-noble-metal catalyst through oxidation improved electrostatic spinning
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a carbon nanofiber-based non-noble-metal catalyst through oxidation improved electrostatic spinning in the technical field of carbon nanofibers and fuel cell catalysts. The method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: dissolving at least one transition metal salt and polyacrylonitrile in a solvent to form a precursor solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning on the precursor solution under certain parameter conditions to obtain iron-containing polyacrylonitrile nanofibers; and heat treating the iron-containing polyacrylonitrile nanofibers in an atmosphere containing a small amount of oxidizing gas to obtain carbon nanofibers containing transition metal and nitrogen element and improved by the small amount of oxidizing gas. According to the method, the cost of the raw materials is low, the operation is convenient and controllable, the operation is easy, the surface structure of the catalyst can be regulated and controlled, and the prepared oxidation improved carbon nanofiber based non-noble-metal catalyst has good catalytic activity on oxygen reduction reaction. The whole preparation process can be combined with a traditional carbon fiber technique, and the method has a prospect that large scale and industrialization of the non-noble metal catalyst can be realized.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which solves the problems of high equipment investment and large public engineering consumption in prior art. The method comprises the following steps: a)polyacrylonitrile powder is dissolved by a solvent I to slurry under the operation temperature T1 at 15-95 DEG C; b)a solvent II and the slurry are contacted to prepare a spinning raw liquid under the operation temperature T2 at 30-99 DEG C; c)the spinning raw liquid and dimethyl acetamide are mixed in a spinning machine, and can be shaped in the spinning machine through a coagulating bath spinning duct to obtain nascent fiber; and d)the nascent fiber is washed, stretched, oiled, dried and then is performed with oxidation and carbonization treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The preparation method better solves the problems, and can be used in the industrial production for producing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofiber-carbon fiber multiscale reinforcement body
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofiber-carbon fiber multiscale reinforcement body, wherein obtained multilayer polyacrylonitrile nanofiber-carbon fiber cloth is thermally treated. Layers of the polyacrylonitrile nanofiber-carbon fiber cloth through thermal treatment are laminated and seamed in 0 degree/0-90 degrees so as to obtain a precursor of a polyacrylonitrile nanofiber-carbon fiber multiscale reinforcement body. High-temperature carbonization treatment is carried out on the obtained precursor of the polyacrylonitrile nanofiber-carbon fiber multiscale reinforcement body so as to obtain a reinforced carbon fiber-carbon nanofiber multiscale prefabricating body. By utilizing a low-cost electrostatic spinning-high temperature carbonization method and a simple laminating seaming method, a carbon fiber-carbon nanofiber multiscale reinforcement body is obtained under the premise that carbon fibers are not lost; according to the carbon/carbon composite material prepared by using the multiscale reinforcement body, the interlaminar shear strength is improved by 30%-50% in comparison with that of the carbon/carbon composite material prepared by using carbon cloth lamination purely.

title: Method for preparing carbon/carbon-silicon carbide composite material for bearings
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a carbon/carbon-silicon carbide composite material for bearings. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a carbon fiber integral felt of 0.15-0.30g/cm<3> from polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fibers through puncture carbonization, or preparing a non-woven cloth carbon fiber integral felt of 0.4-0.6g/cm<3> from non-woven cloth and a mesh tyre through puncture carbonization in an alternating lamination manner; preparing C/C porous preform with density of 1.35-1.75g/cm<3> by adopting a chemical vapor infiltration (CVI) and resin precursor infiltration and pyrolysis (PIP) comprehensive process, and performing a high-temperature treatment at 2,250-2,600 DEG C in the Ar gas protective atmosphere; and vacuumizing, then introducing Ar gas, heating to 2,200-2,350 DEG C to perform liquid silicon infiltration, and preserving heat for 1.5 hours. The method is a preparation method of the carbon/carbon-silicon carbide (C/C-SiC) composite material with little residual silicon and low abrasion rate for bearings.

title: Preparation method of high-modulus graphite fibers
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-modulus graphite fibers. According to the carbon fibers prepared by adopting the existing graphite fiber preparation method, the intensity is reduced excessively, the application field is limited, and the production cost is high. The preparation method comprises the following steps: arranging PAN-based precursor on a pay-off rack, humidifying with deionized water, drying through a drying furnace and drafting, and pre-oxidizing through six continuous oxidization furnaces; running in two temperature zones of a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and running in two temperature zones of a high-temperature carbonization furnace; entering a graphitization furnace to obtain graphitized fibers, conducting surface treatment and sizing, and finally drying and rolling up to obtain high-modulus graphitized fibers. The high-modulus graphite fibers can be continuously prepared through pre-oxidization, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and graphitization of the selected PAN-based precursor, the production flow is simplified, the production efficiency is improved, the maximum modulus of the obtained high-modulus graphite fibers is 395GPa, the intensity is 3500MPa, not only can high intensity be maintained, but also high modulus can be achieved.

title: Preparation method for magnetic active carbon fibers
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method for magnetic active carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of material production. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylonitrile and magnetic ferroferric oxide particles into N,N-dimethylformamide to obtain a spinning solution; performing electrostatic spinning to obtain precursor fibers, and performing pretreatment, pre-oxidization, carbonization and activation on the precursor fibers to obtain the magnetic active carbon fibers. The method is easy to operate, and conditions are easy to control. The prepared material is stable in structure, is high in absorbing property, and can be widely applied in electromagnetic shielding. The magnetic active carbon fibers can be used as adsorption materials and are high in adsorption capacity and high in adsorption speed; furthermore, after being adsorbed, the magnetic active carbon fibers are effectively separated through magnets, and the recycled magnetic carbon fibers can be regenerated and reused.

title: Polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation treatment device and polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation treatment method
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation treatment device and a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation treatment method, belonging to the technical field of preparing carbon fibers. A movable microwave heating furnace (2) is adopted, the wire traveling speeds of the movable microwave heating furnace (2) and polyacrylonitrile fiber (4) are synchronous and controllable, the movable heating furnace can form air convection together with moving polyacrylonitrile fiber, so that reaction heat caused by side effect can be taken away well, and the quality of pre-oxidized fibers is improved. A sand containing hopper (3) with controllable titration speed is fixed on one side of the microwave heating furnace (2), and used for titrating oxidant solution on the pre-oxidized fibers, thus omitting the complicated process of soaking, then taking out again and the like, and preventing the artificial destruction of a precursor structure. By adopting microwave heating principle, oxygen molecules in the oxidant solution take part in pre-oxidization reaction inside, the pre-oxidization degree can achieve consistency inside and outside as far as possible, thus achieving the purpose of reducing the skin-core effect.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based nano porous carbon fibers by using polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane as pore-foaming agent, and polyacrylonitrile-based nano porous carbon fibers
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based nano porous carbon fibers by using polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (POSS) as a pore-foaming agent, and the polyacrylonitrile-based nano porous carbon fibers. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a PAN and POSS blended solution; (2) preparing a nano porous carbon fiber precursor by electrostatic spinning; (3) pre-oxidizing the nano porous carbon fiber precursor; and (4) preparing the nano porous carbon fibers by carbonization. The method is simple and convenient and low in energy consumption. The nano porous carbon fibers obtained by adopting the method are controllable in size, and the average diameter is about 100-1000 nanometers and the aperture is 5-200 nanometers. The aperture size can be regulated according to the content of the PAN/POSS. The PAN-based nano porous carbon fibers have a large specific surface area, the good chemical stability and the high draw ratio and are suitable for being used in continuous production.

title: Graphite carbon fiber felt for sodium-sulfur cell and preparation method of graphite carbon fiber felt
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of graphite carbon fiber felt for a sodium-sulfur cell and belongs to the field of chemical energy storage. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the needling method non-woven processing step: polyacrylonitrile oxidized fiber sold on the market is processed into oxidized fiber felt through the needling method process; the carbonization processing step: the oxidized fiber felt is placed in an inert atmosphere and subjected to thermal treatment at 700-1100 DEG C to obtain carbon fiber felt, wherein the carbonization time is 5 min to 100 h; the graphitization processing step: the carbon fiber felt is placed in the inert atmosphere and subjected to thermal treatment at 1600-2500 DEG C to obtain graphite carbon fiber felt. Through the preparation method of graphite carbon fiber felt for the sodium-sulfur cell, the polyacrylonitrile oxidized fiber sold on the market is used as the production raw material; in addition, the production process is simple; the cost is moderate; the graphite carbon fiber felt can be produced in batches; the conductivity of the prepared graphite carbon fiber felt for the sodium-sulfur cell is enhanced, the compression strength is improved, the physical contact performance with a solid electrolyte ceramic tube is enhanced, and the performance of the sodium-sulfur cell is also enhanced.

title: Preparing method of polyacrylonitrile (PAN) used for carbon fiber
abstract: A preparing method of polyacrylonitrile (PAN) used for carbon fiber is provided. The preparing method adopts a water-phase precipitation polymerization reaction, adopts water-soluble ammonium sulfate-sodium bisulfite-ferrous sulfate as an oxidation-reduction initiation system, adopts a monoester of itaconic acid as a bifunctional copolymerization monomer, and adopts sulfuric acid as a pH conditioner. The bifunctional copolymerization monomer and acrylonitrile are subjected to a precipitation polymerization reaction in a water phase, then the reaction system is alkalified by aqueous ammonia, and after separation, washing and drying, PAN powder is obtained. The preparing method is low in cost, short in polymerization time, and high in production efficiency, and the prepared polyacrylonitrile is high in purity and good in spinnability and preoxidation controllability, so that the preparing method is suitable for large-scale production of carbon fiber precursor and facilitates reduction of the production cost of carbon fiber.

title: Polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: feeding polyacrylonitrile raw silk into a heating furnace with the temperature of 120-150 DEG C, and performing low-temperature heat treatment for 10-60 days to obtain low-temperature heat treated silk; B, feeding the low-temperature heat treated silk into a continuous preoxidation furnace with the temperature of 220-280 DEG C, and performing continuous preoxidation heat treatment for 20-40 minutes to obtain preoxidized silk; C, feeding the preoxidized silk into a low-temperature carbonization furnace, and performing low-temperature carbonization heat treatment at 350-650 DEG C for 4-20 minutes to obtain preoxidized low-temperature carbonized silk; D, feeding the preoxidized low-temperature carbonized silk into a high-temperature carbonization furnace, and performing high-temperature carbonization heat treatment at 900-1,300 DEG C for 1-2 minutes to obtain the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber. The preparation method is simple in process and convenient and safe to perform and control, and meets the requirements of batch production.

title: Method of manufacturing carbon nanofiber based on polyacrylonitrile
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofibers, comprising the steps of: manufacturing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon nanofibers by electrospinning a spinning solution having polyacrylonitrile precursor dissolved in a solvent; immersing the polyacrylonitrile-based nanofibers in a solution containing hydrogen peroxide; irradiating the polyacrylonitrile-based nanofibers, which has been immersed in the solution containing hydrogen peroxide, with radioactive rays; carbonizing the polyacrylonitrile-based nanofibers by heat-treating the polyacrylonitrile-based nanofibers, which has been irradiated with radioactive rays, at temperatures of 700 to 3,000°C. The present invention can reduce energy consumption and can reduce production time in the process of manufacturing carbon fibers as a thermal stabilization process, which is necessarily conducted in the existing process of manufacturing carbon nanofibers, can be omitted or time for the thermal stabilization process can be minimized. Accordingly, the present invention can mass-produce carbon nanofibers in short time using a small amount of energy.

title: Preparation method of grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber, which comprises first evenly dispersing grapheme powder in a solvent to obtain grapheme suspending liquid, simultaneously dissolving polyacrylonitrile powder in the same solvent to obtain polyacrylonitrile solution, and enabling the grapheme suspending liquid to be evenly dispersed into the polyacrylonitrile solution in a blending method to obtain the grapheme-modified polyacrylonitrile solution; then enabling the polyacrylonitrile solution to serve as spinning solution, and preparing a fiber protofilament by means of a wet-process or dry-spray wet spinning process; and finally performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to the fiber protofilament to obtain the grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber. Compared with an existing preparation method of the acrylonitrile base carbon fiber, the preparation method is simple and practicable, and mechanical property and electrical conductivity of the carbon fiber obtained by utilizing the method are remarkably improved. Accordingly, the preparation method is low in cost and high in efficiency, can be used in the fields ofmaterial reinforcement, electric conduction, static resistance, heat conduction and the like, and has good application prospects.

abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite-based carbon fiber, which comprises the following steps: firstly preparing a polyacrylonitrile mixed solution uniformly dispersed with graphene through an in-situ polymerization method, and then employing the mixed solution as a spinning solution and obtaining a polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite protofilament by a wet spinning or dry-jet wet spinning process, and finally making the protofilament subject to a pre-oxidation treatment and a carbonization treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite-based carbon fiber. title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based porous hollow carbon fibers by coaxial electrospinning
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based porous hollow carbon fibers by coaxial electrospinning. The method includes the steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile with additives to serve as outer solution; taking inner polymer to serve as inner solution; inputting the outer solution and the inner solution into outer layers and inner layers of coaxial needles respectively at the constant flow velocity and in the constant velocity ratio for electrospinning so that PAN-based sheath-core composite fibers are obtained; and subjecting the PAN-based sheath-core composite fibers to washing, pre-oxidation and carbonization so that the PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers are obtained. The PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers combine structural characteristics of original porous carbon fibers and original hollow carbon fibers, the specific surface area of the fibers can be greatly increased, and use efficiency of materials is improved. When the PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers prepared by the method are applied to gas adsorption, gas can enter hollow portions of the fibers more easily, so that adsorbability is enhanced while time required by adsorption is shortened.

title: Preparation method for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method for a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The third monomer of a protofilament spinning raw material, i.e., polyacrylonitrile resin, is itaconic acid; a spinning solution is prepared from the resin by using DMSO or DMAc, and spinning and solidification are carried out so as to prepare a nascent fiber. The nascent fiber successively undergoes the following procedures: drip washing with deionized water; dipping in an acidic aqueous solution for 2 to 10 min; dipping in a sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide aqueous solution for 1 to 5 min; water bath drafting in pure water; dipping in the acidic aqueous solution for 2 to 8 min; and hot bath rinsing with deionized water until rinsing liquid is neutral. A carbon fiber protofilament is prepared by subjecting the nascent fiber to post-processing procedures like oiling and dry densification. The protofilament undergoes pre-oxidation in an aerobic atmosphere under the condition of drafting and then undergoes carbonization in an anoxic atmosphere under the condition of drafting so as to obtain a finished product of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based carbon fiber for modifying protofilament through ammonification
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based carbon fiber for modifying protofilament through ammonification, wherein the ammonified PAN protofilament is subjected to pre-oxidation with total draft degree of -2% through 4 temperature zones. The final product of PAN-based carbon fiber is obtained through low-temperature carbonization and high-temperature carbonization. A low-temperature carbonization furnace is divided into 6 temperature zones in total, the total time of low-temperature carbonization is 90-150 seconds, and the draft degree of low-temperature carbonization is 7 per mill. A high-temperature carbonization furnace is divided into 4 temperature zones, the total time of high-temperature carbonization is 60-100 seconds, and the draft degree of high-temperature carbonization is -4 per mill. According to the invention, in the fixed temperature condition and technological conditions, different pre-oxidation times are realized by changing the operation speed of the whole production line. The average strength of the produced carbon fiber reaches 4,538MPa.

title: Preparation method of high-carbon-yield polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-carbon-yield polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Specifically, temperature conditions during a carbonization process are changed, such that fiber yield is improved. The method belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The method is characterized in comprising the steps of: (1) raw fiber preparation; (2) pre-oxidation process; and (3) carbonization process. The carbonization process is carried out under a nitrogen atmosphere. Constant-temperature pre-treatment is carried out upon polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidized fiber for 0.5-2min at a carbonization early stage, wherein a treatment temperature is 280-380 DEG C; two to seven-state gradient heating is adopted in low-temperature carbonization, wherein a temperature is controlled within a range of 300-900 DEG C; and two to five-stage temperature control is adopted in high-temperature carbonization, wherein a temperature range is controlled within 1200-1400 DEG C, such tat carbon fiber is obtained.

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a pre-oxidized fiber, a carbon fiber, and a precursor fiber thereof, which are improved in fiber strength, are low-cost, and are controllable; and to provide a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: There is provided a high-performance carbon fiber obtained by the following steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile and a solvent such that a solid content becomes 0.1 to 25%; adding catalyst potassium permanganate; introducing oxygen-containing gas at a rate of 5 mL/min; pre-oxidizing a spinning solution at a pre-oxidizing temperature of 90°C to 250°C for 1 h to 2.5 h; and spinning this spinning slurry by wet spinning, dry-wet spinning, gel spinning, liquid-crystal spinning, or frozen-gel spinning, followed by washing with water, drawing, and heat setting to obtain a pre-oxidized fiber, which is then subjected to a carbonization process. A method for producing the same is also provided.

title: Carbon Fibers Having Improved Strength and Modulus and an Associated Method and Apparatus For Preparing Same
abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

title: Method of carbon nanotube for modifying polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber interface produced in China
abstract: The invention provides a method of a carbon nanotube for modifying a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber interface produced in China. The technology includes four parts: (1) surface treatment of the domestic polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber: firstly treating and removing colloid on the surface of carbon fiber at the temperature of 600-800 DEG C and then using the mixed acid of nitric acid and sulfuric acid to remove the impurities on the surface of fiber; (2) preparation of domestic carbon fiber preform where the carbon nanotube grows in situ: firstly putting treated carbon fiber needle preform in the organic solution of catalyst precursor and then growing the carbon nanotube in situ in a chemical vapor deposition furnace; (3) densification of preform: adopting chemical vapor infiltration process to densify the preform and depositing the preform for 200-350h so that the density of the preform reaches 1.70-1.75g/cm<3>; and (4) high-temperature heat treatment: putting the material in a vacuum carbonization furnace, heating to the temperature of 2, 000-2, 300 DEG C at the heating rate of 30-50 DEG C/h under the protection of nitrogen, argon and other gases and preserving the heat for 3-5h, and finally, the finished product is obtained.

title: Pre-oxidation pretreatment process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation pretreatment process of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which is characterized in that before preoxidation of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor is placed in a potassium permanganate solution with the weight percentage concentration of 5-15% for dipping treatment for 1-10min, and the dipping temperature is 50-90 ℃; and after the impregnation is finished, washing and drying the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor. The polyacrylonitrile protofilament for carbon fibers treated by the method can ensure that the pre-oxidation reaction is carried out at a lower initial temperature of the cyclization reaction, the heat release of the protofilament is increased, and the pre-oxidation degree is improved. The method is simple and effective and is convenient to operate.

title: Method for modifying polyacrylonitrile by using gamma ray irradiation
abstract: The invention provides a method for modifying polyacrylonitrile (PAN) by using gamma ray irradiation. Being subjected to the gamma ray irradiation in air, inert atmosphere or a vacuum, the heat release of the cyclized PAN can be reduced in the process of heat treatment; and being subjected to the pretreatment of the gamma ray irradiation, the pre-oxidation rate of PAN fiber can be obviously increased. Undergoing the changes in performance, the invention can help control the sharp rise in the temperature of a sample and accelerate the oxidation in the process for PAN fiber or films to carry out high-temperature cyclization or oxidation crosslinking, particularly, the process of precursor pre-oxidation crosslinking for preparing PAN-based carbon fiber. Accordingly, the method of the invention is of potential application value to the reduction in production cost for PAN oxidation products, particularly, the reduction in production cost for PAN-based carbon fiber.

title: Method for modifying polyacrylonitrile fiber by electron beam irradiation
abstract: The invention provides a method for modifying polyacrylonitrile fibers by electron beam irradiation. The adopted technical scheme is that the total irradiation dose is controlled by adjusting the irradiation dose rate of an electron accelerator, so that the purpose of modifying the polyacrylonitrile fiber sample is achieved. After the polyacrylonitrile fiber is irradiated by electron beams, the cyclization exothermicity in the heat treatment process is reduced, and the pre-oxidation speed in the air is obviously accelerated. The performance change can accelerate the oxidation speed and greatly shorten the pre-oxidation time in the high-temperature cyclization or oxidation crosslinking process of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, particularly in the pre-oxidation crosslinking process of precursor for preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Therefore, the method has potential application value in the aspect of reducing the production cost of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Preparation method of carbon/carbon composite material for bearing
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon/carbon composite material with low friction coefficient for a bearing. Is used in the field of high-performance material preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the preform may adopt either of the following two structures: namely a carbon felt or a three-dimensional carbon fiber woven body, wherein the carbon felt is obtained by carbonizing a polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fiber integral felt at 930-970 ℃ under a vacuum condition; and  compacting the prefabricated part: the technology of combining chemical vapor infiltration and liquid resin impregnation is adopted. The chemical vapor infiltration process parameters are as follows: the precursor is propylene, and the pyrolysis temperature is 900-1000 ℃. The technological parameters of liquid-phase resin impregnation, curing and carbonization are as follows: the precursor is furan resin and is soaked under the pressure of 1-5 MPaSoaking; the curing temperature is 170-185 ℃; carbonizing at 930-950 ℃ under a vacuum condition. title: Preoxidation device for PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor connector
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation device in a carbon fiber production process, solving the problem that untreated precursor is easy to catch fire after entering a normal oxidation process. The invention provides a preoxidation device for a precursor connector, and the preoxidation device is provided with an upper furnace body, a lower furnace body, a double suction circulating blower, a heater, a blower, a wind collector, an internal upper circulating air pipe, an internal lower circulating air pipe, a fresh air supply air pipe, a waste gas exhaust system, a temperature control device, a control system, a furnace body sealing component, an internal circulating air pipe sealing component, a furnace mouth sealing component and a tow tension applying device, wherein the upper furnace body is provided with a lifting device for putting the precursor connector part into the furnace body for preoxidation treatment at any time conveniently. The device has compact structure, the upper furnace body and the lower furnace body are separable, and the device is convenient to operate and can be applied to preoxidation treatment of 1K-320K different specifications of precursor connectors. The precursor connector treated by preoxidation by the device has infusible and noncombustible properties when entering a preoxidation furnace in normal production, thereby reducing the probability that the precursor catches fire and burns in the preoxidation furnace.

title: Device for carrying out preoxidation on PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor joint
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation device in the carbon fiber production process, in particular to a device for carrying out preoxidation on a precursor joint, solving the problem that the untreated precursor is easy to burn after entering into the normal oxidation procedure. The device is provided with an upper furnace body, a lower furnace body, a circulating fan, a heater, an air supplying machine, an air collecting machine, a circulating air pipe, a fresh air supplying pipe, a waste gas discharge system joint, a thermocouple, a temperature control device, a control system, a furnace body sealing part, a furnace mouth sealing part and a tow tension applying device, wherein the upper furnace body is provided with a hoisting device convenient for the precursor joint part to be placed into the furnace body at any time to undergo preoxidation. The precursor joint which is subjected to preoxidation by the device has had infusibility and incombustibility when entering into the preoxidation furnace for normal production, thus reducing the possibility that the precursor burns in the preoxidation furnace.

title: Curing treatment method of carbon fiber precursor polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a curing treatment method of a carbon fiber precursor polyacrylonitrile fiber. The method comprises the following steps: pre-cyclizing the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor in the atmosphere of inert gas; carrying out cyclizing and plastic drawing in the atmosphere of inert gas and water vapor; and carrying out oxidation crosslinking in the atmosphere of air, thus obtaining a pre-oxidized polyacrylonitrile fiber. The method has the following beneficial effects: carrying out heat treatment on the fiber in the inert atmosphere is beneficial to implementation of cyclization reaction in the molecules to form rigid ladderlike molecules with regular structure and strong heat resistance, and at the same time, a defined amount of water vapor is introduced to obtain a higher drawing ratio by enhancing the plasticity of the molecular chains in the fiber, thus improving the orientation degree of the rigid molecules along the fiber axis.

title: Preparation method of integral polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber electrode for desalination
abstract: A preparation method of an integral polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber electrode for desalination belongs to the technical field of novel carbon material preparation and water treatment. The method is based on the electrostatic spinning technology, the polyacrylonitrile is electrospun into a film, and then is subjected to preoxidation, carbonization and activation treatment, so that the prepared carbon fiber material has the characteristics of good macroscopic integrity, small fiber diameter, large mass-to-capacitance, high desalting capability and the like. Under the direct current voltage of 1.6V, the NaCl solution with the initial concentration of 70mg/l is subjected to electric adsorption treatment, the adsorption capacity of the carbon fiber electrode reaches 4.64mgNaCl/g, and the strong desalting capacity is shown. The novel carbon fiber electrode can be widely applied to the fields of brackish water and seawater desalination, water softening, heavy metal ion removal and the like.

title: Preparation method of activated carbon fiber membrane with hierarchical pore structure
abstract: A preparation method of an activated carbon fiber membrane with a hierarchical pore structure belongs to the field of preparation and application of novel carbon materials. The method is based on an electrostatic spinning technology, a carbon material with high mesopore content is uniformly dispersed in an organic solution of polyacrylonitrile, and is subjected to electrospinning to form a film; then, the carbon fiber membrane is prepared through the steps of pre-oxidation, carbonization and activation; the material has the characteristics of good integrity, small fiber diameter, strong electric conductivity and the like, and contains hierarchical micropore-mesopore-macropore aperture distribution. The invention realizes the electrostatic spinning technical synthesis route of the layered carbon fiber, and has the characteristics of simple operation, low cost and the like compared with the synthesis of porous carbon by a hard template route. The novel carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the fields of adsorption, separation, electrode materials, restoration of environmental pollutants and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title: Preparation method of grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber, which comprises first evenly dispersing grapheme powder in a solvent to obtain grapheme suspending liquid, simultaneously dissolving polyacrylonitrile powder in the same solvent to obtain polyacrylonitrile solution, and enabling the grapheme suspending liquid to be evenly dispersed into the polyacrylonitrile solution in a blending method to obtain the grapheme-modified polyacrylonitrile solution; then enabling the polyacrylonitrile solution to serve as spinning solution, and preparing a fiber protofilament by means of a wet-process or dry-spray wet spinning process; and finally performing pre-oxidation and carbonization treatment to the fiber protofilament to obtain the grapheme-modified acrylonitrile base carbon fiber. Compared with an existing preparation method of the acrylonitrile base carbon fiber, the preparation method is simple and practicable, and mechanical property and electrical conductivity of the carbon fiber obtained by utilizing the method are remarkably improved. Accordingly, the preparation method is low in cost and high in efficiency, can be used in the fields of material reinforcement, electric conduction, static resistance, heat conduction and the like, and has good application prospects.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite-based carbon fiber, which comprises the following steps: firstly preparing a polyacrylonitrile mixed solution uniformly dispersed with graphene through an in-situ polymerization method, and then employing the mixed solution as a spinning solution and obtaining a polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite protofilament by a wet spinning or dry-jet wet spinning process, and finally making the protofilament subject to a pre-oxidation treatment and a carbonization treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile/graphene composite-based carbon fiber. Compared with the existing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, the carbon fiber prepared by the method of the invention has a significantly increased mechanical property, and the carbonation yield in the preparation process is improved, therefore, the preparation method is an efficient and reliable preparation method with good application prospects.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based porous hollow carbon fibers by coaxial electrospinning
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing PAN (polyacrylonitrile)-based porous hollow carbon fibers by coaxial electrospinning. The method includes the steps: mixing polyacrylonitrile with additives to serve as outer solution; taking inner polymer to serve as inner solution; inputting the outer solution and the inner solution into outer layers and inner layers of coaxial needles respectively at the constant flow velocity and in the constant velocity ratio for electrospinning so that PAN-based sheath-core composite fibers are obtained; and subjecting the PAN-based sheath-core composite fibers to washing, pre-oxidation and carbonization so that the PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers are obtained. The PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers combine structural characteristics of original porous carbon fibers and original hollow carbon fibers, the specific surface area of the fibers can be greatly increased, and use efficiency of materials is improved. When the PAN-based porous hollow carbon fibers prepared by the method are applied to gas adsorption, gas can enter hollow portions of the fibers more easily, so that adsorbability is enhanced while time required by adsorption is shortened.

title: Preparation method for graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for a graphene oxide-modified PAN (Polyacrylonitrile) carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing graphene oxide in solvent, carrying out uniform ultrasonic dispersion and further preparing a PAN spinning solution containing the graphene oxide; carrying out monomer removing and de-aeration on the spinning solution and then spinning by a wet-method spinning process; and finally, washing with water and drying to obtain the graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of simple process, low cost and suitability for industrial production; and the obtained graphene oxide-modified PAN carbon fiber precursor has the characteristics of high orientation degree, high strength and low possibility of generating disorientation in the thermostabilization process.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and a carbon fiber, belonging to the technical field of fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of: enabling polyacrylonitrile protofilament to pass through a continuous pre-oxidization device at a constant speed in a normal pressure and an air medium and carrying out pre-oxidization treatment, wherein the temperature rises by adopting 2-4 temperature zone gradients, and the total time is controlled within 30-45 min; in the low temperature stage of the pre-oxidization process, the reaction temperature is 200-240 DEG C, positive drafting accounting for 0%-8% of the total drafting is added, and the total time is 15-25 min; and in the high temperature stage, the reaction temperature is 240-275 DEG C, negative drafting accounting for 0%-3% of the drafting  is added, the total time is 15-20min, the low temperature stage is divided into one or two temperature zones, and the high temperature stage is divided into one or two temperature zones, and the temperature of the 2-4 temperature zones rises in sequence, therefore the pre-oxidization fiber is obtained; furthermore, performing a regular carbonization treatment in the atmosphere of nitrogen for 5-8 min to obtain the carbon fiber. The preparation method of the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation fiber and the carbon fiber, disclosed by the invention, has the advantages of improving production efficiency of the pre-oxidization and shortening the pre-oxidization heat treatment time.

title: Pretreatment method of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation, and particularly relates to a pretreatment method of polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor. In the method, the polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursor needing pre-oxidation is soaked for a certain time in an amino acid solution with concentration of 7-30% by mass, wherein the amino acid comprises lysine and arginine, and the soaking temperature is 25-85 DEG C. Through the invention, the technical problems of complicated operation, environmental pollution and the like of the existing precursor pretreatment technology are solved. The method provided by the invention is simple to operate and pollution-free, can effectively reduce the starting temperature of the cyclization reaction, reduces the heat discharge in the pre-oxidation process, and avoids the fusion bonding of the precursor in the subsequent treatment processes.

title: Method for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber which is obtained through the preoxidation, low temperature charring, and high temperature charring of a polyacrylonitrile precursor. The peroxidation and the high temperature charring in the invention have fixed technology conditions. Under the conditions of a fixed low temperature charring temperature and a fixed operating speed, through changing the extending rate of the low temperature charring, different extending rates in each low temperature charring technology are realized. In the low temperature charring stage, about 43.3% of the fiber weight is pyrolyzed. Through controlling the extending rate, increasing the compactness and orientation degree of the carbon fiber, decreasing fiber surface defects, namely the fiber defect number, and decreasing the defect size, excessive tension which causes filament breakage, broken filament, and the like can be avoided, fiber defects further increased by an incomplete reaction caused by excessive tension can also be avoided, thereby improving the mechanical properties of the carbon fiber product, and the tension strength of the carbon fiber can reach 4621 Mpa.

title: Efficient preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers
abstract: The invention relates to an efficient preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, belonging to the technical field of preparation of carbon fibers. The invention is characterized in that the technical link of the polyacrylonitrile solvent spinning process is reduced, i.e. a single-channel drawing is adopted instead of the high-temperature drawing technique at higher than 100 DEG C, the drawing temperature is controlled at 80-100 DEG C, the drawing multiple is 3.0-8.0, and the drying densification and thermoforming are completed synchronously; and the subsequent heat treatment process adopts the normal preoxidation and carbonization techniques, thereby achieving the goals of low-cost production of carbon fibers on the premise of not changing the properties of the carbon fibers. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple, and has the advantages of shorter production time and lower production cost.

title: Method for preparing carbon fiber and precursor fiber for carbon fiber
abstract: The method for preparing a carbon fiber of the present invention comprises the following steps: preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution; spinning the spinning solution containing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer to prepare a precursor fiber for a carbon fiber having a water content of 20-50 %; converting the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber into a pre-oxidation fiber while stretching the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber at a ratio of -10 to -0.1 % or 0.1 to 5 % at 180-220 DEG C in an air environment; converting the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber into an oxidation fiber while stretching the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber converted into the pre-oxidation fiber at an elongation of -5 to 5 % at 200-300 DEG C in an air environment; and heating the oxidation fiber under inert atmosphere to carbonize the same.

title: Acrylic precursor fiber for carbon fiber, method for producing the same, and carbon fiber obtained from the precursor fiber
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To produce an acrylic precursor fiber for a carbon fiber that is good in spinnability and excellent in carbonization yield after calcination process, and a carbon fiber obtained from the precursor fiber at low cost.SOLUTION: The acrylic precursor fiber for a carbon fiber comprises a mixture that contains 1 to 100 pts.mass of carbon black with respect to 100 pts.mass of a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer, in which the carbon black has a dibutyl phthalate absorption amount of 100 (cm/100 g) or less, and pH of an aqueous dispersion comprising 90 pts.mass of water and 10 pts.mass of the carbon black is to be 7.0 or more and 8.0 or less.

abstract: PURPOSE: A method for fabricating carbon fiber of polyacrylonitrile is provided to remarkably reduce fuzz using a dimethylaceteamide solidifying solution. abstract: PURPOSE: A method for fabricating carbon fiber with improved opening property is provided to remarkably improve opening property of final carbon fiber by treating the carbon fiber with sizing agent. CONSTITUTION: A method for fabricating carbon fiber with excellent opening property comprises: a step of preparing polyacrylonitrile(PAN)-based precursor spinning solution containing 8-15 wt% of PAN polymers; a step of spinning the PAN-based precursor spinning solution by a dry spinning method; a step of performing precipitating bath and heat stretching in a solidifying solution containing ZnCl_2 to prepare a precursor carbon fiber for 20-40 seconds; a step of performing flame retardance treatment and carbonization; and a step of treating the carbon fiber with a sizing solution containing two or more compounds.

abstract: PURPOSE: A polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber is provided to shorten thermal treatment time and to ensure thermal stabilization. title: Carbon fiber strand and process for producing the same
abstract: A carbon fiber strand which is produced by obtaining a solidified-yarn strand by spinning with a spinneret having 20,000-30,000 spinning holes, passing the strand through an interlacing nozzle having an air blowing pressure of 20-60 kPa to obtain precursor fibers, oxidizing them in heated air having a temperature of 200-280° C. to obtain oxidized fibers, subjecting these oxidized fibers to a first carbonization treatment in an inert-gas atmosphere at a temperature of 300-900° C. in which the fibers are firstly stretched in a stretch ratio of 1.03-1.06 and then secondarily stretched in a stretch ratio of 0.9-1.01, subsequently conducting a second carbonization treatment in an inert-gas atmosphere at 1,360-2,100° C., and then conducting a surface oxidization treatment in an aqueous solution of an inorganic acid salt in a quantity of electricity of 20-100 C per g of the carbon fibers. This carbon fiber strand has a strand tensile strength of 5,650 MPa or higher, strand tensile modulus of 300 GPa or higher, and strand width of 5.5 mm or larger. No strand crack is observed in an examination by a strand crack evaluation method.

title: Method for producing incombustible acrylic yarn and incombustible acrylic yarn manufactured by method
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing an incombustible acrylic yarn and the incombustible acrylic yarn manufactured by the method and also relates to a middle product in the process of producing the incombustible acrylic yarn, wherein the middle product is incombustible spinnable acrylic fibre, incombustible spinnable acrylic carbon fibre and incombustible carded sliver. The method for producing the incombustible acrylic yarn comprises the following steps: preoxidation: polyacrylonitrile protofilament is preoxidated in a phased heating mode; the temperature difference between the phases is between 1 and 5 DEG C; carbonization: the carbonization temperature is between 300 and 1,000 DEG C; the manufacture of the carded silver by a precutting method: the incombustible spinnable acrylic fibre or the incombustible spinnable acrylic carbon fibre is precut to form a plurality of precutting points so as to form the carded silver; and manufacturing the incombustible carded silver into the incombustible acrylic yarns.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a making method of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, comprising: (1) mixing polyacrylonitrile and solvent according to the solid content of 0.1%-25% in a reactor, heating and stirring to completely dissolve the polyacrylonitrile and solvent; (2) after dissolving completely, adding KMnO4, then adding gas with oxide, processing pre-oxidation for the spinning solution; pre-oxidizing at temperature of 90-250 DEG C for 1-2h; reaching different pre-oxidation effect under different pre-oxidation temperatures and different pre-oxidation time; (3) spinning the spinning solution in the step (2) in a spinning machine, then obtaining pre-oxidation filaments with good pre-oxidation degree after water washing, drafting and heat forming; then obtaining high-property carbon fiber through carbonization. The method in the invention carries out innovation for pre-oxidation stage of carbon fiber with convenient operation, simple equipment but rarely pollution for the environment; low-cost controllable pre-oxidation of polyacrylonitrile is implemented and the skin-core structures are reduced, thereby being capable of producing high-property carbon fiber; and the preparation method greatly reduces the production cost of carbon fiber.

title: Preparing process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparing process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises a pre-oxidation step of pre-oxidizing the raw material polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre protofilament for 20 to 40 min at 200 to 230 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 10 percent, and then pre-oxidizing for 20 to 10 min at 230 to 260 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 5 percent and pre-oxidizing for 10 to 20 min at 260 to 300 DEG C with the drafting times being -1 to 2 percent, and a carbonization step of carbonizing at 300 to 800 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 10 percent and then carbonizing at 1000 to 1400 DEG C with the drafting times being -5 to 0 percent in order to acquire the olyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The invention can prevent the fiber from being snapped when drafting, decrease the production of broken filament and improve the quality and the strength of carbon fiber.
