title: Polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof. The polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor of the invention can be used for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fibers. An acrylonitrile binary copolymerization system containing itaconic acid or an acrylonitrile ternary polymerization system containing itaconic acid and methyl acrylate is adopted for spinning by a wet spinning process matched with a circular arc slit spinneret plate, and multiple filament bundles of the hollow carbon fiber precursor can be obtained, wherein the dimension of the outer diameter and the structure of the precursor meet the requirement of a conventional preoxidation carburizing process for precursor fibers, and the groove structure on the surface of the fiber is favorable for improving the interface performance of composite materials.

title: Preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to aThe preoxidation method of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor comprises the following steps: 1. carrying out differential thermal analysis on the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor from room temperature to 500 ℃ to obtain a DSC curve; 2. the following temperature points were determined from the DSC curve: initial temperature point T 0 First temperature point T 1 A second temperature point T 2 And a third temperature point T 3 (ii) a 3. From the initial temperature point T 0 To the first pre-oxidation temperature point T A Is subjected to gradient temperature rise pre-oxidation at a first pre-oxidation temperature point T A ＝T 1 -ΔT 1 Wherein: delta T 1 The temperature is 5-10 ℃; then the pre-oxidized filament is arranged at a second pre-oxidation temperature point T B Pre-oxidizing for 1-2 min; second pre-oxidation temperature point T B ＝T 3 -ΔT 2 Wherein: delta T 2 The value range is 100-200 ℃ and less than T 3 -T 2 . The invention solves the technical problem of low pre-oxidation degree of the existing pre-oxidation method, and improves the mechanical property of the carbon fiber.

title: Conversion of tussah silk into carbon fiber
abstract: The novel technical way belongs to the field of high temperature chemistry. The basic concept of the novel technical way is that: a molecular structural formula (CH2CH2COOH) of tussah silk and a molecular structural formula (CH2=CHCN) of polyacrylonitrile both contain three C molecules. Preoxidation and carbonization are controlled through a computer, and a high-quality carbon fiber is obtained through high-temperature chemical reaction. A production process flow diagram of the novel technical way is shown as an attached figure 1. The chemical basis of the novel technical way is that: under the protection of inert gas, an open loop of a CH main chain is displaced under the action of high-temperature traction so as to form the closed-loop carbon fiber with a linear (C-C) structure. Technical problems to be solved and key points of an embodiment are that: the precision of the temperature of each section of temperature zone, and a dehydration degree of each section of temperature zone during preoxidation are controlled by the computer; hydrogen and nitrogen displacement is performed in the presence of a palladium catalyst to ensure that the purity of the inert gas is more than or equal to 99.99 percent; and a traction multiple of each section of temperature zone is controlled by a frequency converter.

title: Preoxidation device for PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor connector
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation device in a carbon fiber production process, solving the problem that untreated precursor is easy to catch fire after entering a normal oxidation process. The invention provides a preoxidation device for a precursor connector, and the preoxidation device is provided with an upper furnace body, a lower furnace body, a double suction circulating blower, a heater, a blower, a wind collector, an internal upper circulating air pipe, an internal lower circulating air pipe, a fresh air supply air pipe, a waste gas exhaust system, a temperature control device, a control system, a furnace body sealing component, an internal circulating air pipe sealing component, a furnace mouth sealing component and a tow tension applying device, wherein the upper furnace body is provided with a lifting device for putting the precursor connector part into the furnace body for preoxidation treatment at any time conveniently. The device has compact structure, the upper furnace body and the lower furnace body are separable, and the device is convenient to operate and can be applied to preoxidation treatment of 1K-320K different specifications of precursor connectors. The precursor connector treated by preoxidation by the device has infusible and noncombustible properties when entering a preoxidation furnace in normal production, thereby reducing the probability that the precursor catches fire and burns in the preoxidation furnace.

title: Device for carrying out preoxidation on PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor joint
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation device in the carbon fiber production process, in particular to a device for carrying out preoxidation on a precursor joint, solving the problem that the untreated precursor is easy to burn after entering into the normal oxidation procedure. The device is provided with an upper furnace body, a lower furnace body, a circulating fan, a heater, an air supplying machine, an air collecting machine, a circulating air pipe, a fresh air supplying pipe, a waste gas discharge system joint, a thermocouple, a temperature control device, a control system, a furnace body sealing part, a furnace mouth sealing part and a tow tension applying device, wherein the upper furnace body is provided with a hoisting device convenient for the precursor joint part to be placed into the furnace body at any time to undergo preoxidation. The precursor joint which is subjected to preoxidation by the device has had infusibility and incombustibility when entering into the preoxidation furnace for normal production, thus reducing the possibility that the precursor burns in the preoxidation furnace.

title: Curing treatment method of carbon fiber precursor polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a curing treatment method of a carbon fiber precursor polyacrylonitrile fiber. The method comprises the following steps: pre-cyclizing the polyacrylonitrile fiber precursor in the atmosphere of inert gas; carrying out cyclizing and plastic drawing in the atmosphere of inert gas and water vapor; and carrying out oxidation crosslinking in the atmosphere of air, thus obtaining a pre-oxidized polyacrylonitrile fiber. The method has the following beneficial effects: carrying out heat treatment on the fiber in the inert atmosphere is beneficial to implementation of cyclization reaction in the molecules to form rigid ladderlike molecules with regular structure and strong heat resistance, and at the same time, a defined amount of water vapor is introduced to obtain a higher drawing ratio by enhancing the plasticity of the molecular chains in the fiber, thus improving the orientation degree of the rigid molecules along the fiber axis.

title: Preparation method of integral polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber electrode for desalination
abstract: A preparation method of an integral polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber electrode for desalination belongs to the technical field of novel carbon material preparation and water treatment. The method is based on the electrostatic spinning technology, the polyacrylonitrile is electrospun into a film, and then is subjected to preoxidation, carbonization and activation treatment, so that the prepared carbon fiber material has the characteristics of good macroscopic integrity, small fiber diameter, large mass-to-capacitance, high desalting capability and the like. Under the direct current voltage of 1.6V, the NaCl solution with the initial concentration of 70mg/l is subjected to electric adsorption treatment, the adsorption capacity of the carbon fiber electrode reaches 4.64mgNaCl/g, and the strong desalting capacity is shown. The novel carbon fiber electrode can be widely applied to the fields of brackish water and seawater desalination, water softening, heavy metal ion removal and the like.

title: Process for production of precursor fiber for preparing carbon fiber having high strength and high elastic modulus
abstract: The present invention provides a process for producing a precursor fiber which can provide a carbon fiber having high strength and high elastic modulus. The process of the present invention comprises a step where an aqueous solution of amphoteric molecule is prepared; a step where carbon nanotube is added to the aqueous solution of the amphoteric molecule so that the carbon nanotube is dispersed therein to prepare a dispersion of carbon nanotube; a step where the carbon nanotube dispersion is mixed with a polyacrylonitrile polymer and rhodanate or zinc chloride to prepare a spinning dope; a step where a coagulated yarn is prepared from the spinning dope by a wet or dry-wet spinning method; and a step where the coagulated yarn is drawn to give a precursor fiber for carbon fiber.

title: Method for preparing carbon fiber and precursor fiber for carbon fiber
abstract: The method for preparing a carbon fiber of the present invention comprises the following steps: preparing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer solution; spinning the spinning solution containing a polyacrylonitrile-based polymer to prepare a precursor fiber for a carbon fiber having a water content of 20-50 %; converting the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber into a pre-oxidation fiber while stretching the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber at a ratio of -10 to -0.1 % or 0.1 to 5 % at 180-220 ℃ in an air environment; converting the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber into an oxidation fiber while stretching the precursor fiber for a carbon fiber converted into the pre-oxidation fiber at an elongation of -5 to 5 % at 200-300 ℃ in an air environment; and heating the oxidation fiber under inert atmosphere to carbonize the same.

title: Method for manufacturing polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with enganced carbon nano-tube
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing  polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber with reinforced carbon nanometer tubes, which comprises the following steps: respectively dispersing and dissolving carbon nanometer tubes (CNT) and polyacrylonitrile (PAN) in dissolvent, obtaining PAN/CNT spinning solution through mixing the solution, obtaining PAN/CNT fiber through carrying out the wet-spinning method to the solution, then carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization to the wet-spinning fiber to prepare the carbon fiber with reinforced carbon nanometer tubes. The mechanical property of the carbon fiber which is prepared by the method of the invention is obviously improved, and the prepared carbon fiber can be applied to the fields of reinforcing materials, conducting, electrostatic resistance, heat conducting and the like.

title: Method of carbon nanotube for modifying polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber interface produced in China
abstract: The invention provides a method of a carbon nanotube for modifying a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber interface produced in China. The technology includes four parts: (1) surface treatment of thedomestic polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber: firstly treating and removing colloid on the surface of carbon fiber at the temperature of 600-800 DEG C and then using the mixed acid of nitric acid andsulfuric acid to remove the impurities on the surface of fiber; (2) preparation of domestic carbon fiber preform where the carbon nanotube grows in situ: firstly putting treated carbon fiber needle preform in the organic solution of catalyst precursor and then growing the carbon nanotube in situ in a chemical vapor deposition furnace; (3) densification of preform: adopting chemical vapor infiltration process to densify the preform and depositing the preform for 200-350h so that the density of the preform reaches 1.70-1.75g/cm<3>; and (4) high-temperature heat treatment: putting the material in a vacuum carbonization furnace, heating to the temperature of 2, 000-2, 300 DEG C at the heating rate of 30-50 DEG C/h under the protection of nitrogen, argon and other gases and preserving the heatfor 3-5h, and finally, the finished product is obtained.

title: Preparing process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparing process for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises a pre-oxidation step of pre-oxidizing the raw material polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibre protofilament for 20 to 40 min at 200 to 230 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 10 percent, and then pre-oxidizing for 20 to 10 min at 230 to 260 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 5 percent and pre-oxidizing for 10 to 20 min at 260 to 300 DEG C with the drafting times being -1 to 2 percent, and a carbonization step of carbonizing at 300 to 800 DEG C with the drafting times being 1 to 10 percent and then carbonizing at 1000 to 1400 DEG C with the drafting times being -5 to 0 percent in order to acquire the olyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The invention can prevent the fiber from being snapped when drafting, decrease the production of broken filament and improve the quality and the strength of carbon fiber.

title: Method for reducing production of preoxidized broken filament during preparation of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a method for reducing the production of preoxidized broken filament during the preparation of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, characterized in that: dipping: polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor is dipped with pure water until the water content in the precursor is 5-15wt%; or polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor is dipped with epoxy ethane modified silicone oil emulsion or ammonia modified silicone oil emulsion until the water content in the precursor is 5-15wt% and attached amount of oil is 0.5-1wt%; and shaping: the dipped precursor is subject to shaping. Owing to the effect of surface tension of the pure water, a fiber bundle dipped with the pure water is increased in convergence property, and the generated broken filaments are adhered to the fiber bundle; a layer of protective film is formed on the surface of fiber by using the fiber bundle dipped with the oil emulsion, thereby preventing inter-fiber adhesion and doubling and simultaneously avoiding the physical damage to fibers by furnace rollers; and the shaping treatment can effectively relieve the internal stress generated in the production process of the precursor, thereby avoiding fibers from tension fracture in the process of preoxidation.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor and a preparation method thereof. The polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fiber precursor of the invention can be used for preparing polyacrylonitrile-based hollow carbon fibers. An acrylonitrile binary copolymerization system containing itaconic acid or an acrylonitrile ternary polymerization system containing itaconic acid and methyl acrylate is adopted for spinning by a wet spinning process matched with a circular arc slit spinneret plate, and multiple filament bundles of the hollow carbon fiber precursor can be obtained, wherein the dimension of the outer diameter and the structure of the precursor meet the requirement of a conventional preoxidation carburizing process for precursor fibers, and the groove structure on the surface of the fiber is favorable for improving the interface performance of composite materials.

title: Method for modifying polyacrylonitrile by using gamma ray irradiation
abstract: The invention provides a method for modifying polyacrylonitrile (PAN) by using gamma ray irradiation. Being subjected to the gamma ray irradiation in air, inert atmosphere or a vacuum, the heat release of the cyclized PAN can be reduced in the process of heat treatment; and being subjected to the pretreatment of the gamma ray irradiation, the pre-oxidation rate of PAN fiber can be obviously increased. Undergoing the changes in performance, the invention can help control the sharp rise in the temperature of a sample and accelerate the oxidation in the process for PAN fiber or films to carry out high-temperature cyclization or oxidation crosslinking, particularly, the process of precursor pre-oxidation crosslinking for preparing PAN-based carbon fiber. Accordingly, the method of the invention is of potential application value to the reduction in production cost for PAN oxidation products, particularly, the reduction in production cost for PAN-based carbon fiber.

title: Method for modifying polyacrylonitrile by using electron beam irradiation
abstract: The invention provides a method for modifying polyacrylonitrile by using electron beam irradiation. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: by adjusting the irradiation dose rate of an electron accelcrator and controlling the total irradiation dose, the invention can achieve the purpose of modifying a polyacrylonitrile fiber sample, more particularly, being subjected to the electron beam irradiation, the invention can reduce the heat release of the cyclized polyacrylonitrile fiber in the process for heat treatment and obviously increase the pre-oxidation rate of the polyacrylonitrile fiber in air. Undergoing the changes in performance, the invention can accelerate the oxidation and greatly reduce the time for pre-oxidation in the process for the high-temperature cyclization or oxidation crosslinking of the polyacrylonitrile fiber, particularly, the process of precursor pre-oxidation crosslinking for preparing the polyacrylonitrile fiber. Accordingly, the method of the invention is of potential application value to the reduction in production cost for the polyacrylonitrile -based carbon fiber.

title: Method for producing carbon/carbone composite material for bearings
abstract: The invention discloses a method for producing carbon/carbone composite material for bearings. The method is used in the field of high-performance material production. The production method is as follows: preform can be any one of two structures, i.e. a carbon fiber felt or a three-dimensional carbon fiber braid, wherein the carbon fiber felt is made of pre-oxidized polyacrylonitrile fiber integrated felt which is carbonized under the vacuum condition and the temperature of 930 DEG C to 970 DEG C; and the preform is dense: a technique integrated with chemical vapor infiltration and liquid resin impregnation is adopted. The technological parameters of chemical vapor infiltration are as follows: propylene as precursor and pyrolysis temperature of 900 DEG C to 1000 DEG C. The technological parameters of liquid resin impregnation, curing and carbonization are as follows: furan resin as precursor, and impregnation pressure of 1MPa to 5MPa; curing temperature of 170 DEG C to 185 DEG C; vacuum carbonization, and temperature of 930 DEG C to 950 DEG C. The high-temperature treatment temperature is 2250 DEG C to 2600 DEG C. The final density of the carbon/carbone composite material can reach more than 1.8g/cm3.

title: Method for study on thermal stabilization process of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a method for study on a thermal stabilization process of a polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. During the thermal stabilization process, the color of the polyacrylonitrile precursor keeps changing with the deepening of the reaction degree, according to the Lambert-Beer law, the optical density of a material is in direct proportion with the material concentration, and then optical density parameters such as the photo-density OD of a single pixel, the mean optical density MOD and the optical density standard deviation ODSD which can quantify and evaluate the dark or light change of the physical color are introduced into the invention, and the process of the thermal stabilization reaction and the degree of a fiber skin-core structure can be studied by measuring the optical density parameters on the ultra thin section of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. Compared with the prior art, the method of the invention is simple and easy to achieve, reflects the actual thermal stabilization process of the fiber, can respectively characterize the reaction processes of the cortical layer and the core layer of the fiber, and has important guiding significance on preparing the uniform polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber.

title: Method for preparing C/C composite material
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing a C/C composite material, which is mainly used for preparation of the C/C composite material. The method mainly comprises the following steps of: rinsing a carbon fiber felt serving as a raw material by using purified water, drying the carbon fiber felt, then placing the carbon fiber felt into a vacuum generator, performing infiltration on the carbon fiber felt skeleton by using CH3ArCH2NH2 as a precursor in the vacuum generator, thermally treating the infiltrated carbon fiber felt at a high temperature, performing pyrolysis on the carbon fiber felt at the high temperature to form pyrolysis carbon infiltrating into the carbon fiber felt skeleton material and deposited on the surface of the carbon fiber, then soaking the carbon fiber felt into o/m-xylene series compound solution, and performing carbonization and graphitization treatment on the soaked material to obtain the C/C composite material. The tensile strength of the prepared C/C composite material is more than 150GPa, the density is 0.38 to 0.42g/m<3>, and the thermal expansion coefficient is less than 0.42*10<-6>K<-1>. The preparation method has the main advantages of mature technology and simple and convenient operation, and can prepare the high-quality C/C composite material.

title: Preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to a preoxidation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, which comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out differential thermal analysis on the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor from room temperature to 500 ℃ to obtain a DSC curve; 2) the following temperature points were determined from the DSC curve: initial temperature point T 0 First temperature point T 1 A second temperature point T 2 And a third temperature point T 3 (ii) a 3) From the initial temperature point T 0 To the first pre-oxidation temperature point T A Is subjected to gradient temperature rise pre-oxidation at a first pre-oxidation temperature point T A ＝T 1 -ΔT 1 Wherein: delta T 1 The temperature is 5-10 ℃; then the pre-oxidized filament is arranged at a second pre-oxidation temperature point T B Pre-oxidizing for 1-2 min; second pre-oxidation temperature point T B ＝T 3 -ΔT 2 Wherein: delta T 2 The value range is 100-200 ℃ and less than T 3 -T 2 . The invention solves the technical problem of low pre-oxidation degree of the existing pre-oxidation method, and improves the mechanical property of the carbon fiber.

title: Carbon fiber strand and process for producing the same
abstract: A carbon fiber strand which is produced by obtaining a solidified-yarn strand by spinning with a spinneret having 20,000-30,000 spinning holes, passing the strand through an interlacing nozzle having an air blowing pressure of 20-60 kPa to obtain precursor fibers, oxidizing them in heated air having a temperature of 200-280° C. to obtain oxidized fibers, subjecting these oxidized fibers to a first carbonization treatment in an inert-gas atmosphere at a temperature of 300-900° C. in which the fibers are firstly stretched in a stretch ratio of 1.03-1.06 and then secondarily stretched in a stretch ratio of 0.9-1.01, subsequently conducting a second carbonization treatment in an inert-gas atmosphere at 1,360-2,100° C., and then conducting a surface oxidization treatment in an aqueous solution of an inorganic acid salt in a quantity of electricity of 20-100 C per g of the carbon fibers. This carbon fiber strand has a strand tensile strength of 5,650 MPa or higher, strand tensile modulus of 300 GPa or higher, and strand width of 5.5 mm or larger. No strand crack is observed in an examination by a strand crack evaluation method.

title: Carbon Fibers Having Improved Strength and Modulus and an Associated Method and Apparatus for Preparing Same
abstract: The invention is directed to carbon fibers having high tensile strength and modulus of elasticity. The invention also provides a method and apparatus for making the carbon fibers. The method comprises advancing a precursor fiber through an oxidation oven wherein the fiber is subjected to controlled stretching in an oxidizing atmosphere in which tension loads are distributed amongst a plurality of passes through the oxidation oven, which permits higher cumulative stretches to be achieved. The method also includes subjecting the fiber to controlled stretching in two or more of the passes that is sufficient to cause the fiber to undergo one or more transitions in each of the two or more passes. The invention is also directed to an oxidation oven having a plurality of cooperating drive rolls in series that can be driven independently of each other so that the amount of stretch applied to the oven in each of the plurality of passes can be independently controlled.

title: Method for producing incombustible acrylic yarn and incombustible acrylic yarn manufactured by method
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing an incombustible acrylic yarn and the incombustible acrylic yarn manufactured by the method and also relates to a middle product in the process of producing the incombustible acrylic yarn, wherein the middle product is incombustible spinnable acrylic fibre, incombustible spinnable acrylic carbon fibre and incombustible carded sliver. The method for producing the incombustible acrylic yarn comprises the following steps: preoxidation: polyacrylonitrile protofilament is preoxidated in a phased heating mode; the temperature difference between the phases is between 1 and 5 DEG C; carbonization: the carbonization temperature is between 300 and 1,000 DEG C; the manufacture of the carded silver by a precutting method: the incombustible spinnable acrylic fibre or the incombustible spinnable acrylic carbon fibre is precut to form a plurality of precutting points so as to form the carded silver; and manufacturing the incombustible carded silver into the incombustible acrylic yarns.

title: Method for preparing nano carbon fibre by using polyacryl-nitrile (PAN)
abstract: The invention relates to a method used for preparing nano carbon fiber from (PAN, comprising the steps that: (1) polyacrylonitrile (PAN) and polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) are dried, the mixture of PAN and PMMA is melted together in cosolvent N, N- dimethyl acetamide (DMF) under a temperature of 50 to 60 DEG C; (2) the polymer mixture solution is used in wet spinning and the scattering size of PAN on PMMA is regulated and controlled by adjusting the drafting ratio so as to acquire a PAN/PMMA blend fiber, in which PMMA is in a continuous phase and PAN is in a discrete phase; (3) the bend fiber is pre-oxidized in the air as a nano carbon fiber precursor and then carbonized; pre-oxidization technique: when the temperature is 150 to 300 DEG C, the time is 4.5 to 6 hours, carbonization is carbonized with the protection of N2, heating up speed is 2 to 20 DEG C per minute, when the temperature is 500 to 1200 DEG C, the time is 40 to 90 minutes, and the nano carbon fiber with a diameter of 100 to 1000nm and a length-diameter of 50 to 100um is acquired. The technique of the method is simple and the fiber prepared through the method has even size and high purity, thereby being suitable for industrialized production.

title: Preparation method of polymer for polyacrylonitrile base carbon fiber precursors
abstract: A method for preparing polymer for PAN precursor, by copolymerizing the water phase suspend using ammonium persulphate-ammonium sulfite or ammonium bisulfite as a primosome, is disclosed. The polyacrylonitrile powder material is obtained by adding the first monomer acrylonitrile, the second monomer crylic acid, methyl acrylate or acrylamide, and the third itaconic acid, or the first monomer crylic acid, the second monomer methyl acrylate or itaconic acid, and inorganic oxidation-reduction primosome without any metallic ion which comprises ammonium persulphate, ammonium sulfite or ammonium bisulfite and acidified deionized water into the polymerization kettle in defined proportions, controlling the temperature and stirring to react for a time, and discharging by removing the residual monomer, washing and drying. The average molecular weight is from 17.5 myriads to 26.1 myriads, and the distribution index of molecular weight is from 2.70 to 2.91; the intension of polyacrylonitrile precursor tested by spinning sample is from 4.58 to 6.61 CN/dtex; and the carbon fiber strength is 3.61-5.06MPa.

title: Antistatic carbon fiber and preparation thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an antistatic carbon fiber which is made by polyacrylonitrile fiber; wherein, carbon content is more than 68 percent measured by weight percentage, the resistivity of the carbon fiber is between 1 multiplied by 10<8> and 1.5 multiplied 10<-3>Omega cm, and the diameter is 5 to 10um. The polyacrylonitrile fiber can be made into the antistatic carbon fiber with different resistivity after pre-oxidation and carbonization. title: Manufacturing method of nano sized activated carbon fiber comprising metal oxide and electrode for super capacitor using the same nano sized activated carbon fiber manufactured thereby
abstract: A manufacturing method of a nano sized activated carbon fiber comprising the metal oxide and an electrode for a super-capacitor by using the same nano sized activated carbon fiber manufactured thereby are provided to make the spinning compound by adding metal oxide powder into a high polymer solution, to spin the spinning compound as a nano fiber and to perform the stabilization, carbonization of activation of the nano fiber. An organic high polymer material of 7.5 to 15 wt% selected from a group consisting of PAN(Polyacrylonitrile), PMMA(Polymethylmethacrylate), PEO(Polyethylene oxide), Polyvinyl difluoride and polypyrrole is melted into the solution of 85 to 92.5 wt% selected from a group consisting of DMF(Dimethylformamide), THF(Tetrahydrofuran), GBL(gamma-butyroractone), N-methyl pyrrolidone, toluene, acetone, DMAc(Dimethyl acetamide) or two or more mixtures of these so that a high polymer solution is obtained. A metal oxide of 8 to 20 wt% selected from a group consisting of MnO2, RuO2, TiO2, IrO2, TaO2 is dispersed into the high polymer solution so that the spinning solution is obtained. The spinning solution is spun so that a nano fiber is obtained. The nano fiber is heated and carbonized at the temperature of 700 to 900 degrees in centigrade for 30 to 90 minutes under the atmosphere of nitrogen so that the carbon nano fiber is obtained. The vapour is supplied to the carbon nano fiber and heated at the temperature of 700 to 900 degrees in centigrade for 50 to 70 minutes so that the activated carbon nano fiber is obtained.
assignee: 한국생산기술연구원

title: Preparation method of two-phase carbon nanofibers and activated carbon nanofibers by electrospinning from polyacrylonitrile/pitch blend solutions
abstract: A method for manufacturing two-component carbon nanofibers and activated carbon nanofibers is provided to increase specific surface areas of the carbon nanofibers and improve electrical conductivity of the carbon nanofibers, and usefully apply the carbon nanofibers to electrode materials, adsorbing materials, and carbon fiber fillers for composite materials. A spinning solution is prepared by dissolving PAN(polyacrylonitrile) and pitch, as carbon fiber precursors, into an organic solvent solution selected from THF(tetrahydrofuran), DMF(dimethylformamide), DMAc(dimethylacetamide), pyridine, and quinoline. A high voltage is applied to the spinning solution to produce organic nanofibers having radii of 0.1-0.9um through electrospinning. The organic nanofibers are oxidation-stabilized to produce flameproof fibers using air. The flameproof fibers are carbonized, activated, or graphitized to produce carbon nanofibers, activated carbon nanofibers, or graphite carbon nanofibers.
assignee: 주식회사 나노테크닉스
inventors: KIM, CHAN; KIM, YOUNG MIN

title: Preparation method of diffusion layer of fuel cell
abstract: Provided is a method for forming a diffusion layer for a fuel cell, wherein the diffusion layer has excellent mechanical and electrical properties and uniform pores, supplies fuel and air smoothly, is capable of controlling even moisture, and reduces the volume of a total system. The method for forming a diffusion layer for a fuel cell comprises the steps of: using, as a carbon fiber precursor, at least one selected from polyacrylonitrile(PAN), phenol, and pitch, a mixture thereof, or a compound with a nano-size material to prepare a spinning solution; applying high voltage to the spinning solution to perform electrospinning; subjecting the electrospun material to oxidation stabilization under an air atmosphere; carbonizing the elecrospun material at 500-1500°C to obtain nanocomposite carbon fiber and subjecting the nanocomposite carbon fiber to water repelling treatment; and using the obtained nanocomposite carbon fiber as a gas diffusion layer of a fuel cell.

title: Polyacrylonitrile precursor fluidized pre-oxidation furnace
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel fluidized preoxidation furnace for polyacrylonitrile raw yarn, which is composed of a wind distribution chamber, a fluidizing bed, an electric heating system, a pressurized air sealing cabin, a cyclone separator, a speed-regulation driving system, etc. Spherical particle active carbon, silica gel and an Al2O3 fluidizing medium are used for carrying out heat and mass transfer reaction, and the preoxidization treatment effect of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber is enhanced. The present invention has the advantages of high temperature rising speed, good temperature stability, high preoxidization speed, short preoxidization time, etc.
assignee: 山东大学
inventors: BO,WANG ZHU

title: Polyacrylonitrile-radical hollow carbon-fiber film and preparing method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a hollow carbon fiberous film with polyacrylonitrile radicals, and a technique of the preparation method thereof. The present invention is characterized in that the film comprises the following formulation by weight percentages: 70 to 80% of polyacrylonitrile, 5 to 15% of methyl methacrylate and 5 to 15% of polyvinylpyrrolidone. The preparation method for the film orderly comprises film casing solution preparing technology, fiber spinning technology, stretching technology, post treatment technology, preoxidation technology and carbonization technology. The present invention is characterized in that the temperature in the preoxidation technology is from 240 to 300 DEG C; the temperature rising rate is from 2 to 8 DEG C / minute; the temperature preservation time is from 0.5 to 2 hours. Then the temperature is continuously raised, and the carbonization technology is carried out. The carbonization temperature is from 750 to 1000 DEG C; the temperature rising rate is from 8 to 15 DEG C / minute; the temperature preservation time is from 1 to 3 hours. The interception molecular quality of the film of the present invention is from 50 to 150 thousand; the degree of porosity is from 55 to 65%; the water flux is from 150 to 200 l/m<2>h. The film belongs to a typical liquid phase separation film.

title: New technology and device for pdyacrylonitril fiber preoxidation and carbonation
abstract: The present invention provides a new technology for preoxidizing and carbonizing polyacrylonitrile fibers, and a high-frequency negative-pressure plasma heating device for the technology. The device comprises a high-frequency power supply, a parallel-plate electrode, a matched flat quartz glass reaction chamber and an auxiliary device which enables the reaction chamber to form negative pressure and atmosphere with suitable nitrogen and oxygen ratio. Under the functions of the negative-pressure environment and a high-frequency electric field, plasma formed in the reaction chamber makes the temperature of the preoxidization and carbonization technology greatly decrease, the carbonization temperature is similar to or even lower than the fusion points of a plurality of organic substances in the polyacrylonitrile, and thus, the preoxidization working procedure and the carbonization working procedure are carried out in a heating device once; the energy consumption is greatly reduced, the quality is enhanced, and the cost is reduced. The new technology is a significant improvement for the technology which utilizes the polyacrylonitrile to serve as raw material to prepare carbon fibers.

title: Polyacrylonitrile precursor fluidized pre-oxidation furnace
abstract: Disclosed a new polyacrylonitrile protofilament fluidization oxygen-preparing batch. It is made up of a wind-setting room, a fluidization bed, a electric heating system, a compression atmoseal room, a cyclone separator and a govern roll system. It mainly uses spherical particle absorbent charcoal, silica gel and Al2O3 fluidization mediator to do heat-conduction and substance-conducing reactions. So it can improve the oxygen-preparing effect of polyacrylonitrile group carbon fiber. This invention increase temperature quickly, and the temperature's stability is good. Also, the oxygen-preparing' speed is fast, taking a short time to finish.

title: Wave absorbing composite nano-fiber material textile composition and its preparation process
abstract: The invention relates to a composite fiber material, and the combination contains polyacrylonitrile carbon 80-96, nano silicon carbide 4-20%; nickel powder is 6-20% of the fiber in weight, assistant 5-8%. The steps: making ultrasonic wave vibration, mixing and extrusion on silicon carbide, polyacrylonitrile carbon and assistant to produce compound particles; making copolymerization and commixture on copolymerizable monomer to make polyacrylonitrile carbon wave absorbing fiber; spinning silicon carbide/nickel fiber; making preoxidation, carbonization, graphitization, surface nickel processing and weaving on the spinning to obtain the finished product. It has wide screened wave bands, and high electromagnetic wave absorbing rate, has no secondary pollution. It shortens working procedure, reduces cost, and has the characters of high strength, high modulus, low expansion coefficient, etc.

title: Method for producing carbon fiber
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for producing a multifilament carbon fiber having high quality, productivity of the facility and cost competitiveness and producible at a low cost. SOLUTION: The method for the production of a carbon fiber comprises the flame-resisting treatment and precarbonization treatment of a polyacrylonitrile-based precursor fiber bundle, the alignment of the treated fiber bundle on a roller in a state closely contacting the fibers with each other and setting the average fineness of the bundle per 1 mm width on the roller to fall within a specific range and the carbonization treatment of the aligned fibers.

title: Acrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber and method for production thereof
abstract: This invention relates to an acrylonitrile-based precursor fiber for carbon fiber which is prepared from an acrylonitrile-based copolymer containing 96.0 to 98.5% by weight of acrylonitrile units, and which is characterized by a tensile strength of not less than 7.0 cN/dtex, an elastic modulus in tension of not less than 130 cN/dtex, an iodine adsorption of not greater than 0.5% by weight based on the weight of the fiber, a degree of crystal orientation (pi) of not less than 90% as determined by wide-angle X-ray analysis, and a degree of variation in tow fineness of not greater than 1.0%. This precursor fiber has a high strength, a high elastic modulus, a high degree of denseness, a high degree of orientation, and a low degree of variation in tow fineness, and can hence be used to form a high-quality carbon fiber inexpensively by oxidation for a shorter period of time.

title: Densification regulation and control method for high-strength medium-mode carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a densification regulation and control method for high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers, belongs to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber spinning, and solves at least one of the problems of insufficient densification, multiple hole defects, large performance fluctuation and the like of high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers (especially precursor fibers) in the prior art. The invention discloses a densification regulation and control method for high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers, which comprises the steps of solidifying and stretching an acrylonitrile-based polymer spinning solution to obtain primary fibers, adopting a multistage washing process with gradual heating, applying 1.01-1.10 times of draft to each stage of washing, and carrying out hot water draft (multistage) on the washed fibers, wherein the draft multiple and the hot water temperature of each subsection are gradually increased. The regulating and controlling method has the advantages that through technological process design and parameter optimization, the sulfine residue in the precursor fiber is lower, the orientation degree is higher, the densification is better, the orientation degree of the precursor fiber prepared by the regulating and controlling method is more than or equal to 91.5%, the strength of the precursor fiber is more than or equal to 6.8cN/dtex, the elastic modulus of the prepared carbon fiber is 320-340 GPa, and the drafting strength is more than 6000MPa.
assignee: 威海拓展纤维有限公司

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, which comprises the steps of adding a modifier accounting for 2.5% -8.0% of the total mass of a copolymer into a copolymer spinning solution formed by acrylonitrile and carboxyl-containing monomers, uniformly mixing, and then spinning, post-treating, pre-oxidizing and carbonizing to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber. The test result shows that the modifier (guanidine compound or salt thereof) is uniformly distributed in the fiber body, and the modifier and carboxyl are used for synergistic catalysis, pre-oxidation and cyclization reaction, so that the cyclization initial temperature is reduced by 8-15 ℃, the heat release enthalpy is improved by 15-35%, and the problem of a skin-core structure caused by traditional impregnation modification is effectively avoided. The invention can finally raise the carbon yield to more than 52%, and the obtained carbon fiber monofilament has tensile strength not lower than 4.6GPa and good performance uniformity.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维连云港有限公司

title: Low-cost T800-grade carbon fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a low-cost T800-grade carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of polymerizing an acrylonitrile monomer, a comonomer, an initiator and a composite additive in a sodium thiocyanate aqueous solution to obtain a spinning solution, carrying out dry-jet wet spinning on the spinning solution to obtain primary fibers, and carrying out water washing drawing, drying densification, multistage steaming drawing, pre-oxidation, carbonization and surface treatment on the primary fibers to obtain the low-cost T800-grade carbon fibers. According to the invention, the carbon nano tube and the graphene composite additive are added, so that the pre-oxidation initial temperature is reduced, the energy consumption is reduced, and the production cost and the energy consumption are reduced through the waste heat recovery system and the process parameter optimization. The tensile strength of the prepared carbon fiber is more than or equal to 5.8GPa, the tensile modulus is more than or equal to 295GPa, the performance stability is high (CV value is less than 4%), the cost is reduced by 30% compared with the traditional T800-grade carbon fiber, and the carbon fiber is suitable for the fields of aerospace, wind power generation and the like.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维股份有限公司

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile precursor with high density and mechanical strength
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile precursor with high density and mechanical strength. The method adopts a precise multiphase solidification path of horizontal spinning combined with horizontal extrusion-gas phase transition-liquid phase final solidification, so that the primary fiber sequentially undergoes twice 90-degree turning, and then undergoes multistage drafting, water washing, oiling, primary drying densification, secondary deep drafting densification and steam heat setting on a hot roller to prepare the polyacrylonitrile precursor. The precursor wire prepared by the method has a regular circular section and high compactness, has no cracks, the breaking strength is more than or equal to 7.0 cN/dtex, and the tensile strength of the carbon fiber prepared by the precursor wire is more than or equal to 4.95 GPa. The method has strong process controllability and is suitable for industrial production of high-performance carbon fiber precursors.
assignee: 中复神鹰碳纤维连云港有限公司

title: Preparation device and method of low-static polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation method of low-static polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor. According to the invention, the drying equipment, the static eliminator and the ultrasonic oiling device are sequentially integrated, the PAN wet yarn is firstly dried to have the moisture content of 0.8% -1.5%, then the primary electricity elimination is carried out through the static eliminator with the moisture content of 200W-400W, and finally the ultrasonic oiling device is used for applying the antistatic oiling agent, so that the surface static of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor is reduced. The invention realizes the obvious reduction of the surface resistance of the precursor wire through the synergistic effect of physical electricity elimination, chemical neutralization and nanoscale uniform oiling, obviously reduces the broken wire and the broken wire rate in the production process, effectively reduces the defects in the fiber and improves the tensile strength of the final carbon fiber by about 15 percent.

title: Precursor fibers of lignin-based carbon fibers, their production and use
abstract: Described are precursor fibers of lignin-based carbon fibers with a content of water-soluble lignin salt (A). A special characteristic of these precursor fibers is the inclusion of water-soluble polyvinylpyrrolidone or a derivative (B) thereof. Further described is an advantageous process for producing these precursor fibers as well as their advantageous use for producing carbon fibers by carbonization, optionally followed by graphitization.

inventors: FRANK, ERIK; KREIS, PHILIPP; BUCHMEISER, MICHAEL R.

title: Mechanical property detection method for polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor and pre-oxidized fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical property detection method of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursors and pre-oxidized fibers, which comprises the steps of setting detection parameters according to the characteristics of the to-be-detected fibers, establishing a tensile test method of the to-be-detected fibers, adjusting the distance between two clamps on the mechanical property tester, adjusting the load and displacement of the mechanical property tester to zero, clamping a sample on the two clamps, then enabling the mechanical property tester to enter a tensile test process until the sample breaks, repeatedly stretching a plurality of samples for each to-be-detected fiber according to the steps, removing invalid samples, retaining valid samples, and taking an average value as a detection result. The invention is used for providing the method for detecting the mechanical properties of the carbon fiber precursor and the pre-oxidized fiber, which is simple and quick to operate, accurate in result and small in discrete, so as to meet the requirement of rapidly providing mechanical property detection data in the precursor and carbon fiber production process.
assignee: 山西钢科碳材料有限公司

title: High-compression-strength carbon fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a high-strength medium-modulus carbon fiber with high compressive strength and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a precursor through wet spinning, pre-oxidizing, carbonizing at a low temperature, carbonizing at a medium temperature under the protection of high-purity nitrogen containing CH  4  gas at the temperature of 1000-1200 ℃, carbonizing at a high temperature with the gradient temperature of 1300-1800 ℃ to obtain the high-compression-strength high-strength medium-film carbon fiber with the tensile strength of 5.5-6.0 GPa, the tensile modulus of 280-300 GPa, the average diameter of 5.5-7.5 mu m, the carbon fiber bundle silk compression strength of 1.5 GPa-2.3 GPa, the cross section of the medium-film carbon fiber is round or nearly round, and the cross section sheath-core ratio of the medium-film carbon fiber is 1.11< f less than or equal to 1.30. The carbon fiber with large diameter size prepared by the invention has a perfect leather microcrystalline structure, large difference in the graphitization degree of the leather core, high graphitization degree of the leather and large microcrystalline size, and improves the compression performance of the carbon fiber monofilament and the compression strength of the corresponding composite material on the basis of ensuring the high-strength middle modulus mechanical property.
assignee: 北京化工大学

title: Three-dimensional carbon fiber reinforced resin matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a three-dimensional carbon fiber reinforced resin matrix composite material, which comprises the steps of taking mesophase pitch carbon fiber carbon cloth as an XY-direction reinforcement, taking polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber as a Z-direction reinforcement fiber to prepare a three-dimensional carbon fiber fabric reinforcement, sequentially carrying out graphitization, electrochemistry and surface sizing treatment on the three-dimensional carbon fiber fabric reinforcement, dispersing inorganic nano heat conducting particles in organic resin to obtain a matrix resin system, placing the three-dimensional carbon fiber fabric reinforcement in a mould, and injecting the matrix resin system by adopting an RTM process to obtain the composite material. The composite material disclosed by the invention has the room-temperature XY-direction heat conductivity of 208-258W/(m.K) and the Z-direction heat conductivity of 5-54W/(m.K), has excellent mechanical properties, can be used for preparing the structure/functional parts of an aerospace aircraft, and can also meet the requirements of other industrial equipment fields on the light-weight high-strength high-modulus high-heat conductivity composite material.

title: Thermal oxidation stabilization reaction control method for large-tow polyacrylonitrile fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a regulating and controlling method for thermal oxidation stabilization reaction of large-tow Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) fibers, which is characterized in that in the process of thermal oxidation stabilization (thermal reaction) of N (N is 3,4, 5 and 6) temperature areas, the enthalpy values of the initial state and the termination state of the thermal oxidation stabilization reaction of the large-tow PAN fibers and the enthalpy value of the fibers after the thermal oxidation stabilization of the various temperature areas are respectively measured by a Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC), and the enthalpy value of fiber samples after the end of each temperature area is regulated and controlled so that the difference of the enthalpy of the fiber samples in the heat and the enthalpy of the samples in the previous state is equal to one N of the difference of the enthalpy of the initial state and the enthalpy of the fiber samples in the termination state, the difference of the enthalpy difference is controlled within +/-10 percent, and the thermal oxidation stabilization reaction degree of each temperature area is regulated and controlled by using an equal difference enthalpy value method. The thermal reaction of the large-tow PAN fiber controlled by the method has uniform heat release, less redundant reaction and thermal reaction time less than or equal to 60min, and the tensile strength of the finally prepared large-tow carbon fiber is more than or equal to 4.2GPa and the coefficient of variation of the tensile strength is less than or equal to 5%.

title: Preparation method of polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, and ultra-high molecular weight polyacrylonitrile precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fibers, and provides a preparation method of a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, an ultrahigh molecular weight polyacrylonitrile precursor and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the vacuum defoaming homogenizer is used for dissolving and defoaming the polyacrylonitrile powder, so that the process of preparing the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution can be effectively simplified and shortened, and the preparation efficiency is improved. The invention prepares spinning solution by taking the ultra-high molecular weight polyacrylonitrile powder as a raw material, and then prepares the ultra-high molecular weight polyacrylonitrile precursor through the steps of spinning, first coagulation drafting, second coagulation drafting, washing drafting, oiling, drying, steam drafting and the like, and the obtained ultra-high molecular weight polyacrylonitrile precursor has high tensile strength and excellent performance.

title: Preparation method of high-temperature-resistant polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and application of high-temperature-resistant polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in fireproof fabric
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of high-temperature-resistant polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber and application of the high-temperature-resistant polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber in fireproof fabric. The method comprises the steps of adding 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid to improve limiting oxygen index of pre-oxidized fibers, enhancing fireproof performance, dipping perfluorinated laurinol polyoxyethylene ether, spraying carbon powder, reducing coalescence rate of the pre-oxidized fibers, spraying basic aluminum chloride, improving crimp number of the pre-oxidized fibers, improving flexibility, adding hydrogen bromide to oxygen to improve oxidation rate and limiting oxygen index, performing pre-oxidation reaction in a radiation heating mode, inhibiting formation of skin-core structure, removing tarry impurities deposited on the surfaces of the pre-oxidized fibers through ultrasonic wave effect, improving quality of the carbon fibers, treating the pre-oxidized fibers through sodium beta-anthraquinone sulfonate, removing oxygen absorbed by the pre-oxidized fibers, and improving tensile strength of the carbon fibers, so that high-temperature-resistant and high-strength carbon fibers are prepared, and are applied to fireproof fabrics.

title: Production process of bio-based high-modulus carbon fiber and prepared bio-based high-modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a production process of a bio-based high-modulus carbon fiber, which is characterized by comprising the steps of (1) carrying out heat treatment on a cellulose multifilament precursor in a stabilizing furnace, (2) carrying out subsequent heat treatment in a low-temperature carbonization furnace, (3) carrying out subsequent heat treatment in a high-temperature carbonization furnace, wherein the heat treatment in the high-temperature carbonization furnace is carried out at a temperature of 2000 ℃ at most, stretching of multifilament is carried out by more than 30%, and the fiber is not subjected to an ultrahigh-temperature treatment step after the heat treatment in the high-temperature carbonization furnace. The method improves the orientation degree of sp  2  hybridized carbon domain by stretching the fiber with the maximum applicable amount in the high-temperature carbonization furnace, improves the tensile modulus of the bio-based carbon fiber taking the cellulose fiber as a precursor, does not carry out ultrahigh-temperature treatment on the fiber, greatly reduces energy consumption and saves production cost.

title: Polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation method and application thereof, and preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-modulus carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation method and application thereof, and a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-modulus carbon fiber, wherein the polyacrylonitrile pre-oxidation method comprises the following steps: and (3) pre-oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile sequentially by adopting at least three temperature areas under the air atmosphere, wherein the temperature of the first temperature area is controlled to be 180-230 ℃, the temperature of the second temperature area is controlled to be 210-260 ℃ and the temperature of the third temperature area is controlled to be 250-300 ℃ according to the pre-treatment sequence. The method takes the fiber cyclization degree in the pre-oxidation stage as a structural control index, and prepares the pre-oxidized fiber with perfect structure through the regulation and control design of key parameters such as the pre-oxidation temperature, the draft multiplying power, the residence time and the like, thereby preparing the high-model carbon fiber.

abstract: The invention relates to a densification regulation and control method for high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers, belongs to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber spinning, and solves at least one of the problems of insufficient densification, multiple hole defects, large performance fluctuation and the like of high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers (especially precursor fibers) in the prior art. The invention discloses a densification regulation and control method for high-strength medium-mode carbon fibers, which comprises the steps of solidifying and stretching an acrylonitrile-based polymer spinning solution to obtain primary fibers, adopting a multistage washing process with gradual heating, applying 1.01-1.10 times of draft to each stage of washing, and carrying out hot water draft (multistage) on the washed fibers, wherein the draft multiple and the hot water temperature of each subsection are gradually increased. The regulating and controlling method has the advantages that through technological process design and parameter optimization, the sulfine residue in the precursor fiber is lower, the orientation degree is higher, the densification is better, the orientation degree of the precursor fiber prepared by the regulating and controlling method is more than or equal to 91.5%, the strength of the precursor fiber is more than or equal to 6.8cN/dtex, the elastic modulus of the prepared carbon fiber is 320-340 GPa, and the drafting strength is more than 6000MPa.

title: Dry densification polyacrylonitrile fiber and dry densification method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a dry densification polyacrylonitrile fiber, a dry densification method and application thereof, and solves the problems that in the prior art, the polyacrylonitrile fiber is easy to wind due to static electricity in the cooling process after dry densification, and the carbon fiber strength is poor when the polyacrylonitrile fiber is applied to the carbon fiber. The surface voltage and the temperature of the dry densified polyacrylonitrile fiber meet the formula (1) that S=aT+b and the formula (1), wherein a=6-70, b= -500-5660, and T=50-90 ℃. By adopting the scheme of the invention, the winding frequency caused by static electricity in the preparation process of the precursor is below 10 times/month, and when the dried and densified fiber is applied to the carbon fiber, the tensile strength of the carbon fiber can reach 6.20GPa, so that a better technical effect is obtained.

title: Preparation method of high-strength high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based precursor, and polyacrylonitrile-based precursor and application
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-strength high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based precursor, and a polyacrylonitrile-based precursor and application. The preparation method of the high-strength high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based precursor comprises the step of steam drafting, wherein the relation between the steam drafting inlet speed and the tension of the steam drafting outlet precursor satisfies the following relation formula of 0.0024x+0.2975 < y < minus 1.9X  ‑5 x 2  +0.0043x+0.3487, wherein y represents the tension of single fiber at the steam drafting outlet, the unit is cN, and x represents the steam drafting inlet speed, and the unit is m/min. The method of the invention solves the problems of excessive broken filaments and poor mechanical properties of carbon fibers generated in the process of preparing the carbon fibers by using polyacrylonitrile-based precursor under the existing conditions, and can be well used in the industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile fibers for the high-strength high-modulus carbon fibers.

title: Preparation method of high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, and discloses a preparation method of a high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor. The preparation method solves the problem that the polyacrylonitrile powder is not completely dissolved when the raw solution is prepared by dissolution, improves the solid content and stability of the spinning raw solution, prepares the bubble-free and gel-free spinning raw solution, further improves the quality of the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber precursor, and realizes the industrialized production of the high-modulus polyacrylonitrile precursor.

title: High-strength high-modulus precursor for polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a precursor for high-strength and high-modulus polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof, and mainly solves the problems of more pre-oxidized filaments and low strength, modulus and elongation of the carbon fiber in the prior art. The invention adopts wet spinning, and comprises the step of drying and densifying the polyacrylonitrile nascent fiber obtained by the wet spinning, wherein the drying and densification at least comprises 8 hot rolls, the light transmittance ratio of the tow between any two hot rolls to the previous adjacent tow is 0.9-2.0, and the technical scheme well solves the problem and can be used in the industrial production of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursors.

title: Preparation method and application of high-strength high-modulus high-elongation precursor for polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a precursor for high-strength high-modulus high-elongation polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber, and mainly solves the problems of more steam drafting filaments, easy filament breakage, low mechanical property of carbon fiber and high CV value in the prior art. The invention adopts wet spinning, which comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out wet solidification molding, solidification drafting, hot water drafting, water washing, oiling, drying densification, steam drafting and steam heat setting on polyacrylonitrile stock solution, wherein the drying densification adopts hot roller drying, the numerical values of the surface potential E and the tension F of tows between two adjacent hot rollers meet the value of |E  X+1 /E X -F X+1 /F X |≤10×M X+1 /M X , and M is the length of the tows between the two adjacent hot rollers, which are not contacted with the hot rollers. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problems existing in the prior art well, and can be used in the industrial production of polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursors.

title: High-modulus carbon fiber, preparation method thereof and composite material
abstract: The application relates to a high-modulus carbon fiber, a preparation method thereof and a composite material, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out anodic oxidation treatment on graphitized fibers obtained after carbonization treatment to obtain surface modified fibers carrying electrolyte, wherein the electric quantity of the surface treatment of the anodic oxidation treatment is more than or equal to 50C/g, carrying out vibration treatment on the surface modified fibers to remove at least part of the electrolyte, and washing the surface modified fibers subjected to vibration treatment to obtain the high-modulus carbon fibers, wherein the tensile modulus of the high-modulus carbon fibers is more than or equal to 350GPa. In the process of preparing the high-modulus carbon fiber, the vibration treatment is added after the anodic oxidation treatment, so that the electrolyte residue can be effectively reduced, the interface performance of the high-modulus carbon fiber is improved, and the mechanical strength of the composite material is further improved.

title: Method for producing carbon fiber bundle
abstract:

         (b) an oil agent application step of applying a silicone oil agent to a precursor fiber bundle to produce an oil-agent-attached precursor fiber bundle;   (d) a stabilization step of subjecting the oil-agent-attached precursor fiber bundle to an oxidization treatment to produce an oxidized fiber bundle; and   (e) a carbonization step of carbonizing the oxidized fiber bundle, wherein   the silicone oil agent has a skin over time at 250° C. of less than 40 minutes.

title: Polymer for polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber, preparation method and polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a polymer for polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber, a preparation method thereof and the polyacrylonitrile-based large-tow carbon fiber. The polymer comprises an acrylonitrile structural unit, a second comonomer structural unit, a third comonomer structural unit, and a fourth comonomer structural unit, wherein the acrylonitrile structural unit is derived from acrylonitrile, the second comonomer structural unit is derived from a second comonomer, the third comonomer structural unit is derived from a third comonomer, and the fourth comonomer structural unit is derived from a fourth comonomer. According to the invention, the fourth comonomer is introduced, the cohesive energy of the molecular weight of the polyacrylonitrile copolymer is reduced by utilizing the volume effect of the side group, the spinnability is improved, and a molecular-level oxygen permeation channel is potentially reserved in the resin presentation process, so that the pre-oxidation double diffusion reaction is promoted. The strength and the modulus of the large-tow carbon fiber obtained by the invention are improved.

title: T700-level wet-process large-tow carbon fiber as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application discloses a T700-level wet-process large-tow carbon fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding a chain transfer agent in the polymerization process, so that the generation of macromolecular chains in the reaction process is effectively reduced, and the processability of the stock solution is further improved. Meanwhile, performance indexes of products (such as spinning dope, precursor and carbon fiber) at each stage are limited, so that uniformity of the products is better, and meanwhile, the rotational viscosity of the spinning dope is reduced, so that the pressure of a wet spinning spinneret plate can be effectively reduced, and the spinning speed and the production efficiency are effectively improved in the spinning process. In addition, the application limits the hole number and the aperture of the spinneret plate, can obtain the T700 grade 50K big tow carbon fiber with the strength more than or equal to 4900MPa, the modulus more than or equal to 255GPa and the linear density more than or equal to 2800g/km, and fills the blank of the domestic 50K big tow product.

title: High-strength high-modulus high-toughness polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a high-strength high-modulus high-toughness polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, and a preparation method and application thereof, and mainly solves the problems of more precursor filaments after steam drafting and low strength, modulus and elongation of carbon fibers in the prior art. According to the method for manufacturing the high-strength high-modulus high-toughness polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor, wet spinning is adopted, and the fiber after drying densification is subjected to steam drafting test under the conditions of steam pressure of 0.3MPa and drafting multiple of 2.5 times, so that the technical scheme that the tension born by each fiber is 0.5-1.5 cN is adopted, the problems in the prior art are well solved, and the method can be used in industrial production of the polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber precursor.

title: Carbon fibers having improved strength and modulus and related methods and apparatus for making same
abstract: The present invention relates to carbon fibers having high tensile strength. The invention also provides a method and an apparatus for manufacturing the carbon fiber. The method includes advancing the precursor fiber through an oxidation oven via multiple passes, wherein stretching during an initial pass is minimized or completely eliminated or becomes negative, followed by controlled stretching in a series of passes using rollers of increasing speed.

title: Low-cost PAN-based carbon fiber precursor for internal and external co-plasticization melt spinning and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a low-cost PAN-based carbon fiber precursor for internal and external synergistic plasticization melt spinning and a preparation method thereof, wherein the melt-spun PAN fiber is prepared by the synergistic internal and external plasticization method, a proper amount of novel comonomer AMPS and AN are added for polymerization to prepare a P (AN-co-AMPS) copolymer as a melt spinning raw material, the molecular acting force between PANs is reduced from the angle of the internal plasticization method, and the pre-oxidation of the PAN precursor in the later stage is facilitated; the addition amount of the external plasticizer (ethylene carbonate, EC) is reduced from the viewpoint of the external plasticizing process, and the defects of the structure of the precursor caused during the plasticizer removal process are reduced. In addition, the invention uses a small amount of solvent, is environment-friendly, has high spinning efficiency and low manufacturing cost, is beneficial to promoting the large-scale application of carbon fiber in the civil field, and is a PAN precursor preparation method with wide development prospect. The low-cost PAN-based carbon fiber precursor prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention is tested: the fiber diameter is about 100 μm, the tensile strength is 108.8MPa, the tensile modulus is 3267.3MPa, and the elongation at break is 43.4%.

title: Polyacrylonitrile spinning solution and preparation method thereof, and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a polyacrylonitrile spinning solution, a preparation method thereof and polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, and relates to the technical field of carbon fibers. The technical scheme mainly adopted is as follows: a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile spinning solution comprises the following steps: oxidizing the polyacrylonitrile polymer solution subjected to the monomer removal treatment to obtain an oxidized polyacrylonitrile polymer solution; and (3) defoaming the polyacrylonitrile polymer solution after the oxidation treatment to obtain the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution. The preparation method is mainly used for preparing the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution containing the oxidized structure in the molecular chain of the polyacrylonitrile polymer. When the polyacrylonitrile spinning solution is used for preparing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, the pre-oxidation degree is improved, the mechanical property of the carbon fiber is improved, the high-strength high-modulus carbon fiber is prepared, and the pre-oxidation time is shortened, so that the energy consumption and the production cost are reduced.

title: Polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, graphitized carbon fiber, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, graphitized carbon fiber, and a preparation method and application thereof. When the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber is prepared, a carbonization pretreatment step is added between low-temperature carbonization treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment; and graphitizing the polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber to obtain the graphitized carbon fiber. The mechanical properties of the polyacrylonitrile-based graphitized carbon fiber are greatly improved. The invention also provides a parameter model of the carbon fiber structure nitrogen-carbon ratio R, which can reasonably quantify the internal structure of the carbon fiber, and can be well applied to the preparation work of the high-modulus polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber by utilizing the parameter, thereby guiding the production and preparation work for the central control index in the preparation process of the high-performance carbon fiber.
